title: torchtest2: One-Call Sanity Checks for PyTorch Models,Evaluated on Real and Unseen Architectures
summary: Many bugs in deep learning code are silent: a layer that is never called, an optimizer created before the classification head was replaced, a recurrent layer that treats the batch as time, or an ignored attention mask. The code runs, the loss decreases somewhat, and the defect surfaces, if ever, after days of GPU time. We present torchtest2, an open-source library that runs 18 sanity checks on a single batch with one call, restores the PyTorch state it touches, and adapts to model families through plugins. We evaluate it by mutation analysis with 17 classes of silent bugs on 103 models from torchvision, timm and Hugging Face transformers, on 600 random architectures and on 20 hand-written realistic bugs, against the checks of the original torchtest, overfitting a single batch, a smoke test and a training monitor in the style of AUTOTRAINER and DeepDiagnosis. Every mutant is compared with its healthy counterpart, and intervals come from a bootstrap over models. After freezing the tool, we ran it on 191 models of architecture families it had never seen: counting, for every tool alike, a failing report where the healthy model's report does not fail, it detected 78% of the injected bugs (95% CI 75-80), against 40% for the original torchtest checks and 48% for the training monitor. On real models its batch-independence check found a bug in timm's GCViT that couples the images of a batch. Real models also exposed false alarms that neither the tool's own test suite nor random architectures had revealed. Two independent collections of real silent bugs mark the limits of the approach: only 3 of 28 reproduced PyTorch bugs from Stack Overflow and 3 of the 18 silent training errors released with TrainCheck are within reach of a pre-training model tester. A median check takes 1.0 s. We release the library, the benchmark and all raw results.

AI.tldr: 本文提出开源库 torchtest2，可在单个 batch 上一次性执行 18 项 sanity check，自动恢复被修改的 PyTorch 状态，并通过插件适配不同模型族，用以在训练早期发现"静默 bug"。
AI.motivation: 深度学习代码中的缺陷往往是静默的：某层从未被调用、分类头替换前已创建的优化器、把 batch 维当时间维的循环层、被忽略的 attention mask 等。代码能跑、loss 也会略降，缺陷可能要消耗数天 GPU 时间后才暴露，缺乏统一、低成本的早期检测手段。
AI.method: 构建 torchtest2：单 batch 触发 18 项检查、状态可恢复、插件化适配模型族。采用变异分析评估：在 torchvision/timm/HF transformers 的 103 个模型、600 个随机架构及 20 个手写真实 bug 上注入 17 类静默 bug，与原始 torchtest 检查、单 batch 过拟合、smoke test、AUTOTRAINER/DeepDiagnosis 风格训练监控对比；冻结工具后在 191 个未见架构族模型上做零样本泛化测试，区间由对模型的自助法给出，并以"健康模型不报错而变异体报错"作为检出定义。
AI.result: 零样本设置下检出 78% 注入 bug（95% CI 75–80），原始 torchtest 检查为 40%、训练监控为 48%。在真实模型上，batch-independence 检查发现 timm GCViT 中耦合同 batch 图像的 bug；同时真实模型暴露了工具自测与随机架构未能发现的误报。两套真实静默 bug 集合表明方法边界：Stack Overflow 复现的 28 个 PyTorch bug 中仅 3 个、TrainCheck 发布的 18 个静默训练错误中仅 3 个在训练前测试器覆盖范围内。单次检查中位耗时 1.0 s。
AI.conclusion: torchtest2 以极低开销（秒级）显著提升静默 bug 的早期检出率，并具备跨未见架构族的泛化能力，可作为训练前调试的实用工具；但预训练前静态/单 batch 测试对真实世界 bug 的覆盖有限，存在明确的适用边界。可复现性良好：库、基准与全部原始结果均已开源。

title: Plug-and-Play Sensor Evolution in Software-Defined Vehicles through Asset Administration Shells
comment: Peer-reviewed and Published in the 2026 IEEE 31st International Conference on Emerging Technologies and Factory Automation (ETFA)
summary: Software-defined vehicles (SDVs) promise continuous software evolution, but sensor integration in deployed vehicles still depends on manual configuration, hardware-specific drivers, and repeated application-side adaptation. Existing standards address only parts of this problem. AUTOSAR standardizes selected sensor interfaces, the Vehicle Signal Specification (VSS) standardizes signal semantics, and Asset Administration Shells (AAS) standardize digital asset descriptions. However, these building blocks are rarely combined into an end-to-end onboarding path for sensors attached after vehicle deployment. This paper presents an AAS-driven plug-and-play sensor integration framework for safety-supervised sensors. Each sensor is represented by an AAS that combines hardware identification, interface metadata, VSS mappings, and references to containerized driver and optional application software. After physical connection, an edge gateway identifies the device, retrieves the matching AAS, deploys the referenced software, and publishes the resulting data under stable vehicle signal paths. A prototype on a resource-constrained edge gateway connected to an RR100 UGV demonstrates automated integration of a USB camera and an ultrasonic sensor. Across repeated integration cycles, the prototype reaches operational state in about 2s, shows no failed events, and keeps applications independent of hardware-specific interfaces. The results indicate that the introduction of AAS as an executable onboarding contract enables automated runtime deployment of sensor drivers in SDV environments.

AI.tldr: 提出以AAS（资产管理壳）作为可执行上电契约的SDV传感器即插即用集成框架：传感器AAS封装硬件ID、接口元数据、VSS映射及容器化驱动/应用引用，边缘网关识别设备后自动拉取AAS并部署软件，实现约2秒上电、零失败事件。
AI.motivation: SDV宣称可持续软件演进，但部署后新增传感器的集成仍依赖人工配置、硬件专用驱动与应用侧重适配；AUTOSAR、VSS、AAS等标准各自只覆盖片段，缺乏端到端的传感器上线（onboarding）路径。
AI.method: 构建AAS驱动的即插即用框架：(1) 每个传感器用AAS整合硬件识别、接口元数据、VSS信号映射与容器化驱动/可选应用软件引用；(2) 物理接入后边缘网关完成设备识别、匹配检索AAS、部署引用软件、在稳定VSS信号路径下发布数据；(3) 面向"安全监督传感器"场景；在资源受限边缘网关连接RR100 UGV上以USB相机与超声波传感器做原型验证。
AI.result: 重复集成循环中，原型约2秒达可运行状态，无失败事件记录；应用与硬件专用接口解耦。仅两个低复杂度传感器、单一网关平台的工程原型验证，未涉及带宽/算力压力、故障恢复、安全监督机制的量化评估。
AI.conclusion: 将AAS引入为"可执行上线契约"，可在SDV运行时自动部署传感器驱动，是软件架构与系统工程层面的实用贡献；但缺少与现有SDV/ROS 2/ZeroMQ等方案的定量对比，属背景性工具方法。

title: Asymmetric Optical Image Watermarking
summary: Watermark detectors held by a provider cannot be checked by third parties, and a party that can detect a mark can usually also forge it. We study a two-layer image watermark in which the Fourier transform at the core of the pipeline is performed by a coherent optical 4F unit. Layer 1 carries an Ed25519 signature bound to the image content in Fourier magnitudes, so anyone with the public key verifies offline. Layer 2 is a key-defined carrier written by a secret phase hologram and read by a matched-filter correlator. The optics is a scalar-diffraction simulation with finite modulator bits, pixel aperture, pupil, defocus, misalignment, and sensor noise. No hardware is built. All criteria were fixed in a hashed specification before any optical result. The simulated optical signer reproduces the digital pipeline (field error 1.7e-15, bit agreement 99.997%), verifies at least 99.5% of 877 images under each of 8 post-sensor settings, one unattacked, and accepts none of 40,670 unmarked images. The optical carrier is key-selective: the matched key detects it on 99.8% of the unattacked images, and detection falls to 0% under a scale error of 1% and to 0% under a mask shift of 1 bin. Security rests on the signature and the content binding, for which we separate what is provable from what is measured.

AI.tldr: 提出两层图像水印：第一层在Fourier幅度中嵌入Ed25519签名绑定图像内容，任何人可用公钥离线验证；第二层为密钥定义的相位全息载波，由匹配滤波相关器读出。以4F光学系统的标量衍射仿真（含有限调制位深、像素孔径、光瞳、离焦、失调与噪声）验证管线一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有水印中检测器由提供商私有，第三方无法核验，且能检测者通常也能伪造。需要一种可公开验证、且不可伪造的溯源方案，并考察其能否在相干光学4F前端中实现。
AI.method: 数字-光学混合的两层水印架构：核心Fourier变换由相干光学4F单元完成。Layer 1将Ed25519签名通过图像内容绑定写入Fourier幅度，实现无秘密的离线公共验证；Layer 2用秘密相位全息写入密钥定义的载波，由匹配滤波相关器读取，实现密钥选择性检测。光学部分为标量衍射仿真，建模有限调制器比特、像素孔径、光瞳、离焦、失调与传感器噪声，无硬件验证；全部判据在光学实验前写入哈希化规格。
AI.result: 仿真光学签名器复现数字管线（场误差1.7e-15，比特一致率99.997%）；在8种传感器后处理设置下，对877张图像验证成功率≥99.5%，40,670张无水印图像零接受。光学载波具密钥选择性：匹配密钥在未攻击图像上检测率99.8%，1%尺度误差或1 bin掩模平移即降至0%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一个可公共验证（签名+内容绑定）与密钥选择性（相位全息载波）分离的稳健双层水印框架，并给出仿真层面的定量证据与预先注册的评测协议；安全性论证明确区分"可证明"与"实测"部分，但缺少真实光学硬件实验，光学性能结论仍限于仿真。

title: Streaming Generative Video Compression with Embedding Alignment and In-Context Propagation
comment: 15 pages, 18 figures, 5 tables, including supplementary material
summary: Video compression at ultra-low bitrates presents substantial challenges in preserving perceptual quality. Although pretrained video diffusion transformers (DiTs) provide powerful generative priors, existing generative video compression (GVC) methods built on them typically rely on computationally expensive VAE decoders to reconstruct video frames. Moreover, jointly refining multiple frames to exploit the inherent spatiotemporal modeling capabilities of video DiTs introduces additional buffering delay. To address these challenges, we propose SGVC, a streaming generative video compression framework that adapts a pretrained latent video DiT into a causal pixel-space refiner. Specifically, SGVC projects decoded features from a contextual pixel codec directly into the DiT input embedding space. To bridge the representation gap between codec-derived embeddings and pretrained DiT embeddings, we introduce Embedding Alignment, which aligns the projected embeddings with input embeddings extracted from the original frames during training. The refined DiT hidden states are then mapped directly to the pixel domain through a lightweight reconstruction path, bypassing the pretrained VAE decoder. To further exploit the spatiotemporal priors of the video DiT while maintaining causal decoding, we introduce In-Context Propagation, which reuses layer-wise K/V states across frames to exploit historical generative context, improving temporal consistency without requiring clip-wise buffering. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SGVC achieves competitive rate-perception performance, with average BD-rate savings of 71.97% over S$^2$VC in terms of DISTS. Project Page: this https URL

AI.tldr: SGVC将预训练潜空间视频DiT改造为因果像素域refiner，用于流式超低码率生成式视频压缩，通过Embedding Alignment与In-Context K/V复用绕过VAE解码器并避免clip级缓冲。
AI.motivation: 现有基于视频DiT的生成式视频压缩（GVC）依赖计算昂贵的VAE解码器重建帧，且联合精修多帧会引入缓冲延迟，难以满足超低码率下的实时/流式感知质量需求。
AI.method: 提出SGVC流式框架：将contextual pixel codec的解码特征直接投影到DiT输入嵌入空间；引入Embedding Alignment，在训练时把投影嵌入与原始帧提取的DiT嵌入对齐以弥合表征差距；将精修后的DiT隐状态经轻量重建路径直接映射到像素域，绕过预训练VAE解码器；引入In-Context Propagation，跨帧复用逐层K/V状态以利用历史生成上下文，实现因果解码且无需clip级缓冲。
AI.result: 大量实验表明SGVC具有竞争力的率-感知性能，在DISTS指标上相对S²VC平均BD-rate节省71.97%。
AI.conclusion: 预训练视频DiT可直接作为流式像素域refiner，在无需VAE解码与多帧缓冲的条件下取得显著率-感知增益，为低延迟生成式视频压缩提供可行路径。

title: Neural Circuit Architectural Priors for Rat Locomotion
comment: NeurIPS 2026. 10 pages main text, 41 pages total, 7 figures in main text. Code and videos: this https URL
summary: Animals generate behavior through continuous interactions between their neural circuits, bodies, and environment. Embodied simulations study these interactions by testing neural circuit models in biologically realistic settings. Recent efforts have simulated diverse animals, and emerging work on biologically grounded neural architectures has begun to integrate circuit connectivity and single-unit dynamics from experimental data into artificial neural networks, introducing stronger inductive biases and closer mechanistic alignment with biology. How can we develop embodied simulations that enable the study of increasingly complex bodies and neural circuits? In this work, we address the challenge through coordinated advances in the simulated body, neural architecture, and training infrastructure. We introduce Rat v2, an efficient and flexible biomechanical body for simulating rat behavior. To control this body, we develop Rat NCAP, a biologically grounded neural architecture for locomotion based on mammalian spinal circuits that incorporates cell-type-specific connectivity and a novel flexor-extensor neuromechanical interface. To optimize circuit parameters, we develop GPU-accelerated simulation and training infrastructure. The model learns to locomote at different speeds and transition between gaits without imitation learning, producing locomotion statistics, kinematics, and cell-type-specific neural activity consistent with experimental data. Analyses reveal that the neuromechanical interface substantially affects trainability and gait quality, and in silico cell-type ablations reproduce known gait phenotypes and predict gait changes under graded perturbations. Together, these findings support the view that embodied simulations at an intermediate level of abstraction can simultaneously reproduce complex behavior and yield mechanistic insights into the neural circuits that generate it.

AI.tldr: 构建高效犬鼠生物力学身体 Rat v2、基于哺乳动物脊髓回路的生物约束神经架构 Rat NCAP（含细胞类型特异连接与屈伸肌神经力学接口）及GPU加速训练设施，实现无模仿学习的多速度行走与步态切换，并复现实验神经活动与消融表型。
AI.motivation: 现有具身仿真难以同时支撑日益复杂的身体与神经回路；需要在中层抽象度上把实验测得的回路连接与单元动力学引入仿真，兼顾复杂行为复现与机制解释。
AI.method: 三方面协同：1) Rat v2 高效柔性鼠类生物力学身体；2) Rat NCAP 神经架构，映射哺乳动物脊髓运动回路，含细胞类型特异连接与新型屈伸肌神经力学接口；3) GPU 加速仿真与训练基础设施用于回路参数优化；采用强化/任务驱动优化而非模仿学习。
AI.result: 模型自发学会多速度运动与步态转换，运动统计量、运动学及细胞类型特异神经活动与实验数据一致；消融分析显示神经力学接口显著影响可训练性与步态质量；in silico 细胞类型消融复现已知步态表型并预测分级扰动下的步态变化。
AI.conclusion: 中层抽象的具身仿真可同时复现复杂行为并给出神经回路层面的机制洞见，为复杂身体—回路协同研究提供可扩展范式。

title: Lossless Reversible Watermarking for AIGC with Applications in Authentication
summary: AIGC watermarking is commonly used for tracing, but it can also support applications such as authentication and tampering detection. We study lossless reversible watermarking, which enables exact recovery of the original watermarked image after permissible distortions. By exploiting the relatively low entropy of the information required for image generation, together with robust latent-space watermarking, we design a framework that preserves sufficient information for lossless recovery. We then apply the framework to AIGC authentication, which generally faces two key challenges. First, the authentication mechanism must resist adaptive adversaries. Second, the content relevant to authentication, such as visual designs or expressed messages, may depend on application requirements that are not known at generation time. To solve these difficulties, we incorporate cryptographic message authentication to provide unforgeability against adaptive attacks. Lossless recovery provides the original image as reference evidence, after which a suitable analyzer can be selected to make the authentication decision. Experiments on Stable Diffusion demonstrate exact recovery under a wide range of distortions.

AI.tldr: 提出基于低熵生成信息与鲁棒潜空间水印的无损可逆水印框架，通过结合密码学消息认证抵御自适应攻击，实现失真后可精确恢复原图并用于AIGC认证。
AI.motivation: AIGC水印常用于溯源，也可支撑认证与篡改检测，但现有认证面临两大挑战：一是需抵抗自适应敌手伪造，二是认证相关内容（视觉设计、表达信息）依赖生成时尚不可知的应用需求。
AI.method: 利用图像生成所需信息的低熵特性，结合鲁棒潜空间水印构建框架，保留足以无损还原的信息；引入密码学消息认证码提供不可伪造性；以恢复的原图为参考证据，再选用合适的分析器做认证决策。
AI.result: 在Stable Diffusion上验证，在多种失真条件下均可精确恢复原始水印图像。
AI.conclusion: 无损可逆水印可为AIGC认证提供不可伪造的参考证据并支持灵活的事后分析，是兼具溯源与认证能力的实用方案。

title: RFBench: A Simulator-Grounded Multimodal Benchmark for Passive RF Layout Design and Understanding
comment: 29 pages, 4 figures. Code: this https URL . Data: this https URL
summary: While multimodal language models can interpret diagrams and generate structured outputs, their capacity to connect passive radio-frequency (RF) design intent, layout geometry, and electromagnetic behavior remains largely untested. To address this gap, we introduce RFBench, a simulator-grounded dataset and benchmark for passive RF layout design and understanding. The dataset contains 10,000 two-port planar layouts simulated using ADS Momentum, with each layout represented by editable geometric primitives, a raster image, a 16x16 occupancy grid, complex S-parameters at 201 frequency points, a structural category, and an RF response label. Building on these aligned representations, we define seven tasks spanning specification-conditioned layout generation, representation translation, response prediction, simulator-based validation, design diagnosis and improvement, structural understanding, and response classification. Extensive baselines across seven multimodal language models reveal systematic weaknesses in generating structurally valid layouts and predicting electromagnetically faithful responses. We show that RF-specific fine-tuning increases T1a structural validity from 0.0% to 83.2% and the T3 primitive-input within-2-dB rate from 17.7% to 62.8%, demonstrating the value of domain adaptation while leaving considerable room for further progress. RFBench establishes a common testbed for evaluating multimodal RF capabilities and guiding the development of models that connect design intent and layout representations with physical behavior.

AI.tldr: RFBench 是首个基于 ADS Momentum 仿真的无源射频版图理解与设计基准，含 1 万条双端口平面版图及其多模态对齐表示（几何图元、栅格图、16×16 占用栅格、201 点复数 S 参数、类别与响应标签），定义 7 类任务并用 7 个多模态大模型建立基线。
AI.motivation: 多模态语言模型虽能解析图表并生成结构化输出，但其能否把无源射频设计意图、版图几何与电磁行为联系起来尚缺乏系统性检验；领域内也缺少统一、可仿真验证的测试平台。
AI.method: 构建 RFBench：10,000 个平面双端口版图由 ADS Momentum 仿真，每条样本提供可编辑几何图元、栅格图、16×16 占用栅格、201 个频点复数 S 参数、结构类别与 RF 响应标签；据此定义七个任务（规格条件版图生成、表示翻译、响应预测、仿真器验证、设计诊断与改进、结构理解、响应分类），并在七个多模态语言模型上做广泛基线评估，另做 RF 领域微调对照。
AI.result: 基线模型普遍存在系统性缺陷：难以生成结构有效的版图、难以预测电磁上可信的响应。RF 专项微调将 T1a 结构有效率从 0.0% 提升到 83.2%，T3 图元输入下的 2 dB 内命中率从 17.7% 提升到 62.8%，说明领域适配有价值但仍有较大提升空间。
AI.conclusion: RFBench 为评估多模态射频能力提供了统一测试床，可用于引导模型将设计意图与版图表示和物理行为相连接；当前方法是基准与数据集性质的评测工作，未提出将多模态模型直接落地到物理设计流程的新方法，与具身智能/物理仿真核心议题相关度较低。

title: OCLDA-GS: Object-Centric Local Deformation-Aware Gaussian Streaming
summary: Streaming 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) allows for online reconstruction of dynamic scenes from multi-view videos for Free Viewpoint Video (FVV). Current time and storage efficient methods rely on selecting a subset of anchor Gaussians and neighborhood interpolation for fast streamable 3DGS. However, these methods can overlook object-specific motion and introduce inconsistencies near object boundaries. We propose OCLDA-GS, an object-centric streaming framework that dynamically reallocates object and motion-aware Gaussian anchors to allocate anchor Gaussian support for objects undergoing large motion while at the same time, restricting the gaussian neighborhood within object groups for more precise object boundaries. Furthermore, it estimates object-wise rigid transformations (e.g. a hand moving) and leverages these estimates to learn per-anchor local deformation correction for small deformations (e.g. wrinkles on a shirt). Then, we conduct experiments on three dynamic multi-view video datasets and demonstrate improvements over the previous baselines alongside improved quality between refinement timesteps. Under matched refinement budgets, our method improves PSNR over Instant Gaussian Stream (IGS) by 0.169 dB on N3DV, 0.202 dB on Meeting Room and +0.199 on Google Immersive, while reducing the mean PSNR drop between refinement timesteps by 9.2% and 13.8% in N3DV and Meeting Room, respectively.

AI.tldr: OCLDA-GS：面向对象的流式3DGS框架，动态重分配对象与运动感知的锚点高斯，并将邻域限制在对象组内以获得更精确的物体边界；同时估计对象级刚体变换并学习逐锚点局部形变校正，在多视角动态视频上超过IGS基线并减小细化步间质量抖动。
AI.motivation: 现有高效流式3DGS通过选取少量锚点高斯+邻域插值实现可流式重建，但忽略物体特定运动，且物体边界附近出现不一致（跨物体插值）。需在保持时/存储效率前提下改善大运动物体的锚点支持与边界精度。
AI.method: 对象中心的流式框架：1) 动态重分配对象与运动感知锚点，为大运动物体分配更多锚点支持；2) 将高斯邻域限制在对象组内以保持边界锐利；3) 估计对象级刚体变换，并以其为先验学习逐锚点局部形变校正（如衣物褶皱等小形变）。在三个动态多视角视频数据集上验证。
AI.result: 在相同细化预算下，N3DV 上 PSNR 较 Instant Gaussian Stream (IGS) 提升 0.169 dB，Meeting Room 提升 0.202 dB，Google Immersive 提升 0.199 dB；细化时间步之间的平均 PSNR 下降在 N3DV 与 Meeting Room 分别减少 9.2% 与 13.8%。
AI.conclusion: 对象级锚点重分配与刚体+局部形变的分层建模可在不牺牲流式效率的情况下改善动态场景重建质量与时间一致性，属增量式的动态3DGS流式改进。

title: Autoregressive View Model
summary: We present the Autoregressive View Model (AVM), which generates a scene as a stream of views without constructing an explicit 3D representation. Through a unified in-context interface, AVM conditions on images or videos to generate short clips along a requested camera path. Visual context grounds reconstruction and interpolation, while a learned prior enables extrapolation into unseen regions. AVM retrieves relevant views from inputs and generated history to form a bounded active context. We fine-tune a pretrained bidirectional video diffusion transformer with flow matching in an N-in-1-out formulation. We then tune a causal model on its own rollouts to improve photorealism, reduce denoising steps, and limit long-horizon drift. We scale training to approximately 8M scenes and video clips. We evaluate generation capacity and scene persistence across benchmarks for camera control, text control, visual quality, dynamics, sparse and 4D reconstruction, and long-horizon consistency. The results demonstrate that AVM adapts to diverse input and output settings through one in-context interface.

AI.tldr: 提出自回归视图模型(AVM)：以“视图流”直接生成场景，无需显式3D表征；统一in-context接口，用预训练双向视频扩散Transformer做N-in-1-out流匹配微调，再用因果模型自rollout微调，训练规模约8M场景/片段。
AI.motivation: 显式3D重建(NeRF/3DGS)管线重、易受稀疏视角与未见区域限制；希望用单一生成式接口同时统一重建/插值与外推，并能从图像或视频输入沿指定相机轨迹生成。
AI.method: 1) 不建显式3D表示，按相机路径生成短片段流；2) 从输入与已生成历史中检索相关视图构成有界active context，视觉上下文做重建/插值、学习先验做外推；3) 用flow matching微调预训练双向视频DiT为N-in-1-out形式；4) 在自身rollout上微调因果模型以提升真实感、减少去噪步数、抑制长程漂移；5) 训练规模约8M场景与视频片段。
AI.result: 在相机控制、文本控制、视觉质量、动态性、稀疏重建与4D重建、长程一致性等多基准上评估生成能力与场景持续性，显示单一in-context接口可适配多种输入/输出设定。
AI.conclusion: 视图流式生成可替代显式3D建模完成相机可控的场景合成与重建，具备强泛化接口与长程一致性改善，但摘要未给出定量指标与代码/实时性信息。

title: LIC-Audit: How Comparable Are Reported Gains in Learned Image Compression?
summary: Learned image compression (LIC) papers often report BD-rate improvements of only a few percent. They are measured against VTM reference software whose version keeps changing: the claims we audit name 7 versions, 5 in 2025 papers alone. But how comparable are these numbers across papers, and what evidence should future papers give for such small gains? We introduce LIC-Audit, an analysis of 353 released rate-distortion curves from 36 repositories, and a controlled re-evaluation of eight public codec releases with 28,193 encode-decode records. We identify three problems. First, different VTM reference runs change BD-rates by up to 3.56 percentage points, and on CLIC Pro published numbers order 10 of 55 method pairs differently from a common computation; comparing codecs directly over a fixed quality range removes this dependence. Second, releases use different and mostly undocumented conventions for counting bits, computing PSNR, and padding images. Under consistent measurement, the GLIC method's 1.00% lead over the HPCM method on Tecnick becomes a 1.43% deficit, changing only the padding reverses the comparison of HPCM and CMIC, and most gaps narrow when MS-SSIM replaces PSNR. Third, average curves hide how much results vary from image to image, so whether a small gain is statistically significant depends on the assumed variation. An optimistic assumption calls 12.0% of comparisons between equally good codecs significant on test sets as small as Kodak, instead of 5%; a cautious one leaves 18 of 45 differences between recent codecs undecided, yet per-image results show 12 of them to be significant. Beyond auditing past results, LIC-Audit provides a versioned evaluation protocol, a public leaderboard website with a scoring tool, source-linked benchmark data, per-image measurements, and reporting guidelines, to help future LIC papers make comparable and verifiable claims of progress.

title: Bits, Not Boxes: Label-Free Layer Selection for Visual Localization in VLMs
summary: Attention maps cheaply show where a vision-language model (VLM) looks, but attention sinks make them unreliable for localization. Contrasting the question with a generic prompt suppresses sinks, yet only some layers localize the queried object. Existing methods find these layers with box annotations or fixed rules. We show that attention itself can identify them. A question changes how much a head attends to the image and where this attention goes. The two effects separate exactly, and the second, measured in bits on unlabeled questions, indicates which layers localize. WhereBits turns these where-to-look bits into a layer prior and combines it with per-head contrastive scores. Its three design constants were fixed once on labeled COCO data, and a new model or resolution needs only unlabeled questions. Across eight VLMs, WhereBits matches the pointing accuracy of box-tuned layers on COCO and RefCOCO and ranks target tokens better. This advantage holds on a held-out model family and at higher resolutions. Its COCO pointing accuracy is 0.72, against 0.22 for mean attention. In training-free zoom-in, its crops raise V* accuracy by 6.0 points under forced-choice evaluation.

AI.tldr: WhereBits 提出用"注意力去向比特"（where-to-look bits）在无标注问题上自动识别 VLM 中能定位目标物体注意力的层，并将其作为层先验与逐头对比分数结合，提升免训练指向/定位精度。
AI.motivation: 注意力图可廉价反映 VLM 的注视位置，但注意力汇（attention sink）使其定位不可靠；用问题与通用提示对比可抑制 sink，但只有部分层能定位被查询物体。现有方法依赖框标注或固定规则来挑选这些层，缺乏可迁移、低成本的手段。
AI.method: 观察到问题会同时改变某头对图像的总注意力以及注意力在图像中的分布，二者可精确分离；在无标注问题上以比特为单位测量"去向"效应，得到指示定位能力的层先验。将 where-to-look bits 与逐头对比得分融合，构成 WhereBits。仅三个设计常数在带标注 COCO 上一次性固定，新模型或新分辨率只需无标注问题即可适配。
AI.result: 在 8 个 VLM 上，COCO 与 RefCOCO 的指向精度与使用框标注调优的层相当，且目标 token 排序更优；该优势在留出模型家族与更高分辨率下保持。COCO 指向精度 0.72，平均注意力仅 0.22。免训练 zoom-in 场景下，强制选择评测中 V* 精度提升 6.0 分。
AI.conclusion: 注意力"去向"比特是一个无需标注即可预测 VLM 定位层能力的信号，可作为有效的层选择先验，为视觉定位与免训练视觉推理提供可迁移的替代方案。

title: Hebbian self-organization of monosynaptic reflexes in a biologically realistic multiarticular limb
summary: Spinal monosynaptic reflexes depend on patterns of connectivity between muscle spindle afferents and motoneurons that should reflect musculoskeletal dynamics. One possibility is that the details of these circuits are specified genetically, but this requires an unlikely coevolution of musculoskeletal and neural elements. Here we show how biomechanical structure can determine the connectivity of self-organized spinal circuits. Using a neuromechanical model combining a multi-joint limb, proprioceptive feedback, and Hebbian plasticity driven by motor babbling, we find that biologically realistic connectivity emerges spontaneously when babbling is neither too sparse nor too frequent. This results in strong homonymous projections, weaker heteronymous projections among functional synergists, and very weak connections among antagonists. This outcome also depends on musculoskeletal morphometry. Heteronymous synergies form when proximal muscles are strongest---the characteristic gradient of mammalian limbs--whereas excessively strong biarticular muscles lead to unphysiological antagonist coupling. The mechanisms differ: homonymous connections arise from direct sensorimotor correlation during fusimotor coactivation by beta motoneurons, while heteronymous connections depend on multi-joint dynamics that emerge only after homonymous reflexes stabilize and increasing muscle strength generates multisegmental motion. Overall, this study provides a mechanistic basis for fetal sensorimotor development and generates testable predictions about the consequences of naturally occurring and experimentally induced variations.

AI.tldr: 用一个结合多关节肢体、本体感觉反馈与运动"咿呀"驱动Hebbian可塑性的神经力学模型，证明脊髓单突触反射的连接模式可在无遗传指定下由生物力学结构自组织涌现，并依赖肌骨形态与咿呀频率。
AI.motivation: 脊髓单突触反射的连接模式（同名、异名、拮抗肌投射）应反映肌骨动力学，但若完全由遗传指定，则需肌骨系统与神经元件"不合理的协同演化"。作者希望检验生物力学结构本身能否决定自组织脊髓回路的连接性。
AI.method: 构建神经力学模型：多关节肢体 + 本体感觉反馈 + 由运动咿呀（motor babbling）驱动的Hebbian可塑性；系统改变咿呀稀疏/频繁程度与肌骨形态参数（近端肌强度、双关节肌强度），观察稳态连接结构及形成的时序机制。
AI.result: 仅在咿呀既不过疏也不过频时，才自发涌现生物学真实的连接：强同名投射、功能协同肌间较弱的异名投射、拮抗肌间极弱连接。结果依赖形态计量学——近端肌最强时形成异名协同（对应哺乳动物肢体特征梯度），双关节肌过强则导致非生理性拮抗耦合。机制不同：同名连接源于β运动神经元共激活梭内肌纤维时感觉-运动直接相关；异名连接依赖多关节动力学，需在同名反射稳定后、肌力增大产生多节段运动才出现。
AI.conclusion: 为胎儿感觉运动发育提供了机制性解释，并产生关于自然发生与实验诱导变异后果的可检验预测；表明神经回路细节可由肌骨力学结构而非单纯遗传编码决定。

title: TransFIRA+: Transfer Learning for Biometric Recognizability Assessment
summary: Biometric recognition in surveillance, video, and web imagery must contend with extreme variation in pose, blur, illumination, occlusion, and distance, where visual quality metrics fail to predict whether inputs are recognizable to the deployed encoder. Existing face image quality assessment methods rely on visual heuristics, curated annotations, or costly generative pipelines, leaving their predictions detached from the encoder's decision geometry. We introduce TransFIRA, a lightweight framework that grounds recognizability directly in embedding space. TransFIRA derives class-center similarity (CCS) and class-center angular separation (CCAS) from a pretrained encoder's embeddings and learns to predict them from images without quality annotations. Using predicted CCS for template weighting and CCAS>0 as a natural filtering threshold yields state-of-the-art face verification performance on BRIAR, raising TAR at $10^{-6}$ FMR from 0.085 with uniform averaging to 0.598. The predicted scores also reveal how image degradations affect encoder-specific recognizability. TransFIRA+ extends this framework to cross-camera multimodal person identification in untrimmed surveillance video. In this setting, body recognizability scores saturate within a narrow range, making direct weighting effectively uniform. We introduce a post-hoc sigmoid calibration that transforms these saturated scores into informative weights without retraining. After calibration, the BRIAR-trained TransFIRA predictor improves fused face and body identification on two unseen multi-camera datasets, outperforming detector-confidence weighting and uncalibrated CCS-rank weighting. Together, TransFIRA and TransFIRA+ demonstrate that encoder-grounded recognizability generalizes across biometric modalities and recognition settings.

AI.tldr: TransFIRA以预训练编码器的嵌入空间为“质量”定义基准：从嵌入推出类中心相似度(CCS)与类中心夹角分离度(CCAS)，无需质量标注即可学习预测，用于模板加权与过滤；TransFIRA+进一步用事后sigmoid校准，将跨摄像头多模态(人脸+人体)识别中的饱和分数转化为有效权重。
AI.motivation: 监控/视频/网络图像中的生物识别面临姿态、模糊、光照、遮挡、距离的极端变化，视觉质量指标无法预测“对部署编码器是否可识别”；现有FIQA依赖视觉启发式、人工标注或昂贵生成管线，其预测与编码器的决策几何脱节。
AI.method: TransFIRA：从已冻结预训练编码器的嵌入计算CCS（与类中心相似度）与CCAS（类中心角分离度），用轻量网络直接从图像回归这两个量，无需质量标注；推理时用预测CCS做模板加权，用CCAS>0作为天然过滤阈值。TransFIRA+：在未裁剪监控视频的跨摄像机多模态人体识别中，针对分数饱和问题引入事后sigmoid校准，无需重训练即可把饱和分数转为有判别力的权重，并可直接复用BRIAR上训练的预测器。
AI.result: 在BRIAR上，使用预测CCS加权+CCAS过滤后，TAR@FMR=1e-6 从均匀平均的0.085提升到0.598，达SOTA；预测分数还能揭示不同退化对人脸/人体编码器特异性可识别性的影响。经校准后，BRIAR训练的预测器在两个未见多摄像头数据集上改善人脸+人体融合识别，优于检测置信度加权与未校准的CCS-rank加权。
AI.conclusion: 可识别性可由编码器嵌入空间直接定义并学习预测；该度量跨生物特征模态与识别场景（受限人脸验证、开放集多模态视频行人识别）具备可迁移性，且通过简单事后校准即可适配分数饱和的新模态。

title: Gaussian Splatoms: Direct Atomic Structure Identification in Electron Tomography
summary: Atomic electron tomography (AET) computationally reconstructs the 3D atomic structure of materials from a series of 2D projection measurements acquired at different tilt angles. Inspired by Gaussian splatting techniques from computer vision, we introduce an atom-centric parameterization for modeling AET samples. Instead of a conventional volumetric representation with a grid of voxels, we model the sample as a list of atoms, where each atom is a 3D Gaussian characterized by learned location, scale, and amplitude. The Gaussian model is a natural fit for atoms that allows us to easily incorporate prior information grounded in physics; we impose isotropy of atoms, a minimum interatomic distance, and realistic atomic radii. We show in simulation that our method is more robust than volumetric baselines to real-world imaging challenges, including a limited number of measurements and low electron dose. We further show that our method yields a more physically plausible reconstruction of an experimental 23,000 atom iron-platinum nanoparticle than a previously published volumetric reconstruction. Beyond tomography, our representation is a promising tool for any atomic resolution imaging modality (e.g. multislice electron ptychography).

AI.tldr: 提出以原子为中心的参数化方法，用3D高斯（位置、尺度、幅值）表示原子电子断层成像(AET)样本，并注入各向同性、最小原子间距、真实原子半径等物理先验，替代体素表示。
AI.motivation: 常规AET采用体素网格的体表示，需要大量倾斜投影测量，对低剂量与少测量数敏感，且易产生非物理伪影，难以直接嵌入物理先验。
AI.method: 受计算机视觉中高斯splatting启发，将样本建模为原子列表，每个原子为可学习位置/尺度/幅值的3D高斯；通过可微前向投影与2D测量匹配进行优化，并施加各向同性、最小原子间距与合理原子半径约束。
AI.result: 仿真表明在测量数有限和低电子剂量下比体素基线更鲁棒；对实验的23,000原子铁铂纳米颗粒给出比既有体素重建更符合物理的重建结果。
AI.conclusion: 原子中心高斯参数化为原子分辨成像提供了物理先验友好的表示，可推广到多层切片电子叠层成像等模态。

title: Why Sub-4-Bit Vision CNNs Collapse and Where Mixed-Precision Recovery Stops
summary: Deep vision models operating in resource-constrained environments depend heavily on low-bit quantization, yet compressing weights below 4 bits frequently induces catastrophic accuracy collapse. While mixed-precision recovery strategies aim to rescue accuracy by selectively retaining high-precision parameters, the fundamental mechanics of where and why these models collapse remain poorly understood. In this study, we systematically analyze the anatomy of quantization collapse across standard Vision CNNs (including ResNet and EfficientNet backbones) evaluated on the full 50,000-image ImageNet-1k validation set. First, we map the exact progression of degradation, demonstrating that collapse is highly non-linear and concentrated in late-stage pointwise projections and depthwise layers. Second, we introduce a structured, multi-step recovery waterfall that evaluates selective integer precision (INT4/INT8) and selective floating-point scales. We show that keeping less than 5% of critical layer activations in 8-bit precision recovers up to 92% of the accuracy lost during aggressive sub-4-bit compression. Finally, we bridge the hardware reality gap by evaluating deployment performance on standard ARM and x86 CPU architectures. We show that while low-bit quantization reduces memory storage requirements, standard runtime software bit-unpacking introduces a 1.48x to 21.5x execution slowdown depending on batch size, highlighting a critical trade-off between model footprint and actual edge throughput. Our findings provide a practical blueprint for navigating the limits of sub-4-bit deployment without sacrificing hardware performance.

AI.tldr: 系统剖析视觉CNN在亚4比特量化下的崩溃机理（集中在后期pointwise与depthwise层），提出多级选择性INT8恢复瀑布可在精确保留<5%关键层时恢复最多92%损失精度；同时揭示标准CPU运行时反解包的1.48–21.5倍推理减速，指出"存储压缩≠吞吐提升"的部署真相。
AI.motivation: 资源受限边缘设备依赖低比特量化，但权重压到4比特以下常导致精度灾难性崩溃；现有混合精度恢复策略缺乏对"何处崩溃、为何崩溃"的机制性理解，且普遍忽略实际部署吞吐。
AI.method: 在ImageNet-1k完整5万张验证集上，对ResNet/EfficientNet类标准视觉CNN做系统性量化崩溃解剖：先逐层映射退化进程，定位崩溃集中于后期pointwise投影与depthwise层；再构建结构化多步恢复瀑布，逐级评估选择性INT4/INT8精度分配与选择性浮点scale；最后在ARM与x86 CPU上实测部署性能与反解包开销。
AI.result: 崩溃呈强非线性且集中于后期pointwise与depthwise层；保留不足5%关键层激活为8比特可恢复亚4比特激进压缩所损失精度的92%；低比特虽降低存储，但标准运行时软件反解包按batch size不同带来1.48x–21.5x执行减速。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为亚4比特部署提供了实践蓝图：需以层级敏感的混合精度恢复为前提，并显式权衡模型体积与实际边缘吞吐，避免"压缩即加速"的误判。

title: Where Global Context and Weight Sharing Work in Compact Vision Backbones
summary: Compact convolutional backbones such as EfficientNet achieve strong parameter efficiency through local depthwise separable convolutions, yet two structural questions remain central to hybrid design: where does global self-attention improve recognition over pure convolution, and can repeated blocks share weights without losing representational capacity? We investigate both questions on ImageNet-1k (50,000-image validation) using controlled EfficientNet-B0 experiments. First, we show that wrapping a classification backbone in multi-scale feature pyramids (BiFPN) fails to outperform a plain MBConv trunk (69.99% - 71.81% vs. 72.86% plain B0) until paired with stage attention (73.15%). In contrast, keeping the MBConv trunk intact and inserting lightweight zero-gated residual self-attention adapters at stages P3 (28x28 windowed), P4 (14x14 global), and P5 (7x7 global) reaches 74.02% standalone and outperforms a bit-for-bit matched plain-B0 control by +0.954 percentage points (73.88% vs. 72.92%) across an 88-epoch stateless replay schedule, with learned attention amplitude rising monotonically with semantic depth (27.2% at P3 -> 45.4% at P4 -> 66.3% at P5). Second, we evaluate recurrent weight sharing across repeated MBConv blocks with pass-specific BatchNorm statistics (+1,536 parameters per pass). While post-hoc kernel averaging degrades accuracy to 17.03% and single-template stage tying (-27.6% parameters) plateaus at 66.10%, alternating two shared block templates ([B1, A, B, A]) in Stage 6 cuts total model parameters by 10.9% (582K weights) and recovers by +10.82 points in a single epoch to 70.92% (-1.84 points vs. unshared control).

AI.tldr: 在 EfficientNet-B0 上做受控实验，探究混合架构两件事：自注意力适配器应插入何处才优于纯卷积，以及重复 MBConv 块能否共享权重。
AI.motivation: 紧凑卷积主干（如 EfficientNet）参数效率高，但混合设计的两个结构性问题尚无定论：全局自注意力在何处比纯卷积更能提升识别性能；重复块共享权重是否会损失表示能力。
AI.method: ImageNet-1k（50k 验证集）受控实验。(1) 对比将主干包进 BiFPN 特征金字塔 vs 保留 MBConv 主干、在 P3(28x28 窗口)、P4(14x14 全局)、P5(7x7 全局) 插入零门控残差自注意力适配器；(2) 重复 MBConv 块递归权重共享，配 per-pass BatchNorm，比较后处理核平均、单模板阶段绑定与交替双模板 [B1,A,B,A]。
AI.result: BiFPN 包裹 69.99%–71.81%，配阶段注意力才达 73.15%，均低于纯 B0 的 72.86%；适配器方案 74.02%，在 88 epoch 无状态 replay 调度下比逐位对齐的纯 B0 对照高 +0.954pp（73.88% vs 72.92%），注意力幅度随语义深度单调上升（27.2%→45.4%→66.3%）。权重共享方面，核平均退化至 17.03%，单模板阶段绑定（−27.6% 参数）停滞于 66.10%；交替双模板在 Stage 6 减参 10.9%（582K），单 epoch 恢复 +10.82pp 至 70.92%（较未共享对照 −1.84pp）。
AI.conclusion: 全局注意力应作为深层（P4/P5）轻量残差适配插入而非重构为金字塔；重复块共享权重可行但需交替模板，单一模板绑定代价过大。

title: NIRJALA: Draining the Sea out of Gaussian Splatting with Three-Path Optics and Reversible Physics
summary: Water does not just tint an underwater photograph; it rewrites it. Each pixel mixes attenuated scene radiance, backscattered light, and scene light scattered forward on its way to the camera, and many combinations of scene and water explain the same pixels. Most Gaussian-splatting methods for underwater scenes model only the first two effects and remove the water by dividing by a transmission that decays exponentially with range, so their inversion gain grows without bound. We present NIRJALA (Sanskrit for "without water"), a 3D Gaussian Splatting framework that recovers water-free appearance and geometry together. TRIVENI, a three-path image formation model, adds a range-saturating forward-scattering term to direct transmission and backscatter; we prove that this keeps the inversion gain bounded at every range and bound how errors in the estimated backscatter and attenuation propagate into the recovered colours. PRATIBIMBA, a reversible physics anchor, ties a flexible neural water model to a ten-parameter physical model in both directions, so scene content cannot hide inside the water. SAMARASA collects the physics-informed objectives, including a range-binned colour prior. To score water removal against ground truth, we built SAJALA ("with water"), a 30-scene suite path-traced in Blender Cycles with water-free images, depth, and normals under controlled water colour and turbidity. On SAJALA, NIRJALA raises PSNR from 24.34 to 24.76 dB and lowers depth AbsRel from 0.109 to 0.091 against the strongest baseline; on real SeaThru-NeRF scenes it lowers LPIPS from 0.194 to 0.175 while rendering at 44 FPS. We also discuss where appearance metrics and geometry disagree underwater, and the limits of our evaluation.

AI.tldr: NIRJALA 提出三路径水下成像模型（TRIVENI，加入距离饱和的前向散射项使逆变换增益有界）驱动的 3D 高斯泼溅框架，配合可逆物理锚定（PRATIBIMBA）与物理约束损失（SAMARASA）同时恢复无水外观与几何，并构建 30 场景路径追踪数据集 SAJALA。
AI.motivation: 现有水下高斯泼溅仅建模直接透射与后向散射（SeaThru 类模型），通过除以指数衰减透射率去除水体影响，导致逆变换增益随距离无界增长、数值不稳定且在浑浊/远景处退化；同时场景内容与水体参数之间存在严重歧义，缺乏可辨识性保证。
AI.method: 1) TRIVENI 三路径图像形成模型：直接透射 + 后向散射 + 距离饱和的前向散射项，证明逆变换增益在任意距离有界，并给出后向散射/衰减估计误差向恢复颜色传播的界；2) PRATIBIMBA：将灵活神经水体模型与十参数物理模型双向绑定（可逆物理锚），防止场景内容"藏"进水体模型；3) SAMARASA：含距离分箱颜色先验的物理约束目标函数；4) 构建 SAJALA：Blender Cycles 路径追踪的 30 场景合成数据集，含无水真值图像、深度与法线，并控制水体颜色与浊度。
AI.result: 合成 SAJALA 上相对最强基线 PSNR 24.34→24.76 dB，深度 AbsRel 0.109→0.091；真实 SeaThru-NeRF 场景上 LPIPS 0.194→0.175，渲染速度 44 FPS；并讨论了水下外观指标与几何指标之间的分歧及评估局限。
AI.conclusion: 将可辨识性与增益有界的物理成像模型与 3DGS 耦合，可稳定解耦水体与场景，同时提升外观与几何；提升幅度偏温和（PSNR +0.42 dB），主要贡献在于理论保证、真实场景泛化与实时渲染，而非大幅精度跃升。

title: VeriMath: Human-in-the-Loop Generation and Verification of Curriculum-Aligned Mathematics Assessment Items
summary: Automatic generation of mathematics assessment items is a growing area in educational artificial intelligence, yet classroom deployment remains challenging. Generated questions must satisfy multiple constraints: mathematical correctness, curriculum alignment, appropriate cognitive difficulty, and educator reviewability. While prior work has advanced text generation, reliable assessment authoring requires granular control over localized examination formats and expert educational judgment. To address this challenge, we present VeriMath, a generalized, human-in-the-loop framework for generating rigorous, curriculum-constrained mathematics assessment drafts. Using annotated reference items, the framework anchors generation to the requested examination section and cognitive reasoning level, then applies sequential automated verification and guided repair before submitting drafts for expert review. We evaluate VeriMath through a national curriculum case study using 4,555 mathematics items from the Vietnamese Grade 12 curriculum and 50 distinct generation requirements covering multiple-choice, true/false, and short-answer formats. Across two model backbones, the framework produces verifier-accepted drafts for 94% (47/50) of requirements per run. Blind expert evaluations confirm high mathematical accuracy and curriculum alignment, with strict teacher-readiness assessments accepting up to 56.8% of generated items. Analysis of rejected drafts reveals persistent domain-agnostic challenges involving formatting, statement validity, and solution-step completeness. These findings demonstrate that VeriMath can bridge generative AI and dependable educational applications by producing highly reviewable assessment drafts within tightly constrained national curriculum frameworks.

AI.tldr: VeriMath：以标注参考题为锚点，将生成约束到指定题型与认知层级，再经顺序自动验证与引导修复，最后由教师盲审；越南12年级4555题、50项生成要求，两骨干模型均达94%验证器通过率，严格教师可用率最高56.8%。
AI.motivation: 数学测评题自动生成需同时满足数学正确性、课标对齐、认知难度适当与教师可复核性；既往文本生成工作缺乏对本地化考试格式的细粒度控制与专家教育判断的整合，课堂落地困难。
AI.method: 提出人在环框架：用标注参考题将生成锚定到指定考试板块与认知推理层级，随后串联自动验证器与引导式修复（guided repair），再将草稿提交专家复核；在两种模型骨干上评测。
AI.result: 在越南12年级4555道数学题、50项覆盖选择/判断/简答的生成要求上，每轮94%（47/50）要求产出验证器接受的草稿；盲评显示数学准确性与课标对齐度高，严格教师可用率最高56.8%；被拒草稿的失败集中在格式、陈述有效性与解题步骤完整性等跨领域问题。
AI.conclusion: VeriMath 表明，生成式AI经约束化生成+验证修复可在严格国家课标框架内产出高度可复核的测评草稿，衔接生成AI与可靠教育应用；但格式与推理完整性仍是通用瓶颈。

title: mmTherm: Absolute 3D Human Pose Estimation from Low-Resolution Thermal Images and mmWave Radar
summary: Absolute 3D human pose estimation (HPE) aims to recover both a person's body pose and their global position in 3D space. Privacy-preserving millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar provides distance and direction measurement capabilities, but its sparse point clouds make HPE under-constrained. Low-resolution thermal imaging can provide complementary observations of body direction and structure. However, our evaluation shows that a strong feature-level fusion baseline loses much of its localization and HPE advantage when generalizing to unseen subjects, with radial localization becoming less accurate than a radar-only baseline. Motivated by this finding, we introduce mmTherm, a lightweight framework that explicitly incorporates the complementary geometric properties of thermal imaging and mmWave radar. It combines body structure and joint directions estimated from thermal images with range information from radar to localize the body and reconstruct its 3D pose. Experiments on OctoNet show that mmTherm reduces cross-user absolute joint error by 33% and root localization error by 38% relative to the strongest corresponding baselines, while requiring substantially fewer parameters and less computation at inference.

AI.tldr: mmTherm：轻量多模态框架，融合热成像（身体结构与关节方向）与毫米波雷达（距离）实现跨用户绝对3D人体姿态与全局定位，OctoNet 上跨用户关节误差降33%、根节点定位误差降38%。
AI.motivation: 隐私保护场景下，mmWave 雷达点云稀疏导致 HPE 欠约束；低分辨率热成像可提供互补的身体方向/结构信息。但作者发现强特征级融合基线在未见受试者上泛化时优势大幅衰减，径向定位甚至不如纯雷达基线——说明需要显式利用两种模态的几何互补性，而非简单特征拼接。
AI.method: 提出 mmTherm：从热图像估计身体结构与关节方向，从雷达获取距离信息，按几何互补关系显式组合以定位人体并重建3D姿态；框架轻量，参数量与推理计算显著更少。评估方式为跨用户（unseen subject）泛化。
AI.result: 在 OctoNet 数据集上，相比最强对应基线，跨用户绝对关节误差降低33%，根节点定位误差降低38%，同时参数量和推理计算量显著减少。已诊断出特征级融合基线在多用户泛化下径向定位退化的问题。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模模态几何互补性优于隐式特征融合，是隐私保护、非视觉绝对HPE的有效轻量化路线；跨用户泛化是评估该类方法的关键。

title: SpecLook: Speculating Where to Look for Fast and Reliable Agentic MLLMs
summary: Agentic multimodal large language models (MLLMs) that think with images interleave reasoning with zoom-in tool calls. However, this sequential loop is slow, and its answers carry no reliability score. Prior speculation of tokens, reasoning steps, or answers keeps the loop, and answer speculation also accepts confident errors. We find that the loop mostly adds one zoom-in step, with which a small model is ahead of the agent on most splits. Our key insight is to speculate the agent's next observation, which, unlike a drafted answer, can be verified, corrected, and used to test the answer. We propose SpecLook, a training-free speculate-and-verify framework with three levels. A small model drafts a glimpse and re-answers from it, and the question ends if the answer is unchanged and confident. Otherwise, the agent's large model verifies and corrects the glimpse without tools, and their answers are fused. Only questions that still lack evidence reach the agent, in one forward pass that SpecLook-Fast skips, so no question runs the loop. The trace scores every answer's reliability without labels. Extensive experiments on V*, HR-Bench, and POPE show that both are more accurate than every baseline on every split. SpecLook reaches 87.2% and 86.2% mean accuracy with 7.7x and 4.7x speedups over the DeepEyes-7B and Thyme-RL agents, and SpecLook-Fast reaches 9.9x and 6.3x.

AI.tldr: SpecLook：用「小模型起草下一次缩放观测 + 大模型无工具验证纠正」的三级推测-验证框架替代 agent 的串行 zoom-in 循环，实现免训练加速且给出无标签的答案可靠性分数。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型 agent 的「看图思考」依赖串行 zoom-in 工具调用，速度慢且输出无可靠性评分；已有对 token/推理步/答案的推测仍保留循环，且答案推测会接受高置信错误。作者观察到循环通常只多一步 zoom-in，且小模型在多数 split 上已优于 agent，故将推测对象改为可验证的「下一次观测」。
AI.method: SpecLook 为免训练三级推测-验证框架：(1) 小模型起草一次 glimpse 并据此重答，若答案不变且置信则直接结束；(2) 否则大 agent 模型在无工具条件下验证并纠正 glimpse，融合两者答案；(3) 仅仍缺证据的问题交给 agent 做单次前向，SpecLook-Fast 直接跳过该步，从而使任何问题都不运行循环。轨迹层面对每个答案给出无标签可靠性分数。
AI.result: 在 V*、HR-Bench、POPE 上，SpecLook 与 SpecLook-Fast 在每个 split 上均优于所有基线；SpecLook 平均准确率 87.2% 与 86.2%，相对 DeepEyes-7B 与 Thyme-RL 加速 7.7x 与 4.7x，SpecLook-Fast 达 9.9x 与 6.3x。
AI.conclusion: 以「可验证的观测」而非「答案」作为推测单元，是兼顾效率与可靠性的有效路径；免训练、可给可靠性打分、无需执行工具循环，便于部署于多模态推理系统。局限在于评测集中于视觉搜索/幻觉类基准，未涉及具身或物理交互任务。

title: Reference-Guided Data Curation for 3D Medical Vision-Language Pretraining
comment: Accepted at WACV 2027. Code: this https URL
summary: Training 3D vision-language models (VLMs) on large medical imaging datasets collected across institutions is constrained by data quality. Vast, uncurated pools of image-report pairs are characterized by redundancy, class imbalance, and cross-institutional heterogeneity. We address this challenge of data curation for improving 3D VLM pretraining by proposing an offline, training-free, reference-guided data curation recipe. Our approach leverages a small, high-quality reference set to independently extract quality signals for each modality of a large, uncurated pool and merges them through a rank-aggregation step into a single ranking that guides sample selection. We validate this method on datasets comprising 35k 3D abdominal CT volume-report pairs from two institutions and 58k 2D chest X-ray image-report pairs. On 3D CT, using our reference-guided data curation strategy, our curated model matches the zero-shot disease classification performance of a state-of-the-art baseline (Merlin) while using $3.3\times$ less training data and a reference set of 5k samples. On 2D chest X-rays, our method yields a curated model that matches or exceeds the zero-shot disease classification performance of a model trained on the full pool while using up to $10\times$ less training data and a reference set of only 74 samples. Ablations show that the selection is stable under resampling of the reference, that smaller reference sets still outperform random sampling, and that label rebalancing does not improve performance. To support reproducibility, we release our code.

AI.tldr: 提出一种离线、免训练、参考集引导的数据筛选方案：用小型高质量参考集为大规模未筛选图文池分别提取各模态质量信号，经秩聚合融合成统一排序以指导样本选择，在3D腹部CT与2D胸片上验证可大幅减少训练数据。
AI.motivation: 跨机构收集的大规模医学影像图文对存在冗余、类别不平衡与机构异质性，数据质量成为3D视觉语言模型预训练的主要瓶颈，而现有筛选通常需要训练或在线迭代，成本高。
AI.method: 离线、无需训练的参考引导数据筛选流程：(1) 以小型高质量参考集为锚，对未筛选大池的每个模态独立计算质量信号；(2) 通过秩聚合（rank aggregation）将多模态信号合并为单一排序；(3) 按排序选取训练子集。另做参考集重采样稳定性、参考集规模、标签重平衡等消融。
AI.result: 3D CT（35k 体积-报告对，两机构）：仅用5k参考集，筛选后模型在零样本疾病分类上追平Merlin基线，训练数据减少3.3倍。2D 胸片（58k 对）：仅74个参考样本，即匹配或超过全量池训练模型，训练数据最多减少10倍。消融显示选择在参考集重采样下稳定，更小参考集仍优于随机采样，标签重平衡无增益。
AI.conclusion: 数据筛选质量而非数据规模是提升3D VLM医学预训练效率的关键；参考引导加秩聚合是一种低成本、可复现的通用筛选范式（已开源代码），但其适用性限于医学影像领域，未涉及3D重建、机器人或具身智能任务。

title: GRID-UAV: Geometry and Ray-depth Integrated Decision-making for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles
summary: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) encode images with 2D encoders that capture little 3D structure. A common approach is to feed the policy estimated depth, but a UAV chooses its own altitude, must judge distances tens of meters away, where monocular depth is less reliable, and must relate its forward and downward views. On long aerial routes, adding depth features directly brings no significant gain (42.5% vs. 42.6% success), so we study how 3D information should be given to the policy. Analyzing flight failures, we find that two forms of 3D grounding fail in opposite ways: explicit 3D lifting of depth collides less on the way but more often fails to finish at the target, while implicit alignment with a 3D geometry model finishes more often but collides more. We propose GRID, which combines both: (1) it lifts monocular depth into ray-corrected 3D positions in the UAV's frame for both cameras, and (2) during training only, it aligns its visual features with a frozen multi-view geometry model, at no inference cost. GRID adding explicit lifting to implicit alignment significantly increases how often the policy reaches the target ($61.5\% \rightarrow 69.5\%$, $p<0.001$), and adding implicit alignment to explicit lifting significantly increases how often it completes the task once there ($57.7\% \rightarrow 61.4\%$, $p<0.05$). On TravelUAV (3,005 test episodes), GRID achieves the best success rate on every split, with relative gains over the state of the art of 9.5% (seen), 17.1% (unseen objects) and 25.4% (unseen map).

AI.tldr: GRID 用"深度射线校正显式抬升到 3D"+"训练期与冻结多视角几何模型做隐式特征对齐"两种 3D grounding 互补，解决 UAV 长航程 VLA 中单目深度不可靠的问题，在 TravelUAV 全部 split 上取得 SOTA。
AI.motivation: VLA 的 2D 编码器缺乏 3D 结构；直接把估计深度作为特征输入在长航程飞行中几乎无增益（42.5% vs 42.6%）。作者进一步分析失败模式，发现显式 3D lifting 与隐式几何对齐的失效方向相反（前者航程中少碰撞但到点后易失败，后者到点完成率高但易碰撞），因而需要二者结合。
AI.method: GRID 包含两部分：(1) 显式分支——将前视与下视两个相机的单目深度按射线校正抬升到 UAV 自身坐标系下的 3D 位置；(2) 隐式分支——仅在训练阶段用冻结的多视角几何模型对齐视觉特征，推理时零额外开销。
AI.result: 在隐式对齐基础上加入显式 lifting，抵达目标率 61.5%→69.5%（p<0.001）；在显式 lifting 基础上加入隐式对齐，抵达后完成任务率 57.7%→61.4%（p<0.05）。TravelUAV 3,005 个测试 episode 上每个 split 均最优，相对 SOTA 提升 9.5%（seen）、17.1%（unseen objects）、25.4%（unseen map）。
AI.conclusion: 3D 信息应以"显式几何抬升 + 训练期隐式几何蒸馏"互补方式注入策略，而非简单拼接深度特征；该设计在 UAV 视觉-语言-动作导航上取得稳定的跨 split 泛化增益。

title: BiCAT: Bimanual Coordination Action Tokenization
summary: Autoregressive vision-language-action (VLA) models predict discrete action tokens with the next-token objective of their vision-language backbone, so the action tokenizer defines the interface between the policy and the robot. In bimanual manipulation, the two arms share a repertoire of movements yet coordinate through complementary roles, and an action representation should capture both. However, most existing tokenizers encode both arms as a single concatenated action vector, in which motion patterns common to the two arms are not shared and cross-arm dependencies remain entangled within each token. The policy must therefore learn both aspects implicitly. We propose Bimanual Coordination Action Tokenization (BiCAT), which shares one motion representation across arms while conditioning each arm's tokens on its partner through symmetric cross-arm attention and a joint decoder. The policy then predicts all tokens of each arm in parallel, generating the left arm first and the right arm conditioned on it. Across ten RoboTwin 2.0 tasks and six real-world tasks on three embodiments, BiCAT achieves the highest success among the compared tokenizers. In simulation, it improves mean success by 17.6 percentage points over the strongest of eight baselines, with the largest gains on tasks that require close coordination between the arms, while requiring only 40.5 ms per action chunk. These results suggest that the action tokenizer is a natural place to model bimanual coordination.

AI.tldr: 提出双臂协调动作分词器 BiCAT:两臂共享同一运动表征,通过对称交叉臂注意力与联合解码器使各臂 token 以对侧臂为条件,策略并行预测全部 token,仿真与真机均取得最高成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLA 动作分词器把双臂动作拼成单一向量,导致两臂共有的运动模式不被共享,交叉臂依赖纠缠在同一 token 内,协调能力必须由策略隐式学得。
AI.method: BiCAT 在分词器中显式建模协调:共享跨臂的运动表示(共享码本/表征),各臂 token 经对称交叉臂注意力以对侧臂信息为条件,并由联合解码器重构;策略按"先左臂、后以左臂为条件生成右臂"的顺序并行预测每臂全部 token。
AI.result: 在 RoboTwin 2.0 十个任务与三种本体、六个真机任务上成功率均最高;仿真中较八个基线中最强者的平均成功率提升 17.6 个百分点,需紧密协调的任务增益最大,每动作块仅需 40.5 ms。
AI.conclusion: 动作分词器是显式建模双臂协调的自然且高效的切入点,轻量结构即可带来显著成功率提升。

title: MedHarness: A Unified Budgeted Runtime for Reliable Medical Imaging Agents
summary: Medical imaging agents already return answers on heterogeneous imaging surfaces, yet deployment still faces a limited verification budget where each wrong accept can harm clinical trust. When a thin check and a deeper evidence pass disagree on the same case, deciding when to stop, open more evidence, repair, or reject without a shared controller remains ill-posed. Tool-using workflows often lock a surface-specific evidence order per dataset, or a private always-open full-depth verification path; those pipelines stay costly, leave many wrong accepts, and cannot share one controller across modalities. We present MedHarness, a registered multi-surface runtime reliability layer that reformulates post-answer control as shared decision-object attachment after a proposer's initial prediction. Under Shared Decision Object, Minimum-Sufficient Verification, and Intermediate Repair, one shared policy with surface recipe adapters lets a new imaging surface join the same stop / open-evidence / repair / reject controller by recipe registration. On a 512-case live pool, MedHarness cuts wrong accepts versus a full-verification baseline by about 47% and raises accepted accuracy to 83.2% vs. 72.9% at 86.1% coverage versus full release under that baseline. On a failure-enriched multi-surface stress ranking, the same controller cuts estimated remote service calls per case by about 71% versus that baseline under a matched context-load setting. A held-out three-surface check and an alternate language-model transfer keep the same control ordering. The code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: MedHarness：把医学影像智能体的"答后控制"统一为共享决策对象，用同一策略（含表面配方适配器）在停止/补证据/修复/拒答间决策，512例实测错接纳降约47%，远程调用降约71%。
AI.motivation: 医学影像智能体在异构模态上已能给出答案，但验证预算有限、误接纳损害临床信任；现有工具型流程把证据顺序按数据集写死或默认全深度验证，成本高、误接纳多、控制器无法跨模态共享，因此"何时停止/开更多证据/修复/拒答"缺乏统一机制。
AI.method: 提出 MedHarness 运行时可靠性层，将答后控制重构为proposer初始预测之后的"共享决策对象挂接"；遵循三条原则：Shared Decision Object（共享决策对象）、Minimum-Sufficient Verification（最小充分验证）、Intermediate Repair（中间修复）；单一共享策略加表面配方适配器，新影像模态仅需注册recipe即可接入同一控制器。
AI.result: 512例在线池上，相比全验证基线误接纳降低约47%，在86.1%覆盖率下接纳准确率83.2%（基线72.9%）；失败富集多表面压力排序中，匹配上下文负载下每例远程服务调用减少约71%；三表面留出检验与另一语言模型迁移保持相同控制排序。
AI.conclusion: 跨模态的答后验证控制可被单一共享策略+轻量配方注册统一，兼顾成本与可靠性；但属医学影像垂直域，对物理AI/VLA/3D重建等主线仅提供"带预算的停止/升级/修复/拒答"控制、可插拔适配器与选择性预测评测方法的借鉴，无直接可迁移的方法洞察。

title: Learning and Control in Physically Coupled Dynamical Systems
summary: We introduce TAG (Testbed for Autonomous Games), a compact, low-cost robotic platform for studying learning and control in physically coupled dynamical systems. TAG combines an actively tilted and steered ball-in-maze board with a top-mounted rotary inverted pendulum. The pendulum's reaction torque and vibration disturb the board and marble, while the board's tilt, driven by the maze-solving policy, simultaneously disturbs the pendulum's balance. The main challenge in learning control policies for each subsystem is accounting for the impact of one subsystem's dynamics on the other's learning process. To address this challenge, we present complementary reinforcement learning paradigms, leveraging model-based and model-free approaches to learn the control policies for the maze and pendulum, respectively. Our key finding is that introducing the pendulum causes an immediate, sharp drop in the maze policy's success rate, but the policy adapts online and recovers to its pre-coupling performance within a small number of learning episodes. Experimental results show that both policies, trained independently, successfully control the maze board and the pendulum despite their physical coupling.

AI.tldr: 提出低成本耦合动力学机器人平台 TAG（倾斜驱动的滚球迷宫板+顶部旋转倒立摆），用模型基与无模型互补强化学习分别学习两个子系统的控制策略，验证解耦训练的策略在物理耦合下仍收敛并互相适应。
AI.motivation: 研究物理耦合动力系统中各子系统策略学习时相互干扰的问题，需要一个紧凑、可控、可复现的试验平台来暴露并量化这种耦合效应。
AI.method: 构建 TAG 硬件平台：主动倾斜与转向的 ball-in-maze 板 + 顶置 rotary inverted pendulum；迷宫用模型基 RL、倒立摆用无模型 RL 独立训练；实验评估引入耦合后迷宫策略成功率的下降与在线恢复过程。
AI.result: 加入倒立摆后迷宫策略成功率立即显著下降，但仅需少量在线学习回合即可恢复至耦合前的性能；两个独立训练的策略在存在物理耦合的平台上均能成功控制各自子系统。
AI.conclusion: 该平台可作为研究耦合动力学下多子系统 RL 训练与在线适应的可复现试验床，表明模型基/无模型互补范式能容忍一定程度子系统间干扰。

title: BOS Summary: The First Token Matters
summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) and language models (LLMs) often exhibit attention sinks, whereby particular positions, such as the beginning-of-sequence (BOS) token, receive a disproportionate share of attention. Under standard causal masking, however, the BOS query attends only to itself, so the representation that later tokens repeatedly access carries no information about the input. We introduce BOS Summary, a training-free inference-time method that repurposes this persistent pathway to carry input context. At a single transformer layer during prefill, BOS Summary relaxes the causal constraint for the BOS query row alone, letting BOS aggregate all visual and textual input tokens into a self-derived context representation while every other token retains standard causal attention. The enriched representation then remains accessible to the model throughout decoding, with no additional parameters, auxiliary modules, or decoding-time overhead. Across multiple VLM and LLM families and eight multimodal and text-only benchmarks, BOS Summary improves over direct and Chain-of-Thought prompting and outperforms recent sink-intervention methods on multi-step reasoning tasks. A mechanistic analysis shows that making BOS input-specific also weakens its sink dominance and redistributes attention toward content-bearing prompt tokens, indicating that changing what a sink carries reshapes how later layers allocate attention.

AI.tldr: 提出 BOS Summary，一种免训练的推理期方法：在预填充阶段的单个 transformer 层中，仅放宽 BOS 查询行的因果掩码，使 BOS 聚合全部视觉与文本输入形成上下文摘要表示，从而让解码期持续复用的“注意力汇”通路携带真实输入信息。
AI.motivation: LVLM/LLM 普遍存在注意力汇（attention sink），BOS token 获得不成比例的注意力；但在标准因果掩码下 BOS 查询只能看到自身，因此后续 token 反复读取的该位置表示不含任何输入信息，形成“信息空洞的持久通路”。作者希望在零训练成本下把这条通路利用起来。
AI.method: 训练无关的推理时干预：仅在 prefill 阶段选取单个层，解除 BOS 查询行的因果约束，让 BOS 行对所有输入 token（图像+文本）做注意力汇总，得到输入相关的上下文表示；其余 token 保持标准因果注意力。无需额外参数、辅助模块，解码阶段无额外开销。
AI.result: 在多个 VLM 与 LLM 家族、8 个多模态与纯文本基准上，优于直接提示与 CoT 提示，并在多步推理任务上超过近期 sink 干预方法。机制分析显示：使 BOS 输入特异化会削弱其 sink 主导性，把注意力重新分配到承载内容的提示 token 上，说明改变 sink 所携带的内容会重塑后续层的注意力分配。
AI.conclusion: 通过对注意力汇通路的极轻量改造，可在不改动权重的前提下提升推理表现，并揭示了 sink 语义内容与注意力再分配之间的耦合关系；对机器人/具身 VLA 的高效推理与上下文压缩具有潜在借鉴价值。

title: Trust the Ray, Not the Depth: Ray-Lateral Agreement for Multi-View 3D Human Pose Fusion
summary: Put a monocular mesh estimator behind every camera of a calibrated rig, and the reconstructed bodies land a meter or more apart. The cause is geometric: each estimate sits at the depth implied by a focal length the network assumed, not the one the camera has. Its error therefore points almost entirely along its own viewing ray, and the calibration tells us that direction exactly. To address this, we introduce the Ray-Lateral Agreement (RLA), which follows one rule: trust the ray, not the depth. RLA first slides every estimate along its own rays, which removes the depth bias and leaves the shape untouched. It then fuses the views one point at a time, under a Gaussian error whose precision follows each viewing ray. The maximum-likelihood solution is closed-form, interpolates between averaging and midpoint triangulation, and stays well conditioned where triangulation is singular. Robustness is the harder half, because correct views also disagree along their rays. Any weight built on the full residual therefore punishes good views together with bad ones. Ray-lateral agreement instead scores every view, at every point, by its residual across that view's own ray alone. We evaluated RLA on multi-camera public benchmark datasets. Across two, three, and four cameras and three per-view pose estimators, RLA consistently achieves lower worst-case error than all triangulation baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出 Ray-Lateral Agreement (RLA)，用于多相机标定系统下的单目人体网格重建：沿各自视线滑动估计以消除焦距假设导致的深度偏差，再以高斯误差（精度沿视线方向）做逐点闭式最大似然融合，并用仅沿各视线方向的残差做鲁棒加权。
AI.motivation: 将单目网格估计器置于每个已标定相机后时，重建人体彼此相距一米以上。原因是几何性的：每个估计位于网络所假设焦距对应的深度处，而非真实相机焦距对应的深度；误差几乎全部沿其自身观察射线方向，而标定恰好精确给出该方向。
AI.method: 核心原则"信射线不信深度"。1) 沿每个估计自身射线滑动，去除深度偏差且不改变形状；2) 逐点融合多视图，采用沿视线方向精度定义的高斯误差模型，最大似然解为闭式，可在平均与中点三角化之间插值，并在三角化奇异处保持良态；3) 鲁棒性方面，因正确视图的残差也沿射线分布，改用仅在各视图自身射线方向上的残差为每个视图、每个点打分作为权重。
AI.result: 在公开多相机基准数据集上评测，覆盖2/3/4相机组合与三种逐视图姿态估计器，RLA 的最差情况误差始终低于所有三角化基线。
AI.conclusion: 把多视图融合的信任放在射线方向而非深度上，可将标定信息转化为稳定的闭式融合与可靠的视图加权，显著改善多相机人体网格重建的鲁棒性与最坏误差。

title: Beyond the Sink Token: Sink-Guided Key Editing in Vision-Language Models
summary: In vision-language models (VLMs), a few sink tokens attract a disproportionate share of attention. While previous studies have examined why these tokens attract attention, we investigate how the sink-key direction affects attention to image and question tokens. Across four probed VLMs, boosting the magnitude of positive sink-aligned components increases attention on average, whereas boosting negative components decreases it; these responses persist through later layers. This identifies the native sink key as a reference for controlling attention beyond its own position. Motivated by this finding, we propose SHRINK, a training-free method that partially reduces sink-aligned components across visible keys during generation. On nine benchmarks under sampled reasoning, it improves mean accuracy by 5.1 and 2.7 percentage points on LLaVA-OneVision-7B and Qwen2.5-VL-3B, with smaller gains on the other two main models, Qwen2.5-VL-7B and Gemma-3-4B. Beyond SHRINK, rescaling sink-aligned key components can replace the attention operations of two existing attention-steering methods, GIFT and ACG, with comparable accuracy on hallucination benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文研究视觉语言模型(VLM)中"注意力汇(attention sink)"键方向的调控作用：放大与原生 sink 键同向的分量会普遍提升对图像与问题 token 的注意力，反向则抑制，且该效应可跨层持续。据此提出免训练的 SHRINK 方法，在生成时部分削减可见键中与 sink 对齐的分量，在九个基准上平均提升 5.1/2.7 个百分点。
AI.motivation: 已有工作只解释了 sink token "为什么"吸引注意力，但未说明 sink 键方向"如何"影响对其他 token 的注意力分配，也缺少一种免训练、可外部干预的注意力控制手段。
AI.method: 对四个 VLM 做探针实验，沿原生 sink 键方向分解其他可见键的分量，分别放大正、负分量观察注意力变化；以此发现为基础提出 SHRINK：免训练，在解码时对可见键中与 sink 对齐的分量做部分缩减。另证明通过重缩放 sink 对齐键分量可替代 GIFT 与 ACG 的注意力操作。
AI.result: 放大正 sink 对齐分量提升平均注意力、放大负分量降低，效应持续到较深网络层；SHRINK 在九个采样推理基准上使 LLaVA-OneVision-7B 与 Qwen2.5-VL-3B 平均准确率分别提升 5.1 与 2.7 个百分点，Qwen2.5-VL-7B 与 Gemma-3-4B 增益较小；在幻觉基准上以重缩放替代 GIFT/ACG 的注意力算子可取得相当精度。
AI.conclusion: sink 键方向可作为控制注意力的全局参考坐标，SHRINK 提供了无需训练的注意力干预手段，并统一解释了部分既有注意力引导方法的机理。(注：文中 "sampled reasoning" 疑为 "sampled decoding" 类笔误，需查原文确认。)

title: RageVLA: Augmentation-Trained Perception and Action for State-of-the-Art Robustness on LIBERO
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models look saturated on LIBERO, yet most of them fall apart on LIBERO-PRO as soon as an object moves or the instruction asks for something new. We argue that what is missing is not scale but decoupling. In these policies, what to do is tied to where things were during training, to the scene around them and to the wording of the instruction. We cut these ties in two places. In the data, LIBERO demonstrations are re-arranged by general rules: every object and fixture is moved and rotated, tasks are carried into other environments and onto other surfaces, and every instruction is paraphrased. In the policy, a perception engine on frozen DINOv3 features, trained on this augmented data, hands the action model the scene in decoupled form: a list of objects with their positions, and a compact code of what the gripper is looking at, next to image and instruction embeddings from TinyCLIP. A flow-matching diffusion transformer, trained from scratch, acts on this view. We call this combination of Robust Augmentation and Grounded Encoding RageVLA. With 0.21 billion parameters, RageVLA sets a new state of the art on LIBERO-PRO among VLA policies, scoring 0.72 against 0.53 for the best published model, and a larger variant reaches 0.73. Two further tests on LIBERO-Object show that the policy acts on what it perceives. When the object positions it is given are shuffled while the camera images stay correct, its success falls from 0.965 to 0.215. When the target object is displaced by 28 cm, it still succeeds in 0.865 of the episodes, where $\pi_{0.5}$, run through the same harness, succeeds in 0.105.

AI.tldr: RageVLA用"解耦"而非"扩大规模"解决VLA在LIBERO-PRO上的泛化崩溃：数据侧按通用规则重排演示（物体移动旋转、任务跨环境跨台面迁移、指令改写），策略侧用冻结DINOv3特征的感知引擎输出解耦的场景表示（物体列表+位置、夹爪注视目标的紧凑编码），再由从零训练的流匹配扩散Transformer执行。0.21B参数下LIBERO-PRO得分0.72（此前最佳0.53），大模型变体0.73；LIBERO-Object扰动实验证明其确实依赖所感知的位置信息。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA在LIBERO上看似已饱和，但在LIBERO-PRO上一旦物体位置改变或指令表述变化就迅速失效。作者认为缺的不是规模，而是解耦：当前策略把"做什么"与训练时的物体位置、周围场景布局以及指令措辞耦合在一起。
AI.method: 在两个层面切断耦合。(1) 数据侧：对LIBERO演示按通用规则重排——每个物体与固定装置均被移动和旋转，任务被迁移到其他环境和台面，所有指令被改写。(2) 策略侧：基于冻结DINOv3特征的感知引擎在该增强数据上训练，向动作模型提供解耦表示——物体列表及其位置、夹爪当前注视目标的紧凑码，并与TinyCLIP的图像与指令嵌入并列；动作模型为从零训练的flow-matching diffusion transformer。组合称为RageVLA（Robust Augmentation and Grounded Encoding）。
AI.result: 0.21B参数下LIBERO-PRO达0.72 SOTA（最佳已发表模型0.53），更大变体0.73。LIBERO-Object两项消融：相机图像正确但给定物体位置被打乱时，成功率由0.965降至0.215；目标物体位移28 cm时成功率0.865，而π₀.₅在同一测试框架下仅0.105。
AI.conclusion: VLA的鲁棒泛化瓶颈在于表示与数据层面的耦合，而非模型规模；通用规则式演示重排加上显式接地的解耦场景表示，可在小参数量下显著提升分布偏移下的成功率。位置扰动实验表明策略确实依据所感知的物体位置行动（可解释的接地行为），而非仅利用图像纹理捷径。

title: ORGANIC3D: Grounding 3D CT Vision Language Models in Organ Level Image Text Coupling
summary: Vision language models (VLMs) have achieved strong performance in 3D computed tomography (CT) classification, but high accuracy does not reflect whether their predictions rely on the correct anatomical evidence. We introduce ORGANIC3D, a framework for evaluating and improving organ level image text alignment through controlled anatomical interventions. Our benchmark assesses 12 vision encoder checkpoints and 7 generative VLMs using matched patient comparisons, organ erasure, lesion replacement, and laterality perturbations, revealing substantial alignment failures even among top performing models. To learn organ level image text correspondence, ORGANIC3D aligns each finding sentence with the anatomy aware image features and trains on edited scans to anchor this alignment in the organ's image evidence. We further extend this framework to generative VLMs, promoting evidence dependent question answering and report generation. Trained exclusively on public data, ORGANIC3D achieves SOTA classification AUROC on CTRATE, Merlin, and the heldout RADChestCT dataset and reaches 77% laterality accuracy, compared with at most 66% for prior models. Its generative VLM matches or exceeds all evaluated publicly released VLMs on visual question answering, achieves the highest report accuracy, and retracts 96 to 99% of target organ findings after organ removal, versus a maximum of 69% for other models. Together, these results establish ORGANIC3D as a framework for testing whether 3D CT vision language models ground their predictions in anatomical evidence and for improving organ level alignment alongside predictive accuracy.

AI.tldr: ORGANIC3D：通过器官擦除、病灶替换、左右侧扰动等解剖干预，评测并改进3D CT视觉-语言模型的器官级图像-文本对齐，使生成式VLM的证据依赖性与分类AUROC同时提升。
AI.motivation: 现有3D CT分类VLM准确率高，但无法判断预测是否依赖正确解剖证据；需构造受控解剖干预基准来暴露器官级图文对齐失败。
AI.method: 构建基准评测12个视觉编码器与7个生成式VLM；采用配对患者比较、器官擦除、病灶替换、左右侧扰动；将每条发现句与解剖感知图像特征对齐，并在编辑后扫描上训练；扩展到生成式VLM的VQA与报告生成以促进证据依赖回答。
AI.result: 仅用公开数据，在CTRATE、Merlin与留出集RADChestCT上取得SOTA AUROC；左右侧准确率77%（此前最高66%）；VQA持平或优于已公开VLM，报告准确率最高；器官移除后撤回96–99%相关发现（其他模型最高69%）。
AI.conclusion: ORGANIC3D提供了检验3D CT VLM是否基于解剖证据的评测框架，并在保持/提升预测精度的同时改善器官级对齐；属医学影像领域，方法思路可迁移至具身感知的证据接地评测。

title: RESCUE Jumper: A Centimeter-Scale Rolling and Jumping Robot for Search and Rescue
comment: 8 pages, 9 figures, IEEE International Symposium on Safety, Security, and Rescue Robotics 2026, Best Paper Award
summary: Centimeter-scale robots are promising for urban search and rescue because they can enter confined spaces that are inaccessible or unsafe for humans. However, their small size limits obstacle traversal after deployment. This paper presents the RESCUE Jumper, a 125 g mobile robot with a 6.2 cm width and 6.2 cm diameter wheels that combines ground rolling with jumping to traverse steps and gaps that exceeds its rolling capability. The RESCUE Jumper uses its two actuators for both rolling mode and jumping by reversing the direction of wheel motion. Forward wheel motion enables rolling, while reverse wheel motion winds a spring steel tail to store elastic potential energy and release it for jumping. The RESCUE Jumper varies tail winding speed to control jump direction, transitioning from backward to forward jumps as winding speed increases from 0.75 rad/s to 8.73 rad/s. The launch angle of the jumps ranges from 45 degree to -11 degree with respect to the vertical axis, reaching a maximum height of 9.2 cm and a maximum lateral displacement of 11.2 cm. We model the winding speed-dependent jumping behavior in three phases: tail release to determine the contact point and robot orientation, tail straightening until liftoff, and ballistic flight to predict jump height and lateral displacement. Finally, qualitative tests highlight the robot's locomotion in cluttered, real-world environments. The model and experiments presented in this work can inform future designs of space-constrained jump mechanisms in centimeter-scale robots for search and rescue and inspection in unstructured environments.

AI.tldr: 125克厘米级轮式机器人通过反转轮向卷绕弹簧钢尾实现跳跃，用双执行器兼顾滚动与跳跃，可跨越台阶与沟壑。
AI.motivation: 厘米级机器人体积小、能进入人类难以到达的狭小空间用于搜救，但尺寸小导致越障能力差，需在有限体积内兼顾地面滚动与跳跃越障。
AI.method: RESCUE Jumper（宽6.2 cm，轮径6.2 cm，125 g）用两个执行器同时驱动机器人的滚动与跳跃：轮子正转实现滚动，反转则卷绕弹簧钢尾储存弹性势能并释放起跳；通过调节卷绕速度（0.75–8.73 rad/s）改变跳跃方向。
AI.result: 跳跃方向随卷绕速度由后跳转为前跳，起跳角相对竖直轴由45°变至-11°，最大跳高9.2 cm，最大横向位移11.2 cm；并提出三阶段模型（尾部释放确定接触点与姿态、尾伸直至离地、弹道飞行）预测跳高与横向位移，另在杂乱真实环境中做了定性验证。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为厘米级机器人受限空间跳跃机构设计提供建模与实验参考，适用于搜救与非结构化环境巡检。

title: Stability of Parallel Transport Convolution under Riemannian Metric Perturbations
summary: Geometric convolutions on Riemannian manifolds depend on the geometry of the underlying domain, making stability under metric perturbations a fundamental question in geometric deep learning. This paper studies this question for parallel transport convolution through methods from differential geometry and analysis. On a fixed compact manifold, we establish that, for a continuous input signal and a continuous reference kernel supported in a sufficiently small normal neighborhood, the convolution output depends continuously in $L^2$ on the Riemannian metric in the $C^2$-topology, under the specified localization and transport-path conventions. The analysis develops perturbation estimates for geodesics, parallel transport, Jacobi fields, and exponential maps, and uses these estimates to compare the transported kernels. A central difficulty is the cut locus, which obstructs uniform comparison of the transport construction over the entire manifold. We address this difficulty by combining uniform estimates away from the cut locus with integral bounds on neighborhoods of arbitrarily small volume, while also controlling the change in the Riemannian volume measure. The resulting qualitative stability theorem connects perturbation theory for Riemannian geometric constructions with the analysis of spatial convolution operators in geometric deep learning.

AI.tldr: 该文用微分几何与分析工具研究“平行移动卷积”对黎曼度量扰动的稳定性：在固定紧流形上，对连续输入信号与支撑于足够小法邻域的连续参考核，证明卷积输出在L²范数下随度量在C²拓扑中的变化而连续依赖于度量。
AI.motivation: 几何卷积天然依赖底层流形的几何，因此“度量扰动下的稳定性”是几何深度学习的基础性问题，但此前缺乏严格理论刻画；作者希望为平行移动卷积建立定性稳定性定理。
AI.method: 建立测地线、平行移动、Jacobi场与指数映射的扰动估计，用以比较度量变化前后的“被传输核”；针对割迹（cut locus）导致无法在整个流形上均匀比较传输构造这一核心困难，采用“远离割迹的一致估计＋任意小体积邻域上的积分界”相结合的策略，并控制黎曼体积测度的变化。
AI.result: 得到稳定性定理：在给定的局部化与传输路径约定下，卷积算子输出在L²中对黎曼度量（C²拓扑）连续依赖，即度量的小扰动仅引起输出的微小L²变化。
AI.conclusion: 将黎曼几何构造的扰动理论与几何深度学习中的空间卷积算子分析联系起来，为几何卷积的鲁棒性/稳定性提供理论依据，但属于纯定性理论结果，未涉及具体网络实现或实验验证。

title: Layer-Matched Sparse Attention for Low-Redundancy 3D Reconstruction
summary: VGGT reconstructs cameras and geometry from unposed images in one pass, but its global attention grows quadratically with the number of views. Training-free accelerators thin this attention and work well on redundant video, but lose pose accuracy when views share little geometry. This paper traces these losses to two kinds of cross-view information that a uniform sparse approximation can fail to preserve together: diffuse layers aggregate distributed context, whereas matching layers depend on query-specific interactions that carry little attention mass. A per-layer statistic measures the log-mass missed by a mean token. Its row-free proxy is the logit variance, and it selects the estimator for each layer. Diffuse layers use shared, importance-sampled hub keys, with log-weights that make the softmax numerator and denominator unbiased. Matching layers stay exact: every aggressive thinning tested cost accuracy. At equal cost, the selected layers outperform the four shifted windows tested. On 13 unseen low-redundancy scenes with 32 views, LMSA stays within 1.4 AUC@5 of dense attention, compared with 10.3 for AVGGT and 4.5 for SAF3R; its difference from contemporaneous GPA-VGGT is not significant, and only its gains over AVGGT pass both scene-level tests. With 100 views, it stays within 1.9 AUC@5 while its aggregator runs $2.0\times$ faster. Used post hoc to choose the layers GPA-VGGT protects, the statistic improves it by 1.2 AUC@5 for 5% more FLOPs. Applied untuned to $\pi^3$, it beats AVGGT but remains further from dense accuracy.

AI.tldr: LMSA 通过逐层 logit 方差统计区分"弥散层"与"匹配层"，对弥散层用重要性采样的共享 hub key 做无偏稀疏近似、对匹配层保持精确注意力，在低冗余场景下把 VGGT 类全局注意力的训练无关加速做到接近稠密精度且 100 视图时聚合器快 2.0×。
AI.motivation: VGGT 单次前向即可从未定位图像重建相机与几何，但其全局注意力随视图数二次增长。现有训练无关加速器（AVGGT、SAF3R 等）在冗余视频上有效，却在视图几何共享少时显著掉位姿精度；作者认为根因是全局的均匀稀疏近似无法同时保住两类跨视图信息。
AI.method: 提出逐层统计量——用平均 token 漏掉的 log-mass 度量该层偏向"弥散"还是"匹配"，并以无行的代理量（logit 方差）为每层选择估计器。弥散层采用重要性采样的共享 hub key，配合 log 权重使 softmax 分子与分母无偏；匹配层（依赖 query 特异的交互、注意力质量小）保持精确计算，不做任何抽稀。此外该统计量可事后用于为 GPA-VGGT 挑选需保护的层。
AI.result: 13 个未见低冗余场景、32 视图下，LMSA 与稠密注意力差距 1.4 AUC@5，AVGGT 为 10.3、SAF3R 为 4.5；与同期 GPA-VGGT 差异不显著，仅对 AVGGT 的优势通过两项场景级检验。100 视图时差距 1.9 AUC@5，聚合器快 2.0×。等成本下所选层优于测试的四种移位窗口。事后用于 GPA-VGGT 选层可提升 1.2 AUC@5、FLOPs 仅增 5%。未调参移植到 π³ 上优于 AVGGT 但仍离稠密精度较远。
AI.conclusion: 跨视图信息在功能上并非同质，可区分为需保留的 query 特异匹配与可安全聚合的弥散上下文；用逐层统计量做选择性稀疏化是训练无关加速前馈式 3D 重建的可行且高效的路径，但对其他重建主干的可迁移性仍需调优。

title: Learning the Dynamics of Deformable Linear Objects Through Coupled Oscillators for Bimanual Robotic Manipulation
summary: Many learning-based approaches for deformable linear objects (DLOs) rely on simplified deformation models that neglect dynamic effects and the mechanical response of the objects, limiting their applicability to lightweight, compliant objects and slow motions. Inspired by recent advances in learning physically structured dynamics with coupled oscillator networks (CONs), we propose $\Phi$-CON for learning force-driven DLO dynamics. The model combines a floating-base coupled oscillator network (FBCON), whose latent potential energy depends only on the DLO's shape, with a learned affine diffeomorphism $\Phi$ between observed positions along the DLO and latent coordinates. Its shape dynamics are stable by construction, and its Lagrangian structure yields explicit expressions for kinetic and potential energy. We exploit this structure to design a model-based proportional-derivative (PD) controller that compensates for the learned potential forces, thereby establishing closed-loop stability guarantees and ensuring convergence. We evaluate the approach on four simulated DLOs and a real bimanual robot setup. In simulation, $\Phi$-CON achieves prediction accuracy comparable to neural ordinary differential equation (NODE) models and Lagrangian neural networks (LNNs), with $97.2\%$ and $90.2\%$ fewer parameters, respectively. Relative to a model-free PD baseline, the proposed controller reduces mean endpoint regulation error by $97.5$-$99.7\%$ in simulation and achieves a mean per-target reduction of $27.9\%$ across both endpoints in real-world experiments, demonstrating the importance of explicitly accounting for the mechanical response of stiff and heavy objects.

AI.tldr: 提出Φ-CON：将浮动基耦合振子网络(FBCON)与学习到的仿射微分同胚Φ结合，学习受力驱动的可变形线性物体(DLO)动力学，具有拉格朗日结构与构造性稳定，并据此设计模型PD控制器
AI.motivation: 现有学习型DLO方法多用简化变形模型，忽略动态效应与物体力学响应，仅适用于轻质柔性物体与慢速运动
AI.method: FBCON（潜势能仅依赖DLO形状）+ 观测坐标与潜坐标间的仿射微分同胚Φ；形状动力学构造性稳定，拉格朗日结构给出显式动能/势能；基于该结构设计补偿学习势能力的前馈PD控制器并获得闭环稳定性与收敛保证
AI.result: 仿真4种DLO与真实双臂机器人平台：预测精度与NODE、LNN相当，参数量分别减少97.2%与90.2%；相对无模型PD基线，仿真端点平均调节误差降低97.5–99.7%，真机在两端点平均每目标降低27.9%
AI.conclusion: 显式建模刚硬、重型物体的力学响应对力驱动DLO控制至关重要，结构化物理学习+模型控制器可显著提升精度与稳定性

title: Panini- Feasible Grammar For Robot Designs
summary: Symbolic methods make robot designs interpretable but often overlook continuous geometry; learned methods handle geometry but offer less transparent structure. We introduce a typed production grammar that uses case-role relations, parameter inheritance, and specificity-based rule arbitration to generate both manipulation skills and robot morphologies. A geometric realization map translates grammar composition into transformations in SE(3), behaving as a monoid homomorphism when inheritance is inactive and exhibiting a measurable defect when inheritance is enabled. The grammar provides a compact representation, and its arbitration decisions can be recovered from geometric containment (agreement 0.905 +/- 0.062 across 10 seeds, versus 0.611 +/- 0.090 for a Euclidean control). We also introduce PANINI, a cross-entropy search method over grammar-based morphology representations. Across 30 methods and 24 seeds, PANINI achieves the best mean rank but is not statistically distinguishable from strong generic optimizers. Its main demonstrated advantage is therefore structural rather than optimization performance: grammar-generated designs are legal by construction, and coordinated limb placement produces 95% jointly feasible edits, compared with 55% for range-constrained resampling and none for flat parameterization in 6,000 draws. These results show how typed grammars can make robot generation more interpretable and geometrically coordinated, without implying that every feasible design will locomote or that grammar-based search universally outperforms generic optimizers.

AI.tldr: 提出带类型的产生式文法（case-role关系、参数继承、基于具体度的规则仲裁）统一生成操作技能与机器人形态，并给出SE(3)几何实现映射（继承关闭时为幺半群同态，开启时出现可测缺陷），另提出基于文法形态表示的交叉熵搜索PANINI。
AI.motivation: 符号方法可解释但忽略连续几何；学习方法擅长几何但结构不透明。作者希望用一种兼具可解释结构与几何一致性的表示，统一刻画机器人形态与操作技能的生成。
AI.method: 带类型产生式文法：case-role关系 + 参数继承 + 基于具体度的规则仲裁；几何实现映射将文法组合映射为SE(3)变换，分析其在继承开启/关闭下的代数性质（同态性与缺陷）；PANINI：在文法形态表示空间上的交叉熵搜索优化器；与30种方法×24个种子的基线对比，并用6000次采样评估编辑可行性。
AI.result: 仲裁决策可由几何包含关系恢复（一致性0.905±0.062 vs 欧氏控制0.611±0.090，10个种子）；PANINI在30种方法、24个种子中平均排名最佳但与强通用优化器无统计显著差异；文法生成设计天然合法，协同肢体放置产生95%联合可行编辑，范围约束重采样为55%，平坦参数化为0%。
AI.conclusion: 带类型文法可提升机器人生成的几何协调性与可解释性，但其优势主要体现在结构性（合法性、联合可行性）而非优化性能，也不能保证所有可行设计可运动。

title: LuxTac: A Flexible, Scalable, and Open-Source Optical Taxel Array with Distributed Three-Axis Force Sensing for Tactile Robot Learning
comment: 11 pages, 9 figures, 5 tables. Project page: this https URL
summary: Low-cost tactile arrays have made touch a practical input for robot learning, but piezoresistive designs sense only pressure, while camera-based sensors that also resolve shear are too bulky to tile over a gripper. To solve this problem, we present LuxTac, a flexible, scalable optical taxel array, about 3.5 mm thick and built from off-the-shelf parts. Each taxel is a digital RGBC light-to-digital converter under a translucent white silicone layer capped by an opaque black film, so the back-scattered LED light falls monotonically with local indentation depth.
