The same board accepts two interchangeable gel cartridges: a plain one for normal sensing, and one with colored walls that encodes the local shear in the color of the returned light, with no camera, magnets, or bump overlay, making LuxTac, to our knowledge, the first optical taxel array to resolve shear at individual taxels. Characterized with an automated CNC indenter and a six-axis force/torque sensor, the normal cartridge responds linearly to force ($R^2$ = 0.999) from 104 mN to at least 5.8 N, with 2.0% repeatability, 5.9% hysteresis, and a taxel-to-taxel variation of 6-10% after normalization. With the shear cartridge, per-taxel models estimate the three-axis force at every taxel; across three indenter shapes and nine held-out sessions, the summed estimates reach $R^2$ = 0.96/0.96/0.92 in x/y/z, each taxel's estimate 0.92/0.93/0.94, and the median shear-direction error is 4.8 degrees. Adding LuxTac pressure readings to an Action Chunking Transformer policy substantially improves peg-in-hole success over a vision-only baseline. Design files, code, and videos are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: LuxTac：基于数字RGBC光-数字转换器的柔性可扩展光学触觉阵列（约3.5mm厚），无需相机即可在单个taxel上分辨三轴力与剪切，并验证其在VLA策略中提升装配成功率。
AI.motivation: 低成本压阻阵列只能测法向压力，而可测剪切的相机式光学触觉传感器体积过大，无法在夹爪表面高密度铺贴；因此需要一种薄型、可扩展、可分辨剪切的触觉阵列。
AI.method: 每个taxel为半透明白硅胶层（上覆不透明黑膜）下的数字RGBC光-数字转换器，利用背散射光强随压入深度单调下降测法向力；同一电路板可换装两种胶垫：普通型与带彩色侧壁型，后者通过回传光的颜色编码局部剪切，无需相机、磁体或凸点覆盖层。用CNC压头和六轴力/扭矩传感器标定，并以每个taxel的模型估计三轴力。
AI.result: 法向胶垫在104 mN至≥5.8 N范围内线性度R²=0.999，重复性2.0%，迟滞5.9%，归一化后taxel间差异6–10%。剪切胶垫在三种压头形状、九个未见会话上，求和估计x/y/z R²=0.96/0.96/0.92，单taxel 0.92/0.93/0.94，剪切方向中位误差4.8°。将LuxTac压力读数接入Action Chunking Transformer策略，插销入孔成功率显著优于纯视觉基线。
AI.conclusion: LuxTac以低成本商用器件实现薄型、可扩展、单taxel级剪切分辨的光学触觉阵列；设计文件、代码与视频已开源，可直接用于机器人触觉感知与策略学习。

title: DOCK: Dual-Stream-Inspired Self-Supervised Object-Centric Representations Grounded in Robot Kinematics
summary: Latent-space planners select actions by comparing the embedding of a predicted future image with that of a goal image. This assumes that distance in the embedding reflects how far the scene is from the goal. We profile this assumption with simulator-executed futures, which removes prediction error. For six frozen DINO and V-JEPA encoders, feature distance barely tracks the object's distance to its goal: the rank correlation is at most 0.11, against 0.87 for object-mask centroids. It is dominated by background and robot patches, and frozen-feature readouts capture the arm far better than the object. Inspired by the ventral (what) and dorsal (where/how) visual streams, we propose DOCK, which learns an object representation whose changes agree with measured physical motion. A grasped object moves with the gripper, so forward kinematics on the joint angles gives a proxy for the object's displacement without annotation. From 9,951 held-object transport trajectories in 21 simulated kitchen scenes, we mine 404K displacement pairs and train three components: an object token pooled from patch features (what), a spatial ruler that makes differences of readout coordinates equal to measured displacements (where), and a dynamics predictor over object tokens (how). Used as a planning cost, the learned representation places the object in 15 of 21 tasks, as many as an oracle that reads the true object position, while mask geometry reaches 10 and frozen feature distance 9. It still solves the most tasks when the unseen robot arm is visible, and its ranking transfers to held-out layouts with unseen object instances and categories without any adaptation.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出，潜空间规划器默认“嵌入距离≈接近目标的程度”，但作者用仿真中真实执行得到未来帧（排除预测误差）后实测发现，6个冻结DINO/V-JEPA编码器的特征距离与物体到目标的距离几乎不相关（Spearman最高仅0.11，而物体掩码质心为0.87），且距离主要由背景与机械臂patch主导。为此提出DOCK：借助前向运动学从关节角给出被抓取物体位移的代理监督，在21个仿真厨房场景的9,951条搬运轨迹上挖掘404K位移对，训练“what（物体token）+ where（把读出坐标差等于实测位移的空间标尺）+ how（token上的动力学预测器）”三部分表示；用作规划代价时，21个任务中15个成功放置物体，达到读取真实物体位置的oracle水平，而掩码几何为10、冻结特征距离为9；在未见机械臂可见、以及未见布局/物体实例与类别的迁移下仍最优。
AI.motivation: 潜空间规划以“预测未来图像嵌入与目标图像嵌入的距离”为代价，隐含假设嵌入空间距离单调反映任务进展。该假设长期缺乏直接检验：以往评估中预测误差与表示误差混在一起。作者用仿真器执行的真实未来帧做“剖面分析”，剥离预测误差，证明冻结视觉编码器的特征距离几乎不携带物体位姿进展信息（被背景与机器人patch主导），从而揭示冻结特征代价函数的根本失效，并据此提出学习任务对齐表示的动机。
AI.method: 1) 诊断：在仿真中执行轨迹，取真实未来帧作为规划器的“完美预测”，对6个冻结编码器（DINO系列、V-JEPA）计算嵌入距离与物体真实到达距离的秩相关，并用patch级消融定位贡献来源（背景/机器人/物体）。2) DOCK训练：受腹侧（what）—背侧（where/how）双流启发，利用“被抓物体随夹爪运动”→由关节角前向运动学得到物体位移的免标注代理标签；从21个仿真厨房场景9,951条持物搬运轨迹中挖掘404K位移对。3) 三组件：object token（从patch特征池化的物体表征，what）；spatial ruler（学习读出坐标，使其差分等于实测位移，where）；dynamics predictor（在object token上预测位移/演化的动力学头，how）。4) 将学习表示的距离作为规划代价，与oracle真实物体位置、掩码几何、冻结特征距离对比，并做未见机械臂可见性、未见布局/物体实例与类别的迁移测试。
AI.result: 诊断：冻结编码器特征距离与物体到目标距离的秩相关上界0.11，物体掩码质心达0.87；距离估计被背景与机器人patch主导，读出结果对机械臂的捕捉远好于物体。规划：DOCK在21个任务中15个完成任务并放置物体，与读取真实物体位置的oracle相当；掩码几何10、冻结特征距离9。鲁棒性：未见机械臂可见时仍解出最多任务；排序在未见布局、未见物体实例与类别上零适配迁移有效。
AI.conclusion: 论文否定“冻结表征的嵌入距离可作为可靠任务进展度量”这一默认前提，说明物体中心的、与物理运动对齐的表示是潜空间规划的关键；提出的DOCK以自监督的运动学代理监督，将what/where/how解耦，得到可用于规划、且具跨布局与跨类别泛化的物体中心代价函数。局限在于证据全部来自仿真厨房场景与持物搬运任务，尚未验证真实机器人部署与更广泛任务形态。

title: ExiST: Existence-Aware Self-Training for Semi-Supervised Multi-Organ Segmentation
summary: Semi-supervised multi-organ segmentation should learn more than a dozen organs from a handful of labeled scans, and the smallest organs occupy less than one percent of the foreground. We identify a failure mode of self-training that is specific to this regime. When a teacher misses a small organ in a scan, every voxel of that organ receives the confident pseudo-label background, and the student is trained toward the organ absence. Repeated over many scans, this loop extinguishes tail organs. In a pilot study, removing the gallbladder from the pseudo-labels reduced its Dice on AMOS from 36.5 to 1.0. We argue that a missing organ should be treated as unresolved rather than absent and propose Existence-aware Self-Training (ExiST). It builds pseudo-labels by leave-one-out consensus of independently trained networks, screens them with a quality gate on validation scans, and infers, per scan and per organ, whether the organ was found. For every unresolved organ, the background voxels of that scan receive the set-valued target, trained with a marginal cross-entropy that accepts either answer and a Dice term that skips uncertain voxels. We show that this loss never pushes a candidate organ toward absence and never favors one member of the set, which leaves the decision to labeled evidence. ExiST outperforms the current state-of-the-art methods and reaches 77.1 mean Dice on Synapse with 20% labeled scans and 75.9 on AMOS with 5% labeled scans.

AI.tldr: 提出 Existence-aware Self-Training (ExiST)：在半监督多器官分割中把"教师漏检的小器官"视为未决而非缺失，通过留一法共识伪标签、质量门控与逐器官存在性推断，对未决器官的背景体素施加集合值目标与边际交叉熵、跳过不确定体素的 Dice，抑制伪标签自训练对尾部器官的灭绝效应，Synapse 20% 标注达 77.1 Dice、AMOS 5% 标注达 75.9。
AI.motivation: 半监督多器官分割需从极少标注扫描中学习十余个器官，最小器官不足前景 1%。作者指出现有自训练的特定失效模式：教师漏检小器官时该器官所有体素被打上高置信背景伪标签，学生被训练向"器官不存在"收敛，多轮迭代后尾部器官被彻底抹除（消融：从伪标签中删除胆囊使 AMOS Dice 从 36.5 降至 1.0）。
AI.method: 1) 用多个独立训练网络做留一法一致（leave-one-out consensus）构建伪标签；2) 在验证扫描上用质量门控筛选伪标签；3) 逐扫描、逐器官推断"是否被找到"；4) 对未决器官，该扫描的背景体素赋予集合值目标，使用接受两个答案中任一者的边际交叉熵，并配合跳过不确定体素的 Dice 项；作者证明该损失既不会把候选器官推向缺失，也不会偏袒集合中任一成员，决策交由有标注证据决定。
AI.result: 在 Synapse（20% 标注扫描）达到 77.1 平均 Dice，在 AMOS（5% 标注扫描）达到 75.9，优于当前 SOTA；消融显示移除胆囊伪标签会使其 Dice 从 36.5 坍塌到 1.0，佐证失效模式。
AI.conclusion: 将"漏检"与"缺失"解耦，用集合值目标和相应损失设计可从机制上阻断自训练对稀有类/小目标的错误抑制，为半监督小目标学习提供了可推广的原则。

title: SPICE: Stochastic Policy for Interaction in Cluttered Environments
summary: Agricultural tasks such as harvesting and pruning require robots to reach through dense foliage, where contact is often unavoidable and vision is obstructed. Intermittent contact creates an imbalance between free-space and contact-rich observations, complicating the learning of contact-responsive behaviours. We present SPICE, a tactileconditioned diffusion policy for reaching targets in dense plant canopies using tactile sensing as the sole environmental feedback. SPICE exhibits three behaviours: moving through compliant foliage, manoeuvring around partially obstructing stems, and manipulating branches that block the target path. To the best of our knowledge, SPICE is the first tactile-conditioned diffusion policy for target reaching through physically cluttered plant canopies. Across over 180 real-robot trials, SPICE was evaluated against tactile-conditioned, image-conditioned, and reactive-control baselines. Spatial tactile information and explicit contact conditioning proved important, with SPICE achieving 95% branch-manoeuvring success versus 45% for the strongest tactile baseline. SPICE also achieved branch manipulation beyond the reactive controller and remained effective under visual occlusion, where the image-conditioned DP failed. Zero-shot transfer across 40 trials on unseen tomato and lime plants achieved 87.5% success rate. These results demonstrate the potential of tactile-conditioned generative policies for interaction in visually occluded plant environments.

AI.tldr: SPICE：首个以触觉为唯一环境反馈的触觉条件扩散策略，用于在密集植被冠层中完成目标到达，展现穿过柔性叶片、绕开部分阻挡茎秆、拨动阻挡枝条三类行为。
AI.motivation: 农业采摘/修剪需机器人穿过密集枝叶，接触不可避免且视觉严重遮挡；间歇性接触导致自由空间与富接触观测分布失衡，使接触响应行为学习困难。
AI.method: 基于扩散策略的触觉条件生成式策略，利用空间触觉信息（接触位置/分布）作为显式条件信号，不用相机；通过触觉反馈在线调整末端轨迹，应对柔性叶片、茎秆与枝条三类接触情形。
AI.result: 180+ 次真机试验：枝条绕行成功率 95% vs 最强触觉基线 45%；具备基线反应式控制器不具备的枝条拨动能力；视觉遮挡下仍有效而图像条件 DP 失败；对 40 次未见番茄与青柠植株的零样本迁移成功率达 87.5%。
AI.conclusion: 触觉条件生成式策略在视觉遮挡的植物环境中具有显著优势，空间触觉信息与显式接触条件化是关键设计。

title: Recoverability, Not Invariance: Certified Safety for Robots at the Limits of Performance
comment: For our supplementary video, see this https URL
summary: Safety certification in robotics typically rests on forward invariance of the deployed controller, a property that demands high-fidelity models at the edge of the operating envelope, exactly where models are least reliable and robots perform best. As a result, many of the behaviors we most want robots to run, from learned policies to aggressive maneuvers at the limits of traction, cannot be certified at all. We introduce recoverability, a contraction-theoretic safety concept that resolves this tension by certifying a robot's ability to reengage a trusted recovery mode rather than the invariance of a deployed behavior. We prove that switching to the recovery mode from anywhere inside a certified tube guarantees exponential convergence, even under disturbances and model error. To decide when to switch, we derive the contraction insertion gradient, the first-order effect of a recovery insertion on the certificate, and embed it in a switching-time program in which feasibility alone guarantees safety and optimality only shapes performance. To supply the certificates, we develop sequential convex synthesis that monotonically grows the certified tube toward the exact viability kernel. We validate our approach in simulated quadrotor flight through uncertain obstacles, where it outperforms invariance-based safety filters, and in hardware deployments aboard a full-scale IndyNXT autonomous racecar, where it repeatedly recovers the car from an aggressive raceline at the limits of handling in the rain. Recoverability provides a certified exit strategy, extending formal safety guarantees to aggressive, learned, and experimental behaviors without requiring their invariance.

AI.tldr: 提出"可恢复性"(recoverability)安全概念：不再要求部署策略本身前向不变，而是认证机器人能从任意位置切换回可信恢复模式的能力；给出收缩插入梯度与保障安全的切换时间程序，并用序列凸综合逐步扩张认证管趋近精确可行核。
AI.motivation: 机器人安全认证通常依赖部署控制器的前向不变性，需在工况边缘提供高保真模型——而这恰是模型最不可靠、机器人性能最好的区域。导致学习策略、极限附着激进机动等最想要的行为根本无法被认证。
AI.method: 1) 基于收缩理论定义 recoverability：认证的是"能否重新接回可信恢复模式"而非部署行为的不变性，并证明在认证管(tube)内任意点切换可保证指数收敛（含扰动与模型误差）；2) 推导 contraction insertion gradient，即插入恢复对证书的一阶影响，嵌入切换时间规划程序，使可行性单独即保证安全、最优性仅影响性能；3) 序列凸综合(sequential convex synthesis)单调扩张认证管以逼近精确 viability kernel。
AI.result: 仿真四旋翼在不确定障碍中飞行优于基于不变性的安全滤波器；在全尺寸 IndyNXT 自动驾驶赛车实车部署中，雨中反复从极限操控的激进 raceline 成功恢复。
AI.conclusion: recoverability 提供了一种"认证退出策略"，将形式化安全保证扩展到激进、学习型与实验性行为，而无需这些行为满足不变性约束。

title: GRAFT: Graph-Regularized Prototype Fields for Realistic Test-Time Adaptation of VLMs
summary: Unlabeled test data can improve the zero-shot classifier of a vision-language model, yet transductive and test-time adaptation methods often fall below the zero-shot baseline when only a few vocabulary classes are present in a batch or when streams are correlated. We trace this failure to a shared design: every class owns independent parameters estimated from its own samples, so absent or rare classes are left at biased text anchors or fitted to foreign samples. We propose Graph-Regularized Anchor-displacement Field Transduction (GRAFT), which models the adapted prototypes as text anchors plus a displacement field that is partially pooled over a semantic class graph through a Gaussian Markov random field prior, together with an explicit class-presence model. Inference is closed-form and gradient-free on cached features. Anchor-only shrinkage and a single global shift are the two extreme settings of the prior; absent classes are provably harmonic extensions of the present ones, and the pooling strength can be chosen by empirical Bayes. Under the realistic batch and online protocols on eleven benchmarks and four ImageNet shifts, GRAFT improves over the zero-shot model in every setting and over anchor-based transduction where few classes are present.

AI.tldr: GRAFT 提出图正则锚点位移场转导方法：把适配原型建模为文本锚点加位移场，并通过高斯马尔可夫随机场先验在语义类图上部分池化，配合显式类别存在模型；推理为闭式、无梯度。
AI.motivation: 现有转导/测试时自适应在批内类别稀少或数据流相关时会低于零样本基线，根因是每个类独立估计参数，缺失/稀有类停留在有偏文本锚点或被外来样本拟合。
AI.method: 以文本锚点加位移场表示适配原型，对位移场施加基于语义类图的高斯马尔可夫随机场先验做部分池化，并建模类别存在概率；在缓存特征上闭式无梯度求解，池化强度可用经验贝叶斯选择。
AI.result: 在 11 个基准与 4 个 ImageNet 偏移设定、现实批次与在线协议下，GRAFT 在所有设置均优于零样本模型；在类别稀少的批次中优于基于锚点的转导方法。
AI.conclusion: 类条件参数耦合（而非独立）是低类别批次稳健自适应的关键；锚点收缩与单一全局平移是先验的两个极端，缺失类可由在场类的调和延拓恢复。

title: Entropy-Regularized Integrated Gradients for Stable Feature Attribution
comment: 36 pages, 19 figures, 27 tables, including the appendix
summary: Path-based attribution methods like Integrated Gradients (IG) are widely used to interpret neural networks, yet imperceptible input perturbations can drastically alter their attribution maps while leaving model predictions unchanged. We introduce Entropy-Regularized Integrated Gradients (ERIG), a path-based attribution method that intrinsically attenuates gradient irregularities along the integration path using maximum-entropy softmax weighting with temperature parameter $\tau$. We quantify the effect of the entropy-regularized weighting on attribution stability by using the Lipschitz properties of the model and its gradients. We decompose the attribution change under an input perturbation into a model-response term, whose bound is $\tau$-independent, and a weight-variation term, whose bound decreases at rate $\mathcal{O}(1/(2\tau))$. Their ratio $R(\tau)$ characterizes the trade-off between gradient information and attribution stability. We further add a new dimension to attribution evaluation by adapting classical noise estimators into two metrics, LINV-C and LINV-P, that quantify attribution noise. Across eleven CNN and Transformer backbones on ImageNet and Oxford-IIIT Pet datasets, our experiments show that, relative to the next-best method, ERIG remains comparable on ranking-based fidelity metrics while improving localization by approximately 24% and attribution stability by approximately 47-fold on average, reaching up to four orders of magnitude improvement over IG, all at negligible additional computational cost.

AI.tldr: 提出熵正则化积分梯度（ERIG），用最大熵 softmax 加权抑制积分路径上的梯度不规则性，并在理论上用 Lipschitz 性质界定归因稳定性，同时引入 LINV-C/LINV-P 噪声指标。
AI.motivation: 基于路径的归因方法（如 IG）虽广泛用于解释神经网络，但微小且不可感知的输入扰动会显著改变归因图而模型预测不变，说明归因结果不稳定，缺乏鲁棒性保证。
AI.method: 在积分路径上引入带温度参数 τ 的最大熵 softmax 加权，从内在层面平滑梯度不规则性；利用模型及梯度的 Lipschitz 性质将扰动下的归因变化分解为 τ 无关的模型响应项与以 O(1/(2τ)) 速率收敛的权重变化项，并以比值 R(τ) 刻画梯度信息与归因稳定性的权衡；另将经典噪声估计器改造为 LINV-C 与 LINV-P 两个归因噪声度量。
AI.result: 在 ImageNet 与 Oxford-IIIT Pet 上、11 个 CNN 与 Transformer 骨干的实验中，相比次优方法，ERIG 在排序类保真度指标上相当，定位性能提升约 24%，归因稳定性平均提升约 47 倍，相对 IG 最高可达四个数量级，额外计算开销可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 通过最大熵加权可在几乎不损失保真度、几乎不增加成本的前提下大幅提升路径归因的稳定性，并给出理论界与可量化的噪声评价指标，为可解释性方法的鲁棒性提供了原理性设计思路。

title: VIBRA: Backward-Compatible Cross-Modal Retrieval with Consensus Barycenters
summary: Backward-compatible retrieval enables a new encoder to query the gallery that an old model has already encoded, so that a cross-modal retrieval system can be upgraded without re-encoding billions of items. Existing compatible methods either fit the old query and stay near the accuracy of the old model, or run the old and the new encoder for every query. We propose VIBRA, which matches relevance on the old gallery, corrects the errors of a single model with the barycenter of several views, which is itself a query in the old space, and trains the new encoder to inherit this consensus, so that models absent at deployment still shape every query. We show that the barycenter gains margin over the average of its views exactly when their hardest irrelevant items differ, and we characterize the share of this gain that one encoder can reach. On five benchmarks with five upgrades among six CLIP, MetaCLIP and SigLIP2 backbones, VIBRA is the best compatible method in all 50 settings, improving Recall@1 by up to 5.6 points over the strongest baseline and by up to 18.0 points over the old model, while adding less than 1 ms to the latency of the new encoder.

AI.tldr: VIBRA提出向后兼容检索框架：用旧模型空间中的多视图重心作为共识查询，训练新编码器继承该共识，从而在无需重编码画廊的前提下显著提升跨模态检索精度。
AI.motivation: 跨模态检索系统升级时，若更换编码器需重编码数十亿图库项，代价极高。现有兼容方法要么仅拟合旧查询、精度受限于旧模型，要么部署时同时运行新旧编码器、延迟翻倍。作者希望在不增加推理负担的情况下超越旧模型精度。
AI.method: VIBRA在旧画廊上匹配相关性：以若干视图（多个模型/增强）在旧空间中的表示重心构造"共识查询"，作为旧空间中的查询点；理论分析表明，当各视图最难负样本不同时，重心相对视图平均能获得间隔增益，并刻画了单个编码器可继承该增益的比例；随后训练新编码器在旧空间中回归/对齐这一共识，使部署时缺席的模型仍能影响每次查询。
AI.result: 在CLIP、MetaCLIP、SigLIP2共6个backbone、5种升级组合、5个基准共50个设置中全部取得最佳兼容效果；Recall@1较最强基线提升最高5.6点，较旧模型提升最高18.0点，新增延迟小于1 ms。
AI.conclusion: 多视图共识可蒸馏为单一新编码器，实现"零重编码、零额外延迟"的向后兼容检索升级，是当前兼容检索的最优方案。

title: Weight Space Programming for Vision Language Model Repair
summary: In weight-space programming, a language model edits a network's weights directly, without gradients. We ask what a successful repair of this kind relies on. We plant faults in the weights of two vision-language models, SmolVLM-256M and LFM2-VL-450M, and check each edit made by a coding agent against the original weights. Without being told where to look, the agent finds rescaled rows in the projector and noise in the vision encoder of both models, infers the unknown scale factors, restores most or all of the rescaled weights to their exact original values, and returns accuracy to near its original level; programs that it writes from such weights repair unseen checkpoints of the same model without feedback. These repairs depend on a trace of how the faults were computed. The original weights have 16-bit precision, and faults computed in 32-bit arithmetic leave low bits that only the damaged weights carry. Rounding those bits away leaves each model's answers to our test questions unchanged, and the agent, unaided, then restores no weight exactly: on SmolVLM it no longer finds the damage, and in a single session on LFM2-VL its only gain comes from rescaling answer-token embeddings, which changes how often the model answers yes. Marking the damaged weights again in their low bits brings the edits back to them. Rounded weights still hold statistical evidence of the rescaling, in the distribution of stored values and in row norms, and one sentence in the prompt that names such a statistic directs the agent's edits to the damaged rows on both models. Swapped rows or columns, which leave the set of stored values unchanged, are not found unaided on either model within our session budgets. We recommend that studies of weight repair report the number format of the weights and include a rounded control.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究"权重空间编程"（无需梯度的直接权重修复）的成败条件：在SmolVLM-256M与LFM2-VL-450M权重中植入故障，由编码智能体逐项校验并修复。修复依赖故障在16位权重中留下的低位数值痕迹；将低位舍入后（回答不变），智能体无法精确定位损伤。提示中给出一个统计量（值分布/行范数）即可恢复定位能力；而交换行列这类保值变换在会话预算内无法发现。作者建议相关研究报告权重数值格式并设置"舍入对照"。
AI.motivation: 厘清"权重空间编程"这一无梯度权重编辑范式究竟依赖何种信号才能成功，尤其区分"模型行为恢复"与"真正还原原始权重"，从而为该方向的评测建立方法论基准。
AI.method: 在SmolVLM-256M与LFM2-VL-450M两个视觉语言模型的权重中植入故障（投影层行缩放、视觉编码器加噪、行列交换），由编码智能体在无监督提示下对权重做修改并与原始权重逐位比对；通过将16位权重舍入以消除32位运算残留的低位痕迹，对比有无该痕迹下智能体的定位与还原能力，并测试在提示中点明某个统计量（存储值分布、行范数）能否引导编辑。
AI.result: 无提示条件下智能体可发现投影层缩放行与编码器噪声，推断未知缩放因子并将大部分/全部权重精确还原，精度恢复到接近原始水平，且其编写的程序可无反馈地修复同模型未见检查点；但答案不变的低位舍入会使智能体无法精确定位损伤（SmolVLM上完全失效，LFM2-VL上仅有对答案token嵌入重缩放带来的副作用收益）；在提示中指明一个统计量后可重新定位到受损行；保值的行列交换在会话预算内均未被发现。
AI.conclusion: 权重修复的成功高度依赖数值层面的低位痕迹而非语义可解释信号；行为等价不等于权重等价。建议该领域研究报告权重数值格式，并纳入"舍入对照"作为标准评测。

title: Isthmus: Bridging Supervision Islands Restores Uncertainty and Stability in One-Step Flows
summary: One-step flow maps are increasingly used as posterior samplers, where the point of sampling is the uncertainty that the samples carry. We find that the one-step sampler loses this uncertainty and becomes less stable. Compared with multi-step samples of the same network, its samples lose variance and decorrelate. Supervising the one-step jump directly makes this worse; the samples collapse further toward the conditional mean and break down when training is extended. We trace both failures to the locations where training places its pairs of start and end times. Only pairs on the diagonal of the time triangle receive targets from data, and the pair used for one-step sampling is either left unsupervised or supervised on an island, a set of pairs that the self-consistency identity does not connect to the diagonal, where the objective neither determines the one-step map nor anchors its training. We bridge the island with an isthmus, which places 5% of the training pairs along the whole edge of the triangle that joins the one-step pair to the diagonal. The error of the one-step map is then bounded by the self-consistency residual along this edge. With the network, the loss and the inference code unchanged and at no added cost, the isthmus improves one-step sampling across several flow-map objectives, in MRI reconstruction, face inpainting, and unconditional generation on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet 32x32. On brain MRI, it restores one-step calibration to 0.96 and the correlation with multi-step samples to 0.93; both vary far less across seeds, and the agreement holds when training is extended to three times its length.

AI.tldr: 一步流图（flow map）作为后验采样器会丢失采样不确定性，作者将其归因于训练时使用的"起止时间对"位置分布问题，并提出 isthmus 训练对采样策略来修复。
AI.motivation: 一步流图采样器被广泛用作后验采样器，其价值在于样本所携带的不确定性；但作者发现一步采样丢失方差、样本去相关、稳定性下降，且直接监督一步跳跃会加剧塌缩（趋向条件均值）并在延长训练时崩溃。需要定位并修复这一失效机制。
AI.method: 在"时间三角形"框架下分析训练对 (t_start, t_end) 的放置：仅对角线上的配对从数据获得监督目标，而一步采样所用的配对要么无监督，要么处于自一致性恒等式无法连接至对角线的"孤岛"（island）上。提出 isthmus：将 5% 的训练对沿三角形连接一步配对与对角线的那条边分布，使一步映射误差可由沿该边的自一致性残差界定。网络、损失与推理代码均不变，无额外开销。
AI.result: 在 MRI 重建、人脸修复、CIFAR-10 与 ImageNet 32x32 无条件生成上，跨多种 flow-map 目标均提升一步采样质量。脑部 MRI 上一步采样校准度恢复到 0.96，与多步样本相关性达 0.93，两者跨随机种子波动大幅降低，且训练延长至三倍时长时结论依然成立。
AI.conclusion: 一步流图的方差丢失与不稳定源于训练时间对的分布结构；用 isthmus 打通孤岛即可在零成本、零代码改动下显著改善一步采样，为一步后验采样提供了有理论界定的实用修正。

title: How Uncertain Is My Action? Self-Correcting Visual Planning with Frozen World Models
summary: A frozen latent world model combined with sampling-based model predictive control is a visual planner. At deployment, the executed action can depart from the commanded one, and the frozen model has no way to notice. We show that the model can be run in reverse: for any hypothesized actuation shift, it predicts what it should have observed under that shift, and comparing this prediction with what was actually observed quantifies the shift and lets the planner correct itself. Unlike the residual energy, which mixes the shift with the model's own error, the score keeps only the part of the residual that a shift can produce. This shift score detects the shift with a locally optimal test, estimates it with Cramer-Rao error bars, names the dominant generator, and compensates the planner once an alarm fires. On PushT, TwoRoom and OGBench-Cube with a frozen latent world model, measured detection follows the prediction to within 0.05 AUROC. Self-correction raises success from 0.650 to 0.862 on PushT and from 0.378 to 0.432 on the harder Cube task, levels with an oracle that is told the true shift at the same block, better than five common test-time adaptation methods. On a real robotic arm, the score identifies a base-joint offset that no joint encoder registers and reduces the reach error from 36 mm to 3-5 mm, and under shifts drawn at random and sealed before the session, estimates recover 92-94% of the error reduction achieved with the true shift. The broader implication is that a frozen world model can act as a filter by predicting the future, testing action-interface uncertainty and validity, and finally correcting failures.

AI.tldr: 将冻结的隐空间世界模型反向运行：对假设的执行偏移，反推"本应观测到什么"，用残差中可被偏移解释的成分构造偏移分数，实现动作界面偏移的检测、估计、定位与在线自校正。
AI.motivation: 视觉规划器（冻结世界模型 + 采样MPC）在部署时执行动作可能偏离指令，而冻结模型无法察觉该偏移（如底层控制器/关节装配误差），导致开环失效。传统残差能量把"真实偏移"与"模型自身误差"混在一起，灵敏度有限。
AI.method: 逆用世界模型：对每个候选执行偏移，预测该偏移下的观测并与实际观测比较，得到偏移分数（只保留残差中偏移可产生的分量，剔除模型误差）。该分数给出局部最优检测、Cramér-Rao界下的估计误差条、主导偏移源辨识，并在告警后对规划器施加补偿。方法无需重训模型。
AI.result: 在PushT、TwoRoom、OGBench-Cube（冻结隐世界模型）上，实测检测与理论预测相差<0.05 AUROC；自校正将成功率从0.650→0.862（PushT）、0.378→0.432（Cube），与已知真值偏移的oracle持平，优于5种测试时自适应方法。真机机械臂上检测到关节编码器无法反映的基座关节偏移，到达误差由36 mm降至3–5 mm；随机且会话前封存的偏移下，误差削减恢复率达92–94%。
AI.conclusion: 冻结世界模型可充当"滤波器"：通过预测未来来检验动作界面的不确定性与有效性，并据此纠正失败；为世界模型的可信部署提供了轻量的运行时自诊断机制。

title: LoRN: Low-Rank Noise Steering for Generative Robot Policies
summary: Noise steering improves pretrained generative robot policies by learning to select their initial noise without updating model weights. We find that actions in the evaluated world-action models are more sensitive to video noise than action noise, making video noise an expressive input for steering. However, the noise-steering methods we evaluate, in their published forms, struggle to scale to the high-dimensional noise inputs of large policy classes such as world-action models. We introduce Low-Rank Noise Steering (LoRN), a reinforcement learning method that scales noise steering to world-action models. A small steering actor selects a direction through a fixed low-rank random projection, while our norm-controlled construction keeps the resulting noise near the typical scale of a Gaussian sample. This separates the actor's control dimension from the full noise dimension, enabling steering of both video and action inputs. Across three world-action models and ten model-task pairs, video steering improves average success by 26.2 percentage points over the base policy, compared with 7.1 points for DSRL action steering. For smaller action policies, the same construction achieves comparable final success while generally improving early-training success. Steering actors trained in simulation also transfer to three physical bimanual manipulation tasks across two base policies, without additional real-world training.

AI.tldr: 提出 Low-Rank Noise Steering (LoRN)：不改模型权重，用强化学习训练小型 steering actor，通过固定低秩随机投影+范数控制选择初始噪声方向，实现对 world-action model 高维视频/动作噪声的导向，18个模型-任务对平均成功率提升显著，并能从仿真迁移到真机双臂操作。
AI.motivation: 预训练生成式机器人策略（如 world-action model, WAM）不更新权重时，只能靠调节初始噪声来"steering"；作者发现此类策略对视频噪声的敏感度远高于动作噪声，视频噪声是更有表达力的调控输入。但已有 noise-steering 方法难以扩展到高维噪声输入的大型策略类。
AI.method: LoRN 训练一个小的 steering actor，在固定低秩随机投影给出的低维子空间中选择方向，构造出接近标准高斯典型尺度的受范数约束的噪声样本；从而将 actor 的控制维度与完整噪声维度解耦，可同时导向视频输入与动作输入。
AI.result: 在3个 world-action model、10个模型-任务对上，视频 steering 相对基座策略平均成功率提升26.2个百分点（DSRL 动作 steering 仅7.1点）；对较小动作策略达到相当最终成功率，并普遍改善早期训练成功率；仿真训练的 steering actor 无需额外真机训练即可迁移到2个基座策略、3个真实双臂操作任务。
AI.conclusion: 噪声 steering 是免微调提升生成式机器人策略的有效范式，低秩+范数控制的结构化参数化解决了高维噪声的可扩展性问题；视频噪声优于动作噪声作为控制通道，且学到的 steering 具可迁移性。

title: PRISM: Profiling and Representation of Individual Stereotypical Motion
summary: An anatomical pose provides interpretable joint structure, but no fixed set of physical landmarks can fully specify a person's movement. We introduce PRISM, a complementary representation that characterizes repetitive movement using tracked masks and dense optical flow. Torso-relative flow measures intensity, frame-wise mask variation measures spatial extent, signed-flow recurrence estimates frequency, and persistent sliding-window geometry describes the rhythmicity of the movement. Across 1,890 synthetic conditions, the measurements recover controlled speed, amplitude, and frequency while exposing observation limits. An idealized hand-motion experiment demonstrates variation omitted by identical exact COCO-17 trajectories; controlled corruption experiments separately examine measurement sensitivity. Audits of two pose methods on the same data cohort and 36,930 external skeleton clips document incomplete observation and dependence on processing choices. In 1,404 annotated complex stereotypical motor movement bouts from six autistic participants, total flow converges with pose motion, while matched-coordinate examples and repeated-session profiles show differences in intensity, extent, frequency, and rhythmicity within behavior labels. A separate VLM comparison evaluates quantitative frequency estimation, and a profile-conditioned decoder links the measurements to illustrative skeletal movements. PRISM connects numerical profiles to visible examples, providing an interpretable way to compare how the same behavior is expressed beyond its label or event count.

AI.tldr: PRISM：用跟踪掩码与稠密光流构建“重复性运动剖面”（躯干相对流量=强度、掩码逐帧变化=空间幅度、有符号光流回归=频率、滑动窗几何=节律性），在合成/真实数据上验证并审计姿态方法的观测不完整性。
AI.motivation: 解剖姿态提供可解释的关节结构，但任何固定物理关键点集合都无法完整刻画一个人的运动；仅靠姿态轨迹或行为标签会遗漏强度、幅度、频率与节律等表达差异。
AI.method: 以跟踪掩码+稠密光流为互补表征：躯干相对光流测强度，逐帧掩码变化测空间范围，有符号光流递推估计频率，持久滑动窗几何刻画节律。构建1890组合成条件做可控验证与观测极限分析；理想化手部运动实验对比相同COCO-17轨迹；受控破坏实验测敏感性；并用剖面条件解码器由数值剖面生成示意骨架运动。
AI.result: 合成条件下可恢复受控的速度、幅度与频率并暴露观测上限；同一精确COCO-17轨迹下存在被姿态省略的运动变化；两种姿态方法在同队列及36,930段外部骨架片段上显示观测不完整且依赖处理选择；1404段六名参与者标注的刻板运动片段中总流量与姿态运动收敛，但坐标匹配样例与跨会话剖面在同类标签内仍呈现强度/范围/频率/节律差异。
AI.conclusion: PRISM 把数值剖面与可视化样例关联起来，提供在行为标签或事件计数之外比较“同一行为如何被执行”的可解释度量框架；其定位是姿态的补充而非替代。

title: Radar-Native Control Barrier Functions: Doppler Range Rate as a Measured Barrier Derivative
summary: Safe control around dynamic obstacles requires information about both distance and relative motion. Range-based filters commonly reconstruct the required range rate from successive range measurements or from obstacle-state estimators, which can introduce estimator delay or sensitivity to range noise when obstacle motion changes. A frequency-modulated continuous-wave (FMCW) radar measures radial relative velocity directly through Doppler. We use this measurement as the derivative of an ego-centered range control barrier function (CBF) and obtain a closed-form filter on the robot's forward velocity. A measurement margin constructed from sensor error bounds accounts for errors in range, Doppler, ego velocity, and bearing. In 508 paired encounters within the platform's retreat capability, direct Doppler produces two buffer incursions, compared with 15 for a constant-acceleration and 25 for a constant-velocity Kalman filter. On a Unitree Go1, the controller stops at $0.777 \pm 0.015$ m against the predicted $0.758$ m and reacts to a farther approaching object while a nearer static return remains. The guarantee covers the longitudinal range channel under bounded measurement errors and continuously available detections. Direct Doppler removes the need to reconstruct range rate in the safety loop, reducing the delay between a change in obstacle motion and its effect on the safety command.

AI.tldr: 利用FMCW雷达多普勒直接测量径向相对速度，作为以自车为中心的测距控制障碍函数(CBF)的导数，构造机器人前进速度的闭式安全滤波器，并用测量裕度覆盖各类传感器误差。
AI.motivation: 动态障碍物安全控制需要距离与相对运动信息，但基于距离序列或状态估计器的距离变化率重建会带来估计延迟，并在障碍物运动突变时对测距噪声敏感，削弱安全约束的时效性。
AI.method: 以自车中心距离构造CBF，把雷达多普勒径向速度解析地作为CBF的时间导数，得到前进速度的闭式滤波解；由传感器误差界(距离、多普勒、自车速度、方位角)推导测量裕度以保证鲁棒性；实验为平台后撤能力范围内的508对相遇场景，对比恒速与恒加速卡尔曼滤波，并在Unitree Go1上实测验证。
AI.result: 508对相遇中直接多普勒仅出现2次缓冲区侵入，恒加速度KF为15次、恒速KF为25次；Go1上停在0.777±0.015 m，预测值0.758 m，且在存在更近静态回波时仍能对更远接近物体做出反应。
AI.conclusion: 在测量误差有界且检测连续可用时，纵向测距通道的安全性获得保证；直接多普勒免除了安全回路中的距离变化率重建，缩短了障碍物运动变化到安全指令生效之间的延迟，是一种高效、可证明的测距型安全滤波器。

title: LightSEAD: Lightweight SE(3)-Aware Keypoint Detector through Selective Knowledge Distillation
summary: The pursuit of improved performance in deep learning has often been accompanied by increasing architectural complexity and computational demands. We explore an alternative direction: achieving more with less through structured supervision. We introduce LightSEAD, a lightweight SE(3)-aware keypoint detector initialised with calibrated Harris pseudo-labels and enriched through viewpoint-aware and appearance-aware supervision and selective knowledge distillation. LightSEAD comprises only six convolutional layers and 84,289 learnable parameters, achieving competitive repeatability across HPatches, KITTI 06 and 4Seasons while demonstrating its downstream applicability to relative pose estimation on MegaDepth-1500. Further optimised for mixed-precision inference, LightSEAD Coarse achieves approximately 909 FPS on an NVIDIA RTX 4090 and 139 FPS on a Jetson Orin Nano Super.

AI.tldr: LightSEAD: a 6-layer, 84k-parameter SE(3)-aware keypoint detector trained with calibrated Harris pseudo-labels, viewpoint/appearance-aware supervision and selective KD; competitive repeatability on HPatches/KITTI/4Seasons and relative pose on MegaDepth-1500, ~909 FPS (RTX 4090) / 139 FPS (Jetson Orin Nano).
AI.motivation: 深度学习性能提升常伴随架构复杂度和算力膨胀，作者主张用"结构化监督"替代模型堆叠，在极小模型上获得可用的局部特征检测能力，并面向嵌入式/实时部署。
AI.method: 1) 极轻量骨干：仅6个卷积层、84,289个可学习参数；2) 用标定后的Harris响应生成伪标签做初始化；3) 视点感知(appearance-aware)与外观感知监督增强对SE(3)变换的描述判别性；4) 选择性知识蒸馏从大教师模型迁移有效信号；5) 面向混合精度推理优化(Coarse版本)以提升吞吐。
AI.result: 在HPatches、KITTI 06、4Seasons上取得有竞争力的重复性(repeatability)，并在MegaDepth-1500上验证相对位姿估计可用；混合精度下Coarse变体在RTX 4090约909 FPS、Jetson Orin Nano Super约139 FPS。
AI.conclusion: 表明结构化监督+伪标签+蒸馏可在参数量极小的前提下获得可用局部特征检测器，适合边缘端实时SLAM/视觉里程计前端；但缺乏与主流检测器/描述子的全面对比、机器人闭环验证。

title: EyeDiT: Anatomy-Grounded Multi-Modal Eye Generation and Simulation
summary: Synthetic eye data are critical for rapid development of eye tracking (ET) in AR/VR applications. However, existing synthetic eye generators are largely image-centric and lack a high-quality underlying 3D anatomy of the eye, which limits their control mainly to the gaze and provides no anatomical labels. To address this problem, we propose EyeDiT, an anatomy-grounded, multi-modal 3D eye generation and simulation model trained with optical coherence tomography (OCT), labeled anatomy point clouds and near-eye images. Our pipeline first trains a Multi-Modal Anatomy Variational Autoencoder (VAE), which encodes an anatomy-aware latent representation from all input modalities. Then, our Eye Latent DiT is trained to generate latent samples conditioned on the optical axis, the pupil position and radius, and the subject identity. Together with Gaussian decoders for novel-view simulation, our model enables control over the pupil, subject identity and viewpoint for data synthesis. We show that our model outperforms previous eye image synthesis models in novel-view synthesis (24.9 against 21.8 dB PSNR from a single view), and that a public ET neural network trained on our synthetic data shows a smaller sim-to-real gap than when trained on data from other generators (3.5$^\circ$ vs. 8.4$^\circ$ gaze error), approaches a network trained on real data, and further improves ET performance when combined with real data (2.3$^\circ$ vs. 2.6$^\circ$). More information is available on the project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: EyeDiT：以OCT、解剖标注点云与近眼图像联合训练的多模态3D人眼解剖生成/仿真模型，先训多模态解剖VAE得到解剖感知潜空间，再用Eye Latent DiT以视轴、瞳孔位置与半径、受试者身份为条件生成潜样本，配合高斯解码器做新视角合成，用于眼动追踪合成数据。
AI.motivation: 现有合成眼数据生成器以图像为中心，缺乏高质量底层3D解剖结构，控制维度基本局限于注视方向，且无法提供解剖标签，难以支撑AR/VR眼动追踪的数据合成需求。
AI.method: 提出EyeDiT：1）多模态解剖VAE，将OCT、解剖标注点云与近眼图像编码为统一的解剖感知潜表示；2）Eye Latent DiT，以视轴、瞳孔位置与半径、受试者身份为条件生成潜样本；3）高斯解码器实现新视角仿真，从而对瞳孔、身份与视点进行可控合成。
AI.result: 单视角新视角合成PSNR 24.9 dB，优于先前眼图像合成模型的21.8 dB；在合成数据上训练公开眼动网络，sim-to-real差距3.5°对比其他生成器的8.4°注视误差，接近真实数据训练网络，与真实数据混合训练进一步将误差从2.6°降至2.3°。
AI.conclusion: 解剖接地的多模态3D眼睛生成模型可提供可控、带解剖意义的高质量合成眼数据，有效缩小眼动追踪的sim-to-real差距，适合作为AR/VR端训练数据扩增手段。

title: Image-Condition-Controlled Diffusion Network with Large-Scale CT Pretraining for CT-Free Attenuation Correction in Dynamic Cardiac PET
comment: 11 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Radiation and Plasma Medical Sciences
summary: Positron emission tomography (PET) provides quantitative information on myocardial perfusion. In dynamic PET, tracer kinetics are tracked through a series of reconstructed time frames. Reliable attenuation correction is essential for accurate measurements. Clinical attenuation maps ($\mu$-maps) are typically derived from computed tomography (CT), which adds radiation exposure and may introduce PET-CT misregistration due to respiratory and cardiac motion. Moreover, supervised CT-free methods rely on paired non-attenuation-corrected (NAC) PET and CT data, which are scarce, whereas large-scale unpaired CT data are more readily available. To address these challenges, we propose Large-scale Unpaired CT-Informed Diffusion (LUCID), a framework that transfers anatomical priors learned from 10,000 chest CT volumes in the public CT-RATE dataset to $\mu$-map synthesis for dynamic cardiac $^{82}$Rb PET. First, a convolutional neural network (CNN) predicts an initial $\mu$-map from each NAC PET frame. Second, the CT-pretrained diffusion backbone refines a low-noise perturbation of the CNN prediction through a single denoising step, conditioned on the corresponding NAC PET frame via ControlNet. Finally, frame-wise predictions are averaged voxel-wise to obtain the final $\mu$-map. We further introduce the voxel-wise temporal standard deviation (TSD) to quantify inter-frame variability without requiring a reference $\mu$-map. We evaluated LUCID on an in-house dataset of 102 patients and found that it achieved the best quantitative accuracy while maintaining competitive inter-frame consistency. Ablation studies showed that refinement with a diffusion backbone pretrained on in-house CT data from the training patients was less accurate than the CNN prediction alone, highlighting the importance of large-scale CT pretraining.

AI.tldr: 提出 LUCID 框架，利用大规模无关配对胸部 CT（CT-RATE 1万例）预训练的扩散骨干，在 ControlNet 条件下由 NAC PET 帧单步去噪精修 CNN 初始 μ-map，实现动态心脏 82Rb PET 的无 CT 衰减校正；并引入体素级时间标准差（TSD）作为无参考帧间一致性指标。
AI.motivation: 动态 PET 灌注定量依赖可靠的衰减校正，临床 μ-map 通常来自 CT，带来额外辐射与 PET-CT 呼吸/心脏运动失配；而监督式无 CT 方法需要稀缺的配对 NAC-PET/CT 数据，大量无配对 CT 反而易得。
AI.method: 两阶段：CNN 从每帧 NAC PET 预测初始 μ-map；CT 预训练的扩散骨干对 CNN 预测的低噪声扰动做单步去噪精修，经 ControlNet 以对应 NAC PET 帧为条件；帧级预测体素级平均得到最终 μ-map。
AI.result: 在 102 例院内数据上取得最佳定量精度，同时保持有竞争力的帧间一致性；消融显示仅用院内训练病人 CT 预训练扩散骨干的精修效果不如单独 CNN 预测，说明大规模 CT 预训练起关键作用。
AI.conclusion: 大规模无关 CT 预训练可有效迁移解剖先验以支撑 CT-free μ-map 合成，且 TSD 可作为无需参考图的帧间稳定性度量。

title: Learning What to Degrade: A Recoverability-Aware Curriculum for Reliable Smart-Glasses Super-Resolution
summary: Degradations in smart-glasses images obscure small text and fine-grained structures needed by vision-language models (VLMs) for visual assistance. We introduce an high-resolution (HR)-referenced semantic evaluation protocol that compares VLM outputs on restored images with those on corresponding HR references. Our evaluation reveals two failure modes: generative SR can synthesize misleading details, whereas restoration-oriented SR can leave critical evidence blurred or ambiguous. These findings motivate improving faithful detail recovery in restoration-oriented SR, where a key training challenge is to provide sufficiently difficult inputs while retaining recoverable visual information. We propose ReDiC (Recoverability-Difficulty Curriculum), which combines a model-independent recoverability proxy with model-relative restoration difficulty to adapt training degradation severity. ReDiC increases severity when inputs are recoverable and restoration is easy, maintains challenging but recoverable conditions, and reduces severity when estimated recoverability is low. It modifies only training degradation generation, leaving the SR architecture and reconstruction objective unchanged. Across NAFNet, SwinIR, and MambaIR, ReDiC improves average PSNR by approximately 2.5 dB and HR-referenced semantic scores by about 3 points over the corresponding baselines on synthetic benchmarks, with further gains confirmed by LLM-based and human evaluations on 200 real smart-glasses captures.

AI.tldr: 提出HR参考的VLM语义评测协议，揭示生成式SR与实际恢复式SR的两类失败模式，并提出ReDiC可恢复性-难度课程训练策略以提升忠实细节恢复。
AI.motivation: 智能眼镜图像退化会遮蔽视觉语言模型所需的小字与细粒度结构，生成式SR易伪造误导性细节、恢复式SR易导致关键证据模糊，需要改善恢复式SR的忠实细节恢复。
AI.method: HR-referenced semantic evaluation protocol（对比恢复图与HR参考上的VLM输出）；ReDiC课程学习：结合与模型无关的可恢复性代理和模型相对的恢复难度自适应调整训练退化强度，仅改训练退化生成，不改SR架构与重建损失。
AI.result: 在NAFNet、SwinIR、MambaIR上平均PSNR约+2.5 dB、HR参考语义分数约+3分；在200张真实智能眼镜拍摄图上经LLM与人评进一步验证增益。
AI.conclusion: 训练难度课程设计可在不改变模型架构的前提下显著提升恢复式SR的语义忠实度，HR参考语义评测更适合评估面向VLM的恢复质量。

title: Finetuning VLAs for Dexterous Manipulation: The Right Checkpoint Is All You Need
comment: Accepted to the Workshop on Dexterous Manipulation at CoRL 2026
summary: Vision-Language-Action models have demonstrated strong manipulation capabilities. A limitation of VLA models is that most manipulation datasets focus on parallel-jaw gripper systems, making transfer to multi-finger hands challenging, particularly as teleoperation datasets are harder to collect with multi-fingered robots. In this work, we study how to best adapt VLAs to dexterous hands by pairing supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with diffusion-steering reinforcement learning (DSRL). Using $\pi_{0.5}$ and a LEAP hand, we evaluate five fine-tuning recipes across two simulation tasks using only a handful of demonstrations. Our empirical analysis yields three key insights: (1) SFT success is poorly correlated with post-DSRL success, meaning the best SFT checkpoint is rarely the most effective to steer; (2) freezing the vision-language model (VLM) and tuning only the action expert produces the most steerable policy for both training and out-of-distribution placements; and (3) low-rank adaptation (LoRA) is the least steerable approach. Consequently, we recommend an adaptation recipe that freezes the VLM, fully trains the action expert, and eschews SFT rollout success as a checkpoint selection metric.

AI.tldr: 该工作研究如何将VLA模型适配到多指灵巧手：以π_{0.5}与LEAP手为平台，在少量示范下比较SFT+扩散引导RL（DSRL）的五种微调配方，得出三点经验结论：SFT成功率与DSRL后成功率相关性弱；冻结VLM、仅训action expert最易被"引导"；LoRA最不可引导。最终推荐"冻结VLM+全训action expert+不以SFT rollout成功率选checkpoint"的适配方案。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA操作数据集与预训练模型大多基于平行夹爪，迁移到多指灵巧手困难；而灵巧手的遥操数据采集成本高，数据稀缺。因此需要仅用少量示范，找到把已有VLA有效迁移到灵巧手的最优微调+RL后训练配方，并厘清微调方式如何影响后续RL的可引导性（steerability）。
AI.method: 在π_{0.5}（VLA）与LEAP多指灵巧手上，用两个仿真任务、少量示范数据，系统对比5种微调配方（涉及是否冻结VLM、是否全训action expert、是否使用LoRA等），并统一接续扩散引导强化学习（DSRL）进行后训练；以DSRL前SFT成功率、DSRL后成功率（含分布外摆放）为指标，分析SFT质量与可引导性的相关性。
AI.result: 三点实证发现：(1) SFT rollout成功率与经过DSRL后的最终成功率相关性很差，最优SFT checkpoint往往并非最适合被RL引导的起点；(2) 冻结VLM、只微调action expert的配方在两任务与OOD摆放上均给出最可引导的策略；(3) LoRA微调的可引导性最差。
AI.conclusion: 对VLA→灵巧手适配，推荐"冻结VLM + 全参训练action expert + 不以SFT rollout成功率作为checkpoint选择依据"的配方；提示在少样本灵巧操作场景中应以可引导性（是否能被RL继续改进）而非SFT近端性能来评估与选择中间模型。

title: Structured Extraction of Diffraction Data from Covalent Organic Frameworks
comment: 66 pages: main text (19 pages, 7 figures, 3 tables) and Supporting Information (47 pages) in one file. Data and code: this https URL ; database website: this https URL
summary: Powder X-ray diffraction (PXRD) is the primary structural evidence for covalent organic frameworks (COFs) and many other materials. Yet decades of measured patterns exist only as images in published figures. Automatic recovery is difficult, because PXRD figures vary widely in format, from a single curve to crowded stacks with labels, insets, and neighboring plots that challenge traditional computer vision. This work presents a pipeline in which a vision large language model (LLM) interprets the layout of each figure, locating the diffraction plot and its curves and sketching a coarse trace of each, while classical computer vision (CV) refines every trace to pixel-level accuracy. Applied to 3,954 COF articles, the pipeline produces 11,445 calibrated diffraction curves, released in the open database COF-PEAK. Compared with a hand digitization of 60 panels, extracted peak positions differ by a median of only 0.07 degrees. Whereas papers usually report only a few peak angles, which limits further analysis, the digitized curves enable tracking how peak prominence, a possible marker of crystallinity, changes with synthesis conditions. Vision LLMs and classical CV can thus turn such figures into reusable experimental data.

AI.tldr: 提出视觉大模型负责版面理解与曲线粗定位、经典CV负责像素级精修的PXRD图数字化流水线，从3954篇COF文献中提取11445条标定衍射曲线并发布COF-PEAK数据库。
AI.motivation: PXRD是共价有机框架（COF）等材料的主要结构证据，但数十年积累的实测图谱仅以论文图片形式存在；单曲线、堆叠曲线、带标签/插图/相邻子图的多样版式使传统计算机视觉难以自动恢复。
AI.method: 视觉-语言大模型（VLM）先解析整图版面，定位衍射子图及其各条曲线并给出粗略轨迹；再由经典CV对每条轨迹进行像素级精修，完成坐标轴标定，输出定量衍射曲线。
AI.result: 处理3954篇COF文献得11445条标定曲线；与60个面板的人工数字化对比，峰位中位偏差仅0.07°；数字化曲线可追踪峰显著度（结晶度潜在指标）随合成条件的变化。
AI.conclusion: VLM的语义版面理解与经典CV的精确几何拟合互补，可将文献中的图形式实验数据转化为可复用的定量数据，并支撑超越论文原始报告峰角的后续分析。

title: Measuring the Conservatism of Latent Safety Filters for World Models
summary: A latent safety filter decides from the latent of a world model whether a planned action is safe. Conformal calibration sets the threshold of the filter so that it accepts an unsafe action only with a small probability. However, the filter can still be conservative and refuse many safe actions, depending on the latent. To measure the conservatism that a latent forces on the filter, we group similar latents and actions into cells. A filter that gives one decision per cell can refuse the unsafe transitions of a cell only by refusing the safe ones in it as well. We call the share of safe transitions that lie in such cells the overlap. We prove that the overlap is the minimum share of safe transitions that such a filter has to refuse in order to accept no unsafe transition in the data. Both the overlap and the conformal calibration can be applied to any latent. We use this to compare three existing designs, in which the safety labels train a classifier on top of the world model, the world model itself, or a separate encoder beside it. In a visual navigation task, the separate encoder has the lowest overlap, and at the same conformal level its filter refuses the fewest safe actions and lets the planner reach the most goals of the three.

AI.tldr: 该文提出用"重叠度(overlap)"度量隐式安全过滤器因潜空间分组而产生的保守性，并证明其等于数据中零不安全接受所需拒绝的安全转移最小比例，据此比较三种安全标签设计。
AI.motivation: 共形校准可保证潜式安全过滤器低概率接受不安全动作，但针对每组潜表示，过滤器仍可能过度拒绝安全动作；现有工作缺乏刻画"潜表示引起的保守性"的定量工具，难以在设计间做归因比较。
AI.method: 将相似潜表示与动作聚为单元格，定义每格单一决策下无法区分安全/不安全转移导致的overlap；给出定理证明overlap即为零不安全接受时须拒绝的安全转移最小份额；overlap与共形校准均可作用于任意潜表示；在视觉导航任务上比较三种设计：世界模型上加分类器、直接用世界模型潜、并置独立编码器。
AI.result: 视觉导航任务中，独立编码器方案overlap最低；在同一共形校准水平下其过滤器拒绝的安全动作最少，规划器到达目标数最多。
AI.conclusion: overlap为隐式安全过滤器的保守性提供了可证明的下界指标，可作为选择安全标签载体（分类头/世界模型/独立编码器）的实用准则；独立编码器在实验中兼顾安全性与规划成功率。

title: MoMoVL: Modality-Aware Adaptive Compression for On-Device Sparsely-Activated Vision-Language Models
comment: 11 pages, 6 figures, Accepted at WSDM 2027 Findings
summary: The rise of the agentic web has been accompanied by growing demand for on-device Vision-Language Models (VLMs) that perform diverse cross-modal web tasks with enhanced privacy and reduced latency. Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models are widely adopted in modern VLMs for compute-efficient scalability, yet their multi-expert architecture poses deployment challenges due to substantial memory demands. Mixed-precision quantization is an effective compression technique that reduces bit-widths while adapting to the heterogeneous hardware budgets of edge devices, particularly well-suited for MoE due to its inherent structural sparsity, which causes imbalanced importance among experts. While prior work has applied quantization for efficient MoE inference at the edge, we point out that in MoE-based VLMs, the modality-specific characteristics of visual and text tokens further impact expert quantization. To address this issue, we present MoMoVL, a modality-aware adaptive compression framework for MoE-based VLMs that brings vision-language inference within reach of on-device resource budgets. Motivated by our empirical findings on modality-induced disparities across experts, MoMoVL jointly exploits the per-expert activation profile and per-modality quantization sensitivity to guide bit-width assignment. Experimental results show that MoMoVL improves the accuracy-compression trade-off relative to state-of-the-art mixed-precision baselines and reduces memory footprint by up to 15.44% with a modest drop in accuracy over its uniform-precision baseline. Our code and data are publicly available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: MoMoVL：面向MoE架构VLM的模态感知混合精度量化框架，联合利用逐专家激活分布与逐模态量化敏感度分配比特宽度，实现端侧部署。
AI.motivation: MoE-VLM在端侧部署受显存限制；既有MoE量化工作忽略了视觉/文本token的模态差异对专家量化的影响。
AI.method: 经验分析发现模态导致专家间显著差异，据此构建模态感知比特分配：结合per-expert激活剖面与per-modality量化敏感度进行混合精度搜索。
AI.result: 相比SOTA混合精度基线，精度—压缩权衡更优；相对均匀精度基线内存降低最多15.44%，精度小幅下降。
AI.conclusion: 模态感知量化是端侧MoE-VLM高效部署的有效路径，代码与数据公开。

title: What Do Learned 3D Models Add to Localization from Posed References?
summary: Localizing a query from a few posed reference images avoids building a 3D point map. We ask what the camera predictions of learned 3D models add to geometric estimation from the same references, and where failures arise. Across eight learned models and variants and five test sets, we compare reference budgets, swap pose components, and intervene on the references a model sees. At fine pose-error thresholds, geometric estimation with one additional reference is significantly more accurate than every model on two references on Cambridge and NAVER B1 and never significantly worse, alone or as a fallback behind a shared acceptance gate; with the same three references, the more accurate approach depends on the scene. The gain from the learned translation magnitude depends on reference selection: it improves seven of the eight models on 12-Scenes with the spread-out pairs we select, but none of the five we test with the two top-ranked retrieved references. Where retrieval also returns references from other locations, at NAVER Gangnam Station, models fail at different stages. A robust alignment brings Pi3X and MapAnything within 3.3 pp of adding references as needed. In controlled tests, aligning on the nearby references largely restores VGGT, Pi3X and MapAnything but not Depth Anything 3, and pose-conditioned Pi3X recovers only if the far poses are masked and left out of its input-pose normalization.

AI.tldr: 该文系统比较了学习式3D模型（VGGT、Pi3X、MapAnything、Depth Anything 3等8个模型）与几何估计在少样本位姿参考图像定位上的表现，分析失败来源与混合策略。
AI.motivation: 少样本参考图像定位可避免建图，但尚不清楚学习式3D模型的相机预测相对于几何估计究竟带来何种增益、以及在何种条件下会失败。
AI.method: 在5个测试集上对比8个学习模型及变体；改变参考图像数量预算、交换位姿分量、干预输入参考图像；在统一接受门控下将学习模型作为几何估计的补充或回退；在NAVER江南站做检索跨场景干扰的受控实验与稳健对齐。
AI.result: 在严格位姿误差阈值下，几何估计+1张参考在Cambridge与NAVER B1上显著优于所有模型用2张参考的表现且从不变差；学习到的平移模长增益依赖参考选择（12-Scenes分散配对改善7/8模型，高排名检索配对则无改善）；稳健对齐使Pi3X与MapAnything接近按需增加参考表现（差3.3pp）；近邻对齐可恢复VGGT/Pi3X/MapAnything但Depth Anything 3不行，位姿条件的Pi3X需屏蔽远距位姿。
AI.conclusion: 学习式3D模型并非几何估计的稳定替代，其价值高度依赖参考选取与鲁棒对齐；实践中应以统一门控的几何估计为主并选择性引入学习模型。

title: A Hardware-Aware Comprehensive Study of Edge Vision Deployment with A Unified Hardware-Model-Runtime Mapping Framework
summary: The rapid growth of deep learning has driven the deployment of computer vision directly on resource-constrained edge devices. However, the extreme heterogeneity of edge hardware architectures poses major challenges in selecting and designing suitable vision models. This survey bridges the gap between edge hardware constraints, model architectures, and deployment software toolchains. We establish a comprehensive taxonomy classifying edge hardware into three distinct tiers: mid-range devices (GPUs and dedicated NPUs or TPUs), dedicated embedded MPU or SoC processors, and microcontrollers (MCUs). We aggregate and analyze multi-source benchmark results for image classification and object detection across the computing spectrum, spanning from tens of watts down to milliwatt-scale bare-metal MCUs. Based on these empirical findings, we propose a two-tiered hardware-to-model mapping framework that provides concrete model selection matrices across performance priorities (Speed, Balanced, Accuracy) and actionable architectural design principles (peak SRAM budgeting, resolution-first scaling, and algorithm-compiler co-design). Finally, we highlight critical deployment challenges including toolchain fragmentation, operator incompatibility, and Vision Transformer feasibility, and outline promising future research directions in on-device adaptation and sustainable Edge AI.

AI.tldr: 综述边缘硬件（GPU/NPU、嵌入式MPU/SoC、MCU）上的视觉模型部署，整合多源基准并给出按速度/均衡/精度分级的硬件—模型映射矩阵与架构设计原则。
AI.motivation: 边缘硬件架构极度异构，导致视觉模型选型与设计缺乏系统依据，硬件约束、模型架构与部署工具链三者之间存在知识割裂。
AI.method: 建立三级边缘硬件分类体系；聚合跨功耗谱（数十瓦至毫瓦级裸金属MCU）的图像分类与目标检测多源基准结果；据此提出双层硬件—模型映射框架，包含性能优先级下的模型选择矩阵与峰值SRAM预算、分辨率优先缩放、算法—编译器协同设计等原则；并梳理工具链碎片化、算子不兼容与ViT可行性等挑战。
AI.result: 给出覆盖全计算谱的跨源基准汇总分析，以及可直接用于选型的映射矩阵与架构设计准则，并归纳部署瓶颈与未来方向。
AI.conclusion: 该综述为边缘视觉部署提供了从硬件分层到模型选型与协同设计的实用参考框架，但属归纳性综述，未提出新的可执行方法或实机验证。

title: ExecGap: Exploiting Command-Execution Gap for Patch Attacks on Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have become a powerful paradigm for robotic manipulation and show strong promise for real-world deployment, making adversarial robustness critical for reliable robot operation. Existing adversarial attacks on VLA-controlled robots mainly optimize prediction-level discrepancies or rollout-level deviations to disrupt manipulation. However, they rarely account for the fact that VLA-predicted commands are not executed directly, but must be realized through downstream control and robot embodiment. In this paper, we propose ExecGap, an adversarial patch attack framework that exploits this command-execution gap to expose embodiment-specific execution vulnerabilities. Specifically, ExecGap biases VLA-predicted task-space commands toward low-executability directions, which are estimated from kinematic inefficiency and dynamic weak actuation. This induces execution degradation, where the predicted command becomes difficult to realize effectively, thereby impairing task completion. Extensive simulation experiments across multiple VLA policies show that ExecGap induces larger command-execution mismatch and weaker realized execution than existing patch attacks. Real-robot experiments further validate that the deployed patch can induce execution degradation on physical platforms.

AI.tldr: 提出ExecGap对抗补丁攻击框架：利用VLA预测命令与实际执行之间的"指令-执行鸿沟"，将任务空间命令偏置到低可执行性方向（由运动学低效性与动态弱驱动估计得到），从而引发执行退化并破坏任务完成。
AI.motivation: 现有针对VLA机器人操作的对抗攻击主要优化预测层偏差或rollout层偏差，忽略了VLA输出命令需经下游控制器与机器人本体（embodiment）才能真正执行这一事实，因此未能刻画本体相关的执行脆弱性。
AI.method: 基于对抗补丁（adversarial patch）的攻击框架。核心是估计"低可执行性方向"：结合运动学效率（kinematic inefficiency）与动态驱动能力薄弱（dynamic weak actuation）两方面构造目标，将VLA预测的任务空间命令偏置至该方向，使预测命令难以被有效实现，产生命令-执行失配与执行退化。在多个VLA策略上做仿真实验，并在真实机器人平台验证补丁的迁移与部署效果。
AI.result: 多策略仿真实验中，ExecGap相比现有补丁攻击产生更大的命令-执行失配、更弱的实际执行表现；真机实验进一步验证所部署补丁可在物理平台上诱发执行退化。
AI.conclusion: 将攻击目标从"预测偏差"转向"本体执行可行性"是一条被忽视但有效的对抗通道，VLA系统鲁棒性评估需纳入命令-执行鸿沟与本体约束；也提示在部署时应关注下游控制层面的安全防护。

title: CoScan: Multi-Scale Content-Adaptive Space-Filling Scans for Causal State-Space Image Restoration
summary: Selective state-space models (SSMs) have recently shown strong potential for efficient image restoration. A central difficulty, however, is that a 2D feature map typically needs to be linearized into a 1D token sequence for causal state-space updates, making restoration performance highly sensitive to the imposed scan order. Existing deterministic scans follow space-filling principles but remain fixed and content-agnostic, and can yield fragmented or semantically inconsistent contexts under degradations. We propose \textbf{CoScan}, a \textbf{co}ntent-adaptive \textbf{scan}-order design for causal vision SSMs. CoScan learns image-dependent space-filling traversals via differentiable proxy supervision driven by \textbf{scan-quality objectives} that \textit{encourage short-range coherence and causal predictability, while preserving spatial adjacency}. To support hierarchical restoration backbones, we introduce an \textbf{efficient multi-scale scan construction by coarsening a fine-level minimum spanning tree}, producing coherent scans across feature resolutions. In addition, a \textbf{frequency-guided start selection strategy} is designed to \textit{place informative structures early in the sequence prefix to strengthen causal context formation}. Plugged into existing Mamba-based backbones, CoScan yields consistent improvements across several restoration benchmarks with minimal overhead and shows promising results on high-level vision tasks. Code will be released at this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出CoScan：面向因果视觉状态空间模型的内容自适应扫描顺序，用可微代理监督学习图像相关的空间填充遍历，通过MST粗化实现多尺度扫描构建，并用频率引导的起点选择将信息结构置于序列前缀。
AI.motivation: 选择性SSM在图像复原中高效，但2D特征图需线性化为1D序列以进行因果状态更新，性能对扫描顺序高度敏感；现有确定性扫描（如Hilbert/Z-order）固定且与内容无关，在退化图像上易产生碎片化或语义不一致的上下文。
AI.method: 1) 内容自适应扫描：用可微代理监督（scan-quality目标：短程连贯性、因果可预测性、保持空间邻接）学习图像相关的空间填充遍历；2) 多尺度扫描构建：对细层最小生成树进行粗化，跨分辨率生成连贯扫描以支撑层次化复原骨干；3) 频率引导起点选择：把信息量大的结构放在序列前缀，强化因果上下文形成；可即插即用于Mamba类骨干。
AI.result: 在多个图像复原基准上相对现有Mamba骨干取得一致提升，开销极小；在高层视觉任务上亦显示潜力。摘要未给出具体数值。
AI.conclusion: 扫描顺序应作为可学习的内容自适应设计而非固定先验；MST粗化可在多尺度上低成本保持一致扫描，起点选择可显著改善因果上下文构建。属图像复原/底层视觉的方法改进，与Physical AI核心区域（VLA、世界模型、具身导航、前馈3D重建）关联较弱。

title: Improving While Deployed: Learning Proactive End-to-End Driving from Imperfect Human Takeover Data
summary: Once deployed on vehicles, end-to-end driving models continuously encounter challenging scenarios, generating valuable human takeover data that capture both model outputs and human behaviors. However, human interventions are often imperfect, as drivers may intervene too late or unnecessarily. Consequently, direct imitation can reinforce late responses or discourage otherwise appropriate maneuvers. To address this challenge, we propose an offline post-training framework that transforms imperfect takeover data into proactive supervision. We first construct diverse trajectory candidates by augmenting the plans of the deployed model and shifting recorded human corrective maneuvers earlier in time. We then train a scene-conditioned trajectory scorer to rank these candidates using expert demonstrations and unpaired preference signals from takeover logs. Using this scorer, we selectively replace pre-takeover training targets with higher-scoring candidates while retaining the original targets in normal driving scenarios. Finally, we distill the resulting targets into the driving model without changing its inference architecture. In closed-loop evaluations using real-world scenarios reconstructed with 4D Gaussian splatting, our method achieves the highest overall success rate, outperforming the deployed model, direct imitation learning and trajectory post-optimization. These results highlight a practical path toward efficient updates of deployed driving models using existing fleet logs.

AI.tldr: 离线后训练框架：把不完美的接管数据（含过早/过晚/不必要干预）通过轨迹候选增广与人车接管时间前移、场景条件评分器排序，选择性替换接管前训练目标，再蒸馏回原模型。
AI.motivation: 端到端驾驶模型部署后会持续产生人类接管数据，但人类干预本身不完美（过晚或不必要），直接模仿会强化迟滞响应或抑制正确操作，因此需要把"不完美接管"转化为"前瞻性监督"。
AI.method: 1) 对已部署模型的规划做轨迹候选增广，并将记录的人类纠正动作在时间上前移；2) 训练场景条件轨迹评分器，用专家示范和接管日志中的非成对偏好信号排序候选；3) 用评分器选择性替换接管前的训练目标，正常驾驶场景保留原目标；4) 将目标蒸馏进驾驶模型，不改变推理架构。
AI.result: 在4D高斯泼溅重建的真实场景闭环评测中取得最高总体成功率，优于已部署模型、直接模仿学习与轨迹后优化。
AI.conclusion: 提供了利用现有车队日志高效更新已部署驾驶模型的实用路径。

title: Do 3D Point Representations Encode Architectural Functions? Probing Supervised and Pretrained Models on Urban Facades
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: Physical World AI: Geometry, Characteristics, and Multimodal Sensing
summary: Semantic labels say what a building element is, not what it does: two identical-looking windows on one facade may be operable or fixed, a column may carry load or only decorate. We ask whether 3D point representations encode such architectural function. On 22 mobile-LiDAR buildings with 15 functional attributes per element, we hold out entire buildings and compare hand-crafted descriptors, networks trained from scratch and frozen self-supervised point transformers. Descriptors and frozen features are read by the same linear layer. No network trained from scratch, from PointNet to a 108M-parameter PTv3, clearly exceeds the descriptors (0.610 mAP on functionally ambiguous elements), whereas frozen Utonia reaches 0.732. Random-weight controls of the same architectures (0.649 and 0.652) attribute the gain to pretraining (Utonia: +0.080, 95% building interval [+0.035, +0.124]). Pretrained features improve at every tested number of labelled buildings while descriptors and random features plateau, and, in the configurations we tested, fine-tuning erodes the benefit: at today's data scale, function is better read from pretrained representations than learned from scratch.

AI.tldr: 研究3D点表示是否编码建筑构件的"功能"属性：在22栋移动LiDAR建筑、每元素15个功能属性上做留出整栋楼的跨楼泛化评测，比较手工描述子、从零训练网络与冻结自监督点Transformer。
AI.motivation: 语义标签只说明构件"是什么"，不说明"做什么"（可开启vs固定窗、承重vs装饰柱）。作者想探究3D点表示是否蕴含这类建筑功能信息，并厘清功能属性应"读自预训练表示"还是"从零学习"。
AI.method: 跨楼（hold-out building）评测协议；15个逐元素功能属性；同一线性探针头分别读取手工描述子、从零训练网络（PointNet至108M PTv3）与冻结自监督点Transformer（Utonia）特征；并用同架构随机权重对照隔离预训练贡献；分析标注建筑数量缩放曲线与微调影响。
AI.result: 功能模糊元素上手工描述子mAP 0.610；从零训练网络（含PTv3）未见明显超越；冻结Utonia达0.732，随机权重对照0.649/0.652，归因预训练增益+0.080（95%建筑区间[+0.035,+0.124]）。预训练特征在各标注规模下持续改善，描述子与随机特征饱和；测试配置中微调反而侵蚀收益。
AI.conclusion: 在当前数据规模下，建筑功能属性更宜从预训练3D表示中线性读出，而非端到端从零学习或微调；3D自监督预训练确实编码了功能性语义。

title: GTA: Generative Tower of Agents for Scalable Holonic Scene Generation
summary: Scalable world modeling requires coordinating scene-wide goals with fine-grained objects and dynamic characters under limited time and context budgets. We introduce GTA (Generative Tower of Agents), which represents every unit at every level of an adaptive scene hierarchy as a holon, both a self-contained construction task and a composable scene unit. Parallel agents recursively plan the hierarchy top-down, generate assets, and assemble and refine them bottom-up. Uniform interfaces carry scene-wide requirements down the hierarchy, guiding local construction so that each holon fits into the larger one. GTA accelerates scalable world modeling through high-throughput parallel execution while preserving well-structured layouts and fine-grained asset details. GTA then populates the assembled environments with dynamic human characters whose appearance and motion are guided by the scene, yielding realized 4D worlds. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: GTA（Generative Tower of Agents）将自适应场景层级中的每个单元表示为"holon"（既是独立构建任务又是可组合场景单元），通过并行智能体自顶向下递归规划层级、生成资产、自底向上组装精修，并用统一接口将全局需求下传，最终填充由场景引导外观与动作的动态人物，生成4D世界。
AI.motivation: 可扩展世界建模需要在有限时间与上下文预算下，同时协调场景级全局目标与细粒度物体、动态角色；单一模型难以兼顾吞吐与结构/细节质量。
AI.method: 分层多智能体框架：以holon为统一递归单元，并行智能体自顶向下规划、生成资产，再自底向上组装与迭代精修；统一接口传递场景级约束以指导局部构建；随后基于场景引导生成动态人形角色的外观与运动。
AI.result: 摘要仅定性声称通过高吞吐并行可加速世界建模，并保持良好结构化布局与细粒度资产细节，输出含动态角色的4D世界；未报告定量指标、基准或真机/真实数据验证。
AI.conclusion: GTA提供了"智能体驱动的层级化场景构建"思路，与agent-driven对象/场景生成方向高度契合，但仅有概念描述，缺乏实验证据，需查看全文确认。

title: AdaS-ViT: Test-Time Adaptive Routing for Spiking Vision Transformers with Ultra-High Energy Efficiency
summary: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) promise event-driven and energy-efficient vision, yet existing spiking vision transformers (S-ViTs) largely confine spiking tokens to fixed and uniform firing schemes along the temporal, spatial and channel dimensions, whereas suppressing the computational redundancy thus incurred calls for adaptive firing mechanisms that operate jointly across all three axes at test time. To this end, we propose the Adaptive Efficient Integrate-and-Fire (AdaE-IF) model, which consults the attention score of each spiking token and routes salient regions to fine-grained firing patterns while assigning energy-frugal coarse patterns to the remaining regions. Building on AdaE-IF, we further introduce Spiking Gated Self-Attention (S-GSA) and Spiking Local-Gated Unit (S-LGU), which enforce selective spike emission at token and channel granularity. We integrate the aforementioned mechanisms and modules into AdaS-ViT, a test-time adaptive-routing architecture trained with a progressive spatio-temporal curriculum that stabilizes the co-adaptation of firing precision and routing masks. Extensive experiments across benchmarks spanning diverse data scales and modalities demonstrate that AdaS-ViT consistently achieves highly competitive performance. Notably, on ImageNet-1k it consumes only 1.02 to 2.45 millijoules per image and attains an accuracy-per-energy ratio of 32$\times$ to 72$\times$, operating in an economical inference regime and thereby pushing the energy-efficiency boundary further.

AI.tldr: 提出 AdaE-IF 自适应脉冲发放模型，依据注意力分数在时间、空间、通道三维度联合路由细/粗发放模式，并构建测试时自适应架构 AdaS-ViT，在 ImageNet-1k 上单图仅耗 1.02–2.45 mJ，能效-精度比达 32×–72×。
AI.motivation: 现有脉冲视觉 Transformer 的脉冲令牌发放方案在时间、空间、通道维度上固定且统一，导致计算冗余严重；需要在推理时对三个维度联合进行自适应发放。
AI.method: 提出 AdaE-IF：查询每个脉冲令牌的注意力分数，将显著区域路由到细粒度发放模式，其余区域分配节能的粗粒度模式；在此基础上设计 Spiking Gated Self-Attention（S-GSA）与 Spiking Local-Gated Unit（S-LGU）实现令牌级与通道级的选择性脉冲发射；整合为测试时自适应路由架构 AdaS-ViT，并用渐进式时空课程学习稳定发放精度与路由掩码的协同适应。
AI.result: 在多数据规模与多模态基准上性能具竞争力；ImageNet-1k 上单图能耗 1.02–2.45 mJ，精度/能耗比达 32×–72×，处于经济推理区制，进一步推进能效边界。
AI.conclusion: 三维联合自适应发放 + 测试时路由是提升脉冲视觉 Transformer 能效的有效途径，可在几乎不损失精度的前提下大幅降低能耗；但结论仅基于分类类基准，缺少机器人/具身场景的实证。

title: RecallFlow: Episodic Memory as the Source Distribution of Generative Robot Policies
summary: Diffusion and flow-matching policies have become a standard choice for visuomotor imitation learning, owing to their ability to model multimodal action distributions. In memory-dependent manipulation, the robot must act on information that is no longer visible. Existing methods feed the observation history to the policy as an additional condition, while action generation still starts from Gaussian noise. However, the policy must then pick out the relevant target from a long and redundant history, leading to spurious correlations and unreliable decisions as the memory load grows. Additionally, the initial noise carries no information about what the robot has seen, leaving generation without guidance toward the remembered target. To address these issues, we propose RecallFlow, a flow-policy framework that builds the source distribution from episodic memory. Recall-Relocalization relates the memory to the current view through a few recall slots, so that the source reflects where the remembered targets are now. Recall Anchors then turns each slot into a Gaussian component of the source, enabling generation to start close to the intended action instead of from noise. The transport network then completes the action from the current observation alone, keeping inference nearly as cheap as a memoryless policy. We further build a suite of memory-dependent tasks grouped by memory load and compare all policies under a matched protocol. Extensive experiments show that RecallFlow achieves a state-of-the-art average success rate of 80.4% on the public MIKASA-Robo memory benchmark, and outperforms the strongest baseline by 20.3 points on our suite and by 18.8 points on four real-robot tasks.

AI.tldr: RecallFlow 提出基于情节记忆构建流匹配策略源分布的方法：通过 Recall-Relocalization 用少量 recall slots 将记忆与当前视角关联，Recall Anchors 将每个 slot 转化为源分布的高斯分量，使动作生成从记忆引导的近似动作出发而非纯噪声，推理时仅需当前观测。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散/流匹配视觉运动策略在记忆依赖操作中，直接把冗余的观测历史作为额外条件、仍从高斯噪声出发生成动作，导致需从长历史中筛选相关信息，产生伪相关与不可靠决策；且初始噪声不含任何已见信息，生成缺乏朝记忆目标的引导。
AI.method: RecallFlow 框架：(1) Recall-Relocalization，用若干 recall slots 将情节记忆与当前视图关联，使源分布反映记忆目标当前所在位置；(2) Recall Anchors，将每个 slot 转为源分布的一个高斯混合分量，令生成从接近意图动作处启程；(3) transport network 仅凭当前观测完成动作生成，使推理成本接近无记忆策略。并构建按记忆负载分组的一套记忆依赖任务，在统一协议下对比所有策略。
AI.result: MIKASA-Robo 记忆基准上平均成功率 80.4%（SOTA）；在自建任务套件上超过最强基线 20.3 个点，在四项真机任务上超过 18.8 个点。
AI.conclusion: 将记忆显式注入生成过程的源分布，而非仅作为条件，可显著缓解长历史下的伪相关问题，并在保持低推理开销的同时提升记忆依赖操作的成功率与可靠性。

title: GaussLearner: 3D Gaussian Primitives as Self-Regulating Continual Learners
summary: Continual learning of 3D Gaussian fields aims to maintain faithful reconstructions of the evolving world. However, directly fine-tuning an existing Gaussian field on new observations can cause catastrophic forgetting of previously reconstructed content. To address this challenge, existing methods employ selective local optimization, replay, or parameter regularization, yet still struggle to balance adaptation to scene changes with preservation of still-valid content. Our key insight is to view 3D Gaussian primitives themselves as self-regulating continual learners. Based on this insight, we introduce GaussLearner, which equips each Gaussian with a closed continual-learning loop connecting observation, self-regulation, and adaptation at the primitive level. At each novel state, GaussLearner first attributes pixel-wise inconsistencies in current observations to their contributing Gaussians. Each Gaussian then self-regulates through a learning weight that balances current observations against cross-state reliability. This weight governs both Gaussian parameter adaptation and optimizer memory refresh. As current inconsistencies are resolved, the adaptation outcome renews each Gaussian's reliability for future states. The resulting field is a globally coupled population of locally self-regulating learners. Across scenes from CL-Splats, WAT, and our CL-3D dataset, GaussLearner improves average PSNR by 3.41 dB over the strongest baseline. On CL-3D, it achieves the best reconstruction quality on both changed and unchanged views.

AI.tldr: GaussLearner 将 3D Gaussian 基元视为自调节持续学习器，为每个高斯赋予"观测—自调节—适应"闭环，通过像素级不一致归因与学习权重平衡当前观测与跨状态可靠性，从而缓解持续重建中的灾难性遗忘。
AI.motivation: 场景持续变化时，直接在新观测上微调高斯场会导致对已重建内容的灾难性遗忘；现有选择性局部优化、回放和参数正则化方法难以平衡"适应变化"与"保留仍有效内容"。
AI.method: 在每个新状态，将当前观测中的像素级不一致归因到贡献该像素的高斯；每个高斯用学习权重自调节，权衡当前观测与跨状态可靠性；该权重同时控制高斯参数适应与优化器记忆刷新；随不一致被消解，适应结果更新各高斯的可靠性，形成全局耦合的局部自调节学习者群体。
AI.result: 在 CL-Splats、WAT 及自建 CL-3D 数据集上，平均 PSNR 较最强基线提升 3.41 dB；在 CL-3D 上，变化视角与未变化视角的 reconstruction quality 均为最优。
AI.conclusion: 把持续学习粒度下放到高斯基元本身是可行且有效的，可在无需回放或全局正则的情况下兼顾场景变化适应与原内容保持，为增量 3D 重建提供新范式。

title: ZERITH V2.5: From Predictive Power to Policy Learnability
comment: 50 pages, 17 figures, 22 tables. Project page: this https URL
summary: When humans learn to manipulate an unfamiliar object, they may already be able to anticipate how its state will change while still being unable to control it skillfully. This gap between prediction and control motivates us to study how the priors acquired by video generation models can be used effectively by an action policy. We present ZERITH V2.5, a video-action model (VAM) in which the action policy reads intermediate features of a video generation model, and use it to study, under fixed demonstrations and a fixed total number of updates, what kind of predictive training improves subsequent action learning. We find that the way video predictive training is supervised affects subsequent action learning. In our experiments, adapting at many noise levels yields a large gain, while adapting only at the noise level used at deployment yields none. Weight-transfer experiments further show that the gain stays with the adapted weights when they remain in the video generation model and disappears when they are used only to initialize the action policy. Initial loss and gradient measurements at the start of joint training indicate that target-domain predictive training gives the video model a better starting state, making subsequent joint learning of prediction and action easier. Under matched data and training budgets, predictive adaptation improves control. We evaluate the complete policy on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, Meta-World MT50, and real-robot tasks.

AI.tldr: ZERITH V2.5 用视频-动作模型研究"视频生成模型的预测先验如何被动作策略利用"，发现预测训练的监督方式（多噪声级适配）显著提升控制性能，且增益依赖于权重保留在视频模型中。
AI.motivation: 人类学习操作陌生物体时，往往先能"预测"状态变化，之后才掌握"控制"。作者想利用视频生成模型已有的预测先验来加速动作学习，但预测能力如何转化为控制能力并不清楚，因此需要研究预测训练的具体形式对后续动作学习的影响。
AI.method: 构建 video-action model (VAM)：动作策略读取视频生成模型的中间特征。在固定演示数据与固定总更新次数下，对比不同视频预测训练方案的迁移效果；并做权重迁移实验（适配权重保留在视频模型中 vs 仅用于初始化动作策略），以及联合训练起始时刻的损失与梯度测量分析。
AI.result: 在多个噪声级上做预测适配带来大幅增益，而只在部署所用单一噪声级适配则几乎无增益；增益在适配权重保留于视频生成模型时存在，仅用于初始化动作策略时消失；起始损失/梯度表明目标域预测训练赋予视频模型更好的初始状态，使后续预测-动作联合学习更易。在 LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、Meta-World MT50 及真实机器人任务上评测了完整策略。
AI.conclusion: 在匹配数据与训练预算下，预测适配可改善控制；关键在于"如何监督"预测训练以及适配权重是否留在视频模型中，即预训练先验应作为共享表征而非一次性初始化。

title: ACUS: An Angular Calibrated Uncertainty Score for Incomplete-View CT
summary: Sparse-view and limited-arc computed tomography (CT) are commonly treated as projection completion: a network fills an unmeasured view, and the result is ranked by similarity to one ground-truth image. That score can be high even when the query angle is far from every acquired measurement, because a learned prior may invent anatomy the scan never constrained. Existing protocols therefore leave a basic question unanswered: how does predictive reliability change with distance from the acquired views? We propose the Angular Calibrated Uncertainty Score (ACUS) to answer that question. ACUS is the Winkler interval score of a nominal 90% predictive interval on held-out projections, binned by distance to the nearest acquired view. It charges interval width and adds a large miss penalty when a held-out pixel falls outside the interval, so a narrow band helps only when coverage holds. We use collapse on acquired angles as a necessary consistency check on the predictor. On chest and dental cone-beam orbits, interval width grows with the angular gap. Empirical coverage ranges from 77% to 92%, and the peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) of the point estimate falls as the width rises. Nearest-neighbor, interpolation, and point completion, each given one residual scale, have zero reported far coverage and incur outside-distance penalties. ACUS exposes gap-dependent overconfidence that a point-estimate PSNR alone does not measure.

AI.tldr: 提出ACUS（角度校准不确定性分数）：以按"到最近已采集视角的角度距离"分箱的Winkler区间分数评估CT投影补全预测的可靠性，揭示远角度间隙下的过度自信。
AI.motivation: 稀疏视角/有限弧CT常被当作投影补全任务，仅用与单一真值图像的相似度（如PSNR）排序。当查询角度远离所有已采集测量时，学习到的先验可能"捏造"解剖结构，导致高分却不可靠。现有评测协议无法回答"预测可靠性如何随与采集视角的距离变化"这一基本问题。
AI.method: 在留出投影上构造名义90%预测区间，按到最近采集视角的角度距离分箱，计算Winkler区间分数（同时惩罚区间宽度与未覆盖的漏检）。同时以"在已采集角度上坍缩（collapse）"作为预测器的必要一致性检查。在胸部与牙科锥束（cone-beam）轨道上评估。
AI.result: 区间宽度随角度间隙增大；经验覆盖率范围为77%–92%；点估计PSNR随区间宽度上升而下降。最近邻、插值、点补全三类基线在给定单一残差尺度时，远角度报告覆盖率为零，并承受超出区间的惩罚。
AI.conclusion: ACUS可暴露依赖角间隙的过度自信，这是单纯点估计PSNR无法测量的。该方法为稀疏/有限弧CT的预测可靠性提供了角度校准的评测指标。

title: Detect What You Need: Chain-of-Causal Reasoning for 3D Intent Grounding
summary: Accurately matching human intentions in 3D space is an important goal of artificial intelligence. Recently, 3D Intention Grounding (3D-IG) has emerged, aiming to localize target 3D objects given a natural-language intent. Unlike conventional visual grounding with descriptive referring expressions, 3D-IG intents are abstract and non-descriptive, making object localization substantially more challenging. This requires inferring latent functional requirements from non-descriptive intents and aligning them with object-level 3D representations. However, existing methods largely rely on implicit intent-object matching, leading to logical gaps and limited interpretability, robustness, and generalization. To address these challenges, we propose Chain-of-Causal Reasoning (CoCR), a causality-inspired functional dependency reasoning framework that explicitly bridges abstract intentions and candidate objects through intermediate functional requirements. Specifically, CoCR progressively decomposes complex intents into ordered functional requirements, thereby forming an explicit intent-function-object reasoning chain that links abstract intentions to object suitability. Building on this chain, we construct a causality-inspired functional dependency graph to model requirement-attribute relationships and introduce a causal-visual alignment module that aligns function-aware representations with the geometric-semantic features of 3D point clouds, enabling bidirectional verification between structured functional reasoning and visual evidence. Extensive experiments on 3D Intention Grounding and 3D Visual Grounding demonstrate that our method enhances intent-aware object localization. Our code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出Chain-of-Causal Reasoning (CoCR)框架，将抽象3D意图分解为有序功能需求，构建因果启发的功能依赖图，并用因果-视觉对齐模块实现功能推理与点云几何语义的双向验证。
AI.motivation: 3D Intention Grounding的意图抽象、非描述性，需从意图中推断潜在功能需求并与物体级3D表征对齐；现有方法依赖隐式意图-物体匹配，存在逻辑断层，可解释性、鲁棒性与泛化性受限。
AI.method: (1) 将复杂意图逐步分解为有序功能需求，形成显式“意图-功能-物体”推理链；(2) 基于该链构建因果启发的功能依赖图，建模需求-属性关系；(3) 引入因果-视觉对齐模块，将功能感知表征与3D点云的几何-语义特征对齐，实现结构化功能推理与视觉证据的双向验证。
AI.result: 在3D Intention Grounding与3D Visual Grounding基准上均取得提升，增强了意图感知的物体定位能力；代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 显式功能需求中介与因果依赖建模可弥补隐式匹配的缺陷，为抽象意图接地提供更可解释、更稳健的推理范式，并可与通用3D视觉接地任务兼容。

title: GramStatTexNet: Efficient, Interpretable, and Neuro-Inspired Texture Analysis-by-Synthesis
summary: Deep networks achieve high realism in texture synthesis but often rely on opaque, over-parameterized representations that have limited direct connection to biological vision. Neuroscience-informed pyramid models are interpretable, compact, and biologically inspired, but rely on small, hand-curated statistics sets that are difficult to generalize or extend. We introduce GramStatTexNet, a hybrid analysis-by-synthesis framework that combines the multi-scale Gabor filter structure of classical models with the flexibility of Gramian-based correlations, organized into structured filter families. This structured representation enables analyses that are challenging for deep-feature methods: each statistic carries a named filter-family identity, allowing us to decompose synthesis fidelity into per-family contributions and to learn an interpretable, low-dimensional embedding that preserves perceptual texture content. We compare our framework to classical and deep texture-synthesis baselines across diverse texture categories, and on multiple perceptual metrics, highlighting the compactness and interpretability advantages of this hybrid representation, alongside competitive synthesis quality. This same framework extends naturally to peripheral textures via spatial pooling, and to dynamic textures using a spatiotemporal filter bank. GramStatTexNet provides a unified, interpretable framework for analyzing and modeling visual information with natural extensions across space, time, and eccentricity. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: GramStatTexNet 提出一种分析-合成混合框架，将经典多尺度 Gabor 滤波器结构与 Gramian 相关性统计结合成结构化滤波器族表示，用于可解释、紧凑的纹理合成与感知嵌入分析。
AI.motivation: 深度网络纹理合成真实度高，但表示不透明、过参数化，与生物视觉联系弱；神经科学启发的金字塔模型虽紧凑可解释，却依赖少量手工统计量而难以泛化与扩展。作者希望兼得二者优点。
AI.method: 基于多尺度 Gabor 滤波器构建结构化滤波器族，在每个滤波器族内计算 Gramian 相关性统计量，形成带命名的滤波器族身份的分析-合成框架；据此把合成保真度分解为各族贡献，并学习保持感知纹理内容的低维可解释嵌入。通过空间池化扩展到外周视觉，通过时空滤波器组扩展到动态纹理。
AI.result: 在多种纹理类别和多项感知指标上与经典及深度纹理合成基线对比，合成质量具竞争力，同时体现紧凑性与可解释性优势；每族统计量可分解，低维嵌入能保留感知纹理结构。
AI.conclusion: GramStatTexNet 提供了跨空间、时间与偏心度的统一可解释视觉信息分析与建模框架，但其应用局限于纹理/图像统计建模，未涉及机器人、3D重建或具身智能任务。

title: Mean Curvature Minimizing Foliations Of A Vector Field
summary: Streamline patterns are ubiquitous in nature. Prominent examples include white matter fibre tracts in the mammalian brain and arrangements of elongated cells, such as cardiomyocytes in the heart wall. It has been posited that such organisations foliate into locally smooth surfaces to optimise function. However, the recovery of these foliations from a single vector field aligned with the local orientation of the underlying sheets remains an open problem. We address this challenge by introducing a mathematical model of a sheet and developing an algorithm for sheet inference, from measurements of the oriented structures. Given an input vector field, our model estimates a second vector field that is orthonormal to it, while also requiring the Lie bracket of the two to vanish. To balance sheet likelihood against low surface area, we also reduce the mean curvature of the recovered local surface.
