We compute the first variation of an associated energy and provide a numerical method which admits an efficient, parallel implementation for sheet estimation. We demonstrate our approach on both synthetic and biological examples, motivated by applications to medical imaging. These include white matter fibre tracts from a brain atlas and confocal microscopy images of cleared heart wall tissue. For the latter we are able to reconstruct sheets aligned with local cardiomyocyte directions at unprecedented (micrometre) scale.

AI.tldr: 该文提出流线叶面（sheet）的数学建模与推断算法：在给定一个与局部取向一致的向量场条件下，估计与之正交的第二向量场，并要求二者Lie括号为零、同时最小化局部平均曲率，由能量泛函一阶变分导出可高效并行的数值求解方法。
AI.motivation: 自然界中流线模式（如脑白质纤维束、心肌细胞排列）普遍被认为形成局部光滑曲面以优化功能，但如何仅从与局部取向对齐的单一向量场恢复这些叶面仍是未解问题；医学影像中缺乏从取向测量直接重建曲面结构的工具。
AI.method: 建立叶面的数学定义；给定输入向量场，求解一个与其正交的辅助向量场，约束两场Lie括号为零以保证叶状（foliation）可积性，并加入平均曲率项以平衡叶面似然与低表面积正则；推导关联能量泛函的第一变分并给出可并行实现的数值迭代方案。
AI.result: 在合成数据与生物数据上验证：成功从脑图谱白质纤维束重建叶面；对透明化处理的心壁组织共聚焦显微图像，重建出与局部心肌细胞方向对齐的叶面，达到微米级（前所未有）尺度。
AI.conclusion: 可积性约束（Lie括号为零）加曲率正则的单向量场叶面推断框架有效且可并行，但验证局限于医学/生物成像场景，未涉机器人或具身系统。

title: Keep the Reasoning, Read the Image: On-Demand Visual KV for Multi-Turn Reasoning VLMs
summary: Reasoning vision-language models (VLMs) think for thousands of tokens before they answer, and retention policies keep the KV cache affordable by pruning it as the reasoning grows. We find that this pruning sacrifices the image in multi-turn conversations: the image and the reasoning share one budget, so the growing reasoning crowds the visual entries out. A chart question that loses 8 points to the full cache when asked first loses 24 points when asked after a round of reasoning. Protecting a small visual reserve from eviction recovers most of this loss, while adding the same slots to the shared budget recovers considerably less. The image therefore lacks protection, not capacity. Based on this finding, we propose ShelfKV, a training-free method that works on top of existing retention policies. It keeps every visual entry in CPU memory and, at each decoding step, swaps the visual entries that the current query scores highest into the attention slots of the text entries it scores lowest. The image is never evicted, yet it occupies attention slots only while it is read. We evaluate ShelfKV on four benchmarks, three of them conversational, with two retention policies and two reasoning VLMs. In conversations, it improves the strongest existing policy, DBTrimKV, by up to 20.3 points at matched GPU memory, and still leads by 8.7 points when DBTrimKV uses twice the memory. It also consistently outperforms a fixed visual reserve of matched GPU memory in these settings, without hurting accuracy on standalone questions. These results show that the image should be protected from the reasoning but read only on demand.

AI.tldr: ShelfKV：免训练方法，通过将视觉 KV 条目常驻 CPU、按查询分数按需换入低分文本槽位，解决多轮推理 VLM 中视觉 token 被推理 token 挤出 KV cache 的问题，DBTrimKV 上提升至 20.3 分。
AI.motivation: 推理型视觉语言模型生成数千 token 的思维链，保留策略（retention policy）通过剪枝 KV cache 控制开销；但图像与推理共享同一预算，增长的推理内容会把视觉条目挤出，导致多轮对话中图表类问题性能大幅下降（首轮 -8 分，一轮推理后 -24 分）。作者指出问题本质是图像缺少保护而非容量不足。
AI.method: ShelfKV 为无训练、可叠加于现有保留策略之上的方法：所有视觉条目常驻 CPU 内存；每个解码步将当前查询打分最高的视觉条目换入打分最低的文本条目的注意力槽位。图像永不被驱逐，但仅在被读取时占用注意力槽位。
AI.result: 在 4 个基准（3 个为对话式）、2 种保留策略、2 个推理 VLM 上评测；对话场景下在同 GPU 显存下比最强基线 DBTrimKV 最高提升 20.3 分，即使 DBTrimKV 使用两倍显存仍领先 8.7 分；优于同显存下的固定视觉预留方案，且不损害单轮问题准确率。
AI.conclusion: 图像应受保护免受推理内容挤占，但应按需读取；"受保护而非扩容量"的洞察为长推理 VLM 的 KV cache 管理提供通用且免训练的改进路径。

title: DetectViT: Test-time Backdoor Detection for Vision Transformers via Inter-Head Attention Discrepancy
summary: Vision Transformers (ViTs) now underpin the visual encoders of most multimodal models, but this success comes at a cost: relying on third-party pretrained checkpoints leaves these systems open to backdoor attacks. Existing test-time detection methods rely on either the predicted label or intermediate embeddings, limiting their applicability across diverse tasks and incurring substantial computational overhead. In this work, we study how backdoor triggers affect the multi-head attention mechanism of ViTs and identify two distinct anomalous patterns: $\textit{complete attention hijacking}$, causing the attention to exhibit abnormally high inter-head spatial overlap, and $\textit{partial attention hijacking}$, causing an abnormally large variance in the concentration of the attention distribution. Motivated by these findings, we propose $\textbf{DetectViT}$, a test-time backdoor detection method that requires neither training data, model outputs, nor any prior knowledge of the trigger. DetectViT quantifies the two hijacking phenomena via an inter-head consistency score and an inter-head entropy variance score, with thresholds estimated from a small out-of-distribution (OOD) calibration set drawn from an arbitrary source. Across four representative attacks, diverse architectures (DeiT, CLIP, and LLaVA), and downstream tasks (image classification and captioning), DetectViT substantially outperforms all baselines with as few as 64--128 OOD calibration samples, achieving a true positive rate of $100\%$ and a false positive rate of $0.17\%$ on BadCLIP. Notably, it introduces negligible additional overhead by relying solely on attention weights already computed during inference. Code is available at: this https URL .

AI.tldr: DetectViT：利用ViT多头注意力的两种劫持现象（完全劫持→头间空间重叠异常高；部分劫持→注意力集中度方差异常大），以头间一致性分数与头间熵方差分数实现无需训练数据、模型输出与触发器先验的测试时后门检测。
AI.motivation: ViT已成为多模态模型视觉编码器的主流，但其依赖第三方预训练权重，易受后门攻击。现有测试时检测依赖预测标签或中间嵌入，跨任务适用性差且计算开销大。
AI.method: 分析后门触发对多头注意力的影响，归纳出完全劫持（头间空间重叠异常升高）与部分劫持（注意力分布集中度方差异常增大）两种模式；据此构造头间一致性分数与头间熵方差分数，并用来自任意来源的小规模OOD校准集（64–128样本）估计阈值，仅依赖推理时已计算的注意力权重。
AI.result: 在四类代表性攻击、DeiT/CLIP/LLaVA多种架构与图像分类、图像描述任务上全面超越基线；BadCLIP上以64–128个OOD样本取得100%真阳性率、0.17%假阳性率，额外开销可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 注意力头间的空间重叠与熵方差是后门触发的稳定指纹，可作为轻量、通用、无需任务输出与触发器先验的测试时检测范式，适用于多模态与多下游任务场景。

title: Improve How You Improve: Recursive Policy Self-Improvement for Zero-Shot Open-Vocabulary Multi-Object Navigation
summary: To advance the development of embodied general navigation, zero-shot open-vocabulary multi-object navigation has attracted increasing attention, aiming to enable robots to efficiently search multiple objects in unseen environments without training. For this task, the key lies in improving navigation policies from earlier searches to locate subsequent goals more efficiently. Recent methods automate this process through trajectory reflection and rule revision, enabling policy self-improvement. However, the mechanisms for diagnosing problems and generating revisions are typically designed by humans and remain fixed across iterations. Consequently, the system's capacity for continued self-improvement remains constrained, even as its navigation policy evolves. To this end, we propose RPSI-Nav, a Recursive Policy Self-Improvement framework for zero-shot multi-object navigation that revises both the navigation program and its revision mechanism. RPSI-Nav diagnoses search behavior, requests diagnostic views when existing observations cannot distinguish competing causes, and generates targeted navigation revisions. Feedback from subsequent goal searches is linked to the rules that produced these revisions, guiding changes to diagnosis, observation acquisition, and revision planning. The updated improver governs subsequent navigation improvements, forming a recursive loop in which RPSI-Nav revises its own improvement process. Across goals, the robot conditionally inherits accepted program updates and spatial memory, enabling search experience to improve both future navigation and adaptation. Benchmark experiments and qualitative real-robot evaluations validate RPSI-Nav's effectiveness.

AI.tldr: RPSI-Nav：面向零样本多目标导航的递归式策略自我改进框架，可同时修改导航程序与其改进机制（诊断、观测获取、修订规划），并通过跨目标的程序更新与空间记忆继承实现经验迁移。
AI.motivation: 零样本开放词汇多目标导航需在未知环境中连续搜索多个目标，核心在于利用早期搜索经验提升后续目标搜索策略。现有方法虽通过轨迹反思与规则修订实现策略自我改进，但其问题诊断与修订生成机制由人工设计且迭代中固定不变，系统持续自我改进能力因此受限。
AI.method: 提出 RPSI-Nav 递归策略自我改进框架：(1) 诊断搜索行为，当现有观测无法区分竞争性原因时主动请求诊断视角；(2) 生成针对性导航修订；(3) 将后续目标搜索的反馈关联到产生该修订的规则，进而更新诊断、观测获取与修订规划模块；(4) 更新后的"改进器"主导后续导航改进，形成修订自身改进过程的递归闭环；(5) 跨目标有条件继承已接受的程序更新与空间记忆。
AI.result: 基准实验与定性真机评测验证了框架有效性；机器人可利用先前搜索经验同时改进未来导航与适应能力。
AI.conclusion: 将改进机制本身纳入自我改进循环（递归元改进）是突破固定人工规则瓶颈的有效途径，经验跨目标继承进一步放大收益。

title: When accuracy hides risk: risk-controlled confirmation of the critical view of safety under expert disagreement
summary: Automated assessment of the critical view of safety (CVS) in laparoscopic cholecystectomy has advanced rapidly, but a deployed check must decide, before the first clip, whether to confirm CVS. The standard rule calibrates a threshold so that false confirmations are rare on average. We show that this rule concentrates its errors on disputed videos, which one of three expert raters judged sufficient, and that the failure is structural. When reference labels are votes of a panel sampled from a larger expert pool, the rule that maximizes sensitivity at a fixed average false-confirmation rate also maximizes false confirmation of disputed videos, and for recognizers that recover expert judgement with less noise this rate rises with accuracy. We propose certified confirmation, a risk-controlled monitoring rule whose threshold is selected by multiple testing so that, with probability at least 1 - {\delta}, false confirmation is at most {\alpha} overall, among disputed videos, within vendor and country groups, and before CVS is visible, using disputed labels only to calibrate. In a pre-specified, hash-locked evaluation on the 300 test videos (18 countries) of the SAGES CVS Challenge, standard calibration falsely confirmed 8 of 39 disputed videos (0.21; one-sided p = 0.037 against {\alpha} = 0.10), whereas certified confirmation confirmed 2 (one-sided 95% upper bound 0.15). On development data, protection held for vendor and country groups left out of calibration. The cost was confirming 10% rather than 35% of sufficient videos on time. Average accuracy hides this risk; disputed cases must be protected explicitly.

AI.tldr: 提出"认证确认"(certified confirmation)风险受控监测规则，用多重检验选阈值，保证在争议视频、厂商/国别分组及CVS不可见情形下误确认率≤α（概率≥1−δ）；SAGES CVS挑战赛300测试视频上误确认由8/39降至2/39。
AI.motivation: 现有CVS自动判定在首次夹闭前需决定是否确认安全视野，标准阈值校准只保证平均误确认率低，却把错误集中到专家评分存在争议的视频上；作者指出当参考标签为专家小组投票时，最大化固定平均误确认率下灵敏度的规则必然最大化争议视频的误确认，且识别器越准该风险越大，属结构性问题。
AI.method: 将阈值选择表述为多重检验问题，提出带风险控制的监测规则"认证确认"：以至少1−δ概率保证总体、争议视频子集、厂商与国别分组、以及CVS不可见阶段的误确认率均不超过α；争议标签仅用于校准。在SAGES CVS挑战赛300段测试视频（18国）上做预注册、哈希锁定的评估，并考察留出厂商/国别组的迁移保护。
AI.result: 标准校准在39段争议视频中误确认8段（0.21；对α=0.10单侧p=0.037），认证确认仅2段（单侧95%上界0.15）；开发数据上对未参与校准的厂商与国别分组保护依然成立；代价是充分视频按时确认率由35%降至10%。
AI.conclusion: 平均精度会掩盖争议样本上的系统性风险，需对争议病例显式保护；该方法提供可证明的分组与阶段风险界，但以灵敏度/时效为代价，适用于高风险的部署前确认场景。

title: Geometry-bridge flow matching for blind rigid-motion correction in head cone-beam CT
summary: Rigid motion of a patient head during head cone-beam CT (CBCT) scan can degrade image quality and complicate recovery of accurate anatomical structures from the measured projections. We present a 3D flow-matching prior approach that learns the image changes induced by motion. Its geometry-bridge connects motion-corrupted and motion-free Feldkamp-Davis-Kress (FDK) reconstructed images of the same source volume through progressively reduced simulated motion. The forward projector's geometry derivative supplies analytic velocity targets along this path. A plug-and-play loop encompasses the learned image updates together with spline-based pose estimation, conjugate-gradient data consistency, and image total-variation regularization. Both the refined image volume and the FDK reconstructed image volume at the estimated poses are evaluated. On simulated 360-view scans from 30 held-out CQ500 patients with nominal per-component motion amplitudes within 10 mm / 10 degrees, the framework achieved state-of-the-art image reconstruction quality and motion accuracy in comparison with other methos such as learned autofocus and diffusion-based joint reconstruction. Mean peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) reached 37.1 dB and mean detector-plane reprojection error (RPE) was 0.27 mm. With matched endpoints at the inference settings, the geometry bridge improved PSNR by 1.6 dB and reduced RPE by 33% relative to image-linear training. With 50 prior updates and coarse-to-fine motion estimation, total processing time averaged 9.1 minutes per patient on an RTX A6000.

AI.tldr: 用3D flow-matching先验学习“运动引起的图像变化”，通过“几何桥”路径为头CBCT扫描做图像去运动伪影与位姿估计。
AI.motivation: 头部锥束CT扫描期间患者头部刚性运动会降低图像质量并破坏从投影中恢复解剖结构的准确性，需要同时复原图像与估计位姿。
AI.method: 构建同一源体数据在“逐步减小模拟运动”下得到的运动污染与无运动FDK图像之间的geometry-bridge，用前投影几何导数给出解析速度目标训练flow-matching先验；推理时plug-and-play迭代，将学到的图像更新与样条位姿估计、共轭梯度数据一致性、TV正则结合，粗到细估计运动。
AI.result: 30例CQ500留出患者、360视角、每分量≤10 mm/10°运动下PSNR均值37.1 dB、探测器平面重投影误差0.27 mm，优于learned autofocus与扩散联合重建；geometric bridge相对image-linear训练提升1.6 dB并降低RPE 33%；50次先验更新约9.1分钟/例（RTX A6000）。
AI.conclusion: flow-matching几何桥先验可有效校正CBCT头部刚性运动，兼得高质量重建与高精度位姿估计，但属医学成像领域专用方法，非通用3D/机器人核心技术。

title: ROBIN++: Unified Copyright Protection and Tamper Localization for Diffusion Models via Dual-Domain Synergistic Watermarking
summary: Digital watermarking provides a promising solution for verifying the provenance and integrity of generated content. However, existing methods often suffer from an inherent trade-off between copyright robustness and localization sensitivity due to the entanglement of conflicting signals within a single domain. In this paper, we propose ROBIN++, a paradigm that shifts from single-domain entanglement to a Dual-Domain Synergistic design. Our key insight is to explicitly decouple robustness and fragility during injection by assigning them to distinct domains, while re-coupling them for mutual reinforcement during verification. Specifically, we introduce an Adversarial Optimization Algorithm to inject a frequency-domain copyright watermark during generation, maximizing extraction robustness without visual artifacts. Complementarily, a Content-Aware Perturbation generator is integrated into the latent space to inject the spatial-domain localization watermark, ensuring sensitivity to spatial tampering with minimal interference to the copyright watermark. During verification, we propose a dual-branch synergistic detector that facilitates Frequency-to-Spatial Synergy, where robust spectral priors act as global anchors for local anomaly detection. Conversely, a Spatial-to-Frequency Refinement strategy is employed to rectify corrupted latent features using predicted tamper masks. Extensive experiments show that ROBIN++ significantly outperforms existing approaches in both copyright recovery and tamper localization accuracy, effectively mitigating the long-standing trade-off between the two tasks. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: ROBIN++ 提出双域协同水印框架，将版权鲁棒性与篡改定位敏感性分别注入频域和潜空间/空域，并在验证阶段互相强化，缓解二者固有权衡。
AI.motivation: 生成内容溯源与完整性验证需要兼顾“抗攻击的版权水印”和“对篡改敏感的定位水印”，但现有方法把两种冲突信号纠缠在单一域中，导致鲁棒性与敏感性此消彼长。
AI.method: (1) 注入端解耦：用对抗优化算法在生成过程中嵌入频域版权水印，提升提取鲁棒性并抑制视觉伪影；在潜空间集成内容感知扰动生成器注入空域定位水印，降低对版权水印的干扰。(2) 验证端再耦合：双分支协同检测器实现频域到空域协同（鲁棒频谱先验作为全局锚点引导局部异常检测），并采用空域到频域精修，用预测的篡改掩码校正受损潜特征。
AI.result: 实验表明，ROBIN++ 在版权恢复与篡改定位精度两方面均显著优于现有方法，有效缓解了长期存在的鲁棒性—敏感性权衡问题，并提供开源代码。
AI.conclusion: 通过双域解耦注入与协同验证的范式转变，可实质性突破单一域纠缠带来的性能瓶颈，为生成内容溯源与篡改定位提供统一方案。

title: CoT-WAM: Collaborative Training of Vision-Language Models and World-Action Models via Plan Latents
summary: General robot manipulation requires both semantic competence and physical foresight. World action models (WAMs) acquire an understanding of and predictive capability over the physical world by jointly modeling visual foresight and action distributions. However, existing WAMs still lack semantic competence: they have limited ability to perform open-world scene understanding, semantic reasoning, and long-horizon planning. Although vision-language models (VLMs) provide these capabilities, effectively integrating their semantic priors into WAM prediction and control remains challenging. To address this challenge, we propose CoT-WAM, a jointly trained WAM-VLM framework. CoT-WAM uses a learnable embedding to exchange information between the VLM and the WAM, which is supervised by textual and goal-image signals during training to encode rich intent information. A tailored two-stage training strategy enables joint optimization and more effective collaboration between the VLM and WAM. We evaluate CoT-WAM on six benchmarks covering control performance, zero-shot generalization, and long-horizon planning. CoT-WAM achieves SOTA performance on LIBERO, CALVIN, and RoboCasa-Kitchen, and demonstrates stronger zero-shot generalization on LIBERO-Plus and LIBERO-Pro without fine-tuning. On RoboCasa365, it further improves long-horizon planning over baselines with and without external planners. Real-world experiments further demonstrate the effectiveness of our method in practical deployments.

AI.tldr: CoT-WAM 通过可学习 embedding 在 VLM 与 World Action Model 之间交换信息，并以文本与目标图像信号监督该 embedding 编码意图，配合两阶段联合训练，提升机器人操作中的语义理解、零样本泛化与长程规划能力。
AI.motivation: 现有 World Action Model 具备物理前瞻与动作建模能力，但缺乏开放世界场景理解、语义推理与长程规划能力；VLM 虽具备语义先验，却难以有效注入 WAM 的预测与控制流程。
AI.method: 提出 CoT-WAM：联合训练的 WAM-VLM 框架。用可学习 embedding 作为 VLM 与 WAM 之间的信息交换通道，训练时由文本与目标图像信号监督以编码丰富意图；并设计定制的两阶段训练策略实现二者联合优化与协同。
AI.result: 在覆盖控制性能、零样本泛化与长程规划的六个基准上评测：LIBERO、CALVIN、RoboCasa-Kitchen 达 SOTA；无需微调在 LIBERO-Plus、LIBERO-Pro 上展现更强零样本泛化；RoboCasa365 上相对有/无外部规划器的基线均提升长程规划；真机实验验证实际部署有效性。
AI.conclusion: 将 VLM 语义先验通过与 WAM 的联合训练与 embedding 级信息交换机制整合，可在保持世界模型预测能力的同时显著增强开放世界语义理解与长程任务规划，是通向通用机器人操作的一种可行范式。

title: TacPilot: Does Touch Need to Be Everywhere?
summary: Tactile feedback helps visual manipulation policies respond to local contact, but changes in tactile observations do not always require corrective motion, and sustained corrections do not always require new tactile features. We introduce TacPilot, a tactile residual framework that separates representation updates from action intervention around a frozen visual policy. TacPilot uses a perception gate to determine when tactile features need refreshing and updates only affected regions while reusing unchanged features. A separate intervention gate determines whether bounded Cartesian and gripper residuals modify the nominal visual action. This separation allows tactile perception and action correction to follow different spatial and temporal demands during manipulation. In offline expert-trajectory replay, local feature reuse reduces encoded regions by 56.4% relative to periodic full encoding, with essentially unchanged action predictions. In an exploratory simulation evaluation spanning two cylinder sizes, TacPilot succeeds in 26 of 30 trials (86.7%). We further validate TacPilot on OpenArm v2 equipped with Paxini tactile sensors across four contact-rich manipulation tasks.

AI.tldr: TacPilot在冻结的视觉策略之上引入触觉残差框架，用感知门控决定何时刷新触觉特征（仅更新受影响区域、复用未变特征），用独立的干预门控决定是否施加有界的笛卡尔与夹爪残差动作。
AI.motivation: 触觉反馈对视觉操作策略的局部接触响应有帮助，但触觉观测变化不必总触发纠正动作，持续纠正也未必需要新触觉特征；将触觉表征更新与动作干预耦合限制了效率与灵活性。
AI.method: 以冻结视觉策略生成名义动作；感知门控按需刷新触觉特征并区域复用；干预门控独立判断是否叠加有界Cartesian与gripper残差；离线专家轨迹回放与仿真/真机（OpenArm v2 + Paxini触觉传感器，四类接触密集任务）验证。
AI.result: 当地特征复用在离线回放中将编码区域减少56.4%且动作预测基本不变；两种圆柱尺寸仿真探索性评估30次成功26次（86.7%）；OpenArm v2真机四类接触密集任务完成验证（摘要未给出量化成功率）。
AI.conclusion: 解耦触觉感知刷新与动作干预可分别适配操作中不同的时空需求，在保持视觉策略性能的同时降低触觉编码开销，并在真机上具备可行性。

title: Sightline: Long-Window Speculative Decoding for Fast SVG Generation
comment: 45 pages, 23 figures, 34 tables. Code: this https URL
summary: Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) generation models write a graphic as code with one forward pass per token, so drawing is slow. Speculative decoding speeds them up losslessly, and block drafters guess many tokens per pass. On SVG, many of their rounds accept the whole draft and end only at the verification window. We find that their misses are rare and clumped, and that they stay accurate far deeper into a block than on natural language. A run-length identity and three propositions show that a longer window pays once the candidates are wide, up to the drafter's horizon. We propose Sightline, which pairs a window as long as the drafter's horizon with a draft tree wide enough to fill it. Experiments cover text-to-SVG and image-to-SVG with three models on six benchmarks from MMSVG, MMSVG-2M and SArena. In every setting, Sightline is the fastest of the compared lossless decoders. On SArena, it stays the fastest when every decoder shares one loop control. It also leads in almost every setting of six models from four other families, which write SVG code, compressed SVG tokens or Lottie JSON. Analyses trace the lead to rounds that shorter windows cut off, both in loop-free content and in loops. Speculative decoding also saves time for choosing samples by rendering, which beats choosing by likelihood. These results suggest that speculative decoding on vector graphics should verify as far as the drafter sees. Code and data are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出 Sightline：将投机解码的验证窗口扩展至 drafter 的预测视界，并配合足够宽的草稿树，无损加速 SVG/Lottie 等矢量图形生成。
AI.motivation: SVG 生成模型逐 token 自回归前向，绘图推理慢；现有块级投机解码在 SVG 域上存在"整块接受、只在窗口末端才失配"的现象未被利用。
AI.method: 分析发现 SVG 上草稿失配稀疏且成簇、块内深处仍保持高准确率；给出 run-length 同一性及三个命题，证明候选足够宽时更长窗口收益成立。据此设计 Sightline：验证窗口长度=drafter 视界，草稿树宽度足以填满窗口；并用于渲染式采样选择。
AI.result: 在 MMSVG、MMSVG-2M、SArena 六基准、三模型（text-to-SVG 与 image-to-SVG）上，所有设置中均为最快的无损解码器；统一循环控制下仍最快；在 4 个其他家族 6 个模型（SVG 代码、压缩 SVG token、Lottie JSON）上几乎全部领先。渲染选样优于似然选样。
AI.conclusion: 矢量图形投机解码应"验证到草稿器能看到的地方"；更长窗口+宽草稿树是无损加速的关键设计原则。

title: PReMind: When Personal Memory Meets Visual Hazards
summary: Personalized vision-language assistants use visual observations and personal memories to provide advice tailored to the user. When the observed scene contains a physical hazard, personal context, such as allergies, medical conditions, or mobility constraints, can change what help is appropriate. Responding appropriately therefore requires recognizing the visible hazard and applying the relevant person's information. We introduce PReMind-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark that evaluates this combination across diverse hazards and personal-memory conditions. It separately measures memory access, grounding, abstention, and hazard response, and assesses joint success on interdependency cases. Existing models often satisfy one requirement while failing the other, and training only for safety or personalization leaves a gap in joint success. We therefore propose PReMind, a two-phase reinforcement learning framework that combines on-demand and forced-call interactions (memory always retrieved) to jointly train grounded memory use and hazard response. At 4B, PReMind raises joint success from 12.9% to 28.6% over its base on the interdependency set and improves hazard adequacy and correct abstention on the main test. Joint-success gains persist under forced-call evaluation and under a second LLM judge across three Phase II seeds; averaged over these seeds, joint success also improves on unseen hazard groups. These findings highlight the need to evaluate and train personal assistants to connect visual evidence with the relevant person's context.

AI.tldr: 提出 PReMind-Bench 基准，分别评测个性化视觉语言助手对个人记忆的访问、视觉定位、正确弃答与危险响应及其联合成功率；并提出两阶段强化学习框架 PReMind，结合按需与强制调用记忆的交互方式联合训练。4B 模型在相互依赖测试集上联合成功率由 12.9% 提升至 28.6%。
AI.motivation: 个性化视觉语言助手需结合视觉观测与个人记忆（过敏、疾病、行动受限等）才能对场景中的物理危险给出恰当回应；现有模型往往满足其中一项要求却失败于另一项，仅针对安全或个性化训练会留下联合能力的空白。
AI.method: 构建 PReMind-Bench 诊断基准，覆盖多类危险与个人记忆条件，独立度量记忆访问、视觉 grounding、弃答与危险响应，并在相互依赖样本上评估联合成功；训练侧提出两阶段 RL 框架，混合“按需检索”与“强制调用（始终检索记忆）”交互以联合训练 grounded 记忆使用与危险响应。
AI.result: 4B 模型在相互依赖集上联合成功率从 12.9% 升至 28.6%，主测试集上危险响应恰当率与正确弃答率均提升；在强制调用评测和第二 LLM 评判下增益稳健，并跨越三个 Phase II 随机种子，对未见危险类别的平均联合成功率也有提升。
AI.conclusion: 视觉证据与相关个人情境的联结是安全个性化助手的核心能力缺口，需在评测与训练两个层面同时针对性设计；两阶段 RL 与强制调用记忆是有效但仍有较大提升空间的方向。

title: SWIFT: Slow World, Instant Freshness, and Timely Action for Asynchronous Autonomous Driving
summary: Driving scenes keep changing during model computation, making both observation freshness and action-delivery time central to world-action planning. To retain rich generative world priors in autonomous driving without stalling real-time control, we present SWIFT (Slow World, Instant Freshness, and Timely action), a deployment-oriented asynchronous world-action system that moves world updates off the observation-to-action critical path. On a background GPU, a slow Video DiT streams surround-view history into read-only predictive world context, trained with a predictive span that covers both the update interval and background world computation. On a foreground GPU, a lightweight freshness carrier encodes current surround-view images into a gated key/value bank at every step, letting a fast Action DiT combine live visual feedback with the latest completed world context without waiting. On open-loop NAVSIM, SWIFT reaches 94.2 PDMS at 198.4 ms per decision with a trajectory scorer; on closed-loop Bench2Drive, it achieves an 80.30 Driving Score at 109.9 ms foreground latency. SWIFT further transfers to the Waymo E2E hidden test (8.0050 Rater Feedback Score) and nuScenes (0.54 m mean endpoint error, 0.03% mean collision rate). Across all four benchmarks, SWIFT achieves the best results among compared world-action methods, establishing a favorable accuracy-latency trade-off.

AI.tldr: SWIFT is an asynchronous world-action system for autonomous driving that offloads slow world-model updates to a background GPU while a foreground GPU runs a fast Action DiT guided by a lightweight "freshness carrier" KV bank of live surround-view images.
AI.motivation: Driving scenes change within the model's computation window, so observation freshness and action delivery latency are both critical for world-action planning. Existing generative world priors (Video DiT) are too slow to sit on the observation-to-action critical path, creating an accuracy-latency conflict.
AI.method: Two-GPU asynchronous decomposition: (1) background slow Video DiT streams surround-view history into a read-only predictive world context, trained with a predictive span covering the update interval plus background computation time; (2) foreground lightweight freshness carrier encodes current images into a gated K/V bank at every step, and a fast Action DiT fuses live visual feedback with the latest completed world context without blocking.
AI.result: NAVSIM open-loop: 94.2 PDMS at 198.4 ms/decision (with trajectory scorer); Bench2Drive closed-loop: 80.30 Driving Score at 109.9 ms foreground latency; Waymo E2E hidden test: 8.0050 Rater Feedback Score; nuScenes: 0.54 m mean endpoint error, 0.03% mean collision rate. Best among compared world-action methods on all four benchmarks.
AI.conclusion: Decoupling slow world-model updates from the action loop via an asynchronous, freshness-gated KV carrier preserves generative world priors while meeting real-time control budgets, yielding a favorable accuracy-latency trade-off for deployment.

title: RoboDx: Repair and Diagnosis of Faults in Robot Software
summary: A patch to a robot's navigation software can pass every unit test and still drive the robot off its path. Checking how the repaired robot drives catches such patches. It does not show that the agent found everything that was wrong. We introduce RoboDx, a generator of repair tasks for simulated robot navigation software with known injected faults. A hidden verifier marks a repair as verified only if the robot then drives correctly in hidden scenarios, which the agent never sees. A second track hides the code and asks the agent to pick the cause from a list of hypotheses. A task with two faults can contain a quiet fault, a fault that makes no hidden scenario fail unless the other fault is also present. On our set of 100 tasks, RoboDx-Hard-100, almost every repair by Claude Opus 5.5 with standard coding tools is verified. We analyse 94 of the tasks, 44 with one fault and 50 with two. On the 50 two-fault tasks, only 17 of Opus's 49 verified repairs remove both injected edits. Most faults left behind are configuration constants whose correct value the task's documentation does not state. Opus names both faults on 10/50 of these tasks when it cannot see the code. We then give four current models the same measurements of each faulty robot, picked so that, in the simulator, only the true cause produces all of them. The models name the cause on at most 38 of 94 tasks. They are right on almost all when they also get the simulator's output for every hypothesis. Their own predictions of that output give no detectable gain. On 97 tasks from real bug-fix pull requests, Claude Haiku 5.5, the weakest model on the generated tasks, scores lowest, and the other three models are not ordered.

AI.tldr: RoboDx 提出一套带隐藏验证器的机器人导航软件修复任务基准（100 个任务，含注入故障），揭示"修复后能开对"不等于"找到所有故障"：Opus 在 50 个双故障任务中仅 17/49 次真正移除两处注入编辑，且模型在给定充分观测时故障归因准确率最高仅 38/94。
AI.motivation: 机器人导航软件的补丁可通过全部单元测试，却仍会让机器人偏离路径；仅检查"修复后机器人能正确行驶"无法证明代理找到了所有问题。作者希望用带已知注入故障的生成式修复任务，量化现有大模型在机器人软件调试上的真实能力边界，尤其是"静默故障"（单独存在时无隐藏场景失败）与隐藏验证之间的矛盾。
AI.method: 构建 RoboDx：面向仿真机器人导航软件自动生成带已知注入故障的修复任务，并配套隐藏验证器——只有机器人在代理从未见过的隐藏场景中正确行驶，修复才被标记为 verified。设两条轨道：轨道一为代码修复（含双故障任务，可包含需两故障共存才触发的静默故障）；轨道二隐藏代码，要求代理从假设列表中选出根因。另给出四类模型对每个故障机器人的相同测量结果（在仿真器中精心挑选，使仅真实原因能产生全部这些测量），测试因果诊断能力，并考察模型是否需模拟器输出。最后在 97 个真实 bug-fix PR 任务上做跨模型对比。
AI.result: RoboDx-Hard-100 共 100 任务，分析其中 94 个（44 单故障、50 双故障）。Claude Opus 5.5 配合标准编码工具的修复几乎全部被隐藏验证器通过；但在 50 个双故障任务中，其 49 次 verified 修复里仅 17 次真正移除了两处注入编辑，多数残留为配置常量（文档未给出正确取值）。盲测代码时 Opus 在 10/50 任务上同时命中两个故障。因果关系任务中，四模型在最多 38/94 任务上给出正确根因；若额外提供每个假设对应的模拟器输出，几乎全部正确；而模型自行预测该输出则无显著增益。真实 PR 的 97 个任务上，Claude Haiku 5.5（生成任务中最弱）得分最低，其余三模型无稳定排序。
AI.conclusion: 端到端行为验证不足以确立修复的完备性——隐藏验证通过常伴随残留故障，说明"通过测试"与"根因全定位"之间存在系统性鸿沟。模型具备在给定充分观测下的因果诊断潜力，但无法自行生成这类观测；配置常量类故障与静默故障是主要失效模式。基准对真实 PR 任务迁移有效但模型间排序不稳定。

title: Mapping the Design Space of Feature Sampling for Optical Flow
summary: The computation of correlation features is crucial for optical flow estimation. Existing methods (e.g., RAFT) perform fixed-radius lookups on a cost volume, yielding a set of correlation features for each position; alternatively, WAFT performs single-point feature indexing, yielding one correlation feature vector per position. None of them designs a suitable correlation feature sampling scheme for each position according to regional characteristics. Our insight is that not every position requires the same sampling scheme. Applying an identical sampling scheme to every position is either redundant or insufficient and ignores the specific characteristics of the corresponding region. This paper rethinks the design of feature sampling and investigates the following question: should the support of feature sampling---i.e., the extent and directions over which evidence is aggregated---be learned separately for each query position? To study this question, we propose SAGE (Sampling with Anisotropic Gaussian Expectation). This method replaces single-point sampling with a per-pixel anisotropic Gaussian expectation on a fixed candidate grid centered on the current optical flow estimate. A positive-definite precision matrix controls the scale, anisotropy, and orientation of the sampling support, with single-point sampling included as its limiting case. Consequently, the sampling support becomes an explicit and analyzable design variable and provides a principled way to analyze how directional feature aggregation affects correspondence learning. Extensive experiments show that SAGE, while adding only 1.5% multiply-accumulate operations (MACs), effectively improves zero-shot cross-dataset generalization. When trained only on FlyingChairs and FlyingThings, SAGE reduces the end-point error (EPE) by 24.2% and 16.4% on Sintel clean and final, and reduces KITTI F1-epe and F1-all by 7.2% and 11.6%.

AI.tldr: SAGE 提出逐像素各向异性高斯期望的匹配特征采样方案，用正定精度矩阵控制采样支撑的尺度、各向性与方向，将单点采样作为其极限情形，在仅增加1.5% MACs 的前提下显著提升光流零样本泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有光流方法（如 RAFT 的固定半径 cost volume 查找、WAFT 的单点索引）对所有位置采用同一采样方案，既冗余又不足，忽略了各区域自身的几何/运动特性；作者希望将"特征采样支撑"（聚合证据的范围与方向）本身作为可学习、可分析的设计变量。
AI.method: SAGE（Sampling with Anisotropic Gaussian Expectation）：在以上一阶段光流估计为中心的固定候选网格上，用逐像素各向异性高斯期望替代单点采样；以正定精度矩阵参数化高斯核，控制采样支撑的尺度、各向异性和朝向，单点采样为其退化极限；采样支撑成为显式设计变量，便于分析方向性特征聚合对匹配学习的影响。
AI.result: 仅增加约1.5% MACs；仅在 FlyingChairs+FlyingThings 训练时，零样本迁移至 Sintel clean/final 的 EPE 分别降低 24.2% 与 16.4%，KITTI F1-epe 与 F1-all 分别降低 7.2% 与 11.6%。
AI.conclusion: 对每个查询位置学习独立的采样支撑（而非统一采样模板）是有效且低成本的设计：各向异性高斯采样以极小计算开销带来显著的跨数据集泛化提升，并为方向性相关特征聚合提供了可分析的理论视角。

title: Learning Martial Arts Motion Skills for Animating Opponents in VR Sparring Games
summary: Animating virtual opponents is an important yet challenging task in game development. In martial arts games, opponent motions must not only be physically plausible but also exhibit appropriate technique, timing, transitions, and target-directed intent. Traditional game animations often rely on handcrafted clips, state machine transitions, and procedural adjustments, which can be labor-intensive and may limit the behavioral diversity of non-player characters. This paper presents a martial arts motion skills learning framework for character animation in virtual sparring games. Inspired by Tang Soo Do, we collected a martial arts motion capture dataset containing isolated attacking and defending techniques, technique combinations and transitions, and contextual sparring variations. We first pretrained a reusable repertoire of martial arts motion skills from the captured data using reinforcement learning (RL) with adversarial style rewards, and then adapted these skills with task-specific rewards for target-directed striking and threat-aware evasion. We evaluated the motions generated by the learned policy through a user study, in which participants assessed their physical plausibility, smoothness, and martial arts form. To demonstrate their applicability to interactive gameplay, we developed a VR sparring prototype for Meta Quest headsets. The prototype combines policy-generated motion clips with lightweight state-based control to support interactive opponent behavior. Together, these findings support the feasibility of using a learned martial arts skill repertoire as a motion foundation for animating opponents in VR sparring games.

AI.tldr: 提出面向VR格斗游戏的武术动作技能学习框架：先采集Tang Soo Do动作捕捉数据集，用强化学习+对抗式风格奖励预训练可复用的武术技能库，再用任务奖励适配为定向攻击与威胁感知闪避，并结合轻量状态机在Meta Quest上构建VR对战原型。
AI.motivation: 传统游戏NPC动画依赖手工剪辑、状态机与程序化调整，成本高且行为多样性受限；格斗游戏中的虚拟对手不仅要物理合理，还需具备恰当的技术形式、时机、过渡与目标导向意图。
AI.method: 构建包含孤立攻防技术、技术组合与过渡、情境对练变化的武术动捕数据集；以强化学习配合对抗式风格奖励预训练通用武术技能库（repertoire），再通过任务特定奖励微调，实现目标导向打击与威胁感知闪避；最终将策略生成的动捕片段与轻量状态控制结合，部署到Meta Quest VR原型中。
AI.result: 用户研究评估了生成动作的物理合理性、平滑性与武术形式；VR对战原型验证了策略生成动作片段可在交互玩法中驱动对手行为。
AI.conclusion: 学习式武术技能库可作为VR格斗游戏中对手动画的运动基础，替代或补充手工动画管线具备可行性。

title: Estimation-Aware Reachability
summary: Hamilton-Jacobi Reachability computes the states from which a system can be kept safe under worst-case disturbances, but it assumes the state is known exactly, whereas real robots act on noisy estimates whose uncertainty evolves with their motion. We extend Hamilton-Jacobi Reachability to the robot's belief, estimate and uncertainty, treating unexpected measurements as a bounded adversary and enlarging the unsafe set by the current uncertainty, so that certified states are safe with a prescribed probability. The formulation is compatible with existing solvers. In simulation, the resulting safety filters nearly eliminate the collisions of certaintyequivalent HJ and are less conservative than equally safe uncertainty-padding baselines. The implementation code is available at this https URL

AI.tldr: 将Hamilton-Jacobi可达性从精确状态推广到信念状态：把意外测量视为有界对抗，并用当前不确定度扩张不安全集，从而给出具有指定概率保证的安全状态集，且兼容现有HJ求解器。
AI.motivation: 标准HJ可达性假设状态精确已知，而真实机器人只能依赖带噪估计，且不确定性随运动演化，导致"确定性等价"安全滤波器在估计误差下失效；现有的直接加不确定度padding方法又过于保守。
AI.method: 在信念空间上构建HJ可达性：将测量噪声/意外观测建模为有界对抗扰动，用当前信念协方差（不确定度）对不安全集做时变扩张，得到满足给定概率下安全的认证状态集；该方法形式与现有HJ求解器兼容，可直接接入作为安全滤波器。
AI.result: 仿真中安全滤波器基本消除了确定性等价HJ滤波器的碰撞，同时在同等安全水平下比均匀不确定性padding基线保守性更低。
AI.conclusion: 信念感知HJ可达性是实用且低保守性的概率安全认证方案，可作为现有HJ滤波器的最小改动替代；但证据仅限仿真，缺乏真机验证与更复杂不确定度动力学（如非高斯、相关噪声）的评估。

title: TOGBench: Benchmarking and Improving Tiny-Object Generation Fidelity in Aerial Imagery
comment: Accepted to WACV 2027 Round 2. 20 pages, 7 figures
summary: Advances in deep generative models now enable the synthesis of realistic imagery. However, aerial imagery is dominated by tiny objects, such as vehicles, ships, and aircraft, which occupy only a few pixels owing to the overhead, wide-area nature of aerial imaging. Existing generative models struggle substantially more with tiny objects than with larger ones. This limitation has been overlooked, as prior work on generative evaluation emphasizes prompt following or human preference rather than whether small objects are rendered faithfully. To address this gap, we introduce TOGBench, a quantitative, object-level benchmark for evaluating tiny-object generation fidelity in aerial imagery. We further propose two simple train-/inference-time techniques that improve the ability of layout-to-image generators to render small objects, raising their performance on TOGBench.

AI.tldr: 提出TOGBench，一个面向航空影像中小目标（车辆、舰船、飞机）生成保真度的对象级定量基准，并给出两种训练/推理期技巧以提升布局到图像生成器对小目标的渲染能力。
AI.motivation: 现有深度生成模型在航空影像中因俯视、广域成像导致目标仅占数像素，小目标生成质量显著劣于大目标；而既有生成评估侧重提示词遵循度或人类偏好，忽视小目标是否被忠实渲染。
AI.method: 构建对象级、定量的TOGBench基准用于评估航空影像小目标生成保真度；并提出两项简单的训练期/推理期技术，改善layout-to-image生成器的小目标渲染表现。
AI.result: 所提两项技术提升了布局到图像生成器在TOGBench上的性能，缓解小目标生成退化问题。
AI.conclusion: 将小目标保真度作为独立评估维度纳入生成评估体系，并提供可插拔的轻量改进手段；属遥感/航空生成方向，与Physical AI核心线关联有限。

title: RePlan-VLA: Progress-Aware Replanning for Long-Horizon Vision-Language-Action Models
comment: Apoorva Vashisth and Manav Kulshrestha contributed equally to this work. Prof. Zachary Kingston and Prof. Aniket Bera jointly advised this work
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a promising paradigm for general-purpose robotic manipulation, yet their performance often degrades on long-horizon tasks that require multiple interdependent manipulations. Instead of burdening the VLA policies with long-horizon reasoning, memory, action generation, progress tracking, and error recovery, we argue for leveraging their short-horizon manipulation capabilities within an execution-aware framework. To this end, we introduce \textnormal{\textbf{RePlan-VLA}}, a VLA-agnostic framework that translates a VLA's short-horizon capabilities into reliable long-horizon execution. RePlan-VLA explicitly monitors the robot's motion for progress evaluation, and adaptively revises the future plan based on observed outcomes. We preserve the underlying VLA policy entirely, requiring no additional fine-tuning. Experiments on RoboCasa365 and CALVIN benchmarks show an improvement of 21.9% and 10.4% in success rate over the next strongest baseline. We also validate our approach for real-world deployment on a Franka Research 3 robot.

AI.tldr: RePlan-VLA：一个VLA无关的执行框架，把短时序VLA能力转化为可靠的长时序执行，通过显式运动监测评估进度并自适应重规划，无需额外微调。
AI.motivation: VLA模型在需要多步相互依赖操作的长时序任务上性能下降，作者主张不让VLA策略本身承担长时序推理、记忆、进度跟踪与错误恢复，而应在其外层构建执行感知框架复用其短时序能力。
AI.method: 提出VLA无关的RePlan-VLA框架：显式监测机器人运动以评估任务进度，并基于观测到的执行结果自适应修订后续计划；底层VLA策略完全保留，不做任何微调。
AI.result: 在RoboCasa365与CALVIN基准上，成功率相比最强基线分别提升21.9%与10.4%；并在Franka Research 3真机上验证了实机部署有效性。
AI.conclusion: 将长时序推理与错误恢复外置到执行层规划器、保持VLA策略原样的做法，能用极低代价显著提升长时序操作可靠性，并具备实机可部署性。

title: ReflectScene:MLLM-Guided Closed-Loop Diffusion for 3D Indoor Scene Generation
summary: Text-conditioned 3D indoor scene generation requires layouts satisfying geometric, functional, and semantic constraints. However, existing diffusion methods rely primarily on static textual conditions, limiting their ability to assess evolving scenes and translate semantic discrepancies into executable object-level corrections. MLLM-based post-hoc refinement provides semantic feedback but remains decoupled from denoising, potentially disrupting scene this http URL propose ReflectScene, an MLLM-guided closed-loop diffusion framework. First, we introduce Hierarchical Prior-Grounded Scene Understanding that aligns structured layouts with multi-view visual evidence, to interpret object-specific context and scene global semantics via a frozen multi-modal large language model (MLLM). Second, we propose MLLM-Guided Semantic Reward Evaluation to distill MLLM's diagnoses and assessments on possible candidate corrections into a lightweight Reward Predictor, enabling correction decision making with reduced computation burden. Finally, Decision-Conditioned Trajectory-Consistent Diffusion is proposed to integrate selected corrections through transient conditioning and persistent clean-estimate projection, correcting object layout in the generated scene while preserving non-target arrangements throughout this http URL on 3D-FRONT demonstrate improved functional consistency and semantic alignment while maintaining competitive generation quality and diversity.

AI.tldr: ReflectScene：用冻结 MLLM 做闭环语义反馈、并蒸馏为轻量奖励预测器，在扩散去噪过程中以瞬态条件+干净估计投影执行对象级布局修正，提升 3D 室内场景文本条件生成的功能一致性与语义对齐。
AI.motivation: 文本条件 3D 室内场景生成需满足几何、功能与语义约束，但现有扩散方法依赖静态文本条件，无法评估演化中的场景、也难以把语义偏差转化为可执行的对象级修正；MLLM 事后精修虽提供语义反馈，却与去噪过程解耦，易破坏场景一致性。
AI.method: 三步闭环框架：(1) 分层先验场景理解——将结构化布局与多视角视觉证据对齐，借冻结多模态大模型解析对象上下文与全局语义；(2) MLLM 引导语义奖励评估——对候选修正进行诊断评估并蒸馏为轻量 Reward Predictor，降低决策计算开销；(3) 决策条件轨迹一致扩散——通过瞬态条件注入选中修正，并配合持久干净估计投影，在修正目标对象同时保持非目标布局不变。
AI.result: 在 3D-FRONT 上，功能一致性与语义对齐指标提升，同时生成质量与多样性保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 将 MLLM 语义反馈蒸馏后嵌入扩散去噪闭环，可在不显著损害生成质量与多样性的前提下实现对象级可控修正，为语义驱动的 3D 场景生成提供了可执行路径。

title: RoboBuilder: Agentic Robot Co-Design with Real-world Video Feedback in the Loop
summary: Can AI agents design robots that work in the real world? We introduce RoboBuilder, a benchmark in which coding agents co-design a robot's hardware and program from standard parts, motors and a custom 3D-printed part, and every design that passes in simulation is built and tested on a physical course. Simulation alone is not enough: under public part data, none of 15 initial passing designs crossed the real course, so an agent learns the simulator from measurements it requests and videos of real runs. Across four frontier coding agents, ten obstacles at three difficulty levels, 16,427 simulations of 12,774 distinct robots and 135 physical robots built in an estimated 240 hours, agents solve nearly all easy obstacles and invent mechanisms our search baselines do not reach, but falter at harder levels, when one robot must cross every obstacle, and in the real world, where 66% of simulated passes hold across all levels. Closing the loop helps: shown a video of its real failure, an agent redesigns the robot, sometimes correcting its simulator, and removes 72% of level-1 and level-2 failures. RoboBuilder measures progress toward agents that engineer real machines. Project Page: this https URL

AI.tldr: RoboBuilder：编码智能体协同设计机器人硬件（3D打印件+标准件+电机）与程序，通过"仿真→真实建造测试→视频反馈修正仿真器"闭环，在10个障碍×3难度上评估，仿真通过率66%可迁移到真实世界，闭环反馈可消除72%的1–2级失败。
AI.motivation: 现有编码/设计智能体评估多停留在仿真或纯软件任务，缺乏衡量"智能体能否设计在真实物理世界工作的机器人"的闭环基准；作者发现仅凭公开零件数据训练的仿真器，15个通过仿真的设计在真实赛道全部失败，说明单纯仿真评估不足。
AI.method: 构建RoboBuilder基准：智能体用标准零件、电机与自定义3D打印件共同设计机器人硬件并编写控制程序；仿真通过的方案一律物理建造并上真实赛道测试。智能体可主动请求测量数据并从真实运行视频中学习/校正仿真器。4个前沿编码智能体、10个障碍、3档难度，共12,774个不同机器人的16,427次仿真与135台实体机器人（约240小时建造测试）。
AI.result: 智能体近乎解决全部简单障碍，并涌现出搜索基线未达到的机构设计；但多难度综合、单机通全部障碍和真实世界表现明显下降，仿真通过中仅66%在真实成立。提供真实失败视频后，智能体重设计机器人并有时修正仿真器，消除72%的1级与2级失败。
AI.conclusion: RoboBuilder提供了以实体建造为终局的硬件-程序协同设计基准，量化了sim-to-real差距并证明"真实视频反馈闭环"是智能体工程可靠性的关键杠杆，为通向真实机器设计智能体提供可测度量。

title: LAGR: Language-Aware Grasp Re-Ranking for Task Oriented Grasping
comment: Manav Kulshrestha and Shreyans Jain contributed equally to this work
summary: Grasping is a fundamental capability for robotic manipulation, with the appropriate grasp depending on the downstream task. For example, a hammer should be held by its handle for hammering but by its head when it is handed over. Selecting such a grasp requires consideration of two criteria: physical feasibility on the object and suitability for the task. Developing such an approach requires dense grasp labels with both feasibility and task scores on real observations, but existing task-oriented grasping datasets are small, synthetic, or costly to annotate. To address this gap, we construct a dataset of 2.68 million scored 5-DoF grasp annotations over 100,911 image-task pairs from $17$ object categories. Additionally, we introduce LAGR, a task-oriented grasp detection method that explicitly addresses both these challenges. Given vision-language inputs, LAGR first generates task-independent grasp proposals along with a physical feasibility score, and then scores the generated grasps with a language-conditioned re-ranker that reasons over all proposals jointly. Experiments show that LAGR outperforms the next best method by 9.3 percentage points. We further validate LAGR on real objects by executing task-oriented grasps with a Franka Research 3 robot.

AI.tldr: 构建268万条带物理可行性与任务适宜性评分的5-DoF抓取标注数据集（100,911图像-任务对，17类物体），并提出LAGR：先生成任务无关抓取提案与可行性分数，再用语言条件重排序器联合推理全部提案完成任务导向抓取检测，性能领先次优方法9.3个百分点，并在Franka Research 3真机上验证。
AI.motivation: 合适抓取依赖下游任务（如锤子敲击握柄、递交握头），需同时满足物理可行性与任务适宜性；但现有任务导向抓取数据集规模小、合成化或标注昂贵，缺乏真实观测上的密集可行性+任务性双评分标签。
AI.method: 两阶段式LAGR：视觉-语言输入下先产生任务无关抓取提案并给出物理可行性分数，再由语言条件重排序器对全部提案进行联合推理打分；配套大规模真实观测密集标注数据集。
AI.result: 较次优方法提升9.3个百分点；在Franka Research 3真机上执行任务导向抓取验证有效。
AI.conclusion: 分解"可行性生成+语言条件联合重排序"是处理任务导向抓取的有效范式，规模化密集双准则标注数据可显著提升真实场景性能。

title: Temporal Image Representations for Mouse Dynamics Authentication
summary: Mouse dynamics authentication has traditionally relied on handcrafted features or time-series representations that capture both spatial and temporal characteristics of mouse movements. More recent approaches have modeled mouse data as images, enabling the use of powerful pretrained computer vision models. However, prior work primarily focuses on spatial-only representations where the cursor coordinates are plotted as a trajectory image. These representations discard the temporal characteristics which can help discriminate users. In this work, we propose image representations that incorporate speed and velocity information for mouse dynamics authentication. We investigate two mouse data representations, a XYPlot representation that intuitively shows the path of movement, and a Pairwise Distance (PWD) representation that utilizes the entire image canvas to encode relationships between mouse events. Both representations are evaluated under both location-aware and location-free settings using pretrained 2D-CNN and ViT architectures. We found that the incorporation of temporal information improved performance over spatial representations alone, and that the location-aware variants generally outperformed the location-free. We achieve state-of-the-art performance on two datasets, Balabit and TWOS, and extend our evaluation to two other datasets. We found that in general, location-aware PWD with temporal encoding combined with the 2D-CNN architecture provided the best results, with mean EERs of 5.21% and 12.70% on the Balabit Test-1 and Test-2 sets, respectively, 4.94% on TWOS, 6.16% on ChaoShen, and 0.59% on DFL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出融合速度/时序信息的鼠标动力学身份认证图像表征（XYPlot 与 PWD），在 location-aware/free 设置下用预训练 2D-CNN 与 ViT 评估，取得多数据集 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 既有将鼠标数据转为图像的方法仅用光标坐标绘制的纯空间轨迹图，丢弃了有助于区分用户的时序（速度/加速度）特征。
AI.method: 设计两种将鼠标事件转为图像的表征：XYPlot（直观轨迹路径）与 Pairwise Distance (PWD)（利用整幅画布编码事件间关系），并在两者中注入 speed/velocity 时间信息；在 location-aware 与 location-free 两种设置下，分别用预训练 2D-CNN 和 ViT 进行分类评估。
AI.result: 加入时序信息优于纯空间表征；location-aware 变体总体优于 location-free；location-aware PWD + 时序 + 2D-CNN 最佳，Balabit Test-1/Test-2 平均 EER 5.21%/12.70%，TWOS 4.94%，ChaoShen 6.16%，DFL 0.59%。
AI.conclusion: 在鼠标动力学认证中，速度编码的图像表征显著提升判别性能，为生物行为认证提供了新的表征范式。

title: MobileWeave: Program-First Synthesis of Dependency-Linked Tasks for Training Mobile GUI Agents
summary: Native mobile GUI agents require large-scale training trajectories covering both individual app functions and multi-goal workflows within and across apps, which makes automatic task synthesis a promising way to scale training data. Existing synthesis pipelines, however, produce each task as free-form text, leaving implicit how its subgoals depend on one another. This matters because composition is a skill in its own right: a policy may complete each subtask of a workflow on its own, yet fail to chain these subtasks into the complete workflow. We present MobileWeave, which instead synthesizes every task as an executable program derived from the app implementations of a controllable simulator. MobileWeave abstracts each app into a typed capability graph with semantic types shared across apps, composes atomic programs into single- and cross-app composite programs through explicit value and object dependencies, and verifies each program by native execution, deriving both its instruction and its completion check from the same program. Trained on teacher trajectories collected for these tasks and on recovery supervision at the policy's own stalls, MobileWeave-8B improves its base model by 26.7 points on MobileGym and by 8.6, 21.3, and 17.6 points on AndroidWorld, AndroidLab, and MobileWorld, with comparable gains at 4B. Beyond these gains, we find that composition is learnable from task structure: explicit dependencies between subgoals act as a training signal that teaches a policy to compose skills it already masters. We release data, model, and code at this https URL .

AI.tldr: MobileWeave 将移动 GUI 智能体的训练任务合成为基于可控模拟器 App 实现的可执行程序：App 抽象为跨 App 共享语义类型的类型化能力图，通过显式值依赖与对象依赖组合原子程序为单 App 与跨 App 复合程序，并以原生执行验证、由同一程序导出指令与完成校验。
AI.motivation: 现有任务合成管线把任务写成自由文本，子目标之间的依赖关系是隐含的；而"组合"本身是一种独立技能，策略可能在每个子任务上都成功，却无法将其串成完整工作流。原生移动 GUI 智能体需要覆盖单 App 功能与跨 App 多目标工作流的大规模轨迹数据。
AI.method: 以可控模拟器为底座，把每个 App 抽象为类型化能力图（capacity graph），语义类型跨 App 共享；通过显式的值依赖和对象依赖，将原子程序组合成单 App 与跨 App 的复合程序；用原生执行验证每个程序，并从同一程序同时派生自然语言指令与完成条件检查。在合成任务上采集教师轨迹，并在策略自身停滞点加入恢复监督进行训练（MobileWeave-8B / 4B）。
AI.result: MobileWeave-8B 在 MobileGym 上较基座提升 26.7 分，在 AndroidWorld、AndroidLab、MobileWorld 上分别提升 8.6、21.3、17.6 分；4B 规模取得相当增益。分析表明组合能力可从任务结构中学得：子目标间的显式依赖关系作为训练信号，能教会策略组合其已掌握的技能。
AI.conclusion: 将任务表示为可执行程序（而非自由文本）可同时解决可验证性与子目标依赖显式化问题，使技能组合成为可学习信号，并显著提升移动 GUI 智能体的训练数据规模与迁移性能；数据、模型与代码已开源。

title: Grounding Radiology Reports in 3D Chest CT: Results of the ReXGrounding Challenge
summary: Segmenting each reported finding in a radiology scan would allow findings to be measured and tracked over time and let AI systems generate reports that are verifiable, but so far AI models have performed poorly at this task. To advance this task, we organized the ReXGrounding Challenge at MICCAI 2026, the first challenge dedicated to it. Given a non-contrast chest CT scan and the set of findings from its report, participants trained models to produce the corresponding set of 3D segmentations. The challenge used 2,992 training and 200 validation scans from the ReXGroundingCT dataset, and evaluated methods on a held-out test set of 300 scans with 582 findings, exhaustively annotated by board-certified radiologists. In total, 48 teams from 15 countries made 760 submissions, and the best method reached a Dice of 0.375 and a hit rate of 0.77, matching agreement between two independent radiologist groups (Dice 0.32, hit rate 0.76, on a 50-scan subset). On the 100 scans of the pre-challenge benchmark, the winner reached a Dice of 0.390, against 0.285 for VoxTell, the best model before the challenge, which five of the six best teams fine-tuned. Non-focal findings remained far harder to segment than focal ones, instance F1 stayed below inter-reader agreement (0.34 vs. 0.47), and models sometimes segmented the right abnormality in the wrong location. Top methods thus match radiologist agreement in Dice, but non-focal findings, findings with multiple instances, and adherence to the anatomical location described in the text remain open problems.

AI.tldr: MICCAI 2026 ReXGrounding Challenge：基于报告文本的胸部CT逐条发现3D分割，最佳方法Dice 0.375、命中率0.77，与两位放射科医生一致性相当，但非局灶性及多实例发现仍是难点。
AI.motivation: 逐条分割影像报告中的发现可实现病灶测量、时序追踪与可验证的报告生成，但现有AI在此任务上表现很差；为此设立首个专用挑战赛以推进该任务。
AI.method: 构建ReXGroundingCT数据（2,992训练/200验证/300测试扫描，582条发现，由认证放射科医生穷尽标注）；参赛者输入平扫胸部CT与报告中发现的集合，输出对应3D分割掩码；共48支队伍、15国、760次提交，并在100扫描的赛前基准上对比VoxTell。
AI.result: 最佳方法Dice 0.375、命中率0.77，与两组放射科医生间一致性（Dice 0.32、命中率0.76）相当；赛前基准上冠军Dice 0.390 vs VoxTell 0.285（6强中5队微调了VoxTell）；实例F1 0.34低于阅片者间一致性0.47，非局灶性发现远难于局灶性，存在定位正确异常但解剖位置错误的情况。
AI.conclusion: 顶级方法在Dice上已达到人工阅片一致性水平，但非局灶性发现、多实例发现及对文本解剖位置的遵循仍是未解问题。

title: On Demand, Not Uniformity: Adaptive Expert Orchestration for Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning
summary: Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning (MCIT) enables Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to adapt to sequential instruction data while retaining previously acquired knowledge. While recent Mixture-of-Experts (MoE)-based methods mitigate forgetting by freezing historical experts and introducing new ones, they largely overlook the varying adaptation demands across tasks. Probing incoming tasks reveals pronounced heterogeneity in layer-wise gradient pressure and token-wise prediction difficulty. This observation highlights two unresolved decisions: where additional capacity is needed and how strongly new experts should contribute to individual tokens. To address both questions, we propose the Coverage-Calibrated Expert Injection and Residual Arbitration framework (CIRA-MoE), which derives expert acceptance margins via learnable threshold routing to serve as a unified coverage signal. Specifically, historical acceptance evidence guides the selective injection of new experts into insufficiently covered layers. Meanwhile, relative evidence between historical and current experts modulates token-wise residual contributions, coupled with arbitration-consistent regularization to promote expert specialization. Comprehensive experiments on UCIT and CoIN demonstrate that CIRA-MoE outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods in MCIT.

AI.tldr: 提出CIRA-MoE框架，用可学习阈值路由导出专家接受裕度作为统一覆盖信号，指导新专家的选择性注入层与token级残差仲裁，用于多模态持续指令微调。
AI.motivation: 现有MoE式MCIT方法冻结历史专家、新增专家以抗遗忘，但忽视任务间自适应需求差异：作者探测发现层间梯度压力与token级预测难度显著异质，因而需回答"何处需要额外容量"和"新专家对单个token贡献多强"两个问题。
AI.method: CIRA-MoE：1）以可学习阈值路由产生专家接受裕度，作为统一覆盖信号；2）依据历史接受证据，仅在覆盖不足的层选择性注入新专家；3）以历史与当前专家的相对证据调制token级残差贡献，并配合仲裁一致性正则促进专家专精化。
AI.result: 在UCIT与CoIN基准上全面实验，CIRA-MoE优于现有MCIT最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 层间与token级的异质性覆盖信号可用于精准扩容与残差分配，是缓解多模态持续指令微调遗忘的有效路径；但目前缺乏真实机器人/具身任务验证。

title: Control-Aware Separating Hyperplanes for Control Barrier Functions in Planar Navigation
summary: Separating hyperplanes are widely used in Control Barrier Function (CBF)-based collision avoidance, yet their orientations strongly govern control intervention-the deviation of the applied control from the robot's nominal command. Existing methods typically select hyperplane orientations from geometry alone. Jointly optimizing orientations and control yields a continuous, non-convex problem in which local nonlinear solvers suffer from initialization sensitivity, local minima, and unpredictable latency, while discretized orientation grids scale exponentially with obstacle count. For planar navigation of a polygonal robot among polygonal obstacles, we present a solver-free, control-aware separating hyperplane selection method that directly computes a global optimum of this joint problem at each step whenever it is feasible. Exploiting the geometry of Minkowski difference polygons, we reduce this continuous non-convex optimization to evaluating a polynomial-size set of candidate control interventions via closed-form algebraic checks, selecting the feasible candidate of minimum norm. Across 250 simulated navigation scenarios, our method reduces cumulative intervention cost by 3.6% at the median and 27.3% at the 90th percentile compared to a local nonlinear solver, and completion time by 0.6% and 5.6%, respectively. In scalability benchmarks, it achieves a 6.1x per-step speedup at 16 simultaneous obstacles.

AI.tldr: 针对多边形机器人在多边形障碍物间的平面导航，提出无需数值求解器的控制感知分离超平面选择方法：基于Minkowski差多边形几何，将超平面朝向与控制的联合连续非凸优化化为多项式规模候选集的闭式代数检验，选最小范数可行干预，实现每步全局最优。
AI.motivation: CBF-based collision avoidance中分离超平面朝向强烈影响控制干预量，但现有方法仅依几何选取朝向；联合优化控制与朝向为非凸连续问题，局部非线性求解器受初始化敏感、局部极小与延迟不确定困扰，而离散朝向网格随障碍数指数增长。
AI.method: 利用Minkowski差多边形几何，把连续非凸联合优化归约为对多项式规模候选控制干预的枚举，每个候选用闭式代数检验可行性，再取最小范数的可行候选，因而无需迭代求解即可得到全局最优。
AI.result: 250个仿真导航场景中，相比局部非线性求解器：累积干预代价中位数降低3.6%、90分位降低27.3%；完成时间分别降低0.6%与5.6%。扩展性基准中，16个同时障碍物时单步提速6.1倍。
AI.conclusion: 该可证明最优、免求解器、低延迟的超平面选择方法在CBF避障中提升干预效率与可扩展性，但局限于二维多边形场景且证据为仿真，向三维/非凸机器人形态推广尚待验证。

title: HOForce: Motion and Force Reconstruction of Hand-Object Interaction Using a Single-View RGB-D Video
comment: Includes supplementary material. Project page: this https URL
summary: Reconstructing hand-object interactions is an important task, and achieving it with a single camera makes large-scale capture practical but challenging due to heavy occlusions. We introduce HOForce to track hands and objects, and further recover interaction forces from single-view RGB-D video and known object properties. For two-hand manipulation, we jointly model fingertip forces of both hands and the contact forces between objects when two objects are presented. The reconstructed forces also improve motion tracking by giving pose constraints in the occluded regions. HOForce recovers hand and object motion more accurately on DexYCB and TACO and produces less hand-object penetration than interaction baselines on DexYCB. On our dataset of fingertip forces recorded with tactile sensors, HOForce reduces normal-force MAE by 24.5% relative to the strongest baseline. The recovered forces reproduce object motion in MuJoCo and transfer to other engines after adaptation.

AI.tldr: HOForce 从单视角 RGB-D 视频与已知物体属性联合跟踪双手与物体，并恢复指尖力及物体间接触力；恢复的力反过来作为遮挡区域的位姿约束以提升跟踪精度。
AI.motivation: 单相机手-物交互重建便于大规模采集，但严重遮挡使跟踪困难；且现有方法仅恢复运动，未恢复交互力这一物理量。
AI.method: 联合建模双手指尖力与双物体接触力；利用恢复的力生成遮挡区域位姿约束以改善运动跟踪；输入为单视角 RGB-D 视频加已知物体属性；在 MuJoCo 中验证力的物理一致性并进行跨引擎适配。
AI.result: 在 DexYCB、TACO 上手物运动跟踪更准，DexYCB 上穿模更少；自建触觉传感器数据上法向力 MAE 相对最强基线降低 24.5%；恢复的力在 MuJoCo 中复现物体运动并可迁移至其他引擎。
AI.conclusion: 单手-物接触力恢复与运动跟踪形成闭环互益，力可作为物理约束反哺遮挡下的位姿估计，并具备仿真引擎迁移性。

title: Keep the Image in Mind: A Visual Board for Multimodal Agents
summary: Multi-step visual reasoning suffers when early visual misinterpretations persist as incorrect premises in subsequent reasoning. We argue that how visual evidence is represented during reasoning matters as much as how much of it is gathered. Rather than appending observations and inferences to an ever-growing dialogue, we introduce a Visual Board-centered harness that separates visual observations, uncertain interpretations, and derived reasoning within a structured, capacity-bounded, and revisable workspace. This separation makes each premise explicit and auditable, so that conflicts between what is seen and what is derived become detectable even by a text-only critic and can trigger targeted reinspection of the original image. Without task-specific training, our harness consistently outperforms standalone models across 4B, 8B, Qwen3-VL-Flash, and 32B configurations on Euclid30K, SolidGeo, and ChartQA bar charts, with gains of up to 11.68, 18.42, and 24.82 percentage points, respectively. Under identical tools, critic, and interaction limits, the structured Board outperforms shared free-form notes by 6.67 to 13.00 points and no-Board retries by 7.35 to 18.80 points while using 7.9\% to 38.2\% fewer tokens. Supervised fine-tuning on harness trajectories further improves direct answering and critic-free tool use, with positive transfer to chart reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出以Visual Board为中心的视觉推理框架，将视觉观察、不确定解释与派生推理分离在结构化、容量受限、可修订的工作区中，使前提显式可审计并触发针对性重新检视，无需任务微调即在多个基准上大幅提升。
AI.motivation: 多步视觉推理中早期视觉误解会作为错误前提被持续沿用；作者认为视觉证据在推理过程中的表示方式与采集数量同样重要，而不断增长的对话式追加观察与推断难以发现"所见"与"所推"之间的冲突。
AI.method: 设计Visual Board-centered harness：以结构化、容量受限、可修订的工作区分离视觉观察、不确定解释与派生推理三类条目；显式化的前提使冲突可被纯文本critic检测，并触发对原始图像的定点重检；框架不含任务特定训练，另对harness轨迹做监督微调。
AI.result: 在Euclid30K、SolidGeo与ChartQA柱状图上，4B/8B/Qwen3-VL-Flash/32B配置均稳定超越独立模型，最高提升11.68、18.42、24.82个百分点；在工具、critic与交互次数相同条件下，结构化Board较共享自由笔记高6.67–13.00分、较无Board重试高7.35–18.80分，且token用量少7.9%–38.2%；SFT后直接回答与无critic工具使用进一步提升，并向图表推理正向迁移。
AI.conclusion: 结构化的证据表示（而非单纯增加观察量）是缓解多步视觉推理中错误前提累积的关键，可审计工作区带来无需训练的一致增益与成本节省，并具备可微调、可迁移的扩展性。

title: NullTok: empirical-null token selection for training-free long video understanding
summary: Long video understanding remains a daunting challenge for existing multimodal large language models (MLLMs), mainly due to the large number of visual tokens accumulated in long videos. Currently, frame selection and token selection are two main paradigms for addressing this issue, both aiming to select relevant visual information to form a compact input for MLLMs. A natural approach combines these two paradigms by selecting frames before pruning tokens, but noisy frame-level relevance estimates can cause irreversible evidence loss. In this paper, we study this problem from the perspective of assessing the spatiotemporal distribution of query-specific evidence and propose a novel and training-free approach termed NULLTOK. For every patch across all frames, we construct an empirical-null distribution from 64 group-matched irrelevant control queries, capturing the scores expected in the absence of target-specific evidence. Target affinities are calibrated against these same-position references into right-tail Monte Carlo p-values, which are discrete super-uniform under a conditional exchangeability assumption. Calibrated screening and a high-recall semantic guard produce candidate tokens for deterministic visual deduplication and joint spatiotemporal budget allocation. To validate NullTok, we apply it to two representative MLLMs and conduct extensive experiments on a set of video benchmarks. The experimental results demonstrate its effectiveness under a bounded visual token budget. For example, it achieves 65.81% and 68.85% on Video-MME using frozen LLaVA-Video-7B and Qwen3-VL-8B backbones, respectively, at a cap of 64 full-frame equivalents (FFE), without subtitles or audio. These results outperform all evaluated baselines on Video-MME under the same budget for both backbones. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: NullTok：面向长视频 MLLM 的无训练视觉 token 压缩方法，为每个 patch 用 64 个分组匹配的无关控制查询构造经验零分布，将目标亲和度校准为右尾蒙特卡洛 p 值，再做校准筛选+高召回语义守卫+帧内去重+时空预算分配。
AI.motivation: 长视频理解受限于累积的海量视觉 token。现有"帧选择"和"token 剪枝"两条范式若朴素串联（先选帧再剪 token），帧级相关性估计噪声会导致不可逆的证据丢失。因此需要从查询相关证据的时空分布角度重新审视压缩问题。
AI.method: 对全部帧的所有 patch，用 64 个 group-matched 无关控制查询构造经验零分布，刻画"无目标证据"时的期望得分；将目标亲和度对照同位参考校准为右尾 Monte Carlo p 值（在条件可交换假设下为离散超均匀）；再经校准筛选与高召回语义守卫得到候选 token，进行确定性视觉去重与联合时空预算分配。全程无需训练。
AI.result: 在冻结的 LLaVA-Video-7B 与 Qwen3-VL-8B 上，于 64 FFE 视觉 token 预算、无字幕无音频条件下，Video-MME 分别达 65.81% 与 68.85%，在两个骨干的同预算设置下均优于所有评测基线。
AI.conclusion: 统计校准式的 token 筛选可在有界预算下有效缓解帧级先验选择造成的证据损失，且具模型无关、免训练的可插拔特性，适用于长视频多模态理解。

title: Can AI Understand Indonesian Children's Book Illustrations? Compliance, Safety, and the Cultural Alignment Gap
comment: Accepted at Workshop on Computer Vision for Children (CV4CHL) at CVPR 2026 (Non-Proceeding Track)
summary: Children's book illustrations carry developmental, pedagogical, and cultural responsibilities that are often formally codified in guidelines. As AI systems begin entering children's publishing pipelines, both as evaluators and as generators, a natural question arises: can they reliably meet the structural, safety, and cultural standards required? We investigate this across three criteria: guideline compliance, safety, and cultural alignment, using Indonesia's Book Leveling Guideline as a government-issued evaluation framework with explicit visual criteria for four reading levels. To understand how well VLMs can identify and apply these guideline criteria, we first evaluate them on real published children's book pages and compare their assessments against a human baseline. To then examine whether AI-generated illustrations meet the same standards, we apply the VLM judge to images produced by two generation models and cross-check them against a subset of human illustrator raters. We find that VLMs are reliable on explicit criteria such as compliance and safety, but fall short on cultural alignment, systematically missing content that human raters flag as culturally inappropriate. AI-generated illustrations show the same blind spot: they satisfy structural and safety criteria but fail to capture implicit cultural details that human raters consistently identify.

AI.tldr: 以印尼政府《图书分级指南》的四级阅读水平视觉标准为框架，检验视觉语言模型（VLM）在儿童绘本插图上的"指南合规性、安全性、文化契合度"三项能力，并用VLM评审器评估两个文生图模型的生成插图，与人类插画师评级交叉验证。
AI.motivation: 儿童绘本插画承担发展性、教学性与文化性责任，且多被明文规范。AI系统正作为"评审者"和"生成者"进入儿童出版管线，因此需要回答：VLM能否可靠满足结构、安全与文化层面的标准？
AI.method: 采用政府发布的《Book Leveling Guideline》作为评测框架（含四个阅读水平的显式视觉标准）。步骤：(1) 在真实已出版儿童绘本页面上评测VLM的准则识别与判定，并与人类基线对比；(2) 将VLM用作评委（VLM-as-judge）评估两个生成模型产出的插图；(3) 用人类插画师子集评分做交叉检验。
AI.result: VLM在合规性、安全性等显式准则上与人类一致性较好、表现可靠；但在文化契合度上系统性不足，会漏检人类评分者标记为文化不当的内容。AI生成插图呈现同一盲区：满足结构与安全准则，却无法捕捉人类一致识别的隐性文化细节。
AI.conclusion: VLM尚不能独立承担儿童出版中的文化把关角色；显式可编码准则可自动化，隐性文化判断仍需人类在环。对"AI生成内容自动审核"的可信度构成明确警示。

title: Beyond Additive Composition: Interventional Modeling of State-Dependent Cross-Degradation Responses for Composite Image Restoration
summary: Composite image restoration aims to recover images corrupted by multiple coexisting degradations. Existing methods predominantly decompose composite corruptions into individual factors, relying on these isolated priors to guide restoration. However, coexisting degradations are inherently interdependent: the manifestation of one degradation dynamically shifts with the states of others, inducing non-additive interactions that factor-wise paradigms fail to capture. To bridge this gap, we formulate state-dependent cross-degradation responses and propose PROBE, an interventional framework that explicitly models how coexisting degradations influence one another. Specifically, we first construct unified degradation axes by aligning visual and textual degraded-clean offsets. Along these axes, a calibrated coordinate head estimates current degradation states, while bidirectional feature perturbations are injected to probe cross-coordinate responses under the current states. Contrasting these responses with corresponding intensity-matched single-degradation references quantifies intrinsic non-additive deviations, allowing the resulting response descriptors and state coordinates to jointly guide restoration. For comprehensive evaluation, we introduce SCD-15, a new benchmark covering all 15 nonempty combinations of four degradation factors at three severity levels. Experiments demonstrate that PROBE achieves state-of-the-art performance on the CDD-11, AWMM-100K, and SCD-15 composite restoration datasets using a compact model with modest GPU memory requirements.

AI.tldr: PROBE: an interventional framework modeling state-dependent cross-degradation responses for composite image restoration, plus SCD-15 benchmark covering 15 nonempty combinations of 4 degradation factors at 3 severity levels.
AI.motivation: Existing composite restoration decomposes corruptions into independent factors and applies isolated priors, but coexisting degradations are interdependent—one degradation's manifestation shifts with others' states, producing non-additive interactions that factor-wise paradigms miss.
AI.method: Builds unified degradation axes by aligning visual and textual degraded-clean offsets; a calibrated coordinate head estimates current degradation states; bidirectional feature perturbations probe cross-coordinate responses, which are contrasted against intensity-matched single-degradation references to quantify non-additive deviations; response descriptors plus state coordinates jointly guide restoration.
AI.result: SOTA on CDD-11, AWMM-100K and the proposed SCD-15, with a compact model and modest GPU memory.
AI.conclusion: Explicit modeling of interventional cross-degradation responses is an effective and efficient alternative to factor-wise decomposition for composite image restoration.

title: SixthView: A Benchmark for Hidden-View Reconstruction and 3D Assembly Reasoning
summary: Inferring the unseen side of a 3D assembly requires reasoning about part placement and occlusion. Different assemblies can match the observed views while producing different hidden views, leaving the target ambiguous. We introduce SixthView, a benchmark in which models predict a sixth orthographic view from five observed views and information about the component shapes. The benchmark contains 602 synthetic polycube assemblies with 2--10 parts and requires a dense grid of part labels for the missing view, allowing both exact-view and cell-level evaluation. For each item, we exhaustively verify that all legal assemblies consistent with the exact component geometry and observed label grids yield the same target view. With these inputs, the task tests symbolic assembly and coordinate reasoning. The image-only variants additionally require shape recovery from rendered views, where occlusion can make different 3D shapes look identical. We evaluate three vision-language models under four input conditions. Across 552 items with complete evaluations, exact-grid accuracy with images plus exact text ranges from 33.2% to 85.4%. Adding exact text to separate images improves accuracy by 19.7--63.0 percentage points, whereas adding images to exact text changes it by only $-0.5$ to $+2.1$ points. Separate image panels outperform a merged sheet by 6.7--11.1 points. The results show that performance depends strongly on access to exact symbolic information, with little further improvement from images once the geometry is specified. GitHub: this https URL

AI.tldr: SixthView 基准：给定五个正交视图与零件几何信息，预测第六个被遮挡视图的稠密零件标签网格；穷举校验目标唯一性。VLM 实验显示精度高度依赖精确符号文本，图像贡献有限。
AI.motivation: 3D 装配体的不可见侧推理由部分放置与遮挡决定，不同装配可解释同一观测却产生不同隐藏视图（目标歧义）。现有基准缺少对目标唯一性的严格验证与单元级评测，也无法区分"符号装配推理"与"图像形状恢复"两类能力。
AI.method: 构建 602 个合成 polycube 装配（2–10 个零件），要求稠密零件标签网格输出；对每项穷举所有与精确零件几何及观测标签网格一致的合法装配，验证其目标视图一致（保证唯一解）。设置图像-only 与图像+精确文本等四种输入条件，评测三个 VLM，进行 exact-view 与 cell-level 双重评估。
AI.result: 552 个完整评测样本上，图像+精确文本的 exact-grid 精度为 33.2%–85.4%；在分离图像基础上加入精确文本提升 19.7–63.0 个百分点，反之在精确文本上加入图像仅变化 −0.5 至 +2.1 个百分点；分离图像面板优于拼接图 6.7–11.1 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 模型性能主要由能否获得精确符号信息决定，几何一旦给定，图像几乎无额外增益；揭示当前 VLM 在遮挡下的符号装配与坐标推理上存在显著短板。

title: Navigating Robots from Unknown and Uncalibrated Exocentric Cameras via Map Estimation
summary: Exocentric cameras, mounted on walls or ceilings in indoor environments, offer wider vantage points and are less easily occluded than robot-mounted cameras, making them an appealing alternative for perception in robot navigation algorithms. Previous methods that use such cameras, however, require their pose and intrinsics to be known before deployment, demanding calibration that is time-consuming, requires specialized personnel, and must be repeated whenever a camera moves or a new room is navigated. We propose Robot-centric Obstacle Maps from Unknown and uncalibrated eXocentric cameras (ROMUX), an agent that navigates a robot toward point goals while avoiding obstacles using exocentric cameras that are both uncalibrated, meaning the system does not require their pose or intrinsic information as input, and unknown, meaning it is not fit to a specific camera during training and does not require pre-deployment fine-tuning. We train a cross-view transformer on large-scale simulation data to predict metric robot-centric obstacle maps from exocentric images, without conditioning image tokens on camera information. A small policy trained with Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) then navigates on the predicted maps toward a goal coordinate relative to the robot. We benchmark our agent in simulation with cameras randomized per episode, and it matches the success rates of a PPO policy that navigates from a robot-mounted camera. Further, ROMUX works with one camera or multiple cameras with partial views and has been transferred zero-shot to a real robot using a camera at varying positions and orientations across various room layouts.

AI.tldr: ROMUX 用外置未标定相机实现无标定、免微调的外中心视角机器人导航：跨视角 Transformer 预测度量级机器人中心障碍图，PPO 小策略在图上导航，仿真与真机零样本迁移均有效。
AI.motivation: 外置（墙面/天花板）相机视野更广、不易被机器人自身遮挡，是机器人导航感知的有力替代；但已有方法部署前需已知相机位姿与内参，标定耗时、需专业人员，且相机移动或换房间后需重标定。
AI.method: 在大规模仿真数据上训练跨视角 Transformer，从外中心图像预测机器人中心的度量障碍图，图像 token 不以相机位姿/内参作为条件输入，从而对相机标定与具体相机身份免疫；随后用 PPO 训练小型策略，在预测障碍图上朝机器人坐标系下的目标坐标导航；无预部署微调。
AI.result: 仿真中每回合随机化相机参数，成功率与基于机器人自载相机的 PPO 策略相当；支持单相机及多相机部分视图；以不同位置与朝向的相机、多种房间布局零样本迁移到真实机器人。
AI.conclusion: 将"相机未知 + 未标定"作为显式设计约束，通过跨视角障碍图预测与轻量策略解耦，可免去外置相机标定与部署微调，为可即插即用的基础设施级视觉导航提供了可行范式。

title: Coverage Governs Accuracy: When to Expand the Lexicon and When to Fall Back in Low-Resource Manchu OCR
summary: Character-level OCR for low-resource Manchu often produces near-miss spelling errors. Lexicon-constrained decoding can correct such errors with lexical knowledge, but a fixed dictionary cannot cover the many unseen word forms produced by agglutinative word formation. We study whether morphological expansion alleviates this limitation, and how the expansion size and confidence fallback affect recognition. We segment the training transcriptions with a dictionary-based stem list, extract roots and suffix chains from them, generate about 510k candidates, select the expansion size through frequency ranking on the validation set, and decompose accuracy under hard lexicon constraints into the product of coverage and in-lexicon precision. Across three CRNN training seeds, adding 250k candidates to a base dictionary of about 29k words raises the type accuracy on unseen combinations of seen roots from 63.6% to 86.3%, and overall token accuracy from 82.4% to 84.2%. Adding all candidates lowers overall token accuracy to 81.5%, showing that the coverage gain comes with a loss of in-lexicon precision. A further comparison shows that the base dictionary with confidence fallback performs best overall among the CRNN systems tested, reaching 76.1% type and 85.5% token accuracy and outperforming the expanded lexicon both with and without fallback. A Transformer recognizer shows similar trends. These results indicate that morphological expansion relieves the constraint of a fixed dictionary, but a larger lexicon does not guarantee better recognition; in the present low-resource Manchu OCR setting, a selective combination of reliable lexical constraints and open recognition is more effective.

AI.tldr: 为低资源满文OCR，用基于词典的词干切分抽取词根与后缀链，生成约51万形态扩展候选，并以“覆盖率×词典内精度”分解硬词典约束下的准确率，发现选择性地加入25万候选可显著提升未见组合类型准确率，但更大词典反而损害整体token精度，最终“基础词典+置信度回退”效果最佳。
AI.motivation: 字符级OCR在低资源满文上产生近似拼写错误，词典约束解码可纠错但固定词典无法覆盖黏着式构词产生的未见词形，需研究形态扩展能否缓解这一限制，以及扩展规模与置信度回退的影响。
AI.method: 用基于词典的词干表对训练转写文本切分，抽取词根与后缀链生成约510k候选；按验证集频率排序选择扩展规模；将硬词典约束下的准确率分解为覆盖率与词典内精度的乘积；在三个CRNN训练种子及一个Transformer识别器上对比基础词典（约29k词）、扩展词典以及置信度回退策略。
AI.result: 基础词典加入250k候选后，已见词根未见组合的类型准确率由63.6%升至86.3%，整体token准确率由82.4%升至84.2%；加入全部候选则整体token准确率降至81.5%。基础词典+置信度回退在测试的CRNN系统中整体最佳，达76.1%类型准确率与85.5%token准确率，并优于带或不带回退的扩展词典；Transformer呈类似趋势。
AI.conclusion: 形态扩展可缓解固定词典的覆盖限制，但更大词典并不保证识别更好，覆盖增益伴随词典内精度损失；在该低资源满文OCR场景中，可靠词典约束与开放识别的选择性组合更有效。

title: Training-Free Domain Generation for One-Shot Federated Learning with Server-Side Pre-trained Diffusion Models
summary: One-shot federated learning (OSFL) has attracted increasing attention for its ability to substantially reduce communication overhead by limiting client-server interaction to a single communication round. Nevertheless, this limited interaction makes learning from heterogeneous client distributions challenging. Diffusion-based OSFL approaches seek to address this challenge by synthesizing data that approximate client distributions. However, existing diffusion-based approaches often impose substantial computational costs on clients and lack effective visual guidance to generate data aligned with client distributions. To address these limitations, we propose FedDoG, a training-free Domain Generation framework that leverages server-side pre-trained diffusion models to synthesize data aligned with client domains. FedDoG extracts compact domain representations using a frozen image encoder, substantially reducing client-side computational and communication costs. These representations are incorporated into the diffusion model through a pre-trained image-conditioning adapter, thereby providing explicit visual guidance for domain generation. To further improve the quality of synthetic data, FedDoG adapts the strength of visual conditioning according to domain concentration and filters generated samples based on class consistency and predictive entropy. Experiments on three benchmarks demonstrate that FedDoG generates higher-quality synthetic images and outperforms existing OSFL baselines in classification accuracy. Meanwhile, FedDoG reduces client upload and computation time by 99.9% and 91.5%, respectively. The code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: FedDoG：免训练的一次性联邦学习域生成框架，用服务器端预训练扩散模型+冻结图像编码器提取紧凑域表示，经图像条件适配器引导合成客户端域对齐数据，并按域集中度自适应调节条件强度、按类一致性与预测熵过滤样本。
AI.motivation: OSFL仅单轮通信虽大幅降低通信开销，但客户端分布异构（non-IID）导致学习困难；已有基于扩散的OSFL方法在客户端上计算开销大，且缺乏有效视觉引导以生成与客户端分布对齐的数据。
AI.method: 训练-free框架：客户端用冻结图像编码器提取紧凑域表示（降低本地计算与上行通信），通过预训练的image-conditioning adapter注入扩散模型提供显式视觉引导；依域集中度自适应调整视觉条件强度；按类一致性与预测熵过滤合成样本；服务器端预训练扩散模型完成合成，客户端不承担diffusion训练。
AI.result: 在三个基准上合成图像质量更高，分类准确率优于现有OSFL基线；客户端上传量与计算时间分别减少99.9%与91.5%。
AI.conclusion: 将"域表示条件化扩散生成"用于OSFL，以免训练、低客户端开销的方式缓解异构分布问题，验证了紧凑域条件和样本过滤对合成数据质量与精度的有效性。

title: Scalable Iterative Multi-Agent Path Finding under Turn Constraints
summary: Large-scale multi-mobile-robot systems require fast and reliable path planning under realistic motion constraints. Multi-Agent Path Finding with turn actions (MAPF$_T$) explicitly models orientation changes and turn-induced delays, but these constraints increase the computational burden of search-based methods. Priority-inheritance-based planning offers a highly scalable alternative, yet directly extending it to MAPF$_T$ is nontrivial because turn actions break the immediate node-vacation assumption underlying conventional priority inheritance. To address this challenge, this paper proposes PIBT$^*_T$, an efficient iterative solver for MAPF$_T$. PIBT$^*_T$ advances scalable multi-agent coordination by preserving the lightweight single-timestep planning mechanism of Priority Inheritance with Backtracking (PIBT), while introducing dedicated mechanisms to handle turn-induced dependencies, local deadlocks, livelock, and inefficient repeated pushing. Experiments on standard MAPF benchmarks show that PIBT$^*_T$ achieves high success rates and strong scalability, solving instances with up to 1000 agents within seconds. For realistic engineering environments, Action Dependency Graph (ADG)-based execution simulation and a flexible manufacturing system case study show that turn-aware planning better reflects robot execution and reduces actual makespan compared with classical MAPF planning. Experiments with TurtleBot4 robots further validate the practical feasibility of the proposed method.

AI.tldr: PIBT*_T extends Priority Inheritance with Backtracking (PIBT) to MAPF with turn actions (MAPF_T), adding mechanisms to handle turn-induced dependencies, local deadlocks, livelock, and repeated pushing; solves up to 1000 agents in seconds and validates on ADG-based execution simulation, an FMS case study, and TurtleBot4 robots.
AI.motivation: Large-scale multi-robot systems need fast, reliable planning under realistic motion constraints. MAPF_T explicitly models orientation changes and turn delays, but this breaks the immediate node-vacation assumption that underpins conventional priority inheritance, making direct extension of PIBT nontrivial.
AI.method: Iterative priority-inheritance solver for MAPF_T that preserves PIBT's lightweight single-timestep planning while adding turn-aware dependency handling, plus modules for local deadlock resolution, livelock avoidance, and suppression of inefficient repeated pushing.
