AI.result: High success rates and strong scalability on standard MAPF benchmarks (1000 agents within seconds); ADG-based execution simulation and a flexible manufacturing system case study show turn-aware planning reduces actual makespan vs. classical MAPF; TurtleBot4 experiments confirm practical feasibility.
AI.conclusion: Turn-aware scalable MAPF planning improves fidelity of execution and makespan in realistic engineering settings, supported by real-robot validation.

title: ReLoco: Unified Humanoid Locomotion and Fall Recovery via Behavior-Conditioned Motion Priors
summary: Humanoid robots must recover from falls and resume commanded motion to sustain locomotion. Learning these behaviors in one policy requires supervision that accommodates both upright movement and ground-contact recovery. We present ReLoco, a framework that uses behavior-conditioned adversarial motion priors to learn locomotion, get-up from arbitrary fallen postures, and command resumption within one proprioceptive policy. During training, robot posture selects the expert pool and conditions a shared discriminator with two behavior-specific outputs. Task rewards and shared regularization support command tracking and recovery, while temporary assistance facilitates exploration. A simulation-based refinement stage supplies robot-executed motion references for this supervision. Ablations examine conditional supervision, output separation, and reference quality under matched settings. At a common training iteration, the full policy achieves $96.80\%$ independent get-up success and $96.96\%$ push-recovery success, including command resumption. Its torso planar velocity root-mean-square error is $0.1266$~m/s, $14.7\%$ lower than the conditional single-output variant, with similar joint-angle discrepancy measured by dynamic time warping. Deployment on the 64.5-kg Tiangong~3.0 humanoid demonstrates walking, running, get-up, and locomotion resumption after falls using one proprioceptive actor, without controller switching or on-robot policy fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: ReLoco 用行为条件化的对抗运动先验，在单一本体感知策略内统一实现行走/奔跑、任意跌倒姿态起身与指令恢复，并在 Tiangong 3.0 人形实机上部署验证。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人跌倒后需自主起身并恢复指令运动才能持续作业，但"直立行走"与"地面接触恢复"两类行为的监督信号差异大，单策略学习易冲突；现有工作多为独立控制器切换或依赖大量动捕参考。
AI.method: 以机器人当前姿态选择专家池并对共享判别器施加行为条件（双输出头）；结合任务奖励与共享正则项；训练期引入临时辅助力促进探索；增加仿真精炼阶段生成机器人自身可执行的参考运动，替代纯动捕数据；消融条件监督、输出分离与参考质量。
AI.result: 共同训练迭代下，完整策略独立起身成功率 96.80%、推倒恢复成功率 96.96%（含指令恢复）；躯干平面速度 RMSE 0.1266 m/s，较条件单输出变体降低 14.7%，DTW 关节角误差相近。64.5 kg Tiangong 3.0 实机上以单一本体感知 actor 完成行走、奔跑、起身及跌倒后运动恢复，无需控制器切换与在线微调。
AI.conclusion: 行为条件化对抗运动先验可有效解耦"直立运动"与"恢复"两类监督，实现单策略通用恢复能力，并具备零微调的真机迁移性，为人形机器人鲁棒持续运动提供可行范式。

title: GTI: Grounding Task Intent Throughout Long-Horizon VLA Manipulation
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models generate local actions from visual observations, language, and robot state, but long-horizon manipulation requires the global task intent to remain grounded in the currently executable context. We propose GTI (Grounding Task Intent), which uses the current observation and execution history to localize the active subtask and its execution phase. For the same local subtask, GTI generates two phase-dependent visual targets: an interaction/contact state and a local completion state. The local language instruction and the corresponding phase-specific visual target jointly condition the VLA, specifying both what to do now and what state should be reached at the current phase. During execution, anomaly monitoring and local recovery re-establish an intent-consistent execution context through rollback, re-observation, and phase re-evaluation after persistent deviation. We evaluate GTI on RoboCasa365, VLA-Arena Horizon-Long, and real-world PiPER tasks. Relative to matched Global-FT baselines, GR00T success on seen composite RoboCasa365 tasks increases from 14.6%/12.1% to 31.8%/20.4% under ID/OOD evaluation. On VLA-Arena, GTI+$\pi_{0.5}$ reaches 47.6% overall success versus 45.2% for an adapted ForeAct baseline, with gains of 5.2/6.0 percentage points on the harder L1/L2 tasks. In the three real-robot task experiments, mean full-task success increases from 21.7% to 59.2%. The results indicate that persistent semantic intent localization and phase-conditioned visual grounding improve multi-stage execution, while failure-triggered local recovery provides additional deployment-time support.

AI.tldr: GTI通过当前观测与执行历史定位活跃子任务及其执行阶段，生成"接触状态"与"局部完成状态"两个阶段相关的视觉目标，与局部语言指令共同条件化VLA；配合异常监测与回滚式局部恢复。在RoboCasa365、VLA-Arena及真机PiPER上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 长程操作需要全局任务意图在当前可执行上下文中保持落地（grounded）。端到端VLA仅从观测生成局部动作，容易在长序列中丢失"现在处于哪个子任务、哪个阶段"的语义与相位信息，导致执行漂移。
AI.method: (1) 阶段定位：用当前观测+执行历史推断活跃子任务及执行阶段；(2) 阶段条件化视觉目标生成：对同一子任务生成交互/接触态与局部完成态两类视觉目标，与局部语言指令联合作为VLA条件；(3) 部署期容错：异常监测，在持续偏差时通过回滚、重新观测与阶段重评估重建意图一致的执行上下文。
AI.result: RoboCasa365已见复合任务：GR00T成功率达31.8%/20.4%（ID/OOD），对比Global-FT基线14.6%/12.1%。VLA-Arena：GTI+π0.5总体47.6% vs. 适配ForeAct 45.2%，更难L1/L2任务提升5.2/6.0个百分点。真机三任务平均全任务成功率从21.7%升至59.2%。
AI.conclusion: 持续的语义意图定位与阶段条件化视觉grounding能有效改善多阶段长程执行，基于失败触发的局部恢复为实际部署提供额外支撑；方法为模块化外挂式，可迁移至多种VLA骨干（GR00T、π0.5）。

title: ProxySearch: Decoupled Inference-Time Scaling for Diffusion Models via Asymmetric Noise-Rank Transfer
summary: Noise search at inference time improves text-to-image diffusion but requires many multi-step teacher rollouts per query. Distilled few-step models are now routinely released, yet their potential as proxies inside noise search is uncharacterized. We measure proxy-teacher rank agreement across three distillation regimes and three backbones (DiT, MMDiT, UNet) and find a sharp asymmetry. On our main pool, closed-form image statistics transfer from the proxy to the teacher (Spearman $\rho$ up to 0.80), while learned semantic scorers do not ($\rho \le$ 0.12). Paired null controls trace this rank to the first denoising step for coarse statistics and to distillation for finer ones. We use the asymmetry for noise search under a joint constraint: a semantic reward specifies content, and a numeric target specifies image statistics. In PROXYSEARCH, the proxy filters candidates by statistical match in 1 step, and the teacher returns the survivor with the highest semantic reward. No weight trades one objective against the other. On FLUX-1024, PROXYSEARCH tightens the statistical target by 21-23% at the same number of teacher trajectories, with no detected loss on the optimized reward.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统刻画了少步蒸馏扩散模型作为"代理教师"参与噪声搜索的可行性：闭式图像统计量在代理与教师间排名一致性高（Spearman ρ≤0.80），而学习型语义评分器一致性极低（ρ≤0.12）；据此提出 PROXYSEARCH，用代理单步做统计筛选、真实教师仅评估语义奖励，在 FLUX-1024 上同等教师轨迹数下将统计目标误差收紧 21–23%。
AI.motivation: 推理期噪声搜索能提升文生图质量，但每个查询需要大量多步教师 rollout，代价高昂。少步蒸馏模型已普遍开源，但它们在噪声搜索中能否替代教师的性质（代理-教师排序一致性）尚未被刻画。作者希望量化这种代理有效性，并利用其结构差异设计零权衡的搜索策略。
AI.method: 在三种蒸馏范式和三种骨干（DiT、MMDiT、UNet）上测量代理-教师排名一致性，并加入配对零对照（paired null controls）做溯源分析，定位粗统计与细统计的秩来源于首个去噪步与蒸馏本身。基于发现的不对称性，提出 PROXYSEARCH：在联合约束下，代理用 1 步按统计匹配过滤候选，教师仅对幸存者评估语义奖励并返回最优者，从而不在两个目标间做权重折衷。
AI.result: 闭式图像统计量可从代理迁移到教师（ρ 最高 0.80），学习型语义评分器几乎不迁移（ρ≤0.12）。在 FLUX-1024 上，相同教师轨迹预算下统计目标收紧 21–23%，且未检测到所优化奖励的损失。
AI.conclusion: 少步蒸馏模型是可靠的"廉价位"统计代理而非语义代理，其代理有效性具有明确的维度不对称性；这种不对称性可被直接转化为高效的两阶段噪声搜索，在不牺牲语义奖励的前提下改善统计可控性。

title: A Hierarchical Onboard Vision-Language-Navigation Framework for Aerial Robots in Complex Environments
summary: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) are expected to achieve semantic reasoning, intelligent decision-making, and long-horizon navigation under strict onboard constraints. While recent foundation-model-driven approaches have shown promising progress toward this goal, existing methods remain limited by challenges in 3D data availability, trajectory feasibility, long-horizon reasoning, and computational efficiency in complex environments. To bridge these gaps, we propose VLN-AR, a hierarchical vision-language-navigation (VLN) framework for aerial robots. VLN-AR decouples multimodal reasoning and low-level control, enabling structured prediction of 3D pose commands and navigation intentions that are translated into dynamically feasible actions. To mitigate data scarcity and domain gaps, we introduce a fully automated 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS)-based pipeline to generate scalable photorealistic UAV navigation data. A progressive three-stage training strategy further enhances grounding, scene reasoning, and complex navigation. In addition, a lightweight cognitive agent improves long-horizon reasoning via memory-aware task decomposition. Finally, we design onboard optimization techniques, including token sparsification and model lightweighting, achieving 7.1x-9.4x speedup while maintaining high navigation performance on resource-limited UAV platforms. Experiments show great improvements over existing methods in both simulation and real-world UAV navigation. Project website: this https URL

AI.tldr: VLN-AR: 面向无人机具身导航的分层视觉-语言-导航框架，解耦多模态推理与底层控制，结合3DGS自动数据生成、三阶段渐进训练、记忆型轻量认知代理与机载推理优化。
AI.motivation: 无人机需在严格机载算力约束下完成语义推理、智能决策与长时程导航；现有基础模型方法受限于3D数据稀缺、轨迹可行性差、长时程推理弱与计算效率低等问题。
AI.method: 1) 分层架构：高层多模态模型输出结构化3D位姿指令与导航意图，交由底层控制器转为动力学可行动作；2) 基于3D Gaussian Splatting的全自动真实感无人机导航数据生成管线，缓解数据稀缺与域差；3) 渐进式三阶段训练（grounding→场景推理→复杂导航）；4) 轻量化认知代理以记忆感知的任务分解支撑长时程推理；5) 机载优化：token稀疏化与模型轻量化。
AI.result: 机载优化带来7.1x–9.4x加速，同时在资源受限平台保持高导航性能；仿真与真实无人机导航实验均较现有方法有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 分层解耦＋3DGS数据合成＋渐进训练＋轻量认知代理的组合有效弥合数据、可行性与算力鸿沟，具备实机部署可行性。

title: Emo-H2A: Driving a Facial Robot Directly from LLM Hidden States at Token Rate
summary: Diverse, semantically synchronized, and low-latency facial expressions are essential for human-robot interaction. While large language models (LLMs) have endowed anthropomorphic robots with fluent speech, facial expression still struggles to follow the conversation. Motivated by this gap, we present Emo-H2A (hidden-to-actuation), a paradigm that drives a facial robot directly from LLM hidden states during autoregressive decoding. Without a separate emotion label, expression stays continuous and context-sensitive, and the face moves with the unfolding reply. We instantiate this paradigm as EmoManifold, a training-free method that extracts a valence-arousal-dominance (VAD) coordinate from each hidden state, projects it, and drives the face at token granularity. The readout is checked on six language models, and the same projection drives our 29-degree-of-freedom (DoF) facial robot. When driven by this projection, the face shifts its expression in the matching direction on 87.5% of within-reply valence transitions, whereas holding a single label for the whole reply leaves directional tracking near the 50% chance level, and first moves in 0.96s rather than waiting 10-26s for the reply to finish and a turn-level label to return.

AI.tldr: 提出Emo-H2A范式：在LLM自回归解码过程中直接用隐藏状态驱动面部机器人，无需独立情绪标签；实例化为免训练方法EmoManifold，从每个token的隐藏状态提取VAD坐标并投影驱动29自由度面部机器人。
AI.motivation: LLM让人形机器人语音流畅，但面部表情难以跟随对话过程；回合级情绪标签导致表情滞后且缺乏细粒度动态。
AI.method: Emo-H2A范式：直接从LLM解码隐藏状态驱动面部执行。EmoManifold为免训练方法，将每个隐藏状态读出为效价-唤醒-支配(VAD)三维坐标，经固定投影映射到29-DoF面部机器人的动作空间，实现token粒度表情驱动。
AI.result: 在6个语言模型上验证VAD读出；同一投影驱动真实面部机器人。回复内效价转换时表情方向正确率达87.5%，而整句单一标签接近50%随机水平；首次动作延迟0.96s，对比等待回复结束的回合级标签需10–26s。
AI.conclusion: 隐藏状态直接驱动为低延迟、连续、情境敏感的面部表情生成提供了可行路径，且免训练、可跨模型迁移。

title: TRoPE: Topology-aware Relative Positional Encoding for 4D Generation
summary: Video-to-4D mesh generation has made substantial progress in recovering dynamic 3D geometry and motion from monocular videos. However, commonly used feed-forward approaches remain prone to sticking artifacts, where geodesically distant vertices move together incorrectly when they become spatially close. We attribute this failure to cross-part motion leakage: spatially nearby yet structurally distant vertices may retrieve similar motion information when motion decoding fails to distinguish spatial proximity from mesh connectivity. To address this issue, we introduce TRoPE, a topology-aware relative positional encoding that makes mesh connectivity explicit in the interaction between vertex queries and mesh-supported motion sources. TRoPE derives spectral features from the graph Laplacian and constructs pairwise topological relations from distances between multi-scale diffusion features, using these relations to modulate vertex--anchor attention through rotary phases. We further introduce a vertex-wise tail-risk objective that emphasizes persistently high-error vertices to explicitly suppress sticking artifacts. To better characterize and quantify these failures, we introduce MeshSticking-4D, a dedicated benchmark for this failure mode. Experiments on MeshSticking-4D show that TRoPE suppresses sticking artifacts while improving overall motion accuracy. Compared with the baseline, it reduces the worst-vertex error by 39.4% and lowers the separation failure rate from 49.35% to 34.90%. Additional evaluations on Motion-80 and Motion324-Subset show lower tail errors on diverse objects, while transfer to Mesh4D demonstrates applicability across backbones.

AI.tldr: 提出拓扑感知相对位置编码 TRoPE（基于图拉普拉斯谱特征与多尺度扩散特征的距离构建成对拓扑关系，以旋转相位调制顶点-锚点注意力），并引入顶点级尾部风险损失，抑制视频到4D网格生成中的“粘连”伪影。
AI.motivation: 前馈式视频到4D网格生成存在粘连伪影：测地距离远但在空间中靠近的顶点被错误地赋予相近运动，根源是运动解码无法区分空间邻近与网格连通性，导致跨部件运动泄漏。
AI.method: 1) TRoPE：从图拉普拉斯提取谱特征，用多尺度扩散特征间距离构建成对拓扑关系，并以旋转相位方式调制顶点-锚点注意力；2) 顶点级尾部风险目标函数，强调持续高误差顶点以显式抑制粘连；3) 构建 MeshSticking-4D 专用评测基准。
AI.result: 在 MeshSticking-4D 上最坏顶点误差降低 39.4%，分离失败率从 49.35% 降至 34.90%；在 Motion-80、Motion324-Subset 上尾部误差更低，且迁移到 Mesh4D 证明跨骨干适用。
AI.conclusion: 显式引入网格拓扑连通性到注意力机制，并配合尾部风险优化，可有效缓解单目视频驱动的4D网格运动泄漏问题，具备跨骨干可迁移性。

title: What Right-Angle Corners Reveal About an Uncalibrated Camera: Convex Cones, Certified Bounds and Identifiability
summary: The corner of a box or a room, where three perpendicular edges meet, appears in an image as three segments meeting at a point. We ask what such junctions reveal about an uncalibrated camera's intrinsic parameters. Each junction is consistent with an explicit convex set of cameras; when only the focal length is unknown, this set is an interval in closed form. These sets are computed from the image alone, so calibrating from many junctions is a convex feasibility problem. Almost every junction bounds the focal length from below; we characterize when one also bounds it from above, and when many junctions determine it exactly. For a known vertex, the bounds can be certified against any bounded error in the measured edge directions.

AI.tldr: 从单张图中"三垂边交于一点"的角点（box/room corner）出发，推导未标定相机内参的显式凸可行集；仅焦距未知时为闭式区间，多角点标定化为凸可行性问题。
AI.motivation: 探索图像中的结构线索（三面角交点）能在多大程度上约束未标定相机的内参，避免依赖标定板或额外假设。
AI.method: 将每个三正交边交点（three mutually perpendicular edges）与相机参数构成凸集；当仅焦距未知时给出闭式区间；未知顶点时给出下界，刻画何时能给出上界、以及多交点何时唯一确定焦距；已知顶点时可对边方向测量误差给出带界误差下的认证。
AI.result: 几乎所有角点都给出焦距下界；给出上界存在的条件与多角点精确确定的判据；标定被表述为凸可行性问题，并可针对有界测量误差进行认证。
AI.conclusion: 利用场景中普遍存在的正交三面角结构，可从单张图像以凸优化方式获得相机焦距的严格区间约束，为无标定板的自标定提供理论保证与可验证性。

title: Facet-SLAM: Real-Time Triangle Splatting SLAM
summary: Dense SLAM systems based on 3D Gaussian splatting build maps that render photorealistically, but their surface geometry is poor, and obtaining a mesh requires extraction or fusion stages. Triangle splatting avoids this with surface primitives whose vertices can be triangulated directly into a connected mesh, yet SLAM with this representation has so far relied on photometric tracking, which is too slow for localization at sensor rate. We present Facet-SLAM, the first real-time triangle splatting SLAM system for RGB-D cameras. Fast geometric registration is the natural alternative, but it is not sufficient alone, since the mapper's optimization displaces triangles from the observed surface and makes them unreliable registration targets. We therefore separate the two roles: the tracker sets each triangle's centroid from fused depth and registers frames to these centroids by GICP, while the mapper is restricted to non-translating updates via a change of variables. Our system achieves competitive tracking accuracy at around 100 FPS on a desktop GPU and runs at sensor rate on a Jetson AGX Orin. Compared with the photometric approach, it is over 20 times faster, matches rendering quality, and improves surface accuracy, reducing the chamfer distance of the Delaunay mesh on Replica from 1.55 to 0.86 cm. We will release the implementation at this https URL .

AI.tldr: Facet-SLAM：首个实时三角形splatting RGB-D SLAM，将跟踪器（基于GICP配准到由融合深度设定的三角形质心）与映射器（通过变量替换限制为非平移更新）解耦，桌面GPU约100 FPS，Jetson AGX Orin达传感器帧率。
AI.motivation: 3DGS稠密SLAM渲染逼真但表面几何差、需额外出mesh；triangle splatting可直接三角化为连通网格，但其SLAM仅有光度跟踪，速度慢无法实时定位。而纯几何配准又因mapper优化使三角形偏离观测表面而不可靠。
AI.method: 分离跟踪与建图角色：tracker用融合深度设定每个三角形质心，并以GICP将帧配准到这些质心；mapper通过变量替换被约束为不更新平移量，仅优化非平移参数，从而保持质心为可靠配准目标。
AI.result: 桌面GPU约100 FPS，Jetson AGX Orin上达到传感器帧率；相比光度方法快20倍以上，渲染质量相当，表面精度提升——Replica上Delaunay网格chamfer距离从1.55 cm降至0.86 cm。
AI.conclusion: 几何配准需与mapper的平移自由度解耦才能用于三角形splatting SLAM；该解耦设计实现了实时、高质量几何的RGB-D SLAM，代码将开源。

title: Effects of Locomotion and Viewpoint Control on Immersive Robot Telepresence for Navigation and Inspection
summary: In many robot telepresence interfaces, movement and viewing are managed through handheld inputs. This can divide attention between steering, looking, and inspection. We compared joystick versus omnidirectional treadmill locomotion and joystick-based versus head-guided camera control in a within-subject 2x2 study in which 17 participants used a virtual reality headset to guide a quadruped robot through a physical maze while locating marked wall symbols and capturing them as visual evidence. Mixed-effects analyses showed that head-guided camera control was associated with faster completion, lower wall-contact cost, lower workload, and more favorable presence, usability, technology acceptance, and flow than joystick-based camera control. The strongest overall objective performance was observed in the joystick locomotion plus head-guided camera condition, whereas the omnidirectional treadmill plus head-guided camera condition emerged as the strongest experiential compromise. Exploratory camera analyses showed that head-guided camera control reduced switching, increased reliance on the pan-tilt view, and supported a more stable viewing strategy across the maze. These strategy differences were consistent with the performance advantage, especially for wall-contact duration. Targets captured remained near ceiling and simulator sickness remained low across all conditions. Overall, the results indicate that viewpoint control was the stronger differentiator in this combined navigation and inspection task, while locomotion still shaped the objective and experiential tradeoff.

AI.tldr: 17人多因素被试内实验比较摇杆 vs 全向跑步机移动、摇杆 vs 头部引导相机控制对四足机器人VR遥操作导航与巡检任务的影响，发现视点控制是更强的影响因素。
AI.motivation: 手持输入同时承担移动与视角控制会使注意分散于转向、观察与检查之间，需量化移动方式与相机控制方式各自对客观绩效与主观体验的贡献。
AI.method: 2×2被试内设计（摇杆/全向跑步机 × 摇杆相机/头部引导相机），17名被试通过VR头显操控四足机器人在实体迷宫中寻址并拍摄标记符号；采用混合效应模型分析任务时间、撞墙次数/时长、工作负荷、临场感、可用性、技术接受度与心流，并做探索性相机控制策略分析。
AI.result: 头部引导相机显著加快完成速度、降低撞墙成本与工作负荷，并提升临场感、可用性、接受度与心流；综合客观绩效最佳为"摇杆移动+头部相机"，体验折中最佳为"跑步机+头部相机"；头部相机减少相机切换、更多依赖云台视角、观看策略更稳定；目标捕捉接近上限、晕动症低。
AI.conclusion: 在导航+巡检复合任务中，视点控制是主要区分因素，移动方式则塑造客观与体验的权衡；建议遥操作界面优先解耦/头控视角。

title: Angular Conditional Distillation: Overcoming Classifier Geometry Mismatch
summary: Classifier outputs provide a fundamental and univer- sally available knowledge interface for knowledge distil- lation (KD). However, standard logit objectives entangle transferable semantic relations with architecture-dependent parameterization artifacts, causing a classifier geometry mismatch that makes direct knowledge transfer unreliable. To address this, we propose Angular Conditional Distilla- tion (ACD). First, the Angular Coordinate Interface (ACI) reconstructs the student classifier using angular coordi- nates, suppressing magnitude and bias effects to provide a geometry-compatible space. Then, Scale-Invariant Condi- tional Distillation (SICD) standardizes outputs and exclu- sively transfers conditional non-target relations, filtering out untransferable absolute confidence. Together, ACI de- fines where to transfer, while SICD defines what to transfer. Extensive experiments show that ACD achieves state-of-the- art performance over existing KD methods. Moreover, as a universal drop-in replacement, it consistently improves existing distillation pipelines while requiring no feature adapters or additional inference-time cost. Code is avail- able at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出角度条件蒸馏（ACD）：用角度坐标接口（ACI）重构学生分类器以消除模长与偏置造成的几何不匹配，并用尺度不变条件蒸馏（SICD）只迁移非目标类条件关系，作为即插即用模块在无额外推理开销下达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 标准logit蒸馏将可迁移的语义关系与依赖架构参数化的伪影纠缠在一起，导致师生分类器几何不匹配，直接知识迁移不可靠。
AI.method: 两部分：ACI在角度坐标系中重构学生分类器，抑制幅度与偏置效应，构造几何兼容空间（定义"在哪迁移"）；SICD对输出做标准化并仅迁移条件非目标类关系，过滤不可迁移的绝对置信度（定义"迁移什么"）。
AI.result: 大量实验显示ACD优于现有KD方法；作为通用即插即用替换可稳定提升已有蒸馏流程，且无需特征适配器与推理时额外开销。
AI.conclusion: 通过几何解耦"何处迁移"与"迁移何种知识"，ACD提供了简洁有效的logit层面知识蒸馏新范式，工程实用性强。

title: SIGNTOK: A Text-Aligned Continuous Pose Tokenizer for Sign Language Generation
summary: Text-conditioned sign language generation (SLG) depends not only on the generator but also on the space in which signing is generated. Existing approaches generate directly in pose space, in quantized code spaces, or in learned latent spaces trained for reconstruction. We find that these spaces are organized largely by signer identity rather than linguistic content: on CSL-Daily, a test clip's nearest neighbor in raw pose space is the same sentence signed by another person in only 2% of cases. To address this, we propose SIGNTOK, a continuous pose tokenizer whose latent space is shaped by three training-only heads: a kinematics head that predicts motion dynamics, a sentence-level head that aligns signing with the overall text, and a word-level head that aligns short motion windows with content words. Together, these objectives raise the same-sentence cross-signer nearest-neighbor rate to 82%. On three sign language benchmarks, the same generator trained in the SIGNTOK latent instead of pose space raises back-translation BLEU-4 in five of six benchmark-scorer settings at comparable joint accuracy, and word-level alignment gives higher back-translation scores than sentence-level alignment on every benchmark.

AI.tldr: SIGNTOK：用三个仅训练时生效的预测头（运动学、句级文本对齐、词级文本对齐）塑造连续姿态分词器的隐空间，使同句跨签者最近邻率从2%升至82%，同一生成器在该隐空间训练可提升回译BLEU-4。
AI.motivation: 文本条件手语生成依赖"生成空间"的语义组织。现有姿态空间、量化码本空间或重建导向隐空间中，样本组织主要按签者身份而非语言内容（CSL-Daily上原始姿态空间同句跨签者最近邻仅2%），限制生成器的有效学习。
AI.method: 提出SIGNTOK：连续姿态分词器，在训练期引入三个辅助头——运动学头（预测运动动力学）、句级头（整体手语与文本对齐）、词级头（短动作窗口与内容词对齐），以对比/对齐目标塑造以语言内容为主导的隐空间；推理时不使用这些头。
AI.result: 同句跨签者最近邻率由2%提升至82%；在三个手语基准、六种基准-评分器设定中，有五个同一生成器在SIGNTOK隐空间训练较姿态空间训练提升回译BLEU-4，关节精度相当；词级对齐在所有基准上优于句级对齐。
AI.conclusion: 生成空间的组织方式本身是关键建模维度：以语言内容为中心的隐空间比重建导向空间更利于文本条件手语生成，且细粒度（词级）对齐优于粗粒度对齐。

title: How Complete Must an Environment Be to Train a Capable GUI Agent?
summary: Graphical user interface (GUI) agents are widely trained in executable GUI environments. To lower cost, build environments in batches, and reduce manual effort, each work trades away part of the environment through its construction choices. We describe these choices along three dimensions: reward coverage, the goal-reaching trajectories the verifier rewards; data coverage, the application data the agent is exposed to beyond what the task reads or writes; and feature coverage, the application features beyond what the task uses. Existing works set each dimension on engineering grounds, but they do not measure its effect on training. How complete must an environment be to train a capable agent, and along which dimensions? In MobileGym, we adjust each dimension separately, train Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct, and evaluate every policy in the original full environment. A verifier that rewards only one reference path lowers success by 10.53 points, and removing unneeded records also lowers success. Pruning unneeded features instead raises success from 51.61% to 56.13%, entirely on tasks whose environments it left unchanged. The gain reverses when each episode is weighted equally and vanishes when only episodes on the pruned tasks are balanced. Without pruning, length weighting there reinforces long detour successes that erode skills on other tasks. Following these findings, we build MobileGym-Lite, which keeps reward and data coverage complete and prunes unneeded features. It outperforms Full in the full environment (55.48% versus 51.61% success) with lower construction cost.

AI.tldr: 论文系统研究GUI智能体训练环境构建的三个维度（奖励覆盖、数据覆盖、特征覆盖）对训练效果的影响，发现奖励/数据覆盖缺失会降低成功率，而剪除无关特征反而提升性能（51.61%→56.13%），据此构建MobileGym-Lite，在完整环境中以更低成本超过Full（55.48% vs 51.61%）。
AI.motivation: 现有GUI智能体训练环境因成本与批量化需求各自在奖励覆盖、数据覆盖、特征覆盖上做工程性取舍，却从未量化这些取舍对训练效果的影响，因此不清楚"环境要多完整才够用、沿哪个维度最敏感"。
AI.method: 提出MobileGym框架，对三个覆盖维度逐一单独调控，训练Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct，并统一在原始完整环境中评测所得策略；进一步分析按长度/按任务/按episode加权的采样方式对结论的影响，据此设计MobileGym-Lite（保留完整奖励与数据覆盖、剪除无关特征）。
AI.result: 仅奖励单条参考轨迹的验证器使成功率下降10.53点，移除任务无关记录同样降低成功率；剪除无关特征使成功率从51.61%升至56.13%，且增益全部出现在环境未被改动的任务上；该增益在按episode等权时反转、在仅平衡剪枝任务episode时消失；不剪枝时长度加权会强化长绕路成功样本并损伤其他任务技能。
AI.conclusion: 环境完整性需求是维度不对称的：奖励与数据覆盖应保持完整，无关特征则应剪除；MobileGym-Lite在完整环境中达55.48%成功率并降低构建成本，为GUI智能体环境设计提供了可操作准则。

title: VOL-Agent: Programming Your Film via Video Orchestration Language Agentic System
summary: Recent video foundation models generate high-quality and limited-length clips, but orchestrating them into minute-level, story-coherent films remains an open problem. Existing video agents highly rely on natural-language planning or predefined workflows, which make their production hard to program, customize, and extend. Therefore, we introduce VOL-Agent, a programmable video agent built on a Video Orchestration Language (VOL). With static compilation and verification, followed by runtime dynamic loading, VOL-Agent decouples structural reliability from execution flexibility. Through the skill-driven executor, VOL-Agent dynamically resolves tools and skills from an open-world repository and supports user-defined skills in natural language. Moreover, VOL-Agent is capable of crafting new director skills from learned knowledge and improves itself through feedback to accumulate filmmaking knowledge. To overcome the disconnect between different segments, we apply a structural memory mechanism to record and recall world and entity states, sustaining entity and scene consistency across different shots. Critic feedback supports local revision, while reusable filmmaking knowledge and experiences can be retained for subsequent tasks. Experiments on three benchmarks show that VOL-Agent generates minute-scale videos with strong overall quality and limited cost.

AI.tldr: VOL-Agent 是一个基于可编程视频编排语言(VOL)的视频智能体，通过静态编译验证+运行时动态加载解耦结构可靠性与执行灵活性，用技能驱动执行器从开放工具库解析技能、生成新导演技能并通过反馈自我改进，配合结构化记忆保持跨镜头实体与场景一致性，可在三个基准上以较低成本生成分钟级连贯视频。
AI.motivation: 现有视频基座模型只能生成高质量短片段，将其编排为分钟级、故事连贯的长视频仍是开放问题；现有视频智能体高度依赖自然语言规划或预定义工作流，难以编程、定制与扩展。
AI.method: 提出视频编排语言VOL与VOL-Agent：静态编译与验证保证结构可靠性，运行时动态加载保证执行灵活性；技能驱动执行器从开放世界仓库动态解析工具与技能，支持自然语言定义的用户技能，并可从学习知识中合成新导演技能、通过反馈自我进化；引入结构化记忆记录与召回世界/实体状态以维持跨镜头一致性；Critic反馈支持局部修订，可复用创作知识经验。
AI.result: 在三个基准上实验，VOL-Agent 能以有限成本生成分钟级视频，整体质量较强。
AI.conclusion: 可编程、自进化、带结构化记忆的视频编排智能体为长时故事连贯视频生成提供了可定制、可扩展的工程化路径；摘要未给出与强基线对比的量化细节，也缺乏对物理交互/三维一致性的直接证据。

title: MitoWorld: A Stochastic World Model of the Single-Cell Cycle under Genetic Perturbation
summary: A cell observed after a gene knockdown has an uncertain future, both in how its appearance will evolve and when it will divide. Existing approaches predict endpoints or population-level changes without jointly modeling individual trajectories and division timing. In this work, we present MitoWorld, a stochastic world model that generates these future appearances as continuous evolution in a Gaussian reference latent, terminated by a division hazard and converted into images by a conditional diffusion renderer. The ordinary transition provably preserves its Gaussian reference, tying its noise to its dynamics; paired observations identify its discrete transition where stationary marginals cannot. The hazard turns division timing into a survival likelihood that can be tested against real cycle lengths. On 325 held-out MitoCheck tracks spanning 17 knockdowns and a control, MitoWorld lowers FID by 34.6\% and the video metric JEDi by 45.6\% relative to the strongest baselines. Its latent-space prediction intervals achieve near-nominal 90\% coverage, are 35\% narrower than those of a model with freely fitted noise. The hazard also yields cell-cycle length distributions with KS distance close to the model-based finite-sample reference. Testable single-cell stochastic dynamics thus offer a generative tool for time-lapse perturbation screens.

AI.tldr: MitoWorld：面向基因敲低单细胞时序的随机世界模型，在可证保持高斯的参考潜空间中连续演化，以分裂风险函数终止轨迹，再由条件扩散渲染器生成图像；同时能给出可检验的分裂时间生存似然与预测区间。
AI.motivation: 活细胞荧光显微成像中，基因敲低后细胞"外观如何演化、何时分裂"均不确定。现有方法只预测终点或群体层面变化，未联合建模单条轨迹与分裂时间，难以支撑时序扰动筛选的可检验随机动力学。
AI.method: 提出 MitoWorld 随机世界模型：(1) 在高斯参考潜空间做连续时间演化，其"普通转移"可证明保持高斯先验，使注入噪声与动力学绑定；(2) 用成对观测辨识离散转移（稳态边缘分布无法辨识时）；(3) 以分裂风险函数(hazard)将分裂时间写成生存似然，可与真实细胞周期长度做统计检验；(4) 由条件扩散渲染器将潜变量解码为图像。
AI.result: 在 17 组敲低+1 组对照共 325 条 held-out MitoCheck 轨迹上，FID 降低 34.6%、视频指标 JEDi 降低 45.6%；潜空间 90% 预测区间达到近名义覆盖率，且比自由拟合噪声的模型窄 35%；风险函数给出的细胞周期长度分布与模型化有限样本参考的 KS 距离接近。
AI.conclusion: 将单细胞未来外观与分裂时序统一为可检验的随机动力学，为延时扰动筛选提供生成式工具；但其应用域为显微成像而非具身/3D 场景，属邻近技术参考。

title: SimplePro: A Simple Baseline for Proactive Video Understanding
summary: Proactive video understanding requires vision-language models (VLMs) to decide not only what to answer as a video unfolds, but also when newly arrived evidence warrants a response and when to remain silent. Although modern VLMs excel at offline long-video understanding, they struggle in proactive streaming settings, leading prior work to introduce task-specific reinforcement learning or auxiliary triggering modules. We find that explicit reporting rules and structured streaming context substantially improve a frozen VLM's proactive response performance. We exploit this observation to build SIMPLEPRO, a training-free baseline for proactive video understanding. At each decision step, the model combines recent high-resolution frames, bounded historical observations, and prior answer records to determine whether new information warrants a response and, when needed, generate a concise answer. The system then filters consecutive duplicate answers while retaining the raw outputs as context for subsequent decisions. Without any parameter updates or auxiliary triggers, SIMPLEPRO with a 4B backbone consistently outperforms specialized proactive systems across OVO-Bench, StreamingBench-PO, and ProactiveVideoQA. SIMPLEPRO shows overall performance gains as backbone size increases from 2B to 32B. We hope this simple yet effective method will serve as a strong baseline for proactive video understanding, and we will release our code and inference pipeline to support future research.

AI.tldr: SIMPLEPRO：无需训练的冻结VLM基线，通过规则显式化+结构化流式上下文（近期高清帧+有界历史观测+历史回答记录）实现主动式视频理解（何时说、说什么），4B骨干即在OVO-Bench、StreamingBench-PO、ProactiveVideoQA上超越专用RL/触发模块方法。
AI.motivation: 主动式视频理解要求VLM在视频流中同时决定"何时响应"与"回答什么"，现代VLM擅长离线长视频理解但在主动流式设定下表现不佳；已有工作依赖任务特定强化学习或额外触发模块，成本高且不通用。
AI.method: 提出训练-free基线SIMPLEPRO：每个决策步组合近期高分辨率帧、有界历史观测与既往回答记录，依据显式报告规则判断新证据是否值得响应；需要时生成简洁答案；对连续重复答案进行过滤，同时保留原始输出作为后续决策上下文。无参数更新、无辅助触发器。
AI.result: 4B骨干的SIMPLEPRO在OVO-Bench、StreamingBench-PO、ProactiveVideoQA上一致优于专用主动系统；性能随骨干从2B增至32B呈单调提升。
AI.conclusion: 简单有效的提示构造与上下文管理足以替代复杂RL/触发模块，为主动视频理解提供强基线；将开源代码与推理流水线。

title: DORMS: Image Segmentation via Depth-Ordered Region Merge Trees
summary: We introduce DORMS (Depth-Ordered Region Merging for Segmentation), a purely algorithmic approach to image segmentation from monocular depth maps, requiring no neural networks or learned parameters in the segmentation process. An off-the-shelf monocular depth estimator provides the input depth maps. Our method constructs depth-ordered merge trees through a deterministic union-find sweep, combining component area, depth persistence, and spatial contact constraints to guide region merging. A threshold search determines the segmentation granularity according to a specified target region count, while global depth detrending improves the separation of local geometric structures. Extensive experiments on COCO Panoptic, Cityscapes, and ADE20K demonstrate consistent improvements over classical segmentation baselines and competitive performance against zero-shot neural segmentation models. Notably, our method outperforms all evaluated zero-shot models on Cityscapes, while remaining competitive with several approaches on COCO and ADE20K. These results highlight the potential of purely algorithmic geometric reasoning for image segmentation without learned segmentation models.

AI.tldr: DORMS: a purely algorithmic (no learning) segmentation framework that builds depth-ordered merge trees from off-the-shelf monocular depth maps via deterministic union-find sweep, using area, depth persistence and spatial contact cues for region merging.
AI.motivation: Explore whether classical geometric reasoning on monocular depth can replace learned segmentation models, providing a training-free, parameter-free segmentation pipeline.
AI.method: Input from off-the-shelf monocular depth estimator; global depth detrending to enhance local geometry separation; depth-ordered merge trees constructed by deterministic union-find sweep; merging guided by component area, depth persistence and spatial contact constraints; threshold search to hit a target region count.
AI.result: Consistent gains over classical segmentation baselines on COCO Panoptic, Cityscapes and ADE20K; competitive with zero-shot neural segmentation models, and outperforming all evaluated zero-shot models on Cityscapes.
AI.conclusion: Purely algorithmic geometric reasoning on monocular depth is a viable alternative to learned segmentation, though it depends on external monocular depth quality and target-count specification rather than producing semantic labels.

title: 3DTouch: A Tactile-aware VLA Model with 3D Geometric Relations for Dexterous Manipulation
summary: In contact-rich dexterous manipulation, occlusion by the fingers and interacting objects obscures local geometry, preventing visual observations from fully capturing contact locations. Visually similar scenes may also differ subtly in the relative positions of interacting objects, leading to different contact states. We propose 3DTouch, a tactile-geometric conditioning approach for vision-language-action (VLA) models. 3DTouch constructs a shared 3D visuo-tactile representation by expressing RGB-D scene points and dense five-finger tactile measurements in the robot-base frame, preserving each taxel's spatial location and force vector. Hand-object and object-object relations derived from hand landmarks and pose-aligned reconstructed surfaces explicitly describe the relative arrangement of interacting entities. Together, these representations condition the VLA action expert on spatially localized contact forces and relative surface geometry, providing explicit cues for contact adjustment and object alignment. We evaluate 3DTouch on five real-world contact-rich dexterous manipulation tasks using a UR7e robot arm equipped with an XHand dexterous hand. 3DTouch improves the average success rate by 42 percentage points over the corresponding VLA baseline and by 20 percentage points over the strongest evaluated alternative. Ablation studies reveal the complementary benefits of scene geometry and spatial tactile feedback, with further gains from shared spatial grounding and explicit geometric relations.

AI.tldr: 3DTouch 将 RGB-D 场景点与五指密集触觉测点统一表达在机器人基座坐标系下，构建共享 3D 视觉-触觉表示，并结合由手部关键点与位姿对齐重建表面导出的手-物、物-物几何关系，为 VLA 动作专家提供空间定位的接触力与相对表面几何条件。
AI.motivation: 富接触灵巧操作中，手指与交互物体会遮挡局部几何，仅靠视觉无法定位接触点；视觉相似场景在物体相对位姿上存在细微差异，导致接触状态不同。因此需要显式引入空间化的触觉与几何关系线索。
AI.method: 提出 3DTouch：以机器人基座坐标系为共享空间，将 RGB-D 点云与五指密集触觉测量（每个 taxel 保留空间位置与力矢量）统一为 3D 视觉-触觉表示；由手部 landmark 与位姿对齐的重建表面导出显式手-物、物-物关系，作为条件输入 VLA 的 action expert。评估于 UR7e + XHand 真机平台上的 5 个富接触灵巧操作任务。
AI.result: 平均成功率较对应 VLA 基线提升 42 个百分点，较最强对比方法提升 20 个百分点；消融显示场景几何与空间触觉反馈互补，共享空间 grounding 与显式几何关系带来进一步增益。
AI.conclusion: 空间对齐的多模态表示与显式交互几何关系是提升富接触灵巧 VLA 操作成功率的关键，且两类线索互为补充。

title: SEE: Unlocking the Hidden Perception of Frozen VLMs
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) grasp the overall content of an image but often miss the fine details a question hinges on, such as a small object in a large photo or a number in a dense infographic. Yet even when their answer is wrong, the region they point to often contains the evidence. We introduce Self-Elicited Evidence (SEE), a training-free method that lets a frozen VLM look again where it points. When the initial answer has low confidence, SEE prompts the model to propose regions where the details may appear, answers the question on these enlarged crops, and aggregates the answers with the original prediction through confidence-weighted voting. The model also answers with its own transcript, which helps on text-rich images. SEE needs no detector or OCR engine. Across five backbones, SEE improves every small-object benchmark by 2.3-13.1 points and outperforms five training-free baselines on small objects. With SEE, Qwen3.5-4B surpasses the direct answer of Qwen3.5-9B and matches the 6 times larger Qwen3.5-27B.

AI.tldr: SEE：无需训练的VLM自我诱发证据方法，低置信度时让模型自报候选区域、放大裁剪后再作答，并与原预测做置信度加权投票，显著提升小目标与文字密集图像精度。
AI.motivation: VLM能把握图像整体语义，但常遗漏问题关键细节（大图中的小目标、密集信息图中的数字）。观察发现即便答错，模型指向的区域往往仍包含证据，因此可在模型自身指认处"再看一次"。
AI.method: 训练无关：冻结VLM。初始答案置信度低时，提示模型提出可能包含细节的区域；对这些放大裁剪图分别作答（并要求模型给出自转写文本以应对文字密集图像）；最后与原始预测做置信度加权投票融合。无需检测器或OCR引擎。
AI.result: 在5个骨干网络上，SEE使所有小目标基准提升2.3–13.1点，并在小目标任务上优于5个训练无关基线；Qwen3.5-4B+SEE超过Qwen3.5-9B直接作答，并与大6倍的Qwen3.5-27B持平。
AI.conclusion: 利用模型自身的空间指向作为弱定位信号进行自举式重看与置信度聚合，是一种零成本、即插即用提升VLM细节感知的有效手段，可作为感知前端为具身/机器人系统提供更强的细粒度视觉理解。

title: CoRA-VTLA: Contact-Guided Attention and Queryable Response Memory for Tactile Post-Training
comment: 10 pages, 5 figures. Project page: this https URL
summary: In precision manipulation, small errors in alignment or force can cause jamming or deformation, making contact feedback essential for adapting pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) models to these tasks. A single tactile observation leaves the response to recent actions ambiguous. Direct tactile fusion during post-training can also disperse the action expert's visual attention and reduce the share it allocates to contact regions. To address these challenges, CoRA-VTLA augments pretrained VLAs with lightweight tactile modules. A queryable action-response memory retrieves recent contact responses so that the action expert can combine them with immediate tactile feedback. Contact-guided gaze supervision concentrates the visual attention of the tactile semantic token on image regions corresponding to fingertip contact. CoRA-VTLA achieves 73.33% mean success across three MuJoCo tasks, compared with 50% for direct tactile fusion with the same sensor inputs. It also achieves 67% success on an optical-tactile task from the public UniVTAC benchmark and 66.7% mean success across three real-robot tasks. These results show that tactile post-training helps pretrained VLAs adjust to changing contact.

AI.tldr: CoRA-VTLA 用轻量触觉模块增强预训练 VLA：引入可查询的“动作-响应记忆”检索近期接触响应，并用接触引导注视监督将触觉语义 token 的视觉注意力聚焦到指尖接触区域；MuJoCo 三任务 73.33% vs 直接触觉融合 50%，UniVTAC 光学触觉任务 67%，真机三任务平均 66.7%。
AI.motivation: 精密操作中微小对齐或力误差即可引发卡阻/形变，接触反馈对把预训练 VLA 迁移到此类任务至关重要。但单帧触觉观测无法消解“响应来自哪个近期动作”的歧义；直接在 post-training 中做触觉融合还会分散 action expert 的视觉注意力，降低分配给接触区域的份额。
AI.method: 在冻结/预训练 VLA 上挂载轻量触觉模块：(1) 可查询的动作-响应记忆，按查询检索近期接触响应，供 action expert 与即时触觉反馈联合使用；(2) 接触引导的 gaze 监督，约束触觉语义 token 在图像中指向指尖接触区域，避免注意力漂移。仅在 post-training 阶段训练插件模块。
AI.result: 三个 MuJoCo 任务平均成功率 73.33%，同一传感器输入下直接触觉融合为 50%；公开 UniVTAC 光学触觉任务成功率 67%；三个真机任务平均 66.7%。
AI.conclusion: 触觉 post-training 能让预训练 VLA 适应变化的接触条件；关键是显式建模接触响应的时序对应关系并守护视觉注意力分配。

title: Dual-Manifold Variational Autoencoders
summary: In latent diffusion models, expanding the latent dimension of variational autoencoders (VAEs) is essential to push the upper bound of reconstruction quality. However, without explicit structural constraints, such unregularized expansion easily yields a rugged and ill-conditioned latent manifold, causing generated latents to drift off the manifold during generation (i.e., off-manifold problem). Recent works smooth this manifold by using external foundation models (e.g., DINOv2) as a topological regularizer. However, we argue that tying the latent space to frozen external priors inherently restricts generalization: bound by their pre-training distributions and semantic biases, they may fail to capture faithful visual details on out-of-distribution domains. Observing that low-dimensional latents naturally form a smoother, generation-friendly manifold, we propose dual-manifold VAE (DM-VAE) to leverage internal representations as a topological regularizer. Specifically, DM-VAE pairs a high-dimensional reconstructive branch with a low-dimensional branch that extracts a clean topological skeleton, anchoring the high-dimensional manifold to this smooth subspace. Building upon this framework, we further introduce topological representation alignment (TRA) to supervise intermediate generator features during training, and internal guidance with topological skeleton (IG_TS) to guide structural components while preserving high-frequency details at inference. On ImageNet-1K (256x256), our foundation-model-free DM-VAE achieves a state-of-the-art rFID of 0.12 and a generation FID50K of 1.28 (w/o CFG) and 1.20 (w/CFG), and further reaches 1.11 when orthogonally combined with DINOv2.

AI.tldr: 提出双流形VAE（DM-VAE）：用低维分支提取平滑拓扑骨架来锚定高维重建潜空间，替代DINOv2等外部基座模型做拓扑正则，并配套TRA训练监督与IG_TS推理引导，在ImageNet-1K上取得rFID 0.12、gFID 1.28(无CFG)/1.20(有CFG)。
AI.motivation: 潜扩散模型中扩大VAE潜维度可提升重建上限，但无约束扩展会产生崎岖病态的潜流形，导致生成时潜变量漂移出流形（off-manifold）。现有做法用冻结外部基座模型（如DINOv2）做拓扑正则，但外部先验受预训练分布与语义偏置限制，在分布外域上难以捕捉真实视觉细节，本质上约束了泛化性。
AI.method: 观察到低维潜空间天然形成更平滑、利于生成的流形，据此设计DM-VAE：高维重建分支 + 低维分支提取干净拓扑骨架，将高维流形锚定到该平滑子空间，实现内部表征自正则、无需外部基座模型。进一步提出拓扑表征对齐（TRA）在训练中对生成器中间特征施加监督，以及带拓扑骨架的内部引导（IG_TS）在推理时引导结构成分并保留高频细节。与DINOv2正交结合可叠加收益。
AI.result: ImageNet-1K 256×256：无基座模型的DM-VAE rFID 0.12（SOTA），生成FID50K 为1.28（无CFG）、1.20（有CFG）；与DINOv2正交组合时进一步达到1.11。
AI.conclusion: 内部低维流形可作为有效的拓扑正则，替代或叠加外部基座先验，改善潜空间条件数与生成质量；该框架对生成器训练与推理均有可迁移的引导机制。

title: TOMAS: Topology-Aware Operation Modeling and Adaptive Staging for Egocentric Hand Forecasting
summary: Forecasting future hand movements from egocentric videos plays an important role in understanding human intentions and hand-object interactions. However, different manipulation intentions can lead to substantially different hand trajectories even when interacting with the same object. Existing methods have not sufficiently explored the intrinsic relationships between articulated hand movements and object semantics to capture such operation-dependent motion patterns. Therefore, we propose TOMAS, a topology-aware operation modeling and adaptive staging framework for egocentric hand forecasting. Specifically, we develop a topology-aware hand-object reasoning mechanism that associates hand skeletal structures and articulation dynamics with object semantics and spatial relationships to jointly infer potential interaction targets and latent manipulation operations. The resulting object-operation representations provide interaction conditions for future hand trajectory prediction, with supervision adapted to the annotations available in each dataset. Furthermore, we introduce an adaptive staging mechanism that organizes future hand movements into ordered latent stages with learnable temporal boundaries. Stage-specific geometric subgoals are then incorporated to guide trajectory refinement according to the underlying manipulation patterns. Experimental results on multiple publicly available benchmarks demonstrate that TOMAS achieves state-of-the-art performance in multi-dimensional and multi-target hand motion forecasting.

AI.tldr: TOMAS: 拓扑感知的手-物推理 + 自适应分段机制，将操作语义与手部关节动力学耦合，用于自我中心视频中的未来手部轨迹预测，在多基准上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 同一物体在不同操作意图下会呈现差异显著的手部轨迹，现有方法未充分挖掘手部关节运动与物体语义之间的内在关联，难以建模这种"操作依赖"的运动模式。
AI.method: 1) 拓扑感知手-物推理：将手部骨架结构与关节动力学同物体语义、空间关系关联，联合推断交互目标与潜在操作类型；2) 生成的对象-操作表征作为未来轨迹预测的交互条件，并针对各数据集标注差异做自适应监督；3) 自适应分段机制：把未来手部运动组织为带可学习时间边界的有序隐阶段，再以阶段级几何子目标引导轨迹细化。
AI.result: 在多个公开基准上，多维、多目标手部运动预测均取得SOTA性能。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模"物体语义—操作类型"耦合并用可学习阶段划分约束运动，是提升自我中心手部未来预测的有效路径；属于手-物交互感知方向，但与下游可操作策略/机器人执行的衔接尚未验证。

title: Agreement Is Not Accuracy: LiDAR Elevation Errors Hidden in LiDAR-Camera Extrinsics
summary: LiDAR and cameras provide complementary measurements for 3D vision, yet agreement between their observations does not establish the accuracy of either sensor's internal geometry. We show that systematic LiDAR elevation biases can be absorbed into the estimated extrinsics. Using synchronized LiDAR intensities and camera-estimated checkerboard poses, we jointly estimate a sensor-specific elevation correction shared across recordings and extrinsics for each recording. Ray-plane intersections locate the checker pattern without using reported ranges, preventing range errors from directly moving the lookup. Under matched intensity and correction models, this lookup gives smaller camera-consistency residuals than measured-point lookup. Across six identically designed rigs using the same sensor models, recording-excluded corrections reduce the mean translation-reference distance from 7.57 to 3.04 mm. On separate structures, they reduce inter-plane angle errors against references from independent dense camera scans and improve image-edge alignment. Rolling the rigs shifts the plane pairs exhibiting the largest angular improvements, as predicted for an elevation-only correction. Within the ray-plane model, calibration-target projections and loop-consistency residuals change little despite these geometric improvements. These findings show why agreement after extrinsic calibration need not establish correct internal LiDAR geometry. Synchronized observations of a familiar checkerboard provide a practical route to estimating and testing elevation corrections without a dedicated large calibration field. We plan to release code and data for reproducing the main results.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示了LiDAR与相机标定中"观测一致≠内部几何正确"的问题：系统性的LiDAR高程偏差会被外参吸收，并提出用同步的LiDAR反射强度与相机估计的棋盘格位姿联合估计传感器特定高程修正量，从而在不依赖专用标定场的情况下分离外参与内几何误差。
AI.motivation: 多传感器标定通常以外参残差或融合一致性作为正确性判据，但当LiDAR存在系统性高程（仰角）误差时，外参优化会把该偏差"吸收"进旋转量，使标定后仍高度一致却几何不正确，导致下游三维精度受损而无法被常规指标发现。作者希望找到一种低成本、可利用常见标定靶标来识别并校正这一内部几何误差的方法。
AI.method: 用射线-平面求交定位棋盘格图案，而非使用LiDAR上报的距离值，从而避免距离误差直接污染查找位置；在此基础上，对同步的LiDAR反射强度与相机估计的棋盘格位姿进行联合优化，将"跨多次录制共享的传感器特定高程修正"与"每次录制各自的外参"分开估计。只在该联合模型下进行强度-修正匹配查找，并与基于测量点的查找方式作对比。在六个同型号设计的平台上验证，采用留一录制（recording-excluded）的修正量泛化评估，并在独立结构上以密集相机扫描与图像边缘对齐作为参考。
AI.result: 在六个同设计平台上，排除录制的共享高程修正把平均平移参考距离从7.57 mm降至3.04 mm；在独立结构上，降低了相对独立密集相机扫描参考的平面间夹角误差，并改善了图像边缘对齐效果。将平台滚动后，出现最大角误差改善的平面组合随之改变，符合"仅高程修正"模型的预测。同时，在射线-平面模型下，标定靶投影与闭环一致性残差几乎不变，说明这些传统指标无法反映上述几何改进。
AI.conclusion: 外参标定后的观测一致性不能证明LiDAR内部几何正确；同步观测常见棋盘格即可实用地估计并检验高程修正，无需专用大型标定场。作者计划开源代码与数据以复现主要结果。

title: LaST1.0: A Unified Latent World-Action Model with Control-Centric SpatioTemporal Reasoning
summary: World-Action Models couple action learning with future prediction, enabling robotic policies to capture environmental dynamics for robust control. However, prevailing methods take a reconstruction-oriented approach to model future videos, allocating substantial capacity to appearance details that are incidental to control. In this work, we reformulate world modeling for manipulation as control-centric future prediction in latent space, and present LaST1.0, a unified latent World-Action Model. Rather than modeling an observation-complete video future, LaST1.0 predicts compact, geometry-aware latent targets derived from future wrist views, focusing the supervision on the evolving robot-object interactions required for fine-grained manipulation. To better support this control-centric paradigm, LaST1.0 revisits the visual input interface and attention mechanism of its unified architecture. It adopts a vision-encoder-free design with a lightweight patch embedder, exposing fine-grained visual cues directly to the backbone, and introduces LaST-Attention for structured spatiotemporal interactions across modalities. Evaluations across two robot embodiments, five challenging manipulation tasks, and three simulation benchmarks---RLBench, LIBERO, and LIBERO-Plus---demonstrate that LaST1.0 achieves state-of-the-art success rates and generalizes to novel scenarios. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of control-centric latent world modeling for robust manipulation.

AI.tldr: LaST1.0 将操作任务的世界建模重构为潜空间中的"以控制为中心的预测"：不再重建完整未来视频，而是预测来自未来腕部视角的紧凑几何感知潜变量目标，并配合无视觉编码器的轻量 patch embedder 与 LaST-Attention，在 RLBench、LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus 上取得 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有 World-Action Model 采用重建导向的未来视频建模，大量容量被消耗在与控制无关的外观细节上，监督信号冗余且低效。作者希望把世界模型的预测目标转向真正影响精细操作决策的机器人-物体交互几何动态。
AI.method: 在潜空间预测未来腕部视角的紧凑、几何感知潜目标，取代观测完整的视频重建；架构上取消重型视觉编码器，改用轻量 patch embedder 将细粒度视觉线索直接送入主干；提出 LaST-Attention 实现跨模态结构化时空交互；动作学习与未来预测统一在一个 World-Action Model 中。
AI.result: 在两个机器人本体、五项挑战性操作任务以及 RLBench、LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus 三个仿真基准上达到 SOTA 成功率，并能泛化到新场景。
AI.conclusion: 以控制为中心的潜空间世界建模比重建导向建模更有效，可作为鲁棒操作策略的统一范式；但证据目前限于仿真基准，缺少真机验证与开源信息。

title: SIRAZ: Sparse Inter-Layer Residual Aggregation for Zero-Shot Visual Neural Decoding
summary: Brain-computer interfaces aim to establish direct communication between neural activity and external systems, making interpretation of brain signals an important problem. In this context, neural visual decoding seeks to infer visual information from neural activity by learning a mapping between brain responses and the corresponding visual stimuli. It investigates how visual information emerges from neural signals and relates to perceptual processing while enabling the reconstruction or retrieval of visual stimuli from neural signals. Our brain primarily follows a hierarchical pathway to process visual information captured by the eye. However, neural representations learned by existing methods differ fundamentally from those produced by the biological visual system. To bridge this gap and mimic the human vision hierarchy, we introduce Sparse Inter-layer Residual Aggregation for Zero-shot (SIRAZ). SIRAZ is a framework that aligns neural visual representations by jointly modeling early visual processes via fovea- and magnocellular-pathway-inspired Difference-of-Gaussians transformations. To align the semantic information with neural information, it extracts multiple intermediate representations of the image at multiple depths and passes them through the Residual Gated Adapter Mechanism. To study the temporal dynamics of neural signals, the Direction-aware Multi-Scale Temporal Attention Encoder is introduced to align the learned neural representation with the final visual representation. The proposed framework achieves 92.5% top-1 and 99.27% top-5 accuracy in the intra-subject setting on the THINGS-EEG dataset, and 50.25% and 75% top-1 and top-5 accuracy in the THINGS-MEG dataset. The results indicate that combining biologically motivated visual representations with the structured modalities of neural dynamics improves cross-modal alignment and zero-shot image retrieval.

AI.tldr: SIRAZ：用类视网膜高斯差分变换+残差门控适配器+方向感知多尺度时序注意力，将EEG/MEG神经表征与图像语义表征对齐，实现零样本图像检索。
AI.motivation: 现有神经视觉解码方法学习到的神经表征与生物视觉系统的层级结构本质不同；需要模仿人类视觉层级（早期视觉处理、多深度语义、神经时序动态）以缩小神经-视觉语义鸿沟。
AI.method: SIRAZ框架：1) 用受中央凹/magnocellular通路启发的Difference-of-Gaussians变换建模早期视觉处理；2) 提取图像多深度中间表征，经Residual Gated Adapter机制注入并保留预训练语义；3) 用Direction-aware Multi-Scale Temporal Attention编码器对齐神经信号时序动态与最终视觉表征。
AI.result: THINGS-EEG被试内设定 top-1 92.5%、top-5 99.27%；THINGS-MEG top-1 50.25%、top-5 75%。表明生物启发的视觉表征与结构化神经动态模态结合可提升跨模态对齐与零样本检索。
AI.conclusion: 将生物启发的视觉表征与神经时序建模结合，可有效对齐脑信号与视觉语义，提升零样本图像检索性能。

title: WaveView: The Novel View Is in the Noise
summary: Generative novel view synthesis (NVS) employs a diffusion model to render a static or dynamic scene from a target camera view. Explicit warp methods complete a reprojection of the source with video diffusion models, and implicit methods encode the camera parameters or 3D cues. Both add inference overhead, and the generated layout often drifts from the ground truth. We present WaveView, which injects the warped source into the phase of the initial noise of a pretrained generator. The Dual-Tree Complex Wavelet Packet Transform (DT-CWPT) allows local and anisotropic phase injection. The generator is thus constrained less in disoccluded regions and along the epipolar line. WaveView keeps the architecture and adds negligible overhead. On the DL3DV benchmark, it outperforms all baselines in every overlap bin. In the hardest bin, it gains 0.84 dB PSNR on the covisible region over MetaView, which shares its generator, while running 2.1 times faster. For dynamic NVS, fine-tuning AnyView with the same noise raises its zero-shot PSNR on AnyViewBench from 11.58 to 12.35 dB.

AI.tldr: WaveView将源视图重投影结果注入预训练扩散生成器初始噪声的相位（DT-CWPT局部各向异性相位注入），实现低开销的生成式新视角合成，在DL3DV各重叠区间全面领先，最难区间较MetaView提升0.84 dB PSNR且快2.1倍。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式NVS中，显式warp+视频扩散方案与隐式编码相机参数/3D线索的方案都带来额外推理开销，且生成布局常偏离真值；作者希望在保持架构不变、开销可忽略的前提下，用源视图几何信息约束生成过程。
AI.method: 将warp后的源视图编码进预训练生成器初始噪声的相位，而非作为额外条件网络分支；采用双树复小波包变换（DT-CWPT）实现局部、各向异性的相位注入，使生成器在遮挡消失区域与极线方向上约束更弱。
AI.result: DL3DV基准上在所有重叠区间超过全部基线；最难区间共视区域PSNR比同生成器的MetaView高0.84 dB，推理快2.1倍；动态NVS上，用相同噪声微调AnyView，AnyViewBench零样本PSNR从11.58提升至12.35 dB。
AI.conclusion: 通过在噪声相位域注入warp信息，可在不改架构、几乎零额外开销下获得几何一致性更强的生成式NVS，并可直接迁移到动态场景模型。

title: ReSynth: Constructing Synthetic Supervision for Multi-Image Understanding
summary: People often understand the world by comparing different views of it. Vision-language models (VLMs), however, receive these views as separate images and still struggle to relate them. One problem is data. Training on these tasks requires groups of images with a known relationship: the same object from different viewpoints, or the same scene before and after a change. Such examples are hard to collect at scale from existing photo collections. We introduce ReSynth, which turns single-image perception and controllable image generation into cross-image relational supervision. Localized editing produces before-and-after pairs, viewpoint generation produces multiple views of the same instance, and verified scene contents support comparisons of counts and attributes. ReSynth combines Qwen3-VL-8B's captioning, grounding, and counting capabilities with Qwen-Image-2.1's generation and editing capabilities. It verifies single-image facts such as object counts and attributes, then combines these facts to construct multi-image QA. Using GRPO on approximately 440K ReSynth questions, with no real images during training, Qwen2.5-VL-7B and Qwen3-VL-8B improve by 17.73 and 6.10 average points on BLINK, MUIRBench, and VLM2-Bench, while single-image performance is broadly preserved on Qwen2.5-VL-7B and improves across all four evaluated benchmarks on Qwen3-VL-8B. Notably, this supervision enables the 8B perception model itself to outperform Qwen3-VL-235B on BLINK and MUIRBench.

AI.tldr: ReSynth通过可控图像生成（局部编辑、视角生成、计数/属性验证）从单张真实图像合成跨图像关系监督数据，用约44万条多图QA以GRPO训练VLM，显著提升多图关系理解能力且几乎不损失单图性能。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）难以理解多视角/前后对比等跨图像关系，核心瓶颈是数据：需要已知关系的图像组（同物体不同视角、同一场景变化前后），难以从现有照片集大规模收集。
AI.method: 提出ReSynth数据合成流程：利用Qwen3-VL-8B的captioning、grounding、counting与Qwen-Image-2.1的生成/编辑能力，先校验单图事实（目标计数、属性），再由局部编辑构造前后对比对、由视角生成构造同一实例的多视角、由已验证场景内容支持计数与属性比较；将事实组合为多图QA，用GRPO在约440K问题上训练Qwen2.5-VL-7B与Qwen3-VL-8B，训练全程不使用真实图像。
AI.result: 在BLINK、MUIRBench、VLM2-Bench上平均提升17.73与6.10分；Qwen2.5-VL-7B单图性能基本保持，Qwen3-VL-8B在四项评测基准上全面提升；经该监督后，8B感知模型在BLINK与MUIRBench上超过Qwen3-VL-235B。
AI.conclusion: 跨图像关系监督可由单图像感知加可控生成可靠合成，纯合成数据即可有效训练多图关系推理能力，为VLM多图理解提供可扩展的数据路径。

title: ProtoBridge-CLIP: Observation-Masked Finding Prototypes for Medical Image--Report Representation Learning
summary: Radiology reports distinguish affirmed findings, explicit negations, and unmentioned concepts, but conventional global image--report contrastive learning often compresses these different evidence states into a single study-level target. We introduce \model{}, which combines symmetric global image--report alignment with observation-masked finding supervision and a soft relation objective over affirmed report concepts. Text-derived finding prototypes are aligned with local visual tokens, while uncertain and unmentioned concepts are excluded from direct finding labels. We evaluate the framework on three CT benchmarks and five chest-radiograph benchmarks, together with component ablations, paired and clinical retrieval, localization, perturbation robustness, calibration, and per-finding analyses. \model{} achieves macro-AUROC values of 73.6%, 66.5\%, and 68.8% on CT-RATE, RAD-ChestCT, and INSPECT, and 80.2%, 91.4%, 78.5%, 86.5%, and 90.8% on ChestXray14, CheXpert, PadChest, RSNA, and SIIM-ACR, respectively. Relative to the matched global-only controls, the findings and relation objectives yield consistent gains across the evaluated datasets. These results demonstrate the practical value of treating observed and unobserved report concepts differently during medical image--text representation learning.

AI.tldr: 提出图像-报告对比学习框架，区分报告中"已确认""明确否定""未提及"三类发现状态，用观测掩码的发现级监督与软关系目标提升医学图文表征。
AI.motivation: 常规全局图文对比学习把已确认发现、明确否定与未提及概念压缩成单一研究级目标，丢失了否定/不确定/未提及这些关键证据状态，限制了表征的临床可用性。
AI.method: 对称全局图文对齐 + 观测掩码的发现级监督（由文本导出的发现原型与局部视觉token对齐，仅用已确认概念作标签，排除否定与未提及概念）+ 在已确认报告概念上的软关系目标；在三套CT与五套胸片基准上评估，并做组件消融、配对/临床检索、定位、扰动鲁棒性与校准分析。
AI.result: CT-RATE/RAD-ChestCT/INSPECT macro-AUROC 为 73.6%/66.5%/68.8%；ChestXray14/CheXpert/PadChest/RSNA/SIIM-ACR 为 80.2%/91.4%/78.5%/86.5%/90.8%；相对同配置全局-only 基线，发现目标与关系目标在各数据集上带来一致增益。
AI.conclusion: 在医学图像-文本表征学习中显式区分"已观测"与"未观测"报告概念具有实际价值，可稳定提升多数据集性能与检索/定位等下游表现。

title: Choosing Supervised Post-Processing for Frozen Person Detectors: Information, Object Changes, and Complete Cost
summary: A frozen detector computes hypotheses that can support better final outputs through supervised post-processing. Choosing a readout requires knowing which available information improves detection and what its processing costs. We compare candidate scores, class distributions, geometry, native-set summaries and adapted neighborhood meta classification under common candidate, supervision and operating-point conditions. On 320 held-out CrowdHuman images, adding native-set context to a 97-dimensional readout yields 275 more matches and 96 more unmatched predictions. On a separate 319-image cohort, Full100 matches 6004 objects,versus 5848 for source-selected raw WBF and 6002 for a MetaDetect-style adaptation. Its gain over raw contains 300 added and 144 lost discoveries. After execution-equivalent optimization, Full100 and the meta-statistics readout both take approximately 95 ms per complete warm request on a fixed 64-image workload. Source-frozen transfer gives positive point results on 223 MOT17Det frames from seven sequences, while the main MIAP result shows no improvement. The study supports using sufficiently informative output readouts while retaining optimized meta classification as a competitive option. It also shows why feature dimension and net detection gain alone are unreliable guides to adoption.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统比较冻结检测器的多种后处理读出（评分、类分布、几何、native-set 摘要、邻域元分类），在 CrowdHuman/MOT17Det 上给出匹配数与单请求延迟的对照结论。
AI.motivation: 冻结检测器输出的候选假设需要经监督后处理才能形成最终结果，但选择哪种读出方式、维度多高、是否引入 native-set 上下文缺乏统一条件下的实证依据；作者希望避免仅凭特征维度或"净检测增益"做采纳决策。
AI.method: 在统一的候选集、监督标签和操作点条件下，对比多类 readout：提升后的评分、类别分布、几何特征、native-set 汇总统计、自适应邻域元分类（MetaDetect 风格）以及完整 97 维/Full100 读出；并做执行等价的优化后计时对比（64 图固定负载、warm request）。
AI.result: CrowdHuman 320 张留出图像上加 native-set 上下文使 97 维读出多出 275 个匹配、96 个未匹配预测；319 张图像队列中 Full100 匹配 6004 个目标，优于 raw WBF（5848）和 MetaDetect 式适配（6002），相对 raw 为新增 300、丢失 144；优化后 Full100 与元统计读出均约 95 ms/请求；MOT17Det 7 序列 223 帧上源域冻结迁移仅点估计为正，主 MIAP 结果无提升。
AI.conclusion: 在成本可控前提下，应优先采用信息量足够的输出读出，同时保留优化后的元分类作为有竞争力选项；特征维度和净检测增益均不能作为采纳与否的可靠判据。

title: Freeforward4d: Annotation-free feed-forward 4d reconstruction of driving scenes
summary: Feed-forward 4D reconstruction enables efficient creation of renderable driving scenes for autonomous driving simulation. However, most existing methods rely heavily on dataset-provided cameras, LiDAR depth, or 3D box annotations, limiting their applicability to unannotated driving videos. Pretrained visual models can predict cameras, depth, and object tracks from RGB alone, but their geometry is mutually inconsistent: multi-view predictions come in short windows with independent scales and frames, while monocular depth is metric only per image. Our key insight is that, once reconciled into a single metric frame, these priors can replace dataset annotations for feed-forward 4D reconstruction. We present \textbf{FreeForward4D}, which calibrates overlapping prediction windows against monocular metric depth and registers them into one frame across time. On this geometry, 2D tracks are associated across cameras in 3D, and objects move through hierarchical motion that combines a shared object velocity with local Gaussian corrections, so that both training and inference use only RGB videos. On Waymo, FreeForward4D achieves 27.66 dB PSNR and 0.836 SSIM while recovering metric-scale cameras and depth without scale alignment. It surpasses STORM, SLARM-F, UFO, DGGT, and StreetForward, which rely on dataset annotations, in full-image PSNR and attains the best RGB fidelity on 8-second windows. RGB-only fine-tuning further adapts the framework to nuScenes and Argoverse 2. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: FreeForward4D 用预训练视觉模型的相机/深度/轨迹先验替代数据集标注，通过对齐重叠预测窗口到单目度量深度并跨时间配准、在3D中关联2D轨迹、用"共享物体速度+局部高斯修正"的分层运动建模，实现仅需RGB视频的前馈4D驾驶场景重建。
AI.motivation: 现有前馈4D重建方法依赖数据集提供的相机参数、LiDAR深度或3D框标注，难以用于无标注的驾驶视频；而直接用预训练视觉模型的预测又存在几何不一致（多视角短窗口各自独立尺度与坐标系、单目深度仅逐图度量）。作者洞察：只要统一到同一度量坐标系，这些先验即可替代标注。
AI.method: 以单目度量深度为基准校准相互重叠的预测窗口，并将其跨时间配准到同一坐标系；在此几何上把2D轨迹跨相机关联到3D；物体运动采用分层建模：共享物体速度加局部高斯修正；训练与推理均仅用RGB视频。
AI.result: 在Waymo上达27.66 dB PSNR、0.836 SSIM，且在无尺度对齐条件下恢复度量尺度的相机与深度；全图PSNR超过依赖标注的STORM、SLARM-F、UFO、DGGT、StreetForward，并在8秒窗口上取得最佳RGB保真度；仅用RGB微调可迁移到nuScenes与Argoverse 2。
AI.conclusion: 将基础视觉模型的多视角/单目先验几何统一后，可完全摆脱数据集标注进行前馈4D重建，并达到甚至超越标注依赖方法的渲染质量，具备跨数据集的可迁移性。

title: Modelling the human-exoskeleton interaction interface - Benchmarking MuJoCo's deformable model
summary: The human-exoskeleton interaction interface, consisting of the exoskeleton attachment and the underlying human soft tissue, can affect the transfer of assistance. MuJoCo's \textit{flexcomp} has been previously used to model the soft tissue, but its accuracy has not been benchmarked against a finite element model. We benchmarked the \textit{flexcomp} Saint Venant-Kirchhoff (StVK) and Stable Neo-Hookean (SNH) models against COMSOL's Yeoh model in three cases: \textit{case 1}) spherical indentation, \textit{case 2}) compression, and \textit{case 3}) compression of a thigh. We compared force and strain energy as a function of indentation depth, hysteresis and computation time. MuJoCo's models capture force trends with a correlation of 0.97-0.99, but showed a stiffer response, which could be attributed to the volumetric locking of the linear finite elements. The MuJoCo models systematically underestimated hysteresis as MuJoCo's Rayleigh damping could not substitute a viscoelastic model. Moreover, MuJoCo's computational advantage was speed dependent: it was 2-2.5 times faster for spherical indentation, but COMSOL was faster for the other cases, which have more degrees of freedom and contacts. Although MuJoCo's \textit{flexcomp} offers a combination of soft-tissue modelling and multibody dynamics, the limitations regarding the stiffening and hysteresis should be addressed to be used for the analysis of the human-exoskeleton interaction interface.

AI.tldr: 对比MuJoCo flexcomp（StVK、SNH）与COMSOL Yeoh软组织模型在球压、压缩、大腿压缩三场景下的力、应变能、滞后与计算耗时表现。
AI.motivation: 人-外骨骼交互界面由外骨骼绑缚与人体软组织构成，其力学行为影响助力传递；flexcomp已被用于软组织建模但精度未经有限元基准校验。
AI.method: 以COMSOL Yeoh粘超弹模型为基准，在三种工况下比较力-压入深度曲线、应变能、滞回环与计算时间，并分析误差来源（体积锁死、瑞利阻尼无法替代粘弹性）。
AI.result: MuJoCo模型能捕捉力趋势（相关0.97–0.99）但响应偏硬（归因于线性单元体积锁死）；系统性低估滞后；速度优势依场景而定：球压快2–2.5倍，自由度与接触更多的工况下COMSOL更快。
AI.conclusion: flexcomp兼具软组织建模与多体动力学仿真能力，但需解决刚化与滞后建模不足问题，方可用于人-外骨骼交互界面分析。

title: HHW-Ego: DSLR-Quality Enhancement for Multi-Source Wearable Ego Imaging
summary: Wearable ego-centric images are now in high demand for scenarios ranging from daily smart glass usage to embodied intelligence. But the image quality is far behind smart phone due to the lacking paired high-quality reference images and the dedicated enhancement systems. To solve this, a customized degradation pipeline is designed to generate paired samples matching wearable camera images, boosting the upper limit of enhancement performance. Besides a two-stage enhancement framework is further built: first, tuning an efficient model on the paired dataset to enhance real wearable images; second, using hyperspectral data to refine color temperature for better quality. Moreover we present HHW-Ego, a multi-source paired dataset integrating with Hyperspectral, High-dynamic range and Wearable Ego-centric data, which includes 5,000 image groups spanning indoor/outdoor and day/night scenes. On held-out paired data, Stage-1 fine-tuning improves PSNR, SSIM, Lab distance, and LPIPS for Real-ESRGAN and PFT-SR. On real wearable images, no-reference metrics, human preference, gamut analysis, and visual comparisons characterize the effects of Stage 2.

AI.tldr: 提出HHW-Ego多源配对数据集（高光谱+HDR+可穿戴第一视角，5000组室内外/昼夜图像）及定制退化管线与两阶段增强框架，利用高光谱数据精修色温。
AI.motivation: 可穿戴第一视角图像在智能眼镜与具身智能中需求旺盛，但因缺乏配对高质量参考图像和专用增强系统，画质远逊于手机。
AI.method: 设计匹配可穿戴相机特性的定制退化管线生成配对样本；构建两阶段增强框架：Stage-1在配对数据上微调高效模型（Real-ESRGAN、PFT-SR）增强真实可穿戴图像，Stage-2利用高光谱数据精修色温。数据集含高光谱、HDR与第一视角多源配对，覆盖室内外与昼夜。
AI.result: 在留出配对数据上，Stage-1微调提升PSNR、SSIM、Lab距离与LPIPS；在真实可穿戴图像上通过无参考指标、人类偏好、色域分析和视觉对比验证Stage-2效果。
AI.conclusion: 配对数据合成与高光谱辅助的两阶段增强可有效提升可穿戴第一视角图像质量，数据集可支撑该方向研究。

title: WAM-Policy: World Action Models with On-Policy Distillation for Quadrupedal Loco-Manipulation
comment: Code: this https URL , Website: this https URL
summary: Arm-free quadrupeds can perform loco-manipulation, walking on three legs while manipulating with a front leg, yet no existing policy for it follows language instructions. World action models (WAMs) have emerged as effective language-conditioned manipulation policies, but are pretrained for robot arms and sample slowly. WAM-Policy turns one WAM into a quadrupedal loco-manipulation policy via two stages. The first, Cross-Morphology Policy Adaptation and Acceleration, adapts the arm-centric WAM to quadrupeds and distills the transferred policy into a student with one video and two action steps by on-policy self-distillation (OPSD). This student, however, is bounded by its teacher, which only imitates demonstrations. The second stage, Task-Specific Improvement and Merging, therefore tunes the teacher by reinforcement learning (RL) and merges the slow specialists into one few-step student by multi-teacher on-policy distillation (M-OPD). On QLM-Bench, ten simulated tasks with 1,000 demonstrations synthesized without teleoperation, the transferred policy reaches 77.0%, and the OPSD student keeps 76.7% while sampling 14 times faster. Task-specific RL and M-OPD lift it to 85.0%. We also deploy the OPSD student on a real Unitree Go2 Air. WAM-Policy thus achieves a stronger quadrupedal policy at a fraction of the inference cost.

AI.tldr: WAM-Policy 通过两阶段方法把面向机械臂的世界动作模型（WAM）迁移为无臂四足机器人三足行走+前腿操作的语言条件策略，并用在线自蒸馏加速、再用强化学习+多教师在线策略蒸馏融合，实现少步推理。
AI.motivation: 无臂四足可执行 loco-manipulation（三足行走、前腿操作），但现有策略均不支持语言指令；WAM 作为语言条件操作策略效果良好，却面向机械臂预训练且采样极慢，无法直接用于四足形态与实时部署。
AI.method: 两阶段：(1) Cross-Morphology Policy Adaptation and Acceleration——将机械臂为中心的 WAM 适配到四足形态，并通过 on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) 蒸馏为仅需 1 个视频步 + 2 个动作步的学生策略；(2) Task-Specific Improvement and Merging——用强化学习微调教师策略，再用 multi-teacher on-policy distillation (M-OPD) 将多个慢速专家合并为单一少步学生。在 QLM-Bench（10 个仿真任务、1000 条无遥操作合成演示）上评测，并在 Unitree Go2 Air 真机上部署 OPSD 学生。
AI.result: QLM-Bench 上迁移策略达 77.0%，OPSD 学生保持 76.7% 且采样快 14 倍；任务专属 RL + M-OPD 提升至 85.0%；OPSD 学生成功部署于真实 Unitree Go2 Air。
AI.conclusion: 跨形态世界动作模型迁移 + 自蒸馏 + RL 专家合并可在极低推理成本下获得更强的四足 loco-manipulation 策略，验证了 WAM 向非机械臂形态与实时部署转移的可行性。

title: FlyVQA: Seeing Video Frame Interpolation Quality through Fly Eyes
summary: The ultimate ambition of visual quality assessment is to reproduce the neural computations of human vision and thereby achieve full alignment with human perception. However, the immense complexity of human visual circuitry makes this goal difficult to realize. Recently released fly visual connectomes provide a tractable biological starting point. Despite differences between fly and human vision, the fly's well-characterized motion pathways motivate us to investigate their potential for assessing the perceptual impact of temporal distortions. In this paper, we use a shared, frozen fly visual circuit to perform full-reference quality assessment of frame-interpolated videos, whose artifacts can disrupt temporal consistency. Specifically, compound-eye sampling maps reference and distorted sequences into the circuit, while a connectome-aware readout quantifies discrepancies in cell-type-specific activity and excitatory--inhibitory synaptic dynamics. Reference-guided temporal pooling and a lightweight regression head integrate these differences into a quality score. Experiments across multiple interpolation methods demonstrate better agreement with human ratings than CNN, RNN, and Transformer baselines with comparable parameters, supporting a biologically grounded approach to perceptual quality modeling.

AI.tldr: 用共享冻结的果蝇视觉回路（connectome）做帧插值视频的全参考质量评估，在多种插值方法上与人主观评分一致性优于同参数量 CNN/RNN/Transformer。
AI.motivation: 视觉质量评估的终极目标是复现人类视觉的神经计算以对齐人类感知，但人脑视觉回路过于复杂。新发布的果蝇视觉连接组提供了可处理的生物学起点：虽与人类视觉存在差异，但其运动通路刻画完善，可用于研究时间失真（帧插值伪影破坏时间一致性）的感知影响。
AI.method: 采用共享、冻结的果蝇视觉回路：复眼采样映射将参考序列与失真序列送入回路；connectome-aware 读出量化细胞类型特异活动及兴奋—抑制突触动力学差异；再经参考引导的时间池化与轻量回归头融合为质量分数。
AI.result: 在多种插值方法上，与人类评分的吻合度优于参数规模相当的 CNN、RNN 与 Transformer 基线。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持以生物学为依据（生物连接组回路）的感知质量建模路径，为时间失真评估提供了可解释的替代方案。

title: Rethinking Contrastive Targets in Radiology Language-Image Pretraining
summary: CLIP-style contrastive image-text pretraining is widely used in radiology data, where each image is paired with one report and every other report in the batch is treated as a negative. Under this recipe, two failures appear, neither of which is systematically addressed by existing contrastive learning theory: zero-shot evaluation peaks then degrades while training loss keeps decreasing, and training fails to learn from large batches. We hypothesize the cause is structural rather than radiology-specific: many unpaired reports share clinical findings with a given image, so CLIP's paired-identity target is systematically biased, not merely noisy. To test this, we construct CLEVR-Radiology, a synthetic testbed that preserves only this overlapping-fact structure and reproduces both failures. With evidence that the structure is sufficient to reproduce the failures, we develop a target-misspecification theory that explains both failures from a single deterministic gradient bias amplified by batch size, and use it to motivate a minimal compatibility-based correction, CorLIP: text is treated as positive whenever its clinical assertions agree with the image, with no architecture changes. Beyond benchmark improvements, CorLIP largely removes the post-peak degradation, makes large-batch training succeed where it previously collapsed, substantially amplifies the gains from more data, and is the only configuration that remains stable up to B=2048. The correction transfers from chest X-ray to 3D CT modalities.

AI.tldr: 论文指出CLIP式图文对比预训练在放射学场景中因"多份报告与同一图像共享临床发现"导致配对身份目标存在系统性偏差（目标设定错误），据此构建CLEVR-Radiology合成测试床复现两种失败模式，提出目标错误设定理论（确定性梯度偏差随batch size放大），并提出无需改架构的兼容性修正方法CorLIP。
AI.motivation: CLIP式对比学习在放射学数据上存在两个未被现有理论系统解释的失败：(1) 零样本评估先升后降，而训练损失持续下降；(2) 大batch训练无法带来收益甚至崩溃。作者假设根因是结构性的——大量"未配对"报告与给定图像共享临床发现，使得配对身份目标被系统性偏置而非仅是噪声。
AI.method: 1) 构建CLEVR-Radiology合成数据集，仅保留"发现重叠事实"结构以验证其充分性；2) 提出目标错误设定（target misspecification）理论，用单一确定性梯度偏差解释两种失败，并说明batch size如何放大该偏差；3) 提出CorLIP：基于兼容性构造正样本——只要文本的临床断言与图像一致即视为正例，无需改动架构。
AI.result: CorLIP在基准上取得提升，基本消除峰值后的性能退化，使原本崩溃的大batch训练成功，显著放大多数据带来的收益，且是唯一在B=2048下仍稳定的配置；该修正可从胸部X光迁移到3D CT模态。
AI.conclusion: 对比学习中"配对身份"正样本假设在存在共享语义的领域会被系统性违背，形成梯度偏差；以语义兼容性替代身份配对是一种最小、通用且可跨模态迁移的修正方案。

title: Semi-Supervised GAN-Based Segmentation of CTPA Scans for Pulmonary Emboli Boundary Extraction
comment: 2026 IEEE 39th International Symposium on Computer-Based Medical Systems (CBMS), Limassol, Cyprus
summary: Pulmonary embolism (PE) is a pulmonary vascular disease associated with high morbidity and mortality, where delayed diagnosis can be fatal. While computed tomography pulmonary angiography (CTPA) is the clinical gold standard for PE detection, interpreting these scans manually is time-consuming and error-prone. In this work, we propose a semi-supervised segmentation method, employing generative adversarial networks (GANs) to leverage large pools of unlabeled CTPA scans. The proposed method addresses more effectively the challenges of CTPA image segmentation than previous methods by employing the dice loss and the cross-entropy loss to tackle the highly imbalanced nature of CTPA scans, the feature matching loss to encourage the generator to produce anatomically plausible segmentation maps that are indistinguishable from ground truth, as well as the self-training loss to reinforce learning from highly-confident pseudo-labeled samples. The experimental evaluation on a publicly available dataset shows that the proposed method maintains accurate segmentation, despite a limited number of labeled CTPA scans. with a Dice coefficient of 88.75% and a 95th percentile Hausdorff distance (HD95) of 1.74, outperforming fully supervised baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出基于GAN的半监督CTPA肺栓塞分割方法，结合Dice与交叉熵损失、特征匹配损失和自训练损失，在少量标注下取得Dice 88.75%、HD95 1.74。
AI.motivation: CTPA是肺栓塞临床诊断金标准，但人工判读耗时且易错；同时标注数据稀缺，需在有限标注下提升分割精度。
AI.method: 半监督分割框架，用GAN利用大量无标注CTPA扫描；Dice+交叉熵损失应对类别极度不平衡，特征匹配损失约束生成器输出解剖上合理的分割图，自训练损失强化高置信伪标签样本的学习。
AI.result: 在公开数据集上，Dice 88.75%、HD95 1.74，优于全监督基线，且在标注样本有限时保持稳定精度。
AI.conclusion: GAN式半监督分割可有效缓解医学影像标注稀缺问题，但属医学影像领域专用方法，对通用视觉/具身智能任务的方法启示有限。

title: STAR++: A Physical-Aware Benchmark and Framework for Astronomical Super-Resolution across Multiple Filters
summary: Astronomical super-resolution (ASR) aims to reconstruct high-resolution star fields from low-resolution telescope observations across multiple filters for astrophysical analysis. However, developing a physics-aware ASR framework faces two challenges: 1) Data view: no large-scale benchmark supports field-level ASR, especially on unseen filters. 2) Method view: Existing ASR methods often fail to preserve stellar flux across spatial resolutions. Moreover, ASR requires reconstructing high-frequency components, including accurate star locations and profiles, making it more ill-posed than natural-image SR. To tackle these problems, we introduce STAR++, a large-scale benchmark comprising approximately 1.7 million flux-consistent image pairs across 36 filters, derived from Hubble Space Telescope (HST) observations. STAR++ uses a flux-preserving data generation pipeline to ensure photometric consistency across resolutions and provides the Flux Error (FE) metric to evaluate ASR models from a physical perspective. To address method-level challenges, we propose a Flux-Invariant Super-Resolution Plus (FISR++) model that generalizes to unseen filters while accurately reconstructing flux-consistent high-resolution images. Beyond the flux-preserving modules, FISR++ introduces two novel components. Specifically, a Filter-Aware Adapter (FAA) incorporates filter metadata to adapt image representations to varying spectral and optical conditions. In addition, a Spatial Ambiguity Disentangle Loss (SADL) models spatial ambiguity as pixel-shift uncertainty, mitigating the smoothing of learned conditional mean reconstructions caused by this ambiguity. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FISR++ consistently outperforms existing ASR methods in reconstruction quality and flux accuracy, while generalizing to unseen filters, highlighting its effectiveness for photometrically faithful ASR.

AI.tldr: STAR++ 是约 1.7M 对、36 个滤光片（含未见滤光片）的 HST 天体超分基准，配合通量保持一致的数据生成流程与 Flux Error 指标；FISR++ 模型用 Filter-Aware Adapter 注入滤光片元数据、用 Spatial Ambiguity Disentangle Loss 建模像素位移不确定性，在重建质量与通量精度上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 天体超分（ASR）比自然图像超分更病态，需重建恒星位置与轮廓等高频信息；现有工作存在两方面不足：缺少支持场级、可泛化到未见滤光片的大规模基准；现有方法在跨分辨率时难以保持恒星通量（光度一致性）。
AI.method: 构建 STAR++ 基准：约 170 万对通量一致图像、36 个滤光片、源自 HST，采用保通量数据生成管线并提出 FE（Flux Error）物理评价指标。提出 FISR++：在保通量模块之上加入 Filter-Aware Adapter（利用滤光片元数据适配不同光谱/光学条件的图像表征）与 Spatial Ambiguity Disentangle Loss（将空间歧义建模为像素位移不确定性，缓解条件均值重建的过度平滑）。
AI.result: 大量实验表明 FISR++ 在重建质量与通量精度上稳定优于现有 ASR 方法，并能泛化到未见滤光片，体现其在光度保真超分上的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作以「基准 + 指标 + 方法」闭环推进物理感知天体超分，把光度一致性作为一等目标；但属天文领域 CV，与具身智能/3D 世界模型主线相关性有限，仅作方法论与工具参考。

title: Semantic-aware Contrasting with Explicitly Disentangled Representations for AI-Generated Video Detection
summary: The rapid proliferation of AI-generated videos (AIGVs) has raised critical concerns about content authenticity. Existing benchmarks suffer from a fundamental limitation: real and fake videos are often collected or generated from different semantic distributions. As a result, detectors may rely on spurious correlations involving objects, scenes, or actions rather than intrinsic artifacts introduced by generative models. To this end, we introduce SAVGE, a large-scale semantically aligned AIGV detection dataset comprising 2,369,822 videos, including 424,115 real videos and 1,945,707 generated videos. SAVGE organizes samples into real-fake semantic groups by using captions paired with real videos as prompts for text-to-video generation, thereby providing both group-level correspondence and textual semantic anchors. Based on SAVGE, we further propose Explicit Disentangling and Semantic-aware Contrasting (EDSC), a model-agnostic training framework for learning artifact-focused representations with reduced semantic interference. EDSC first extracts and aligns visual semantic features with textual representations, and then explicitly suppresses semantic information in the artifact branch while contrasting real and fake samples within each semantic group. By integrating caption-guided semantic supervision with intra-group contrastive learning in a two-phase optimization strategy, EDSC encourages detectors to capture generation-related cues under matched semantic conditions. Extensive experiments on SAVGE and GenVideo demonstrate that EDSC improves most evaluated backbone-metric combinations, enhances robustness under challenging evaluation settings, and strengthens cross-dataset generalization. These results highlight the importance of semantic alignment in AIGV detection and validate explicit semantic-artifact disentanglement as an effective strategy for robust detector learning.

AI.tldr: 提出语义对齐的AI生成视频检测数据集SAVGE（236万视频）与模型无关训练框架EDSC，通过显式解耦语义与伪影并做语义组内对比，提升检测鲁棒性与跨数据集泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有AIGV检测基准中真实与生成视频来自不同语义分布，检测器易依赖物体、场景、动作等虚假相关而非生成模型内在伪影，导致泛化性差。
AI.method: 用真实视频配对字幕作为文生视频提示构建真假语义组，提供组级对应与文本语义锚点；EDSC框架先提取并对齐视觉语义特征与文本表示，再在伪影分支显式抑制语义信息，并在每个语义组内进行真假对比；采用两阶段优化结合字幕引导语义监督与组内对比学习。
AI.result: 在SAVGE与GenVideo上，EDSC在多数主干网络-指标组合上均有提升，在挑战性评测设置下更鲁棒，并增强跨数据集泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 语义对齐对AIGV检测至关重要，显式语义-伪影解耦是学习鲁棒检测器的有效策略。

title: CURVTON-205K: A Mask-Free Difficulty-Stratified Synthetic Dataset for Robust and Scalable Virtual Try-On
comment: Accepted at IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV) 2027. Project page: this https URL
summary: Recent advances in 2D virtual try-on (VTON) have largely focused on architectural innovation, yet robust performance in diverse real-world conditions remains challenging. We argue that failure modes in VTON, such as inaccurate occlusion handling, unconstrained poses, and poor coverage of under-represented garments and appearance factors, are tightly coupled to dataset design choices and long-tail data regimes.
