To support this task, we construct the Human-Robot Paired Affordance Dataset (HPAD), the first large-scale 3D affordance benchmark in which every object is annotated with both human-prior and simulation-validated robot labels. HPAD covers 2,137 objects across 80 categories and 13 atomic action primitives, yielding over 27,000 object-action pairs. On top of HPAD, we propose the 3D Affordance tRansfer neTwork (ART). ART first filters geometric false positives in the human prior via a reliability gating stream, then reconstructs the prior into a robot-actionable distribution through hierarchical reconstruction and a graph-diffusion refinement that resolves the topological mismatch between human and robot affordances. Experiments on HPAD demonstrate the reliability of the proposed task and the superiority of ART. We further validate ART on a 6-DoF arm with a parallel-jaw gripper in a 2,400-execution benchmark across 12 objects and 4 action categories; ART attains the best success rate (86.5% over its 480 trials), confirming the practicality of the transfer paradigm. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出"3D Human-to-Robot Affordance Transfer"新任务与HPAD数据集（2137物体/80类/13种动作基元，>2.7万物体-动作对），并设计ART网络（可靠性门控流 + 层级重建 + 图扩散精修）将人类先验转换为机器人可执行affordance。
AI.motivation: 现有3D affordance方法直接以人类先验为参考，忽视了affordance并非物体固有属性而与智能体具身结构强耦合；人手与机器人末端执行器在结构和形态上的差异导致人类先验直接迁移时严重不兼容。
AI.method: 构建Human-Robot Paired Affordance Dataset（每个物体同时含人类先验标注与仿真验证的机器人标签）；提出ART网络：先用可靠性门控流过滤人类先验中的几何假阳性，再通过层级重建与图扩散精修将先验重构为机器人可执行的分布，以解决人-机affordance的拓扑失配。
AI.result: 在HPAD上验证了任务可靠性与ART的优越性；进一步在6-DoF机械臂+平行夹爪上进行2400次执行基准测试（12物体/4类动作），ART在其480次试验中取得86.5%的最佳成功率。
AI.conclusion: affordance迁移需显式考虑具身差异；仿真验证的配对标注与"过滤-重建-精修"流程可实现可执行的人类→机器人3D affordance迁移，并在真实机械臂上具备实用性。

title: VideoACE: Benchmarking Agentic Video Understanding through High-Frame-Rate Actions
summary: Agentic video understanding requires models to actively interact with video environments to gather evidence and form judgments. Evaluating this capability therefore requires assessing whether models can translate opportunities for interaction into better understanding. We introduce VideoACE, a benchmark for assessing video understanding under conditions that support sustained interaction. We focus on high-frame-rate action videos, where rapid, subtle changes make targeted observation especially valuable. The benchmark comprises 1,000 multiple-choice questions spanning six categories of fine-grained action understanding, accompanied by temporal evidence annotations and user hints screened for answer leakage. Its evaluation environment combines video inspection tools with a user simulator, allowing models to adjust temporal coverage, sampling density, and spatial detail, and to revisit evidence and revise their judgments under simulated user feedback. We evaluate single-pass observation, autonomous tool use, and tool use combined with user feedback to examine how effectively models exploit these opportunities. Evaluation of five models reveals distinct patterns in how they acquire evidence and respond to opportunities for further interaction. These findings establish VideoACE as a testbed for examining agentic video understanding beyond performance under a fixed observation setting.

AI.tldr: VideoACE：面向agentic视频理解的交互式基准，聚焦高帧率动作视频，含1000道多选题、时间证据标注与用户模拟器，支持调节时间覆盖/采样密度/空间细节及多轮反馈修正。
AI.motivation: 现有视频理解评测多为固定观测条件下的单次作答，无法检验模型能否将"可交互机会"转化为更好的理解；高帧率动作视频中快速细微变化使主动观测尤为关键。
AI.method: 构建benchmark：1000道六类细粒度动作理解多选题 + 时间证据标注 + 经过答案泄漏筛查的用户提示；评测环境集成视频检视工具与用户模拟器，模型可调整时间覆盖、采样密度、空间细节，并在模拟反馈下重访证据、修订判断；设置单次观测、自主工具使用、工具+用户反馈三种设置对比。
AI.result: 对五个模型的评测揭示其在证据获取方式及对进一步交互机会的响应上呈现明显不同的模式。
AI.conclusion: VideoACE为超越固定观测设定、考察agentic视频理解提供了测试平台。

title: Worth Another Look:Constrained World-Model Planning for Visual Inspection
summary: Visual inspection in field robotics and environmental monitoring must localize multiple targets under strict compute and sensing caps. Exhaustive sweeps waste calls on absent classes, while myopic and search-free policies stumble over heterogeneous tariff cliffs or discard viewport edits whose value emerges only after re-querying. We formulate inspection over frozen detectors as neuro-symbolic observation planning under partial observability, decoupling a compact recurrent world model (WM) from exact symbolic feasibility and tariff rules. Receding-horizon beam search with online replanning jointly schedules class queries, crops, enhancements, and termination (stop), paired with slack-aware shadow pricing and legal fallback at larger budgets. Across eight terrestrial, optical, and sonar benchmarks, multi-step lookahead outperforms static schedules and search-free offline RL under tight budgets -- gaining up to 28.4 AP percentage points over static priority on RUOD and 15.1 on ARIS -- while dynamic pricing lifts large-budget performance on all eight domains at 11 ms planning cost. Ultimately, pairing lightweight learned dynamics with exact symbolic constraints turns frozen detectors into adaptive, budget-aware inspection agents without retraining.

AI.tldr: 将冻结检测器下的多目标视觉巡检建模为部分可观测下的神经-符号观测规划：紧凑循环世界模型与精确符号可行性/代价规则解耦，用带在线重规划的滚动时域束搜索联合调度类别查询、裁剪、增强与终止，并引入松弛感知影子定价。
AI.motivation: 现场机器人与环境监测巡检受严格算力与感知预算约束：穷举扫描浪费在不存在类别上；短视或无搜索策略难以处理异构代价断崖（tariff cliffs），且会丢弃需重新查询后才显现价值的视口编辑操作。
AI.method: 在部分可观测下做神经-符号观测规划：紧凑循环世界模型（学习动态）+ 精确符号可行性/代价约束。滚动时域束搜索配在线重规划，联合调度类别查询、裁剪、增强、停止；大预算下加松弛感知影子定价与合法回退（legal fallback），检测器全程冻结不重训。
AI.result: 八个陆地/光学/声呐基准上，紧预算下多步前瞻优于静态调度与无搜索离线RL：RUOD 上较静态优先级最高提升 28.4 AP 点，ARIS 上 15.1；动态定价在全部八个域提升大预算性能，规划开销仅 11 ms。
AI.conclusion: 轻量学习动态 + 精确符号约束可将冻结检测器转为自适应、预算感知的巡检智能体，无需重训练；为低成本现场感知提供可部署的规划式方案。

title: Monitoring Unplanned Construction Using Satellite Change Detection
summary: Cities need land for homes, shops, roads, and public services. New construction changes that land. It can harm natural areas and water bodies, add to waste, and strain public services. NITI Aayog's 2021 report stated that 65% of 7,933 urban settlements in India had no master plan. That number tells us about planning coverage at the time. It does not tell us whether any single building was authorised. Artificial intelligence, which lets computers learn patterns from data, can help find physical changes by comparing satellite images taken on different dates. We test simple methods on two public datasets from outside India. First, we turn each image into a set of numbers using a pretrained neural network, a model already trained to recognise patterns in images. We feed those numbers to standard machine-learning classifiers that predict land categories and physical changes. The methods reach about 95 percent accuracy at spotting built-up land and about 83 percent accuracy at saying whether a small pair of images shows change, where each pair gets one label. We also train a small neural network on a standard change-detection benchmark. Separately, we run a preliminary descriptive check on an Agra sample of 48 patches, 7 of them positive. The results show that satellite images carry information about physical change. They do not show whether construction was planned or permitted.

AI.tldr: 利用预训练CNN特征+经典机器学习分类器及小型神经网络，在印度以外的两个公开数据集上做建筑用地识别与成对影像变化检测（约95%/83%准确率），并对Agra 48个影像块做初步描述性检验，强调卫星影像只能反映物理变化而非规划许可。
AI.motivation: 印度城市缺乏总体规划覆盖（NITI Aayog 2021：7,933个城镇中65%无总体规划），但该统计只说明规划覆盖率，无法判断单体建筑是否获批；因此尝试用遥感+AI检测物理变化，探索其能力边界。
AI.method: 两阶段浅层管线：用预训练神经网络将影像嵌入为特征向量，再输入标准机器学习分类器完成土地类别预测与变化判别（成对影像单一标签）；另在标准变化检测基准上训练小型神经网络；对Agra 48个样本patch（7个正例）做初步描述性分析。
AI.result: 建筑用地识别约95%准确率，成对影像变化判别约83%准确率；Agra样本仅作初步描述性检验，样本量小（7正例）不足以支撑推断。
AI.conclusion: 卫星影像确实携带物理变化信息，但无法判断建设是否经规划或获批；方法局限于离线特征+浅层分类器，缺少时序/实例级许可核查能力。

title: High-Precision Docking of Differential-Drive Mobile Robots Through LiDAR and Vision Collaboration
summary: Precise docking requires a differential-drive robot to correct lateral offset through coupled rotation and translation within a short approach distance. We combine global navigation with terminal control using complementary LiDAR and visual observations. A line fitted to the cabinet front gives normal distance and heading. An AprilTag identifies the workstation; intersecting its center ray with the LiDAR plane determines tangential position. Taught observations define the docking reference and can cancel repeatable fixed biases under unchanged mounting and geometry. Lateral pre-alignment and continuous visual servoing coordinate the approach, with predictive stopping to account for low-speed actuation lag. Across two sessions using the same navigation and docking code at five workstations on Robot 2, all 111 tasks completed, including 101 on the first attempt. Relative to the taught observations, onboard longitudinal, lateral and heading residual root-mean-square values were 1.51 mm, 5.93 mm and 0.238 degrees, respectively. Joint acceptance within plus or minus 10 mm per position axis and plus or minus 1 degree heading was 96.4% (107/111), or 95.5% (106/111) with a plus or minus 0.5 degree heading limit.

AI.tldr: 差速驱动机器人结合LiDAR拟合柜面直线与AprilTag中心射线做终端对接，配合预对准与视觉伺服预测停车，111次任务全部完成，横向RMSE 5.93 mm，联合验收96.4%。
AI.motivation: 短距离内仅靠全局导航无法修正横向偏差，需在有限接近距离内通过耦合旋转-平移完成精确对接，并要求在不改变安装与几何的条件下消除可重复的系统偏差。
AI.method: 全局导航+终端控制融合互补的LiDAR与视觉观测：对柜体前面拟合直线得到法向距离与航向；AprilTag识别工位，其中心射线与LiDAR平面相交求切向位置；由示教观测定义对接参考并抵消重复性固定偏差；采用横向预对准、连续视觉伺服与考虑低速执行滞后的预测停车。
AI.result: 两台次、同一导航与对接代码、5个工位、Robot 2上111次任务全部完成（101次首次成功）；相对示教观测的纵向/横向/航向残差RMS为1.51 mm、5.93 mm、0.238°；±10 mm + ±1° 联合验收通过率96.4%（107/111），±0.5°限位下95.5%（106/111）。
AI.conclusion: 多传感器几何先验+示教偏置补偿+预测停车可在短距离内实现毫米级重复对接，方法工程性强但场景较受限，属移动机器人高精度对接的实用方案。

title: TrajWAM: Trajectory-Conditioned Future Learning for Vision-Language Driving
comment: 22 pages, including supplementary material. Code and model weights: this https URL
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) connect future scene prediction with action planning for autonomous driving. Each driving record pairs an executed ego trajectory with its observed future, providing a factual outcome for learning this connection. We present TrajWAM, a trajectory-conditioned WAM that improves vision-language driving through auxiliary bird's-eye-view (BEV) future learning. An ego-trajectory query conditions DINOv3-aligned BEV predictions from shared planner representations. Training combines factual reconstruction under the executed trajectory with one-sided feature separation under an unlabeled perturbed trajectory. Together, these objectives train the shared planner to generate driving waypoints. Native inference directly generates waypoints and bypasses the auxiliary future-prediction branch. On all 220 Bench2Drive routes, TrajWAM achieves 91.53 Driving Score and 75.45% Success Rate, exceeding a schedule-matched planning-only fine-tuning baseline by 5.31 Driving Score points and eight successful routes.

AI.tldr: TrajWAM：以自车轨迹为条件的世界动作模型，用DINOv3对齐的BEV未来预测作为辅助任务增强视觉-语言驾驶规划，推理时直接输出waypoints。
AI.motivation: 每条驾驶记录天然包含"已执行轨迹—观测到的未来"配对，作者希望利用这一事实性监督来强化未来预测与动作规划的连接，从而提升VLA驾驶策略的规划质量。
AI.method: 共享planner表征下，用ego-trajectory query条件化BEV未来特征预测（对齐DINOv3特征）；训练目标包含两部分：在执行轨迹下的事实重构损失，以及在无标注扰动轨迹下的单侧特征分离损失；推理时仅走原生waypoint生成分支，跳过未来预测头。
AI.result: Bench2Drive全部220条路线取得91.53 Driving Score与75.45%成功率，相较调度匹配的纯规划微调基线提升5.31 DS、多8条成功路线。
AI.conclusion: 轻量辅助未来学习可有效改进VLA驾驶规划，且不增加推理开销；但验证局限于闭环仿真基准，缺实车证据与代码/效率细节。

title: WM^MLLM: Turning MLLMs into World Models
comment: 25 pages, 14 figures, 8 tables; project page: this https URL
summary: Video world models keep the world in the context of a generator, so a revisit is synthesized again and earlier edits can drift or disappear. We present WM^MLLM, the first interactive world model built on multimodal large language models (MLLMs), for persistent, editable world generation from a single image. WM^MLLM keeps the world state outside every generator, as a panorama with a revision history, and lets the MLLMs write it: they turn each request into operations on this state, select where a local edit is written, and check every candidate before it becomes the next state. Image generators only propose views, and video only presents them. Users can walk to new places and return, edit objects through text or a box, place subjects, and change lighting, weather or season. By construction, a revisit at the same revision reproduces the earlier view exactly, a local edit leaves every panorama pixel outside its region unchanged, and each request starts from the result of the previous one. Against six world model baselines on MBench-A, WM^MLLM has the highest mean on all four environment-recovery metrics (Epipolar 91.5 versus 0.1 to 74.0) and completes the most camera round trips (85.3% versus at most 50.9%). It has the best value in all 15 CompBench columns against 15 baselines. On 112 local edits judged blind, selecting the region to write after generation raises completion from 34.8% to 83.0%. On 258 WBench and MBench-A items, all 46 revisits recover their earlier views, and all 97 local edits that pass the check leave panorama pixels outside their region unchanged.

AI.tldr: WM^MLLM 将世界状态外部化为带修订历史的全景图，由 MLLM 将其翻译为对状态的操作（选择局部编辑写入区域并校验候选），生成器仅提出来视角，实现单图持久可编辑的交互式世界模型，重访可精确复现、局部编辑区域外像素不变。
AI.motivation: 视频世界模型把世界保存在生成器的上下文中，导致重访需重新合成、先前编辑会漂移或消失，缺乏持久性与可控编辑性。
AI.method: 构建基于 MLLM 的交互式世界模型：世界状态存储为全景图+修订历史，独立于生成器；MLLM 将用户请求转为状态操作，选择局部编辑的写入位置，并在成为下一状态前校验候选；图像生成器仅提出视角、视频仅呈现视角。
AI.result: MBench-A 四个环境恢复指标均值最高（Epipolar 91.5 vs 0.1–74.0），相机往返完成率 85.3%（基线≤50.9%）；CompBench 全部 15 列对 15 个基线最优；盲评 112 次局部编辑中，生成后选择写入区域将完成率从 34.8% 提升至 83.0%；258 项测试中 46 次重访全部复原，97 次通过校验的局部编辑均保持区域外全景像素不变。
AI.conclusion: 将世界状态显式外置并由 MLLM 作为状态写入与校验的控制层，可从结构上保证重访一致性、局部编辑局部性与请求链式一致性，显著优于视频生成式世界模型基线。

title: From Neural Tokens to Language: Dual-View EEG Semantic Bridging for Brain-to-Text Generation
summary: Visually evoked EEG-to-text generation aims to produce natural-language descriptions from neural responses elicited by visual stimuli. Existing approaches typically compress EEG signals into a single global representation and directly project it into the hidden space of a large language model (LLM), which may limit the preservation of complementary visual semantics under noisy and subject-dependent EEG signals. We propose a dual-view semantic token bridging framework that exploits raw images and sketch images as complementary visual supervision to learn raw-oriented and sketch-oriented EEG semantic token streams. To interface these structured neural representations with an LLM, we introduce a branch-specific semantic query bridge that aggregates each token stream into compact semantic slots and converts them into LLM-compatible soft prompts. A progressive adaptation strategy further transitions the learned visual-semantic interface from image-supported training to image-free EEG-conditioned generation. Experiments demonstrate strong subject-wise EEG classification performance and competitive EEG-to-text generation across multiple LLM backbones. Ablation, branch-level representation, and EEG-label disentanglement analyses further show that the two EEG streams learn complementary view-oriented representations and that EEG-derived prompts provide sample-specific information beyond category labels.

AI.tldr: 提出双视角语义token桥接框架，用原图与素描图作为互补视觉监督，学习raw-oriented与sketch-oriented两路EEG语义token流，并经分支特定语义查询桥转换为LLM可用的soft prompt，配合渐进式适应策略从有图训练过渡到无图EEG条件生成。
AI.motivation: 现有EEG-to-text方法将EEG压缩为单一全局表示并直接投影到LLM隐空间，在噪声大、跨被试差异显著的EEG下易丢失互补视觉语义。
AI.method: 双视图语义token桥接：raw图像与sketch图像双路监督学习两路EEG语义token流；分支特定语义查询桥将每路token聚合为紧凑语义槽并转为LLM兼容soft prompt；渐进式适应策略从图像辅助训练迁移至纯EEG条件生成。
AI.result: 被试级EEG分类表现强，多个LLM骨干上EEG-to-text生成具竞争力；消融、分支级表示与EEG-标签解耦分析显示两路流学到互补的视角特定表示，EEG派生prompt提供超出类别标签的样本特异信息。
AI.conclusion: 多视图互补监督与结构化token桥接可有效缓解单全局表示的信息瓶颈，为脑信号到语言的跨模态对齐提供可迁移的接口设计范式。

title: SpiderMark: Hybrid Watermarking for Generative AI via Algorithmic Injection and Learning-Based Verification
summary: The proliferation of diffusion-based generative models has intensified the need for reliable methods to trace and verify the provenance of AI-generated images. Existing watermarking approaches for diffusion models typically rely on isotropic frequency patterns and handcrafted detection metrics, which are prone to directional vulnerability and threshold instability across diverse image transformations. We propose SpiderMark, a hybrid watermarking framework that combines algorithmic frequency-domain injection with learning-based probabilistic verification, requiring no modifications to pretrained diffusion model weights. SpiderMark embeds a structured spider-web pattern, comprising radial spokes and concentric polygonal rings, into the Fourier representation of the initial latent noise, and trains a lightweight ResNet-18 verifier augmented with auxiliary similarity cues (PSNR and L1) to produce a continuous watermark confidence score for watermark detection. Across nine evaluation conditions, SpiderMark achieves the highest fixed-threshold Accuracy in eight, while retaining strong detection on unseen COCO prompts without verifier retraining. CLIP similarity and FID measurements show that these detection gains are accompanied by small measured differences in prompt alignment and distributional image quality. SpiderMark establishes that structured watermark geometry and learned probabilistic verification can be unified into a single, practical framework, bridging the gap between imperceptibility, robustness, and real-world verifiability for generative AI content attribution.

AI.tldr: SpiderMark：在初始潜噪傅里叶域嵌入蛛网状结构水印，并用ResNet-18概率验证器（含PSNR/L1辅助线索）输出连续置信度，无需改扩散模型权重
AI.motivation: 扩散生成图像溯源需求上升，但现有水印依赖各向同性频域模式与手工检测阈值，存在方向性脆弱和跨变换阈值不稳定问题
AI.method: 在初始latent噪声的Fourier表示中注入由径向辐条与同心多边形环构成的蛛网模式（算法式注入），再训练轻量ResNet-18验证器，融合PSNR与L1相似度辅助线索，输出连续水印置信度；不改动预训练扩散模型权重
AI.result: 在9种评估条件下有8项取得最高固定阈值Accuracy；对未见COCO提示词无需重训验证器仍保持较强检测；CLIP相似度与FID显示在提示对齐与分布质量上仅有小幅差异
AI.conclusion: 结构化水印几何与学习式概率验证可统一为单一实用框架，在不可感知性、鲁棒性与实际可验证性之间取得折中

title: TapTacTouch: Shape Completion from Sparse Tactile Contacts with Geometric Priors
summary: 3D object reconstruction is essential for robotic perception and manipulation, yet conventional approaches predominantly rely on visual observations that can be limited by occlusion or unavailable in visually constrained environments. In this work, we propose a vision-free, training-free, and category-agnostic framework for reconstructing 3D object meshes from sparse tactile contacts without relying on pretrained shape models. A 6-DoF robotic arm equipped with a 20-DoF multi-finger robotic hand collects tactile observations using 3x3 pressure sensor arrays mounted on the finger pads. The acquired tactile measurements are transformed into 3D contact constraints through robot kinematics and integrated into a multi-scale Gaussian Process Implicit Surface (GPIS). To address sparse and incomplete surface observations, the proposed method incorporates contact confidence weighting, weak pseudo-surface constraints, and an observation-driven geometric prior to preserve local surface geometry and provide structural guidance in unobserved regions. Real-world experiments on six objects achieve a Chamfer Distance (CD) of 1.610, an Earth Mover's Distance (EMD) of 7.738, and an F-Score of 95.00, with reconstruction completed in an average of 49.99 s per object. These results demonstrate that sparse tactile sensing can provide sufficient geometric information for continuous 3D object reconstruction without visual or semantic information.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无视觉、免训练、类别无关的稀疏触觉3D网格重建框架：用20自由度多指手的3x3压力阵列采集接触，经运动学转为3D接触约束，融合进多尺度GPIS，并引入接触置信加权、弱伪表面约束与观测驱动几何先验；真实实验中6个物体平均CD 1.610、EMD 7.738、F-Score 95.00，单物体约49.99秒。
AI.motivation: 机器人感知与操作依赖3D物体重构，但常规方法主要依靠视觉，易受遮挡限制或在视觉受限环境中不可用；同时现有形状重建往往依赖预训练形状模型或语义先验。因此希望仅凭稀疏触觉接触即可完成连续3D重建。
AI.method: 硬件为6-DoF机械臂+20-DoF多指手，指尖贴装3x3压力传感器阵列采集触觉观测；通过机器人运动学将触觉测量转换为3D接触约束，作为隐式表面观测注入多尺度高斯过程隐式曲面（GPIS）回归。针对观测稀疏与不完整，加入三项机制：接触置信度加权、弱伪表面约束、观测驱动几何先验，以保留局部几何并在未观测区域提供结构引导。
AI.result: 真实世界6个物体的实验：Chamfer Distance 1.610、Earth Mover's Distance 7.738、F-Score 95.00，单物体平均重建耗时49.99秒。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏触觉感知即可提供足够几何信息，在无视觉、无语义信息、无预训练形状模型、无训练的条件下实现连续3D物体网格重建，说明触觉可作为视觉受限场景中可行的重建模态。

title: DetailScale-SR: Decoupling Restoration and Continuous Detail Control for Real-World Super-Resolution
summary: Real-world image super-resolution often seeks the most detailed plausible reconstruction, although more detail is not always desirable. The same degraded image may require restrained restoration, faithful reconstruction, or enhanced visual detail according to user intent. We present DetailScale-SR, a preference-conditioned framework that continuously controls reconstructed detail for a fixed low-resolution input without altering the scene being restored. Rather than relying on post-processing or repeatedly rewriting prompts, it learns a continuous family of reconstructions while separating content recovery from detail preference. This enables a smooth transition from conservative restoration to richly textured results under consistent input and semantic constraints. Its controllable range also extends beyond conventional restoration: DetailScale-SR can enhance high-frequency structures and generate perceptually richer textures than the paired high-resolution reference. Text restoration is another distinct strength. For text-rich scenes, especially Chinese posters and signs, it recovers more legible and character-faithful text than prior generative SR methods under matched textual guidance. DetailScale-SR therefore unifies continuous detail control, beyond-reference enhancement, and reliable recovery of semantically important content. Our model is available at this https URL

AI.tldr: DetailScale-SR: 一个偏好条件化的真实图像超分框架，可在固定低分输入下连续控制重建细节程度，实现从保守复原到超参考增强的平滑过渡。
AI.motivation: 真实超分常被默认为"最大化细节"，但同一退化图像在不同用户意图下可能需保守复原、忠实重建或增强细节；现有方法依赖后处理或反复改写提示词，难以在不改变场景内容的前提下连续调节细节。
AI.method: 学习一个连续的显式偏好条件重建族，将内容恢复与细节偏好解耦；在一致输入与语义约束下通过单一条件连续插值细节强度，而非后处理或提示词重写。
AI.result: 可在保守到丰富纹理之间平滑过渡；可控范围超出常规复原，能增强高频结构并生成比配对高分参考更丰富的纹理；在中文字海报/标牌等文本密集场景中，同等文本引导下字符忠实度与可读性优于已有生成式超分方法。
AI.conclusion: 统一了连续细节控制、超参考增强与语义关键内容（尤其文本）可靠恢复三目标，为可交互、意图可控的超分提供单模型方案。

title: Target-Consistent Action Guidance via Semi-Unbalanced Optimal Transport for Drifting World Models
summary: Action-conditioned world models let robots imagine the outcomes of their actions for planning and offline policy evaluation, but these uses need many rollouts, which multi-step diffusion makes expensive. Drifting models move the iteration from inference to training and generate samples in one network pass. DriftWorld brought this paradigm to action-conditioned world models; to strengthen action following, it repels predictions from the current frame, a construction borrowed from classifier-free guidance. We show that this accentuation has a target bias: the push persists even when a prediction matches the recorded future, in kernel, balanced, and unbalanced Wasserstein drifting fields alike. We introduce Mass-Share Accentuation (MSA) to remove this bias. MSA treats the current frame as a counterfactual destination competing with the recorded future in a semi-relaxed optimal transport problem; subtracting the closed-form share of the correct future makes the guidance vanish at the target, and the remainder is shared by all predictions. We prove that the recorded future is the unique fixed point along the motion direction for collapsed predictions, and that the guidance fades with prediction error. On Push-T, Robomimic, and BridgeV2, where trained models under-react rather than overshoot, MSA improves action ranking, response slope, and moving-region error over latent-space baselines at no inference cost, though these benchmarks do not isolate bias removal as the cause.

AI.tldr: 指出 DriftWorld 类动作条件世界模型中"从当前帧推开"的引导项存在目标偏差（即使预测等于真实未来仍有推力），提出 Mass-Share Accentuation（MSA），用半松弛最优传输将当前帧视为反事实目的地，减去正确未来的闭式份额使引导在目标处归零，并给出唯一不动点与误差衰减证明。
AI.motivation: 行动条件世界模型在规划与离线策略评估中需要大量 rollout，多步扩散推理昂贵；drifting 模型把迭代搬进训练、单次前向出样本，DriftWorld 沿用此范式并用类似无分类器引导的"远离当前帧"项加强动作跟随，但这种加权存在目标偏差，需在零推理开销下消除。
AI.method: 将当前帧视为与真实未来竞争的反事实目的地，构造半松弛最优传输问题；减去正确未来对应的闭式质量份额以去除偏差，剩余部分由所有预测共享（MSA）。理论上证明在塌缩预测下真实未来是运动方向上唯一不动点，且引导强度随预测误差衰减；在 kernel、balanced/unbalanced Wasserstein 三类 drifting 场中统一分析。
AI.result: 在 Push-T、Robomimic、BridgeV2 上，MSA 相对潜空间基线在动作排序、响应斜率、运动区域误差上均有提升，且不增加推理成本；作者亦承认这些基准未能隔离"偏差消除"这一因果因素（模型表现为反应不足而非过冲）。
AI.conclusion: 引导强度偏差是类 CFG 帧排斥设计的固有缺陷，MSA 以传输质量份额的形式给出无偏、单步生成的替代方案，为高效动作条件世界模型提供了可证明正确的引导机制，但方法收益的归因仍需针对性消融。

title: Training Denoising Models of Any Architecture Without Stored Images
summary: Can a pretrained denoising model replace the dataset used to train it? We investigate this question through teacher-supervised training, showing for the first time that continuous-time diffusion and flow models of any architecture and size can be trained from random initialization without stored images. Our students regress the teacher's velocity on a rolling pool of noisy samples, advanced along trajectories of random step counts to obtain independent, dense and approximately continuous noise levels. This saves considerable storage for large datasets and applies even when the data are unreleased or private. Our experiments include 12 teachers of 6 families and 6 datasets. Our method outperforms standard training of the same network on CIFAR-10 for students 4x smaller than the teacher, comes within 0.75 to 1.92 FID of it at the teacher's size and surpasses training on teacher-generated images and step reduction methods without teacher-based initialization. Our code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出teacher-supervised训练：学生扩散/流模型从随机初始化开始，在滚动噪声样本池上回归教师模型的速度场，无需存储图像即可训练任意架构与规模的连续时间扩散/流模型。
AI.motivation: 大规模数据集的存储成本高，且部分数据未公开或属于私有，无法直接用于训练扩散/流模型；探索预训练去噪模型能否替代其训练数据集本身。
AI.method: 学生模型在滚动噪声样本池上回归教师速度场（velocity matching）；样本沿随机步数轨迹推进，以产生独立、稠密且近似连续的噪声水平。池中样本无需真实图像，仅由教师采样生成，避免存储原始数据。
AI.result: 覆盖6个模型族的12个教师、6个数据集。CIFAR-10上：学生比教师小4倍时优于同网络标准训练；与教师同规模时FID差距仅0.75–1.92；优于基于教师生成图像的训练及步数削减方法（无教师初始化）。
AI.conclusion: 预训练去噪模型可在无原始图像存储的条件下充当数据替代，实现有效知识蒸馏式训练，利于私有/未发布数据场景，并显著节省存储。

title: Neural Network-Based In-Contact Task Segmentation of Demonstrated Robot Motions via Hand Guiding
comment: Extended abstract, accepted and presented at the 1st German Robotics Conference (GRC 2025), Nuremberg, 13-15 March 2025; no official proceedings, not peer-reviewed; see also this https URL
summary: Intuitive robot programming approaches, such as Programming by Demonstration, enable non-experts to teach robots tasks through hand-guided demonstrations. However, for in-contact tasks requiring force control for parts of the motion, automated segmentation of motion types is crucial for improving usability. Considering the related work, this work proposes a neural network-based segmentation method categorizing motion into three fundamental types using input data of cartesian twists and wrenches at the end effector. We collect demonstration data using a 7-axis robot with a wrist-mounted force torque sensor and generate ground truth labeling by hand. While still in development, our research direction aims to enable non-experts to program in-contact tasks more intuitively.

AI.tldr: 提出基于神经网络的示教编程运动分割方法，利用末端笛卡尔twist与wrench输入，将演示轨迹划分为三种基本运动类型，面向需力控的接触式任务。
AI.motivation: Programming by Demonstration 使非专家能通过手把手示教编程机器人，但对含接触、需要力控的轨迹段，需自动分割运动类型才能提升可用性；现有工作尚未充分解决该问题。
AI.method: 使用7轴机器人+腕部力/力矩传感器采集示教数据；以末端笛卡尔twist与wrench为网络输入，训练神经网络进行三分类运动类型分割；真值标签由人工标注生成。
AI.result: 摘要为work-in-progress，未报告量化结果，仅说明已建立数据采集与人工标注流程并提出分割网络框架。
AI.conclusion: 作者期望该方向最终让非专家更直观地编程接触类任务；当前方法仍处开发中，缺少与基线方法的对比与泛化性评估。

title: ProbeShare: Probing a Few, Sharing Across Many for Fast World-Model Planning
summary: Visual planning with a frozen joint-embedding world model supports robotic reaching and object manipulation by evaluating candidate action sequences against an image goal before execution. Standard cross-entropy method (CEM) planners roll out every candidate independently through a billion-parameter predictor, even when nearby actions induce similar scene changes. This redundant computation grows with population size and search rounds, slowing closed-loop replanning. We observe that candidates within a planning step share an observation history and thus a common action-to-feature map. Based on this insight, we propose ProbeShare, which measures local responses with a few representative probes and reconstructs each candidate's feature grid through scene-conditioned, geometry-aware weighting. When promising candidates move beyond existing probe coverage, ProbeShare evaluates a new probe to rescore nearby candidates. Across four RoboCasa tasks, ProbeShare accelerates episode planning by 43.8--128.9 times over dense RoboJEPA and at least $14.2\times$ over competitive baselines, with greater mean goal progress in a matched-time comparison.

AI.tldr: ProbeShare 通过复用单步规划内的共享 action-to-feature 映射，用少量探针 rollout 加几何感知重建取代 CEM 中逐候选独立前向，实现 43.8–128.9× 的规划加速。
AI.motivation: 冻结的联合嵌入世界模型做视觉规划时，标准 CEM 对每个候选动作序列独立地通过十亿参数预测器前向，而邻近动作引起的场景变化高度相似，导致计算冗余随种群规模与搜索轮数线性增长，拖慢闭环重规划。
AI.method: 观察到同一规划步内所有候选共享观测历史，因此共享同一个从动作到特征的映射；用少量代表性探针测量局部响应，再通过场景条件化、几何感知的加权方式重建每个候选的特征网格；当有潜力的候选超出已有探针覆盖范围时，增评一个新探针以对邻近候选重新打分，避免全量 rollout。
AI.result: 在四个 RoboCasa 任务上，相比密集 RoboJEPA 加速 43.8–128.9 倍，相比最强竞争基线至少 14.2 倍，且在等时间预算对比下平均目标推进度更高。
AI.conclusion: 规划步内的候选共享局部动力学结构可被低秩/局部探针近似，探针共享式特征重建是降低世界模型规划计算开销的有效途径，且不牺牲规划质量。

title: Psychometrics-Inspired Coreset Selection for Image Quality Assessment
summary: Collecting large-scale subjective annotations remains a critical bottleneck in training accurate image quality assessment (IQA) models. Coreset selection reduces this burden by selecting representative images before annotation. However, diversity in a visual feature space does not necessarily reflect diversity in perceptual quality, raising a fundamental question about which quality-related factors the representation should encode. We propose GRAM, a quality-aware representation learning framework inspired by the graded response model (GRM) from psychometrics. GRM describes how an individual's latent ability determines the probabilities of reaching successive assessment grades, with response sensitivity and grade thresholds governing this relationship. In this paper, we find that this principle naturally aligns with perceptual quality assessment, where the impact of image degradation depends on image content and distortion characteristics. Building on this connection, GRAM models quality judgments through three complementary factors: latent quality, content-dependent response sensitivity, and distortion-dependent grade thresholds. These factors jointly determine the probabilities of attaining different quality grades and the resulting expected quality score. The learned parameters provide a structured quality-aware representation that complements general visual features for coreset selection. Experiments on nine datasets demonstrate improvements across different selection strategies, downstream IQA models, and annotation budgets. The code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: GRAM：借鉴心理测量学中的等级反应模型（GRM），将质量判断建模为潜在质量、内容相关响应敏感度与失真相关等级阈值的三因子结构，学习质量感知表征用于IQA数据集的coreset选择。
AI.motivation: 大规模主观标注是IQA训练的核心瓶颈；常规coreset选择依赖通用视觉特征空间的多样性，但视觉多样性不等价于感知质量多样性，因此需要明确"表征应编码哪些质量相关因素"。
AI.method: 提出质量感知表征学习框架GRAM。基于GRM：个体潜在能力决定逐级评分等级的概率，由响应敏感度与等级阈值调节。类比到图像：潜在质量、内容依赖的响应敏感度、失真依赖的等级阈值三因子共同决定各质量等级概率与期望质量分数；学到的结构化参数作为表征，与通用视觉特征互补用于coreset选择。
AI.result: 在9个数据集上，跨多种选择策略、多种下游IQA模型以及不同标注预算均取得提升。
AI.conclusion: 心理测量学建模思路可为IQA主动学习/数据选择提供结构化、可解释的质量感知表征；代码将公开。

title: ViLFlow: Parallel Vision-Language Generation with Continuous Latent Flows
summary: Vision-language generation has predominantly relied on autoregressive and discrete diffusion models. Autoregressive models generate tokens sequentially, while discrete diffusion models typically predict tokens independently within each denoising step. We propose ViLFlow (Vision-Language Flow), a continuous-flow vision-language model that combines joint modeling of output embeddings with parallel token decoding. ViLFlow adapts pretrained continuous language generation to visual question answering and image captioning through learned image guidance and prediction-aware token decoding. A visually adapted teacher provides image-guided predictions as additional denoising supervision. The denoiser learns to reproduce these predictions directly, retaining one image-conditioned prediction per generation step. We train the token decoder on denoiser predictions and paired reference text to improve the conversion of continuous outputs into words. The decoder can be adapted independently, improving answering and captioning without further denoiser training. For captioning, it also supplies text feedback during late denoising, allowing decoded words to inform subsequent refinement. ViLFlow outperforms autoregressive and masked-diffusion baselines by up to 8.46 percentage points on VQAv2 and 4.50 points on GQA without GQA training. On COCO Karpathy test, it improves CIDEr by 16.25 over masked diffusion and 17.81 over sampled autoregression.

AI.tldr: ViLFlow 将连续流匹配(continuous flow)与并行 token 解码结合，用于视觉-语言生成（VQA、图像描述），通过图像引导教师监督与预测感知 token 解码器提升性能。
AI.motivation: 自回归模型逐 token 生成慢，离散扩散在每步独立预测 token、缺乏联合结构；作者希望把连续空间联合建模与并行解码的优点结合，并迁移到多模态生成任务。
AI.method: 在输出 embedding 上做连续流联合建模并使用并行 token 解码；用视觉适配的教师模型提供图像引导预测作为额外去噪监督，使去噪器每步直接复现一个图像条件预测；token 解码器在去噪器预测与配对参考文本上训练，且可独立微调；描述任务中解码器在去噪后期回传文本反馈以指导精化。
AI.result: VQAv2 上比自回归与掩码扩散基线最高提升 8.46 个百分点，未用 GQA 训练即在 GQA 提升 4.50 点；COCO Karpathy 测试集 CIDEr 比掩码扩散高 16.25、比采样自回归高 17.81。
AI.conclusion: 连续流 + 并行解码的视觉-语言生成范式可行且有效，解码器解耦训练带来额外收益，文本反馈可进一步精化生成；但任务限于 VQA/描述，缺乏具身或 3D 世界模型验证。

title: Joint Image Denoising and Interpolation via Mixed Graph Filtering
summary: Images often require both denoising and interpolation, yet treating the two tasks separately is suboptimal: interpolation introduces correlated noise that complicates subsequent denoising, while denoising may remove image details useful for interpolation. In this paper, we study joint image denoising and interpolation from a mixed graph filtering perspective, where denoising is modeled using undirected graph filters and interpolation using directed graph filters. We first establish that, under mild conditions, any (pseudo-)linear denoiser and interpolator can be interpreted as solution filters of maximum a posteriori (MAP) estimation problems regularized by undirected and directed graph smoothness priors, respectively. Guided by these results, we formulate graph-based joint denoising and interpolation problems using both directed and undirected graph structures. We characterize when joint denoising/interpolation reduces to a separable pipeline and when a genuinely coupled optimization is required. For the non-separable case, we recover sparse graph operators from given denoisers and interpolators, yielding an efficient linear-system formulation solvable via conjugate gradient. Experimental results demonstrate that our proposed joint framework consistently outperforms separate denoising and interpolation pipelines across multiple denoiser-interpolator combinations.

AI.tldr: 从混合图滤波视角联合建模图像去噪（无向图滤波）与插值（有向图滤波），给出二者可解释为MAP解滤波器的条件，区分可分离流水线与真正耦合优化，并用共轭梯度求解。
AI.motivation: 去噪与插值分开处理非最优：插值引入的相关噪声干扰后续去噪，去噪又会抹去插值所需的细节。
AI.method: 证明温和条件下任意（伪）线性去噪器/插值器分别对应无向/有向图平滑先验MAP解滤波器；据此构建有向+无向图结构的联合去噪-插值问题，刻画可分离条件，并对不可分离情形从给定算子恢复稀疏图算子，得到可用共轭梯度高效求解的线性系统。
AI.result: 多种去噪器-插值器组合下，联合框架一致优于分离式流水线。
AI.conclusion: 联合图滤波框架提供了统一理论与可落地的线性求解器，验证耦合处理的必要性；属经典逆问题优化工作，与Physical AI/VLA/3D/机器人方向关联较弱。

title: End-to-End Landsat Land Surface Temperature Reconstruction with AlphaEarth Embeddings
summary: Land surface temperature (LST) data at Landsat's 30 m resolution is important for many applications, but cloud contamination prevents its spatially continuous observations. Here, we propose A$^2$E$^2$, an end-to-end U-Net that integrates annual temperature cycle (ATC), coarse LST from Earth system modeling, and AlphaEarth embeddings for Landsat LST reconstruction. The ATC supplies a physics-guided thermal prior, the coarse LST provides a temporal background, and the U-Net converts the embedding field into day-specific fine-scale correction using observed pixels. Experimental results on four seasonally distributed Landsat 8/9 scenes over New York City in 2022 show that A$^2$E$^2$ achieves 0.78 K mean absolute error and 1.01 K root mean squared error, reducing error by 60.1% relative to baseline method without spatial correction and by 3.7% relative to the same U-Net guided by annual mean spectral reflectance. Sensitivity analysis shows stable performance regardless of distance to clear pixels and percentage of blocked pixels. Independent validation with ECOSTRESS LST shows that Earth foundation model embeddings have better performance than annual mean spectral bands for LST reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 提出端到端 U-Net 框架 A²E²，融合年温度循环（ATC）物理先验、地球系统模式粗分辨率 LST 与 AlphaEarth 嵌入，用于 Landsat 30 m 地表温度重建。
AI.motivation: Landsat 30 m 地表温度（LST）受云污染影响，难以获得空间连续观测，需要有效的重建方法。
AI.method: 以 U-Net 为主干，ATC 模型提供物理引导的热先验，粗分辨率建模 LST 提供时间背景，并利用 AlphaEarth 地球基础模型嵌入场，将嵌入场转换为基于观测像元的逐日精细尺度校正。
AI.result: 纽约市 2022 年四个季节的 Landsat 8/9 场景上 MAE 0.78 K、RMSE 1.01 K，相比无空间校正基线降低误差 60.1%，相比以年均光谱反射率引导的同构 U-Net 降低 3.7%；对清晰像元距离和遮挡像元比例具有稳定性；ECOSTRESS LST 独立验证显示地球基础模型嵌入优于年均光谱波段。
AI.conclusion: 多源先验与地球基础模型嵌入相结合可有效重建云污染下的连续 LST；但仅在单一城市、少数场景上验证，未涉及代码/模型公开信息。

title: CommDreamer: Radio-Geometric World Models for Mapless Cellular-Connected UAV Trajectory Planning
summary: Reliable cellular connectivity and collision-free flight are essential for unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) operations in low-altitude urban canyons, where dense 3D buildings obstruct flight clearance, shadow serving base stations, and create strong co-channel interference at street intersections. Existing planners either require prior 3D city meshes and channel knowledge maps unavailable onboard, or rely on model-free reinforcement learning with low sample efficiency and poor cross-city generalization. We propose CommDreamer, a mapless radio-geometric world model that fuses raw onboard 3D LiDAR scans, multicell cellular reports, and shift-invariant relative kinematics to jointly infer local obstacle clearance and directional signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio (SINR) dynamics. Using a categorical recurrent state-space model, CommDreamer compresses multimodal measurement histories into a coordinate-invariant latent belief, enabling the UAV to foresee deep shadow zones and train a lightweight online policy purely via multi-step latent imagination without prior maps or antenna patterns. Zero-shot evaluations across unseen urban morphologies in our open-source ray-tracing simulator, AeroCity-RT, show that CommDreamer converges within 150 episodes where model-free reinforcement learning fails to complete flights, achieving 100.0% mission success with zero collisions while lifting median route SINR to 8.02 dB and cutting effective SINR outage by over 50% relative to radio-blind world-model and reactive LiDAR baselines.

AI.tldr: CommDreamer：面向城市峡谷UAV的无地图无线电-几何世界模型，融合机载LiDAR、多小区蜂窝报告与平移不变相对运动学，用分类循环状态空间模型压缩为坐标不变隐信念，纯靠多步潜空间想象训练轻量在线策略，实现100%任务成功率与零碰撞。
AI.motivation: 低空城市峡谷中3D建筑遮挡飞行空间、遮蔽基站并造成街口强同频干扰，可靠蜂窝连通与无碰撞飞行缺一不可；现有规划器要么依赖机载不可得的3D城市网格与信道地图，要么是无模型RL，样本效率低、跨城市泛化差。
AI.method: CommDreamer为无地图radio-geometric世界模型：输入原始机载3D LiDAR扫描、多小区蜂窝测量报告及平移不变相对运动学；采用分类型循环状态空间模型（categorical RSSM）将多模态量测历史压缩为坐标不变隐信念，联合推断局部障碍净空与有向SINR动态；在潜空间多步想象中训练轻量在线策略，无需先验地图或天线方向图。
AI.result: 在自建开源射线追踪仿真器AeroCity-RT的未见城市形态上做零样本评测：150回合内收敛（无模型RL无法完成飞行），任务成功率100.0%、零碰撞，中位路径SINR提升至8.02 dB，有效SINR中断相对radio-blind世界模型与反应式LiDAR基线降低逾50%。
AI.conclusion: 隐式世界模型+潜空间想象训练可在无先验地图与信道知识条件下统一处理几何避障与通信质量优化，并具备跨城市零样本泛化能力；主要局限是验证限于自研射线追踪仿真，尚缺真实飞行与真实蜂窝网络实验。

title: Allocentric Memory, Egocentric Acting: A Dual-Frame VLA for Urban Aerial Navigation
summary: Language-goal aerial navigation requires a UAV to reach a destination specified in natural language using observations collected during flight. A key challenge is linking changing egocentric perception with spatial evidence anchored to stable locations for long-range navigation. We propose CityNav-VLA, a dual-frame vision-language-action model for urban navigation integrating dynamic egocentric context with persistent allocentric spatial memory. The UAV incrementally accumulates visual observations on a fixed north-up map initialized with geographic and landmark priors, preserving evidence across viewpoint changes. A dynamic query conditioned on the instruction, current observations, UAV state, and motion history retrieves relevant memory evidence to predict a map-frame target. A deterministic controller converts this target into body-frame commands using the UAV's current pose, connecting global reasoning with egocentric execution. To reduce target fluctuations over long horizons, early goal commitment (EGC) fixes the execution target to the coordinate-wise median of the first $K$ predictions without extra trainable parameters. On Test Unseen, CityNav-VLA reduces NE by 21.2% and improves SR and SPL by 15.8% and 30.9%, respectively. It also reduces NE by 6.2% and improves SR and SPL by 5.6% and 23.2%, respectively, relative to the former SOTA after dataset refinement. Cumulative ablations show that navigation-map features yield the largest gains, while metric coordinates further improve endpoint accuracy. With a 4B-scale backbone, inference averages 0.68 s per decision with 8.6 GB peak memory on a single A100, presenting remarkable model efficiency.

AI.tldr: CityNav-VLA：双坐标系VLA模型，将动态自我中心观测与固定北向地图上的持久他中心空间记忆结合，实现语言目标的城市无人机长程导航。
AI.motivation: 语言目标空中导航的核心难点在于把不断变化的自我中心感知与锚定在稳定空间位置的证据关联起来，以支持长程导航；纯自我中心策略难以跨视角保持证据。
AI.method: 在初始化了地理与地标先验的固定北向地图上增量累积视觉观测，形成他中心空间记忆；用由指令、当前观测、UAV状态与运动历史条件化的动态查询检索相关记忆，预测地图坐标系目标；确定性控制器依据当前位姿转换为机体系指令；提出早目标承诺（EGC），将执行目标固定为前K次预测的坐标中位数，无额外可训练参数。
AI.result: Test Unseen上NE降低21.2%，SR与SPL分别提升15.8%和30.9%；数据集精炼后相对前SOTA NE降6.2%，SR/SPL升5.6%和23.2%。消融显示导航地图特征贡献最大，度量坐标进一步提升终点精度。4B骨干单卡A100平均每决策0.68 s，峰值显存8.6 GB。
AI.conclusion: 双坐标系（他中心地图记忆+自我中心执行）设计是长程语言导航的有效范式，EGC以零参数代价抑制长时程目标抖动，模型在效率与精度上均具竞争力。

title: One Shot, Any View: High-Fidelity Video Reshooting with Geometry Guidance and Visual References
summary: Filming a scene from an additional angle after production usually requires a costly reshoot. We present One Shot Any View, a system that takes a recorded clip and generates a reshot video of the same performance along a user-specified camera trajectory. As in recent geometry-grounded methods, the system conditions generation on the source video and an explicit 3D prior, namely a point video rendered along the requested trajectory from a feed-forward reconstruction of the source video. We target human-centric cinematic videos, which are often shot with long lenses, shallow depth of field, and low-key lighting, all of which degrade feed-forward reconstruction. Existing geometry-grounded methods tend to inherit the degraded point video, and their output quality drops visibly. Two designs make such point videos usable. First, in addition to rendered videos of 3D assets, we train on real-world multi-camera videos, whose point videos are produced by the same reconstruction pipeline as at inference. This training-inference consistency enables the generator to take only the composition of people and scene elements from the point video, and their appearance from the source video. Second, a geometry-anchored RoPE offset keeps the generated video temporally synchronized with the source while largely preventing the output from copying the degraded appearance of the point video. Meanwhile, since the generator is a pretrained reference-to-video (R2V) model, the system also accepts optional character and scene reference images, which supply the appearance of regions that the source never shows. In both objective and human evaluations, One Shot Any View outperforms existing reshooting methods.

AI.tldr: 提出 One Shot Any View：给定已拍摄视频与用户指定的相机轨迹，生成同一表演的"补拍"视频。基于前馈重建渲染的点视频作为3D先验，通过真实多机位视频训练（训练-推理一致）与几何锚定 RoPE 偏移，解决电影级长焦/浅景深/低调光场景下退化点视频带来的质量下降，并支持可选的角色/场景参考图补全未观测区域。
AI.motivation: 后期补拍镜头成本高昂（需重新组织拍摄）。现有 geometry-grounded 重拍方法在人体中心的电影级视频（长焦、浅景深、低调光）上，因前馈重建质量差而被点视频退化"传染"，输出质量明显下降。
AI.method: 1) 在真实世界多机位视频上训练，其点视频由与推理阶段相同的重建管线生成，实现训练-推理一致，使生成器只从点视频继承人物与场景布局（构图），外观取自源视频；2) 几何锚定 RoPE 偏移，保持生成视频与源视频的时间同步，同时抑制从退化点视频复制外观；3) 基于预训练 reference-to-video (R2V) 模型，可接收可选角色/场景参考图以补全源视频未拍摄区域的外观。
AI.result: 在客观指标与人工评测中，One Shot Any View 均优于现有重拍（reshooting）方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过训练-推理一致的真实数据训练与几何锚定的位置编码设计，可使退化点视频成为可用先验，实现低成本的单段视频任意视角补拍，并可扩展至参考图驱动的未观测区域生成。

title: Spark-H3: Adaptive Block Sparse Attention for Video Diffusion Models
summary: Long video sequences make attention a substantial cost in video diffusion models. Block sparse attention (BSA) reduces this cost by computing selected blocks exactly while compressing the remaining blocks. However, fixed token grouping can place tokens with dissimilar attention preferences in the same group, while uniform key averaging can underestimate the attention mass of compressed blocks. We introduce Spark-Attn, a training-free BSA method comprising Spark-Reblock and Spark-Reweight. Spark-Reblock recursively groups tokens by attention preference while preserving regular block shapes for efficient GPU execution. Spark-Reweight uses the global mean query as an anchor to construct attention-weighted key-value representations and logit biases for the compressed blocks, calibrating their attention mass. We instantiate Spark-Attn in MiniMax-H3 as Spark-H3. At 10% exact-block density, Spark-H3 delivers a 2.49$\times$ DiT speedup and reaches 24.81 dB PSNR against the corresponding dense outputs on MiniMax-H3 (20 denoising steps, 345 frames, 1344$\times$768). Increasing the density to 20% further improves PSNR to 26.76 dB while still achieving a 2.26$\times$ DiT speedup. These results demonstrate that Spark-H3 achieves a state-of-the-art quality-efficiency trade-off for training-free BSA on video diffusion models.

AI.tldr: Spark-Attn：一种免训练的块稀疏注意力方法，用基于注意力偏好的递归重分组（Spark-Reblock）与基于全局均值查询锚点的加权键值/偏置校准（Spark-Reweight）替代固定分组与均匀键平均，在视频扩散模型中实现质量-效率更优的权衡。
AI.motivation: 长视频序列使注意力成为视频扩散模型的主要开销。现有块稀疏注意力（BSA）存在两点缺陷：(1) 固定 token 分组会把注意力偏好差异大的 token 分到同一块；(2) 压缩块使用均匀键平均会低估其注意力质量（attention mass），导致精度损失。
AI.method: 免训练 BSA，包含两个组件：Spark-Reblock 按注意力偏好递归地对 token 分组，同时保持规整块形状以保证 GPU 执行效率；Spark-Reweight 以全局均值查询作为锚点，为压缩块构造注意力加权的键值表示与 logit 偏置，从而校准其注意力质量。在 MiniMax-H3 上实例化为 Spark-H3。
AI.result: 10% 精确块密度下，Spark-H3 在 MiniMax-H3（20 步去噪、345 帧、1344×768）上获得 2.49× DiT 加速，相对稠密输出达 24.81 dB PSNR；提升至 20% 密度时 PSNR 升至 26.76 dB，仍有 2.26× 加速。
AI.conclusion: Spark-H3 在免训练 BSA 场景下取得当前最优的质量-效率权衡，表明基于注意力偏好的重分组与加权校准能有效弥补固定分组和均匀平均的精度损失。

title: Towards Vacuum-Assisted Robotic Needle Interventions: From Fluid Aspiration to Tissue Biopsy
comment: 8 pages, 8 figures, Submitted to the 2027 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA)
summary: Robotic ultrasound-guided needle interventions have primarily focused on target localization and accurate needle placement, while the subsequent acquisition of diagnostic material remains comparatively underexplored. Moreover, pleural fluid aspiration and tissue biopsy are typically addressed as separate procedures, despite sharing common requirements for ultrasound guidance, safe access, and sample transport. This work presents a unified robotic framework for ultrasound-guided fluid and tissue extraction using a single vacuum-assisted end effector. The proposed system combines force controlled ultrasound scanning, semantic target identification, automated needle deployment, and procedure specific material acquisition. A coaxial needle assembly and shared pump assisted pathway enable direct pleural fluid aspiration, while controlled cannula actuation provides the additional cutting action required for solid-tissue acquisition. End-to-end evaluation using a Franka Emika Panda robot over 50 phantom trials achieved successful extraction in 23/25 pleural fluid aspiration trials (92\%) and 22/25 tissue acquisition trials (88\%). Following successful tissue-target access, acquisition and transport were completed in all 22 trials.

AI.tldr: 提出统一的机器人超声引导抽吸/活检框架：单一真空辅助末端执行器结合力控超声扫描、语义目标识别、自动进针，通过同轴针组件+共享泵通路实现胸腔积液抽吸，通过可控套管驱动增加切割动作实现实体组织取样。体模50次试验：抽液23/25（92%），组织取样22/25（88%）。
AI.motivation: 机器人超声引导针刺研究多集中于目标定位与精准置针，后续诊断材料的获取（抽液、活检）被显著忽视；且积液抽吸与组织活检通常被当作两个独立流程处理，尽管二者共享超声引导、安全入路与样本输运等共性需求。
AI.method: 单一真空辅助末端执行器统一两类任务：力控超声扫描（force controlled scanning）、语义目标识别、自动进针部署、按流程定制材料获取；同轴针组件与共享泵通路实现直接抽液，套管（cannula）受控驱动提供额外切割动作以取实体组织。Franka Emika Panda 机器人上完成端到端50次体模验证。
AI.result: 抽液成功率92%（23/25），组织取样成功率88%（22/25）；在成功到达组织目标后的22次试验中，取样与输运全部完成。
AI.conclusion: 单一硬件构型可复用共享的超声引导、安全入路与真空-输运通路，实现抽液与活检的统一机器人化；后续需在真实组织/活体条件下验证泛化性与安全性。

title: Do Thinking VLMs Need to Keep Looking at Long Videos? Write It Down, Then Look Away
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) reason about long videos over hundreds to thousands of tokens. Every decoding step re-reads the key-value (KV) cache of the entire video. Must the model keep looking while it reasons? In LookAway, the model first writes timestamped notes on what the question needs and then puts the video away. Once the notes close, the inference engine hides the video's KV cache for the rest of the response. Across both hybrid and pure-attention VLMs, dependence on the video is concentrated early in the response. On Qwen3.6-27B, writing notes preserves accuracy better than free reasoning at the same withdrawal step. Replacing them with another video's notes harms accuracy, whereas keeping the video visible alongside the model's own notes adds no significant benefit. Without additional training, LookAway nearly matches full-video thinking accuracy at 0.12-0.13 times its modeled decode cost. To shorten this initial look, we fine-tune the model on its own correct LookAway responses. Reinforcement learning then rewards correct answers while penalizing KV reads. The trained model puts the video away after a median of 66-68 tokens. Across three held-out benchmarks, it writes more tokens than an identically trained full-video model yet reads only 27-35% as many KV positions at matched accuracy.

AI.tldr: LookAway：让视频VLM先写出带时间戳的笔记，随后隐藏视频KV cache继续推理；无训练即可在0.12–0.13倍解码成本下逼近全视频精度，经微调+RL后中位66–68 token即"放下视频"，KV读取量降至27–35%。
AI.motivation: 长视频VLM推理需在数百到数千token的KV cache上逐解码步重读视频，算力/显存开销巨大；作者观察到对视频的依赖集中在回答早期，因而探索"能否在推理中途撤掉视频"。
AI.method: 两步法：1) LookAway推理范式——模型先写出带时间戳、针对问题的笔记，引擎随即屏蔽视频KV cache，后续生成仅依赖笔记与文本上下文；在混合与纯注意力VLM上验证，并做笔记替换/视频保留等消融。2) 训练——先在自己正确的LookAway回答上微调以缩短"观看"阶段，再用强化学习奖励答案正确、惩罚KV读取，压缩首次观看到约66–68 token。
AI.result: Qwen3.6-27B上写笔记比同一撤回步的自由推理更能保精度；换成他人视频笔记会掉点，而笔记+视频同看无显著增益；无需训练即达全视频精度、解码成本0.12–0.13倍；训练后在三个留出基准上以27–35%的KV位置读取量达到相当精度，且生成token数多于同等训练的全视频模型。
AI.conclusion: 长视频VLM的视觉依赖是"前重后轻"的，显式笔记可作为可迁移的压缩记忆；结合SFT+RL可学到极短的观看预算，实现大幅KV效率收益而几乎不损精度。方法属推理效率/机制分析类，与具身感知、3D重建主线无直接方法关联。

title: Look Closer, Look Back, or Wait for Agentic Streaming Video Understanding
summary: Streaming video models must answer questions about a live video under strict memory and latency limits. Feeding only the latest few frames keeps present perception sharp, whereas adding past frames dilutes attention on the current scene and triggers hallucinations. Recent cascade methods retrieve past frames when uncertain, but they still fail when current frames are blurry or when decisive future clues have not appeared yet. We introduce ActiveForager, a streaming video agent that maintains a clean short working window and gathers extra evidence only on demand. For each query, the agent either answers directly, zooms into high-resolution recent frames, recalls past events from memory, or waits for upcoming frames. When recalling history, a shared-weight sub-agent verifies candidate clips in isolation and returns a compact evidence summary. A stream-decoupled attention mask then keeps historical evidence from interfering with present visual tokens. We train this policy using counterfactual information gain, which rewards a tool call only when the gathered evidence makes the true answer more likely and prevents tool collapse across all actions. Across Qwen2.5-VL-7B and Qwen3-VL-8B on OVO-Bench, ActiveForager improves real-time perception, historical recall, and proactive response at once, lifting overall accuracy on Qwen3-VL-8B from 47.6% to 65.9%. It also doubles zero-shot accuracy on the multi-hop Video-Holmes benchmark while adding minimal visual tokens per query.

AI.tldr: ActiveForager：面向流式视频问答的按需取证智能体，维护干净的短工作窗口，按查询动态选择直接作答/高清放大/历史回忆/等待未来帧，配合共享权重的验证子智能体与流解耦注意力掩码，并用反事实信息增益训练工具调用策略。
AI.motivation: 流式视频模型受严格内存与延迟约束：只看几帧会丢失历史，加入历史帧又会稀释当前场景注意力导致幻觉；现有级联检索方法在当前帧模糊或关键线索尚未出现时失效。
AI.method: 提出主动取证的流式视频智能体：短时工作窗口 + 按需四类动作（直接回答、高清放大、记忆回忆、等待未来帧）；回忆时以共享权重子智能体隔离验证候选片段并输出紧凑证据摘要；流解耦注意力掩码防止历史证据干扰当前视觉 token；以反事实信息增益奖励塑造策略，抑制工具坍缩。
AI.result: 在 OVO-Bench 上同时提升实时感知、历史回忆与前瞻响应，Qwen3-VL-8B 总体准确率由 47.6% 提升至 65.9%（Qwen2.5-VL-7B 亦提升）；Video-Holmes 多跳基准零样本准确率翻倍，且每查询额外视觉 token 很少。
AI.conclusion: 按需取证+证据隔离注意力+信息增益策略学习是解决流式视频长程推理的有效范式，但本文属通用视频智能体，与具身导航/VLA/3D 重建/世界模型等核心方向仅有间接联系。

title: Old Experience, New Lessons: Relabeling Autonomous Robot Rollouts in Interactive Imitation Learning
summary: Interactive imitation learning enables robots to learn from human interventions during deployment. These interactions naturally produce sparse human corrections and abundant autonomous robot experience without human action labels. Yet existing methods either leave this experience unused for action supervision or imitate historical robot actions, which can reinforce suboptimal behavior. To address this limitation, we propose Set-valued Relabeling of Autonomous experience (SeRA), a framework that learns from autonomous robot experience through set-valued supervision of policy relabels. Later policy checkpoints relabel this experience, and agreement across checkpoints filters the relabels. Since agreement does not guarantee correctness, SeRA constructs desired action sets around accepted relabels. Following Set-Supervised Diffusion Policy (SDP), it trains an action-chunking diffusion policy to increase the probability of actions within these sets. A step-masked denoising loss combines accepted relabels with available human corrections in partially supervised chunks. Experiments across five simulated manipulation tasks in online and offline settings show that SeRA improves policy performance over SDP and outperforms baselines that imitate historical robot actions or exact relabels. On a real-robot tomato-picking task, SeRA achieves 80% success, compared with 40% for SDP, using the same human feedback and training budget. These results demonstrate that relabeled autonomous robot experience can complement human corrections to improve policy performance.

AI.tldr: 提出 SeRA 框架，利用多策略检查点对自主机器人经验进行集合值重标注（set-valued relabeling），并以 set-supervised diffusion policy 训练动作块扩散策略，在人机交互模仿学习中提升性能。
AI.motivation: 交互式模仿学习中，人类干预产生的纠正稀疏，而机器人自主经验数量丰富却缺乏动作标签；现有方法要么不利用这些经验，要么直接模仿历史机器人动作，会强化次优行为。
AI.method: SeRA 用后续策略检查点重标注自主经验，通过检查点间一致性筛选可靠重标注；因一致性不等于正确性，围绕被接受的重标注构造"期望动作集合"，遵循 Set-Supervised Diffusion Policy 训练动作块扩散策略以提升集合内动作概率；对部分监督的动作块使用步掩码去噪损失，融合重标注与人类纠正。
AI.result: 五个仿真操作任务（在线与离线设置）中优于 SDP 及模仿历史动作或精确重标注的基线；真机番茄采摘任务成功率 80%，对比 SDP 的 40%（相同人类反馈与训练预算）。
AI.conclusion: 重标注的自主机器人经验可有效补充人类纠正，从而提升策略性能。

title: Semantic Guidance for Joint Infrared-Visible Video Fusion and Frame Interpolation
summary: Infrared and visible video fusion at high frame rates requires recovering missing observations when camera rates differ or fall below the desired output rate. Cascading interpolation and fusion can accumulate errors and cause brightness fluctuations. Motion and occlusion further complicate content selection, particularly when missing visible frames also remove direct semantic guidance. We propose SAFI, which uses semantics at the target time to guide joint interpolation and fusion. When the visible frame rate exceeds the infrared rate, available visible frames provide semantic context directly. At times without visible observations, motion guides local matching, and propagation recovers semantics from neighboring frames. Semantic context complements aligned image features at the target time, while matching confidence helps select reliable infrared and visible information. Reconstruction and fusion share source selection within each scale, allowing supervision on missing frames to guide fusion. To preserve visible appearance and reduce flicker, we bound thermal enhancement and penalize brightness inconsistencies across frames while accounting for changes in thermal contrast. Experiments on three datasets show improved visual quality with less computation than cascaded baselines and consistent temporal gains when input rates differ. SAFI maintains strong downstream tracking performance despite missing frames. The code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: SAFI：用目标时刻语义引导红外与可见光视频的联合插值与融合，替代“先插值后融合”的级联流程，在缺帧、双模态帧率不一致条件下提升视觉质量、降低计算量并抑制闪烁，同时保持下游跟踪性能。
AI.motivation: 高帧率红外-可见光视频融合常需在相机帧率不同或低于目标输出帧率时补全缺失观测。级联“插值→融合”会累积误差并引发亮度波动；运动与遮挡使内容选择困难，而缺失可见光帧会同时丢失直接的语义引导。作者希望用目标时刻的语义信息统一次引导插值与融合。
AI.method: 提出SAFI框架：（1）可见光帧率高于红外时，直接用已有可见光帧提供目标时刻语义上下文；无可见光观测时，由运动引导局部匹配并从邻帧传播恢复语义；（2）语义上下文与目标时刻对齐的图像特征互补，匹配置信度用于可靠地选择红外/可见光信息；（3）多尺度内重建与融合共享同一源选择，使缺失帧上的监督信号可直接指导融合；（4）为保留可见光外观并抑制闪烁，对热增强做上界约束，并对跨帧亮度不一致施加惩罚，同时考虑热对比度的变化。
AI.result: 在三个数据集上，视觉质量优于级联基线且计算量更少；输入帧率不一致时获得稳定的时序增益；在存在缺失帧的情况下仍保持较强的下游跟踪性能；代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 将语义引导的匹配/传播与多尺度共享源选择耦合，是对红外-可见光融合中缺帧与异步帧率问题的一种有效单阶段替代方案，兼顾效率与时间一致性。

title: QDD-MM: A Simple and Compact Open-Source Muscle Module with Quasi-Direct-Drive Motor for Tendon-driven Robots
comment: Accepted to IEEE-RAS Humanoids 2026, website - this https URL , youtube - this https URL
summary: Tendon-driven robots, which actuate like biological muscles by using motors to wind wires, offer advantages such as variable stiffness and redundant actuation. Despite these advantages, musculoskeletal structures inherently involve a large number of diverse muscles, making it desirable to compactly modularize each muscle unit and flexibly accommodate diverse muscle arrangements. While various small muscle modules have been proposed to date, existing designs tend to be complex, difficult to maintain, and suffer from low backdrivability and limited actuation speed due to their high gear ratios. In this work, we propose QDD-MM, a muscle module that leverages recent advances in quasi-direct-drive motors to achieve a simpler and more compact structure with higher backdrivability and faster actuation than previous modules. By utilizing quasi-direct-drive motors, the module eliminates the need for dedicated force-sensing mechanisms, significantly simplifying the overall design, while also supporting flexible wire routing in multiple directions, various module-to-module connections, and even the use of the module body itself as a structural component. QDD-MM integrates these capabilities into a reusable muscle module, and its design is openly available at this https URL . We developed tendon-driven robots with one joint and either two or three muscles, as well as a partial musculoskeletal humanoid, using the proposed QDD-MM and verified their effectiveness. We expect that this muscle module will democratize tendon-driven robotics and further accelerate progress in the field.

AI.tldr: 提出 QDD-MM 肌腱驱动机器人肌肉模块，基于准直驱电机实现结构简化、紧凑化与高背驱性，并支持多方向走线、模块互连与作为结构件复用。
AI.motivation: 现有小型肌肉模块结构复杂、难维护，且因高减速比导致背驱性差、驱动速度低，难以支撑多肌肉、多样布置的肌骨式紧凑模块化需求。
AI.method: 采用准直驱（quasi-direct-drive）电机作为驱动源，利用其天然的力矩-电流关系免除专用力传感机构，从而简化设计；模块支持多方向柔性走线、多种模块间连接方式，并可将模块本体用作结构件；设计开源。
AI.result: 构建了单关节、含两至三条肌肉的肌腱驱动机器人，以及部分肌骨式人形机器人，验证了模块的有效性。
AI.conclusion: QDD-MM 以更简单紧凑的结构提供更优背驱性与更快驱动速度，有望降低肌腱驱动机器人的门槛并推动该领域进展。

title: Remote Teleoperation of Endovascular Robots: A Network Emulation Framework for Systematic Performance Evaluation
summary: Remote endovascular teleoperation requires network performance to be evaluated in relation to physical navigation and operator experience, while the effects of network degradation on the usability of remote endovascular systems remain insufficiently characterized from the perspective of clinical users. We developed a network emulation and benchmarking framework that combines an endovascular robot with data streaming. We conducted a user study involving eight clinicians from interventional neuroradiology and general interventional radiology and eight engineering students, who performed 480 navigation attempts across 15 network conditions. Communication performance and received video quality were assessed alongside navigation outcomes, confidence, workload and clinician rated acceptability. Under the most impaired combined condition, success was 78.1\%, compared with 93.8\% under the reference condition, and mean attempt time increased from 63.5 to 94.3\,s. At 5\% configured packet loss, 87.5\% of attempts succeeded, although all eight clinicians rated the condition unacceptable. Perceived video quality was associated with clinician confidence and acceptability, with mean within participant Spearman correlations of 0.72 and 0.78, respectively. Framework integration on a second robotic platform additionally supported successful remote navigation over a real network. Our framework provides a reusable basis that can help identify communication bottlenecks and assess their effects on navigation and clinician acceptance for endovascular intervention telesurgery tasks.

AI.tldr: 开发血管内机器人远程操作的网络仿真与基准测试框架，联合8名临床医生与8名学生完成480次导航试验，覆盖15种网络条件，量化通信指标、视频质量与导航成功率、信心、负荷及可接受性。
AI.motivation: 远程血管内介入对网络性能与物理导航、操作者体验的耦合关系缺乏临床用户视角的系统刻画，亟需可复用的评估方法来识别通信瓶颈。
AI.method: 构建端到端网络仿真+数据流基准框架（血管内机器人+视频流），进行16人用户研究（8名介入放射临床医生、8名工程学生），跨15种网络条件共480次导航尝试；同步采集通信性能、接收视频质量、导航结果、信心、工作负荷与临床可接受性评分，并在第二个机器人平台上验证真实网络下的远程导航。
AI.result: 最差复合条件下成功率78.1%（参考条件93.8%），平均尝试时间63.5s→94.3s；5%配置丢包下成功率仍达87.5%，但8名临床医生全部判定不可接受；感知视频质量与信心、可接受性的组内Spearman相关均值分别为0.72和0.78；框架在第二平台真实网络下成功实现远程导航。
AI.conclusion: 提出可复用的网络仿真与基准评估框架，可将通信瓶颈与导航性能、临床可接受性定量关联；成功率的容忍区间与主观可接受性阈值存在显著错位，仅以任务成功率为指标不足以评估遥操作可用性。

title: CROMPT: Adapting CLIP via Cross-Modal Prompting for Robust Zero-Shot Generalization under Adverse Weather
summary: Domain adaptation for semantic segmentation is challenging when target-domain images are unavailable during training. Zero-shot domain adaptation addresses this by adapting models using only textual descriptions of the target domain. However, existing prompt-learning methods are not well suited for ResNet-based CLIP vision backbones or pixel-level cross-modal feature alignment. We propose CROMPT, a prompt-learning framework for zero-shot domain adaptation in semantic segmentation. CROMPT introduces Cross-Modal Feature Augmentation (CROMA), combining Random Visual Prompting with Hybrid Textual Prompting (HTP) to jointly adapt visual and textual representations. We further propose CROMA-VL, which leverages vision-language models to generate domain-conditioned prompts, and a progressive easy-to-hard adaptation strategy for improved domain invariance. Experiments on two benchmark datasets demonstrate consistent improvements over strong baselines and state-of-the-art methods, achieving 1.63-2.63% mIoU gains while maintaining inference-time complexity. These results establish CROMPT as an effective and efficient framework for zero-shot multi-domain semantic segmentation. OpenReview: this https URL

AI.tldr: CROMPT：面向语义分割零样本域自适应的提示学习框架，提出跨模态特征增强（CROMA）、视觉-语言提示生成（CROMA-VL）与由易到难的渐进适配策略。
AI.motivation: 训练时目标域图像不可用，现有提示学习方法不适配基于ResNet的CLIP视觉骨干，也难以支持像素级跨模态特征对齐。
AI.method: 随机视觉提示 + 混合文本提示（HTP）联合调整视觉与文本表征；CROMA-VL利用视觉-语言模型生成域条件提示；配合渐进式易到难适配策略提升域不变性。
AI.result: 在两个基准数据集上相较强基线与SOTA方法稳定提升，mIoU增益1.63–2.63%，且推理复杂度不增加。
AI.conclusion: CROMPT为高效有效的零样本多域语义分割框架。

title: AnchorUp: Anchoring Feature Upsampling on a Classical Interpolation
comment: Accepted to WACV 2027. Code: this https URL
summary: Vision foundation models produce semantically strong features on a coarse patch grid, and dense prediction needs them at pixel resolution. Existing learned upsamplers close that gap by regressing the high-resolution feature map from the low-resolution one, typically through cross-attention driven by the input image. We observe that most of what they regress needs no learning: plain bilinear interpolation already reproduces the smooth regions of the target, and recent benchmarks even report bilinear and bicubic on par with several learned upsamplers. The rest is mostly edges and fine details, which suggests that these learned upsamplers spend much of their capacity re-computing the smooth content that classical interpolation provides. We therefore introduce AnchorUp, which stops predicting the high-resolution feature map and predicts only its correction from the interpolation. It keeps a parameter-free classical upsampler as an anchor, obtains a second prediction from a small guidance network, and blends the two through a single learnable scalar gate. Because the anchor supplies the smooth content, the guidance network only has to correct what remains. An analysis of the learned correction confirms that it concentrates on edges and fine details, and so the network can be small: AnchorUp uses 167,425 parameters, a quarter of the budget of the strongest baseline, NAF, and runs at 64% of its latency. Trained once on DINOv3 with only the first of NAF's two training stages, and evaluated on that backbone plus six held-out ones, it is already on par with NAF trained through both stages on Pascal VOC and Cityscapes. Our method surpasses it on DAVIS-2017 video object segmentation; the gain holds on every backbone and is larger in contour accuracy F. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: AnchorUp将稠密预测中的特征上采样重构为"经典插值锚点+小网络残差校正"，用167K参数(NAF的1/4)、64%延迟，仅一阶段训练即在Pascal VOC/Cityscapes上与NAF两阶段持平，并在DAVIS-2017视频目标分割上超越，且跨7个backbone泛化。
AI.motivation: 视觉基础模型输出的是粗patch网格上的语义强特征，稠密预测需要像素级分辨率。现有学习式上采样器通过交叉注意力从低分辨率特征回归高分辨率特征图，但作者观察到其回归的大部分内容（平滑区域）无需学习——双线性/双三次插值已可复现，甚至有benchmark显示其性能与多个学习式上采样器相当；真正需要学习的是边缘与细节，因此学习式上采样器大量容量被浪费在重算经典插值已能提供的平滑内容上。
AI.method: 提出AnchorUp：不再直接预测高分辨率特征图，而只预测其相对插值的校正量。结构上包含(1)无参数经典上采样器作为锚点(anchor)，(2)一个小型引导网络(guidance network)给出第二个预测，(3)通过单个可学习标量门控(scalar gate)融合二者。由于锚点提供平滑内容，引导网络只需校正残差，因而可极小化。作者还分析了学习到的校正分布以验证其集中于边缘与细细节。
AI.result: AnchorUp仅167,425参数，为最强基线NAF的1/4预算，推理延迟为其64%。仅在DINOv3上训练且只使用NAF两阶段训练中的第一阶段，在Pascal VOC与Cityscapes上即与NAF两阶段训练持平；在DAVIS-2017视频目标分割上超过NAF，该增益在全部backbone上成立，且在轮廓精度F上增益更大；共在DINOv3加六个held-out backbone上评估。
AI.conclusion: 将上采样分解为"免参数插值锚点+轻量残差校正"是一种高效替代端到端特征回归的范式，显著降低参数与训练成本（单阶段）而不损精度，并在边缘敏感的轮廓指标上获益；代码已开源。属于通用视觉表征工具，对下游稠密预测方法有直接可复用的工程价值，但不涉及物理AI/机器人本体任务。

title: Proprioceptive Simultaneous Base and Terrain Elevation Estimation for Legged Robot Locomotion
summary: Legged robots in visually degraded environments must rely exclusively on proprioceptive sensing, under which global position and yaw are unobservable. Vertical drift is particularly detrimental, as it corrupts the height reference required by swing-leg trajectories and can destabilize the robot. We treat the terrain itself as a persistent proprioceptive landmark: every footstep provides a height measurement that anchors the vertical axis. We propose Simultaneous Base and Elevation Estimation (SBEE), a real-time open-source framework in which a Left-Invariant Extended Kalman Filter (LI-EKF) for floating-base estimation and a grid-based elevation map are coupled in a bidirectional loop, mirroring SLAM with terrain elevation in place of landmarks. Stable foot contacts insert uncertainty-aware height samples into the map, and previously mapped cells are fed back as uncertainty-weighted vertical pseudo-measurements that act analogously to loop closures. Unlike contact-aided invariant filters, the LI-EKF consumes a kinematic velocity measurement instead of augmenting the state with a contact model per leg, so its state dimension is independent of the number of legs. We evaluate SBEE in MuJoCo on quadrupedal and bipedal platforms and on the ANYmal-D GrandTour dataset over 296 m of locomotion, reducing the absolute trajectory error by 22.1% relative to the best of three state-of-the-art proprioceptive estimators.

AI.tldr: 提出SBEE实时开源框架，将LI-EKF浮基状态估计与栅格高程图双向耦合，把地形高程当作本体感知地标来消除视觉退化环境下的竖直漂移。
AI.motivation: 在视觉退化环境中腿部机器人只能依赖本体感知，此时全局位置与偏航不可观，竖直漂移会破坏摆动腿轨迹所需的高度基准并导致失稳。作者希望利用每一步落脚本身提供的高度信息来锚定竖直轴。
AI.method: 将地形视为持久本体感知地标：Left-Invariant EKF负责浮动基估计，与栅格高程图构成双向闭环，类比以地形高程代替路标的SLAM。稳定足端接触将带不确定度的高度采样写入地图，已建图单元作为不确定度加权的竖直伪观测反馈给滤波器，类似回环约束。与contact-aided invariant filter不同，LI-EKF直接使用运动学速度量测，不按腿扩展接触模型，状态维度与腿数无关。
AI.result: 在MuJoCo中于四足与双足平台验证，并在ANYmal-D GrandTour数据集上覆盖296 m行走；相对三种SOTA本体感知估计器中的最佳者，绝对轨迹误差降低22.1%。
AI.conclusion: 把落脚高度作为持续地标并与高程图做双向耦合，可有效抑制视觉缺失下的竖直漂移，且实现与腿数无关、可实时运行并开源。

title: Fuse to Recognize the Unseen: Class-Relative Infrared-Visible Fusion for Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation
summary: Visible-infrared image fusion leverages complementary thermal cues to enhance visual perception, particularly under challenging illumination. However, such perceptual complementarity does not readily translate into semantic gains in open-vocabulary semantic segmentation (OVSS), where CLIP-based models are predominantly pretrained on RGB imagery. Directly introducing IR information may instead disrupt RGB-language alignment, turning promising thermal cues into semantic interference that undermines unseen-class recognition. Our pixel-level RGB-IR semantic analysis reveals that class-relevant thermal cues can correct certain RGB misclassifications while preserving reliable RGB predictions, motivating RGB-anchored, class-relative thermal cue selection. Based on this insight, we propose EmergeFuse, an infrared-visible fusion framework for OVSS that selectively converts complementary thermal evidence into unseen-class semantic corrections. Specifically, class-relative cue selection evaluates RGB-IR semantic responses and calibrated thermal evidence relative to RGB predictions, generating class-relative correction requests through competitive selection. Text-contrast image rectification then translates these selected requests into semantic rectification directions through text contrasts, guiding evidence-gated feature updates to realize complementary thermal evidence for unseen-class recognition. Experiments on three benchmarks demonstrate gains of up to 4.755% in unseen-class mIoU and 15.730% in strict complementary conversion rate over existing fusion methods, while maintaining competitive fusion quality.

AI.tldr: 提出 EmergeFuse，用"类别相对的热线索选择 + 文本对比图像校正"把 RGB-IR 互补热信息转化为开放词表语义分割（OVSS）中未见类别的语义纠正，避免直接融合破坏 CLIP 的 RGB-语言对齐。
AI.motivation: CLIP 类 OVSS 模型主要在 RGB 图像上预训练，直接引入红外信息会破坏 RGB-语言对齐，使热线索变成语义干扰。像素级 RGB-IR 语义分析显示：类相关热线索能纠正部分 RGB 误分类，同时不损害可靠的 RGB 预测，因而需要"以 RGB 为锚、类别相对"的热线索选择。
AI.method: 1）类别相对线索选择：将 RGB-IR 语义响应与标定后的热证据相对 RGB 预测进行评估，通过竞争性选择生成类别相对的纠正请求；2）文本对比图像校正：用文本对比把选中的请求转成语义纠正方向，引导证据门控的特征更新，实现面向未见类的互补热证据注入。
AI.result: 在三个基准上，未见类 mIoU 最高提升 4.755%，严格互补转换率最高提升 15.730%，同时保持有竞争力的融合质量。
AI.conclusion: 红外-可见光融合对 OVSS 的价值不在提升视觉质量，而在于以 RGB 为锚点选择性地纠正未见类语义；该方法可兼顾融合质量与开放词表识别性能。

title: Pixel2Perspective: A Benchmark for Multi-Modal and Multi-View Generalization in Vision-Language Models
summary: Embodied AI systems, such as drones and autonomous vehicles, improve navigation by enhancing perception in environments containing unseen objects. While Visual Language Models (VLMs) offer strong image understanding, their real-world application is underexplored. For effective deployment, open-vocabulary semantic segmentation (OVSS) models, leveraging models like CLIP to assign pixel-level labels from text, must be robust to outdoor conditions, adverse weather, and varying viewpoints. Despite their potential, these models encounter significant challenges in cross-domain generalization, hindering their practical use in embodied AI applications. In this work, we present Pixel2Perspective, a benchmark for multi-angle object localization and open-vocabulary segmentation across both aerial and ground perspectives. This benchmark supports thorough evaluation across different viewpoints and sensor modalities. We assess foundational models like CLIP and advanced OVSS models using a curated dataset that spans varied outdoor conditions, sim-to-real scenarios, and multiple sensors, including infrared, to support the development of robust and generalizable perception systems. We also present a novel framework, Multi-Source RGB-IR Uncertainty Quantification (MSRIQ), which jointly models aleatoric and epistemic uncertainties across RGB and infrared imagery. This approach supports robust evaluation of open-vocabulary segmentation models across diverse environmental conditions. Our work sets a robustness-driven benchmark, providing key insights and laying the foundation for future research in open-world embodied AI perception. The benchmark and project page are available at this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出 Pixel2Perspective 跨视角（航拍+地面）开词汇分割与目标定位基准，并给出 MSRIQ 框架在 RGB-IR 上联合建模偶然/认知不确定性以评估 OVSS 鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 具身智能（无人机、自动驾驶）需在未见物体、恶劣天气与多视角下可靠感知，而 CLIP 类开词汇语义分割（OVSS）模型跨域泛化差，缺乏覆盖多视角、多传感器、仿真到现实条件的系统性评测手段。
AI.method: 构建 Pixel2Perspective 基准：航拍与地面多视角、多模态（含红外）数据，涵盖多样室外条件与 sim-to-real 场景；评测 CLIP 等基础模型与先进 OVSS 模型；提出 Multi-Source RGB-IR Uncertainty Quantification（MSRIQ），在 RGB 与红外模态上联合建模偶然不确定性与认知不确定性。
AI.result: 摘要未给出具体量化指标，主要贡献为提供跨视角、跨模态的鲁棒性评测协议与不确定性量化框架，并总结 OVSS 模型在不同视角与传感器下的失效模式与关键观察。
AI.conclusion: 工作定位为鲁棒性驱动的基准与方法框架，为开放世界具身 AI 感知的后续研究提供基础，但缺乏下游导航任务闭环与实机部署验证。

title: Can Weight-Space Programming Alter Learned Ethical Priorities?
summary: We investigate whether a weight edit can alter how a model trades off honoring a commitment against benefiting more people. In a concept-supervised text model, we alter fitted choice weights so that the benefit required to override a formal pledge is larger than for an ordinary promise. Across six independently trained text readers, the edit selects the larger group in both orders on 100% of targeted ordinary conflicts and 83.3% of targeted formal conflicts. It preserves the source model's success rates on smaller conflicts and its factual accuracy. The remaining formal-conflict failures coincide with errors reading a beneficiary number. A separate classifier demonstrates why this distinction matters: reusing a factual answer passes an unconditional choice test but fails to preserve small-gap promises. In a YOLO11n pilot on COCO128, a bias edit increased small-target matches from 3/43 to 9/43, and an equivalent score calibration reproduced the retained detections. These exploratory results show a way to test selective changes to learned priorities in a model with an exposed trade-off mechanism. Whether the method can discover such changes in less structured language models remains open.

AI.tldr: 通过概念监督的权重编辑，可选择性改变文本模型在"守约"与"惠及更多人"之间的权衡优先级，并在YOLO11n上验证了类似的偏置编辑对检测的影响。
AI.motivation: 探索能否通过直接的权重编辑（而非重训练）改变模型学到的价值/优先级权衡机制，并检验这种改变是否具有选择性与可解释性。
AI.method: 在概念监督的文本选择模型中，调整拟合的选择权重，使"推翻正式承诺所需的最小受益量"高于普通承诺；在六个独立训练文本读取器上验证，并与无条件选择分类器对比；另做YOLO11n/COCO128的偏置编辑试点，用小目标匹配数与等效分数校准做对照。
AI.result: 六组读取器中，目标普通冲突100%、目标正式冲突83.3%选到更大受益群体；小冲突成功率与事实准确率保持不变；剩余失败与受益人数字读取错误相关；无条件选择测试虽通过，但无法保留小差距承诺；YOLO11n小目标匹配从3/43提升到9/43，分数校准复现了保留的检测。
AI.conclusion: 权重编辑可在暴露权衡机制的模型中实现选择性偏好改变，该方法能否推广到结构较弱的语言模型仍待研究。

title: OCTR2A: Real-Time RGB-to-BEV Trajectory Projection and Forecasting at Urban Intersections
summary: Trajectory forecasting at urban intersections is often studied assuming that reliable bird's-eye-view (BEV) motion histories are available, which in practice requires costly resources such as LiDAR, aerial views, HD maps, or calibrated infrastructure. We address this upstream perception-to-forecasting problem by reconstructing and predicting agents' BEV trajectories only from paired opposite-corner RGB cameras mounted on existing urban infrastructure at variable heights at inference time. We introduce the Opposite-Corner Trajectory Reconstruction and Anticipation Architecture (OCTR2A), a modular pipeline integrating per-view detection with class refinement, geometric cross-camera matching, transformer-based BEV projection, and egocentric GRU forecasting, trained in cascade and mainly supervised with a soft multi-scale spatial-overlap loss. Since no public benchmark provides this sensing configuration, we introduce R3ST++, a Blender-based synthetic benchmark built from SIND trajectories that provides synchronized opposite-corner views, cross-view correspondences, and BEV ground truth, while also serving as a deployment-support simulator for site-specific fine-tuning. Experiments on these datasets show that, with 12 observed and 12 predicted frames at 10\,Hz, OCTR2A achieves projection~-~forecasting ADE/FDE of 0.144/0.140~-~0.154/0.241~meters in real time on a single consumer GPU. Evaluated on ground-truth BEV histories, the forecasting module improves over the strongest state-of-the-art methods on SIND by 66.7\%/41.7\% ADE/FDE. Transfer experiments on TUMTraf-V2X show that R3ST++ pretraining supports adaptation to real-world roadside domains with different sensing configurations.

AI.tldr: OCTR2A: 仅用一对对角安装的 RGB 摄像头，端到端重建并预测 BEV 轨迹，配合合成基准 R3ST++。
AI.motivation: 城市路口轨迹预测研究普遍假设已有可靠 BEV 运动历史，实际部署却依赖 LiDAR、航拍、HD 地图或标定设施等昂贵资源。作者希望直接从既有基础设施上的成对对角 RGB 相机完成"感知—预测"上游问题。
AI.method: 模块化流水线：逐视角检测+类别精炼 → 几何跨相机匹配 → Transformer BEV 投影 → 自车坐标 GRU 预测；级联训练，主要监督为软多尺度空间重叠损失。同时用 Blender 基于 SIND 轨迹构建 R3ST++ 合成基准，提供同步对角视角、跨视角对应与 BEV 真值，并可作站点特定微调仿真器。
AI.result: 10Hz 下 12 帧观测/12 帧预测，单卡消费级 GPU 实时运行，投影—预测 ADE/FDE 约 0.144/0.140–0.154/0.241 m；在真值 BEV 历史上预测模块较 SIND 上最强 SOTA 提升 66.7%/41.7%；TUMTraf-V2X 迁移实验显示 R3ST++ 预训练可支撑向不同传感配置的真实路侧域适配。
AI.conclusion: 证明低成本 RGB 基础设施即可贯通感知到预测，合成仿真器兼具基准与部署微调价值；但核心证据仍以合成与迁移实验为主，缺少大规模真实路口闭环验证。

title: Towards Pose-Robust Few-Shot Vision-Language-Action Models
comment: 17 pages, 13 figures, 17 tables (including supplementary material). Project page: this https URL
summary: Fine-tuning a vision-language-action (VLA) model on a few dozen demonstrations is the standard way to put a manipulation policy on a robot, yet the resulting policy silently assumes that the camera and the robot base stay exactly where they were during data collection: a bumped tripod or a base re-docked a few centimetres away makes it reach for the wrong place. We show that both failures are one phenomenon, a change of the camera-to-base extrinsic that the policy has memorised, and that the robot carries everything needed to undo it. We introduce WACO, a world-anchored canonicalization framework for VLA models: the arm, placed by forward kinematics at the measured joint angles, serves as a metric calibration target, and the static scene serves as the world anchor that tells a moved camera from a moved robot. From a single RGB-D frame, WACO estimates both shifts without ground-truth extrinsics or extra data, canonicalises the image to the calibration viewpoint and the state, action and start pose to the calibration base frame, and fine-tunes the unmodified policy under the artefacts of its own estimator. We also introduce LIBERO-PoseShift, the first benchmark for RGB VLAs with graded camera, base and compound shifts. Across LIBERO-PoseShift, the LIBERO-Plus camera track and four real-world tasks on a UR5e robot, WACO consistently outperforms the standard few-shot recipe and prior viewpoint-robust methods, raising shifted success by 13.2 points in simulation and by 36.7 points on the real robot, recovering 90% of the simulation gap to a ground-truth oracle and 87% of the real-robot gap, and establishing a new state of the art among methods that use no perturbed training data, with no test-time calibration. Project page: this https URL .

AI.tldr: WACO: 用机器人自身正运动学臂+静态场景作为世界锚点，从单帧RGB-D估计相机-基座外参偏移，对图像/状态/动作做规范化后微调VLA，无需真值外参或扰动数据。
AI.motivation: 少样本微调的VLA策略隐式记忆了采集时的相机-基座外参，相机被碰动或基座重新对接几厘米即失效；作者主张相机移动与基座移动本质是同一外参变化，且机器人自身携带可消解该变化的信息。
AI.method: 前向运动学给出的机械臂几何作为度量标定靶，静态场景作为世界锚点区分"相机动了"还是"机器人动了"；单帧RGB-D在线估计两个偏移（无需GT外参/额外数据），将图像规范化到标定视角、状态/动作/起始位姿规范化到标定基座系，再在自身估计器误差下微调原始策略（估计器-策略协同训练）。同时提出LIBERO-PoseShift基准（分级相机/基座/复合偏移）。
AI.result: 在LIBERO-PoseShift、LIBERO-Plus相机轨道及UR5e真机四项任务上均优于few-shot基线与此前视角鲁棒方法：仿真偏移场景成功率+13.2点，真机+36.7点，分别恢复约90%与87%相对GT oracle的差距；在使用无扰动训练数据、且测试时不需标定的方法中达到SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 将外参偏移视为可在线自标定的单一现象并做"世界锚定规范化"，是让VLA在部署位姿漂移下鲁棒的低成本有效范式；估计器-策略联合训练与配套基准具有复用价值。

title: Transferable Named Sparse Features for Morphology-based Gleason Grading
