summary: Deep learning systems grade prostate biopsies at the level of pathologists, but most report a grade without the glandular architecture that justifies it. This work presents a grading system built on a sparse code over the tokens of a pathology foundation model. A sparse autoencoder pretrained on biopsies is aligned with multi-reader annotations, so that 69 of its 2048 features are named after Gleason morphologies such as cribriform glands, cords, and comedonecrosis. The same code feeds a grading network, which reads all features to predict Gleason patterns and the Grade Group, while morphology maps read directly from the named features. We evaluate the system on five public datasets that include needle biopsies, tissue-microarray cores, multi-reader annotations, and three scanners. The morphology maps remain stable across alignment runs and, without retraining, detect cribriform glands in external biopsies (area under the receiver operating characteristic curve, AUROC, 0.849) and pattern 5 in unseen cores when evaluated by up to six pathologists (AUROC 0.846 to 0.919). In an independent biopsy cohort, Grade Group agreement with three pathologists on Leica scans is close to their agreement with each other. Removing the named features reduces the corresponding Gleason pattern predictions by 49% to 98%, with effects larger than those from 20 activity-matched random feature removals. These results show that a shared sparse representation can support competitive Gleason grading while providing named morphological evidence that transfers across datasets and whose contribution to grading can be measured directly.

AI.tldr: 用稀疏自编码器对齐病理基础模型token，得到69个以Gleason形态命名的可解释特征，既供分级网络预测Gleason模式/Grade Group，又直接生成形态图；在5个公开数据集上实现接近病理学家的分级一致性，并能跨数据集零样本检测筛状腺体与模式5。
AI.motivation: 深度学习前列腺活检分级已达到病理学家水平，但通常只输出分级结果，不提供支撑该结论的腺体结构证据，缺乏可解释性与可审计性。
AI.method: 在病理基础模型token上构建稀疏码：预训练稀疏自编码器与多读者标注对齐，使2048个特征中69个被赋予筛状腺体、索状结构、粉刺样坏死等Gleason形态名称。同一稀疏码同时输入分级网络（读全部特征预测Gleason模式与Grade Group），并由命名特征直接生成形态图；通过消融（移除命名特征、20组活动量匹配的随机特征移除）量化其贡献。
AI.result: 5个公开数据集（穿刺活检、TMA芯、多读者标注、3台扫描仪）：形态图在对齐重复间稳定；外部活检零样本筛状腺体检出AUROC 0.849，未见芯上模式5在最多6位病理学家评估下AUROC 0.846–0.919；独立队列Leica扫描下与3位病理学家的Grade Group一致性接近病理学家彼此间一致性；移除命名特征使对应Gleason模式预测下降49%–98%，效应强于20组活动量匹配随机特征移除。
AI.conclusion: 共享稀疏表示可同时支撑有竞争力的Gleason分级与命名化形态证据，证据可跨数据集迁移且其贡献可被直接度量，为“可解释但不牺牲性能”的医学分级提供范式。

title: SCOUT: Risk-Guided Foundation-Model Escalation for Robust Tissue Detection in Whole-Slide Images
summary: Reliable tissue detection is essential for whole-slide image analysis, yet high average segmentation accuracy can conceal failures involving pale tissue, small fragments, and heterogeneous staining. Pathology foundation models offer transferable representations, but exhaustive inference is computationally demanding and may introduce false-positive tissue predictions. We propose SCOUT (Selective Correction of Uncertain Tissue), a risk-guided cascade that selectively refines an initial thumbnail-based tissue mask. A lightweight audit network estimates the spatial distribution of segmentation errors and prioritizes candidate regions for processing by a frozen pathology foundation model. An asymmetric consensus rule integrates the resulting predictions with the initial mask to recover missed tissue while limiting false positives. A calibrated slide-level review score additionally controls the marginal rate of unflagged case-group failures under the calibration assumptions. Evaluation on a public multi-source, multi-stain benchmark shows that SCOUT reduces the proportion of case groups requiring mask correction from 38.1% for the best released detector to 18.6%, with particularly pronounced improvements in immunohistochemistry. Source-held-out experiments demonstrate better generalization than a segmentation network trained on the same annotations, while selective inference achieves an observed failure rate no higher than processing all candidate regions. Downstream, lymph-node classification with SCOUT masks is non-inferior to that obtained with two of the three released detectors evaluated. A variant built on an openly licensed foundation model is publicly released as an installable Python package with trained weights. These results support risk-guided foundation-model inference as an effective approach to tissue detection across heterogeneous histopathology data.

AI.tldr: SCOUT：风险引导的级联框架，用轻量审计网络定位初始缩略图组织掩膜的误差区域，仅对这些候选区域调用冻结的病理基础模型进行选择性推理，并用非对称共识规则与初始掩膜融合，再用校正后的滑片级评分控制漏检失败率。多源多染色基准上需人工校正的病例组比例从38.1%降至18.6%。
AI.motivation: 全切片图像的组织检测中，高平均分割精度会掩盖淡染组织、小碎片和染色异质样本上的失败；病理基础模型虽提供可迁移表征，但全图推理计算昂贵且易产生假阳性组织预测，因此需要"只在需要处调用大模型"的机制。
AI.method: 1）基于缩略图得到初始组织掩膜；2）轻量审计网络估计分割误差的空间分布，对候选区域排序；3）冻结的病理基础模型只处理被优先选中的区域；4）非对称共识规则把基础模型预测与初始掩膜融合（偏向补回漏检组织、抑制假阳性）；5）校准的滑片级复核分数用于控制未被标记的病例组级失败的边际比率。另有一个基于开放许可基础模型的变体，已作为可安装 Python 包与权重发布。
AI.result: 在公开多源、多染色基准上，需校正的病例组比例由最佳已发布检测器的38.1%降至18.6%，免疫组化染色提升最明显；源数据留出实验中泛化优于用相同标注训练的分割网络；选择性推理的失败率不高于对全部候选区域推理；下游淋巴结分类性能与三个已发布检测器中的两个相当（非劣）。
AI.conclusion: 风险引导的基础模型选择性推理是应对异质组织病理数据组织检测的有效范式：把昂贵模型的计算预算集中在不确定区域，并用校准机制给出可解释的失败率保证，同时提供开源实现便于复现与落地。

title: One Affinity, Two Axes: Bidirectional Slot Attention for Iterative Aggregation across the Structure--Detail Spectrum in Visual Retrieval
summary: Aggregating dense patch tokens into compact and discriminative global descriptors is central to visual retrieval. Although foundation models provide rich local features, existing aggregation heads still rely on single-pass mappings and lack an explicit mechanism to coordinate structural and fine-grained cues. Therefore, we propose Bidirectional Slot Attention (BiSA), which reformulates aggregation as an iterative coupled system. Cross-Axis Consensus (CAC) progressively refines learnable slots by interpreting a single shared token--slot affinity along two complementary axes. Along the competition axis, slots vie for each token under a temperature shared across all of them, determining token ownership and inducing a non-redundant scene decomposition. Along the selection axis, a slot-specific temperature governs the breadth of each slot's response, spanning a spectrum from broad layouts to sparse fine-grained details. Their consensus couples non-redundant decomposition with multi-granular slot specialization. Furthermore, the two axes expose intrinsic token-reliability cues at no extra cost: a token's claim strength under competition and its salience under selection. Progressive Token Filtering (PTF) converts these cues into a retention probability that down-weights unreliable tokens before the next CAC iteration, without any segmentation branch or external prior, forming a self-reinforcing loop of competitive decomposition, selective focusing, and feedback purification. Across all three retrieval tasks, BiSA leads on five of six place recognition benchmarks (+4.2 R@1 on Baidu Mall), tops all 16 metrics of drone--satellite geo-localization (+8.4 R@1 at 150 m), and improves instance-level retrieval on ROxford-Hard by 4.5 mAP points. Notably, the selection axis adds only 20 learnable scalars, yet improves average R@1 by 2.8 points.

AI.tldr: BiSA将视觉检索的patch token聚合重构为迭代耦合系统，用跨轴共识（竞争轴+选择轴）共享token-slot亲和度，并借竞争强度与选择性显著性做渐进token过滤，形成自增强闭环。
AI.motivation: 基础模型提供丰富局部特征，但现有聚合头依赖单次映射，缺乏显式协调结构布局与细粒度线索、且无法识别不可靠token的机制。
AI.method: Bidirectional Slot Attention：Cross-Axis Consensus沿竞争轴（共享温度、slot争夺token，形成非冗余场景分解）与选择轴（slot专属温度，控制响应宽窄，从全局布局到稀疏细节）解读同一token–slot亲和度并求共识；Progressive Token Filtering利用两轴免费获得的token可信度线索（竞争认领强度、选择显著性）转成保留概率，在下一轮迭代前降权不可靠token，无需分割分支或外部先验，构成竞争分解—选择性聚焦—反馈净化的自增强循环。
AI.result: 在三个检索任务上：place recognition六个基准中五个领先（Baidu Mall R@1 +4.2）；drone–satellite地理定位16项指标全部第一（150 m处R@1 +8.4）；ROxford-Hard实例级检索mAP +4.5。选择轴仅增加20个可学习标量，平均R@1提升2.8点。
AI.conclusion: BiSA以极低参数开销实现结构/细粒度协同聚合与自净化的slot attention聚合头，在视觉定位与检索基准上全面领先，但属通用检索表征学习，与具身智能核心方向关联较弱。

title: CanopyKV: Remember beyond the Crop for Fast Active Visual Reasoning
summary: Active visual reasoning enables multimodal models to answer challenging visual questions by gathering fine-grained evidence through iterative image inspection and tool use. However, accumulating crops and reasoning tokens expands the key-value (KV) cache, making compression important for reducing memory and inference costs. Existing KV compression methods typically select historical tokens based on attention, recency, or redundancy. These criteria do not explicitly distinguish locally replaced evidence from complementary information needed for future exploration: each crop refreshes a local region, while earlier views may still support subsequent decisions. Discarding such evidence can impair accuracy or require additional search, while scoring and cache reorganization can offset the computational savings from compression. We introduce CanopyKV, a training-free KV compression framework that uses parent-child crop relationships to retain complementary evidence, keeps retained history stable, and protects the state needed for ongoing reasoning. Tool metadata provides retention signals without additional attention scoring, while compact KV storage reduces subsequent attention costs. Across VisualProbe, V*, HR-Bench, and MME-Lite, CanopyKV achieves state-of-the-art answer accuracy and end-to-end efficiency among the evaluated KV compression methods. On MME-Lite, it retains approximately one-quarter of Dense's total KV while improving accuracy by 10.5 percentage points and accelerating complete reasoning by $1.64\times$.

AI.tldr: CanopyKV：一种无需训练的视觉推理KV缓存压缩框架，利用"父子裁剪"关系保留互补证据、稳定保留历史、保护推理状态，借工具元数据提供保留信号。
AI.motivation: 主动视觉推理中，裁剪与推理token不断累积使KV缓存膨胀；现有压缩方法依据注意力、新近性或冗余度选token，无法区分"被局部替换的证据"与"未来探索仍需的互补信息"，丢弃会掉点或触发额外搜索，而重打分与缓存重排又抵消了压缩收益。
AI.method: 以父子裁剪（parent-child crop）层级关系为结构先验：保留跨层级互补证据，冻结已保留历史以保持稳定，并保护当前推理所需状态；利用工具元数据（如裁剪坐标/来源）直接生成保留信号，无需额外注意力打分；紧凑KV存储降低后续注意力开销。整流程training-free。
AI.result: 在VisualProbe、V*、HR-Bench、MME-Lite上，在所评测的KV压缩方法中取得SOTA答案准确率与端到端效率；MME-Lite上仅保留约1/4 Dense总KV，准确率提升10.5个百分点，完整推理加速1.64×。
AI.conclusion: 结构化（裁剪谱系）元数据可替代注意力打分成为高效、免训练的KV压缩准则，在保持精度的同时显著降低内存与推理成本，适用于多模态主动推理/工具调用型智能体场景。

title: SearchDiffusion: Information-Guided Diffusion Planning for Object Search
summary: Object search in unknown environments requires robots to gather useful observations while avoiding obstacles and accounting for limited sensor visibility. We present SearchDiffusion, a diffusion-based planner that generates position and heading trajectories using a learned dense utility map. The map represents geometric accessibility, useful visibility, and semantic progress. It conditions trajectory generation and provides an objective for sampling guidance. Sampled map hypotheses provide additional geometric context, while geometric and heading guidance, validity checks, and analytical selection support execution. Across 90 simulated tasks on 24 map layouts, SearchDiffusion achieved 95.6\% target detection at greater computational cost. Ablations show complementary benefits from utility and guidance, with limited additional detection benefit from runtime map hypotheses. In ten physical quadruped trials using OneMap relevance maps, eight were successful under operator assessment, without fine-tuning on real-robot data. These results support combining learned spatial utility with guided trajectory generation for object search under partial observability.

AI.tldr: SearchDiffusion: a diffusion-based object-search planner that generates position-heading trajectories conditioned on a learned dense utility map encoding geometric accessibility, visibility utility, and semantic progress; validated in 90 simulated tasks and 10 real quadruped trials.
AI.motivation: Object search in unknown, partially observable environments requires the robot to actively gather informative observations while respecting obstacle constraints and limited sensor field of view; needs a planner that jointly handles geometric feasibility, information gain, and semantic priors.
AI.method: Learned dense utility map (accessibility + useful visibility + semantic progress) is used to condition a diffusion trajectory generator (position & heading) and to define the guidance objective at sampling time; includes map-hypothesis sampling for geometric context, geometric/heading guidance, validity checks, and analytical selection of candidate trajectories.
AI.result: 95.6% target detection across 90 simulated tasks on 24 layouts, at higher compute cost; ablations show complementary utility/guidance benefits and marginal gain from runtime map hypotheses; 8/10 physical quadruped trials succeeded using OneMap relevance maps with no real-robot fine-tuning.
AI.conclusion: Combining learned spatial utility with guided diffusion trajectory generation is effective for object search under partial observability, transferring zero-shot to a legged robot.

title: Teaching VLMs What to Say, Not How to Reason: Rethinking Counterfactual Reasoning in Autonomous Driving
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 Main Track (41 pages, 14 figures, 14 tables). Project page: this https URL
summary: End-to-end autonomous driving systems have been shown to suffer from shortcut learning and causal confusion, limiting their ability to generalize robustly under distribution shift. To mitigate these limitations, recent works based on Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have explored incorporating linguistic reasoning capabilities into driving decision-making, reporting improvements in driving performance. In particular, counterfactual (CF) reasoning has been proposed to enable self-reflective, high-level causal understanding. However, it remains unclear whether the language-based reasoning mitigates shortcut learning or merely shifts it from visual representations to linguistic patterns, creating an illusion of causal understanding. Moreover, existing approaches often conflate intervention-based reasoning with CF reasoning, leaving the effects of genuine CF reasoning unexplored. In this work, we examine what CF reasoning actually induces in VLM-based autonomous driving and observe that it shifts the action distribution toward more conservative behaviors while increasing uncertainty in reasoning and decision-making. This effect persists under reinforcement fine-tuning, suggesting that it is not merely a transient artifact. Furthermore, visual attention analysis shows that CF reasoning does not alter visual grounding, while causal intervention experiments reveal that masking causally relevant and non-causal factors in accident scenarios results in comparable decision change rates. Overall, these results suggest that CF reasoning does not induce genuine causal reasoning grounded in visual evidence. Instead, it acts as a linguistic shortcut that reshapes the action distribution, teaching models what to say but not how to reason, highlighting a gap between language-based reasoning and causal understanding in autonomous driving.

AI.tldr: 论文实证检验了基于VLM的端到端自动驾驶中"反事实(CF)推理"的真实作用：CF推理并不带来基于视觉证据的真实因果理解，而是一种语言捷径——将动作分布推向保守、增加推理不确定性，且认知干预实验显示因果相关与非因果因素遮蔽对决策改变率影响相当。
AI.motivation: 端到端自动驾驶系统存在捷径学习与因果混淆，难以在分布偏移下稳健泛化；现有VLW驾驶工作引入反事实推理声称提升因果理解，但尚不清楚语言推理究竟是缓解了捷径学习，还是把捷径从视觉表征转移到语言模式上，形成"因果理解的错觉"；且现有方法常把干预式推理与反事实推理混为一谈。
AI.method: 对VLM自动驾驶模型进行反事实推理的机理分析：(1) 考察CF推理对动作分布与不确定性统计的影响；(2) 在强化微调下验证该效应是否持久；(3) 视觉注意力分析考察视觉定位是否改变；(4) 在事故场景中遮蔽因果相关/非因果因素，比较决策改变率作为因果敏感度检验。
AI.result: CF推理使动作分布向更保守行为偏移，并提高推理与决策不确定性，该效应在强化微调后依然存在；CF推理不改变视觉注意力定位；遮蔽因果相关因素与非因果因素导致相近的决策改变率，表明模型对视觉因果证据不敏感。
AI.conclusion: 反事实推理并未诱导以视觉证据为基础的真实因果推理，而是一种重塑动作分布的语言捷径，教会模型"说什么"而非"如何推理"，揭示了语言推理与因果理解之间的鸿沟，对VLM驾驶中的推理式训练提出警示。

title: Where Should a Diffusion Transformer Meet Its Teacher?
summary: Representation Alignment (REPA) significantly accelerates Diffusion Transformer training by guiding intermediate student features with a pretrained visual teacher, yet existing methods typically attach supervision to a single fixed layer. As student representations evolve, however, we find that the most effective layer for alignment varies across training stages. To track this evolving layer suitability online without costly search, we measure gradient compatibility between the flow-matching and alignment objectives, and propose AdaREPA, an online routing framework that adaptively selects the supervision layer as training progresses. AdaREPA uses a softmax distribution over smoothed layer compatibility scores to sample a layer for alignment at each training step. This probabilistic routing adapts teacher supervision to the student's changing learning needs, with minimal training overhead and no additional inference cost. On ImageNet-256, AdaREPA accelerates convergence and improves generation quality across model sizes, while revealing how the most suitable layers for supervision shift over training.

AI.tldr: AdaREPA 提出在线路由框架，通过衡量流匹配损失与对齐损失的梯度兼容性，用 softmax 概率采样动态选择对学生特征施加教师监督的层，替代固定单层对齐。
AI.motivation: 现有 REPA 类方法将预训练视觉教师监督固定挂在某一层，但学生表征随训练演化，最优对齐层会阶段性漂移，穷举搜索代价高。
AI.method: 计算各候选层的流匹配梯度与对齐目标梯度的兼容性得分，做平滑后经 softmax 形成层级分布，每步按分布采样一层进行表示对齐；无额外推理开销。
AI.result: 在 ImageNet-256 上，跨模型规模加速收敛并提升生成质量，同时揭示了监督最优层随训练阶段迁移的规律。
AI.conclusion: 对齐层应按训练进程自适应选择，基于梯度兼容性的概率路由是一种低成本、免搜索的有效方案。

title: Enhancing Active Learning Performance with Initial Data Selection Based on Foundation Models
summary: In active object detection, selecting the initial labeled pool is essential, especially in complex datasets with expensive labeling and low resource budget. This study presents an active learning framework designed to optimize the initial training cycle of active learning for the object detection task. Our approach diverges from traditional methods by utilizing feature-based clustering from the YOLO-World model and refining images based on objectness scores rather than relying on uncertainty sampling in the initial cycle. This approach focuses on finding samples with various features and emphasizes training in areas where the foundation model is most confident. Doing so helps the model better understand different types of objects. For subsequent cycles, we employ a consistency-based sampling technique to maintain the robustness of the training process. To evaluate our method, we use two complex datasets called Aquarium and NWPU VHR-10, which are well known for their diverse object sizes and challenging conditions. In the NWPU dataset, our method increases mAP50 by an average of 6.6% in image-based evaluation. Moreover, the image refinement method shows an improvement of approximately 11% in object-based evaluation. The results show improvements in model performance and labeling time, demonstrating the advantages of using foundation models in early cycles of active learning. An implementation of the algorithm is available at this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向目标检测主动学习的初始轮次优化框架：用 YOLO-World 特征聚类选多样样本，并结合 objectness 分数精炼图像；后续轮次改用一致性采样。
AI.motivation: 主动学习中初始标注池选择对昂贵标注、低预算的复杂数据集至关重要，传统不确定性采样在首轮效果有限。
AI.method: 基于 YOLO-World 基础模型的特征聚类做多样性选样；按 objectness 分数对图像进行精炼筛选（聚焦基础模型高置信区域）；后续轮次采用一致性采样维持训练稳健性。
AI.result: 在 Aquarium 与 NWPU VHR-10 上验证；NWPU 上基于图像评估 mAP50 平均提升 6.6%，基于目标的评估在图像精炼加成下约提升 11%，并缩短标注时间。
AI.conclusion: 利用基础模型先验可显著改善主动学习早期轮次的样本选择效率，兼顾性能与标注成本，但实验限于两个领域数据集，缺乏与通用检测基准及机器人等下游任务的可迁移性验证。

authors: Heitor Eduardo Ferreira Campos Morato Filpi
title: Reliable Tree Recruitment from Scarce Annotations for Forest Inventory Expansion
summary: Species-level inventories of individual tree crowns (ITCs) from UAV imagery are limited by annotation cost: in tropical forests, many species are represented by only a handful of field-validated crowns. We propose a reliable tree recruitment framework that expands a small annotated inventory by iteratively self-training a multi-task DeepLabV3 network, combining semantic segmentation with a crown-distance regression head, on RGB UAV orthomosaics. At each iteration, candidate crowns enter the training inventory only if they pass a confidence filter on class probability and distance map and a morphology filter on crown area and solidity, with at most five new crowns per species, keeping recruited samples consistent with the reference inventory. We evaluate the framework at two Brazilian sites: an Amazonian rainforest in Acre (17 species, 355 annotated crowns, 4 cm GSD) and a forest site in the Cerrado of Maranhão (4 species, 51 annotated crowns, 1.8 cm GSD). Over 20 iterations, the number of retained crowns grew from about 500 to 960 in Acre and from about 700 to over 3100 in Maranhão, while crown-level F1 exceeded single- and multi-task DeepLabV3 baselines (53.5% vs. 50.0% and 45.2%; 92.2% vs. 79.7% and 83.6%). The framework offers a low-cost route to expanding species inventories with consumer-grade UAVs and limited fieldwork.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于多任务DeepLabV3（语义分割+树冠距离回归）迭代自训练框架，配合类别概率、距离图置信度过滤和面积/实心度形态学过滤，每物种每轮最多新增5个树冠，用低成本无人机RGB正射影像扩充小样本树种清单。
AI.motivation: 热带森林中单木树冠（ITC）物种级清单受标注成本制约：大量物种仅有少量野外地基验证树冠样本，限制了监督分割的可扩展性。作者希望在不增加野外工作量的前提下，利用消费级无人机影像扩增有标注树冠清单。
AI.method: 以RGB正射影像为输入，构建多任务DeepLabV3网络，同时输出语义分割（类别概率）与树冠距离回归（crown-distance map）；采用迭代自训练（伪标签）流程，候选树冠需通过两项过滤：类别概率与距离图的置信度过滤，以及树冠面积与实心度的形态学过滤；每物种每次迭代最多吸纳5个新树冠，使新增样本与参考清单分布一致。在巴西两站点验证：Acre亚马逊雨林（17种、355个人工标注树冠、4 cm GSD）与Maranhão Cerrado（4种、51个树冠、1.8 cm GSD）。
AI.result: 经过20次迭代，保留树冠数量在Acre由约500增至960，在Maranhão由约700增至3100以上；树冠级F1显著优于单任务与多任务DeepLabV3基线（53.5% vs 50.0% / 45.2%；92.2% vs 79.7% / 83.6%）。
AI.conclusion: 该自训练招募框架为使用消费级无人机与有限野外调查数据扩充物种清单提供了低成本、可靠的路径，尤其适用于样本极稀少的类热带森林场景。

title: RAPID: Reconstruction Accelerated by Polarization-Informed Depth for 2D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Efficient and accurate 3D surface reconstruction from multi-view images remains a fundamental challenge in Gaussian splatting. Many existing methods rely on sparse geometric initialization and iterative densification, resulting in substantial optimization overhead and difficulties in balancing rendering quality and geometric accuracy, particularly in reflective and weakly textured regions. To address these limitations, we propose RAPID, a geometry-first framework that uses multiview polarization cues to recover dense surface priors. We integrate surface normals into depth maps using sparse geometric anchors. These depth maps are then fused across views. Curvature-adaptive sampling and oriented Gaussian initialization then support efficient optimization. Experiments on the PISR dataset demonstrate an approximately \(5\times\) speedup over PhyGaP, which is a state-of-the-art Gaussian-based reconstruction method. RAPID reduces the average optimization time from approximately 21 minutes (PhyGaP) to 4 minutes while maintaining competitive novel-view synthesis quality and mesh reconstruction accuracy. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of RAPID in accelerating Gaussian optimization from polarimetric multi-view inputs.

AI.tldr: RAPID：用多视角偏振线索先恢复稠密表面先验（法向+稀疏几何锚点融合成深度图），再曲率自适应采样并定向初始化高斯，实现快速3D高斯表面重建。
AI.motivation: 现有高斯泼溅重建依赖稀疏几何初始化与迭代致密化，优化开销大，且在反射与弱纹理区域难以兼顾渲染质量与几何精度。
AI.method: 几何优先框架：将表面法向与稀疏几何锚点结合得到深度图，跨视角融合；随后进行曲率自适应采样与有向高斯初始化，支撑高效优化。
AI.result: 在PISR数据集上相较SOTA方法PhyGaP约5×加速，平均优化时间由约21分钟降至4分钟，新视角合成质量与网格重建精度保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 偏振多视角输入下的先验初始化可显著加速高斯优化，但验证仅限单一数据集，泛化性与真实场景适用性仍需检验。

title: StrideWorld: Benchmarking Scene Rigidity and Action Consistency in Interactive Video World Model
summary: Interactive video world models turn user commands into the exploration of a generated scene, which requires the scene to keep its 3D structure as the camera moves and each action to keep a stable effect. Existing benchmarks mostly evaluate these properties against references fitted to the video under test, either a scene reconstructed from its own frames or a camera trajectory aligned to the command path with a free scale. Such references can absorb gradual scene deformation and changes in pace and route length, so these errors can pass undetected. We therefore introduce StrideWorld, a benchmark whose references are fixed before the motion they judge. It evaluates scene rigidity against the ground-truth geometry of the start view, and action consistency against the stride of each action, the camera motion of one command. The stride is measured on the model's first steps and then used to test the steps that follow, so each model is judged only against its own steps. Its measurements are validated on rendered videos with known camera motion, and its scores agree with human judgments. Across \nvideos{} videos generated by \nmodels{} open models from $140$ start views, all models but one deform their scenes as the camera moves, with offsets up to $7.3$ times those of a rigid rendering along the same camera path. Most models keep a steady pace when a single action is held. Along composed routes, several models often stall, and most completed routes end away from the positions predicted by each model's own strides. Only the two models that scale commands by the estimated scene depth bring most routes close to these positions. Fine-tuning two models on a few rendered clips removes most of their mid-route stalls. Code, data, and a leaderboard are publicly available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出 StrideWorld 基准：参考在运动发生前即固定，用起始视角的真值几何检验场景刚性、用模型自身前几步测得的 stride 检验动作一致性，揭示交互视频世界模型中普遍存在的场景形变与路线停滞问题。
AI.motivation: 现有交互视频世界模型基准的参考是"贴合被测视频"得到的（自重构场景或自由缩放对齐的轨迹），会吸收渐进形变与节奏/路线长度变化，使误差漏检。
AI.method: 参考先行固定：场景刚性用起始视角 ground-truth 几何约束；动作一致性用单条命令的相机位移 stride，先由模型最初几步测得，再用其检验后续步（模型只与自身步长比较）。测量在已知相机运动的渲染视频上验证，分数与人工判断一致。
AI.result: 140 个起始视角、9 个开源模型共若干视频：除一个模型外均在相机运动时形变，偏移达刚性渲染的 7.3 倍；单动作保持时节奏稳定；组合路线上多个模型停滞，多数到达点偏离自身 stride 预测；仅两个按估计场景深度缩放命令的模型大多接近预测位置；少量渲染片段微调可消除大部分中途停滞。
AI.conclusion: 参考前定可暴露被自拟合指标掩盖的形变与一致性问题；深度感知的命令缩放与少量微调是有效改进方向。代码、数据与榜单公开。

title: Why Multi-Source Audio Fails to Compose: A Geometric Diagnosis and Its Remedy
summary: Multi-source audio-to-image generation exhibits consistent compositional failures when audio tokens occupy geometrically displaced, semantically unanchored positions in the CLIP text-token space, where the diffusion U-Net lacks the prior to reliably attend to them or ground them in distinct spatial regions. We formalize this as the geometric displacement phenomenon and expose it through a two-level clustering analysis comparing BEATs and CLAP embeddings at the raw encoder and projected CLIP token levels. Three geometric properties emerge as important: intra-class compactness, angular alignment with the CLIP text manifold, and inter-token spatial separation. We show that CLAP, whose contrastive language-audio pretraining aligns embeddings with natural language semantics, substantially outperforms BEATs on all three properties, improving the silhouette score by more than 3x and the Audio-Image Content score as well. Building on this analysis, we introduce a multi-token extension that requires no diffusion-backbone retraining and assigns each audio source to a distinct placeholder token in the CLIP tokenizer, complemented by a mixed inference-time objective that combines Attend-and-Excite with an A* spatial separation loss to resolve residual cross-token interference. For evaluation, we construct multi-audio compositional benchmarks from VGGSound (VGG2, VGG3, and VGGN) and extend six standard audio-image metrics to the multi-source setting. Across five benchmarks and four strong baselines, our method achieves strong results on the metrics most directly tied to compositional faithfulness, with AIC improvements of up to 2.25x over the strongest baseline and FID reduced by nearly 2x on two-source generation. We propose geometric displacement as a diagnostic framework for cross-modal generation systems that project learned embeddings into a pretrained contrastive space.

AI.tldr: 论文将多源音频到图像生成中的组合性失败形式化为"几何错位"现象，通过两层聚类分析比较BEATs与CLAP嵌入在原始编码器层与投影CLIP token层的几何性质，发现CLAP在类内紧致性、与CLIP文本流形角度对齐、token间空间分离三项上显著更优；进而提出免扩散骨干重训练的多token占位符扩展方法，并配合Attend-and-Excite与A*空间分离损失的混合推理目标，在多个多音频组合基准上大幅提升组合忠实度指标。
AI.motivation: 多源音到图生成存在稳定的组合性失败：音频token在CLIP文本token空间中位置几何错位且语义未锚定，扩散U-Net缺少可靠关注与空间接地先验。作者希望用几何视角解释并诊断这一失败，并在不重训扩散模型的前提下修复。
AI.method: 1）提出"几何错位"概念框架，用原始编码器层与CLIP投影token层的两级聚类分析对比BEATs与CLAP，量化三项几何属性：类内紧致度（silhouette）、与CLIP文本流形的角度对齐、token间空间分离。2）多token扩展：为每个音频源分配CLIP tokenizer中独立的占位符token，无需重训扩散骨干。3）推理时混合目标：Attend-and-Excite结合A*空间分离损失，缓解跨token残余干扰。4）构建VGG2/VGG3/VGGN多音频组合基准，并把六项标准音-图指标扩展到多源设定。
AI.result: CLAP在三项几何属性上全面优于BEATs，silhouette提升>3x，Audio-Image Content（AIC）分数也更高。在五个基准、四个强基线上，方法在最直接反映组合忠实度的指标上表现最佳：AIC最高提升2.25x，双源生成FID降低近2x。
AI.conclusion: 作者将"几何错位"确立为跨模态生成系统的诊断框架，适用于把学习到的嵌入投影进预训练对比空间的情形；分析结论（对比语言对齐嵌入更利于token接地）与多token+空间分离推理的组合方案共同缓解了多源组合性失败。

title: PhysResponse: Probing the Physics of Video Generation with Controlled Interventions
comment: 11 pages. This version contains the main paper and references only. Supplementary material will be added in a later revision
summary: Video generation models are increasingly viewed as world simulators, which requires not only plausible motion but dynamics that respond correctly to specified physical parameters. Existing models, datasets and benchmarks, however, largely target physical plausibility, leaving this physical parameter responsiveness insufficiently explored. We introduce PhysResponse, a benchmark that measures it at two levels: scene-conditioned simulator inversion recovers the effective gravity, friction and initial speed of generated motion, and event evaluation tests outcomes near and across critical transitions. Evaluating ten image-to-video models, we find that even the lowest parameter errors exceed those of physically correct videos by over an order of magnitude, that models rarely reproduce both outcomes of a transition pair, and that the two levels expose complementary failures that visual metrics such as PSNR miss. To supply the missing training signal, we construct 72,000 simulated videos of 20 multi-object interaction types with controlled parameters; fine-tuning on them lowers parameter errors, even on held-out interaction types, and transfers to real videos and an external physics benchmark. Continued training with a numerical encoder further lowers all three errors on held-out types. PhysResponse provides a foundation for world simulators that follow physical conditions, not just appearances.

AI.tldr: PhysResponse基准从"场景条件下的模拟器反演"和"临界跃迁事件评估"两个层面衡量视频生成模型对物理参数（重力、摩擦、初速度）的响应能力，并构建72k受控参数仿真视频进行微调以弥补训练信号。
AI.motivation: 视频生成模型被视为世界模拟器，但现有数据集与基准只关注物理"合理性"，忽视了生成动力学能否正确响应给定物理参数这一关键能力。
AI.method: 提出PhysResponse基准：1）通过反演生成视频的动力学，恢复其等效重力、摩擦系数与初速度，量化参数误差；2）事件评估，检验模型在临界跃迁附近与跨越跃迁时能否复现两种结果。评测10个图像到视频模型；并构建72,000段覆盖20类多物体交互、参数受控的仿真视频，用微调提供训练信号，进一步加入数值编码器做持续训练。
AI.result: 即使最优模型的参数误差也比物理正确视频高一个数量级以上；模型很少能同时复现跃迁对的两种结果；两个评估层级揭示了PSNR等视觉指标无法反映的互补失效。在受控仿真视频上微调可降低参数误差，且可泛化到未见交互类型、真实视频与外部物理基准；配合数值编码器的持续训练在未见类型上进一步降低三项误差。
AI.conclusion: PhysResponse为"遵循物理条件而非仅外观"的世界模拟器研究提供了评测基础与可用的训练信号，揭示当前视频生成模型在物理参数响应上的显著不足。

title: Resolution as Attention for Efficient Agent Memory Perception
summary: LLM-based agents accumulate extensive interaction histories when solving complex, long-horizon tasks, making efficient memory management critical to their performance and scalability. While existing memory management methods primarily focus on what to retain or retrieve, they often overlook how much perceptual detail should be allocated to individual past interactions. We posit that effective agent memory depends not only on the information preserved, but also on the granularity at which each past interaction is perceived. Motivated by this insight, we propose Resolution as Attention (RAA), a memory perception mechanism that uses visual resolution as a means of attention allocation across interaction histories. RAA renders past interactions as images and dynamically adjusts their resolution at every step according to their relevance to the agent's upcoming decision, preserving fine-grained information for critical interactions while reducing visual-token consumption for less relevant ones. To adaptively determine the perceptual fidelity of each interaction, we train a lightweight relevance estimator with teacher-model guidance and further optimize it to preserve the agent's decision consistency at a reduced visual-token cost. Experiments across multiple tasks and backbones show that RAA reduces token consumption by over 50% without compromising task performance. Moreover, RAA can be integrated as a plug-in perception layer with existing memory management methods, yielding further token savings and revealing adaptive perception as a complementary dimension of agent memory.

AI.tldr: 提出 Resolution as Attention (RAA)，将历史交互渲染为图像并用视觉分辨率作为注意力分配手段，按相关性动态调整每个历史交互的分辨率，配合轻量相关性估计器与决策一致性优化。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体在长程任务中积累大量交互历史，现有记忆管理方法只关注"保留什么/检索什么"，忽略了对每条历史交互应分配多少感知细节（粒度）这一维度。
AI.method: RAA 把过去交互渲染成图像，在每一步根据与下一步决策的相关性动态调整其分辨率：关键交互保留高分辨率细粒度信息，弱相关交互低分辨率以节省视觉 token。相关性由教师模型指导训练的轻量估计器给出，并进一步以保持智能体决策一致性为目标、在更低视觉 token 代价下优化该估计器。
AI.result: 在多任务、多骨干模型实验中，token 消耗降低超过 50% 而任务性能不下降；作为插件式感知层与现有记忆管理方法结合可带来额外 token 节省。
AI.conclusion: 记忆有效性不仅取决于保留的信息内容，还取决于每条历史交互被感知的粒度；自适应感知构成智能体记忆的一个互补维度，可与现有"保留/检索"式记忆管理正交叠加。

title: Probing Physics in Motion Diffusion Models Against Their Own Estimate
summary: Recent studies report that video diffusion models "know more than they show": physical properties decode better from their activations than from their inputs or outputs. But a diffusion model computes its clean-sample estimate from those same activations, so such a comparison measures how easily a readout extracts the information. Whether the model hides anything is a separate question. We set out to find hidden physical knowledge in kinematic text-to-motion diffusion models, where the physics of every intermediate estimate can be computed exactly, and recorded every layer along the sampling trajectories of MDM (two checkpoints) and MotionDiffuse. Against the usual baselines the layers do look ahead of the model's own estimate on balance and flight. With every readout tuned the same way, the estimate closes the gap: for balance and flight, adding a layer gains at most 0.01, a size that a positive control shows we would detect. The fall rate of jumps is the one clear exception. Early in denoising, MDM's layers add about 0.08 in $R^2$ (up to 0.11 in a refit) that the estimate does not yet show, and the gain fades as sampling proceeds; on MotionDiffuse it is small and not robust. The estimate also flags floating samples without training, but aborting them saves under a tenth of the compute. In a video model, plausibility that linear probes miss in Wan 2.1's clean latent becomes readable after one fixed nonlinearity.

AI.tldr: 该文重新审视"视频扩散模型知道得比展示得多"的结论，在运动学文本到动作扩散模型（MDM、MotionDiffuse）上逐层探测物理属性，发现统一调参后中间层相对模型自身干净估计的增益几乎为零，仅跳跃坠落率在去噪早期有约0.08的R²优势。
AI.motivation: 已有工作通过比较激活与输入/输出声称扩散模型"隐藏"了物理知识，但模型正是用这些激活计算干净样本估计，二者比较实际只反映读出器（readout）的提取难易，而非模型是否真的隐藏信息；需要一个物理量可精确计算、可逐层逐时刻检验的设定来澄清。
AI.method: 在文本到动作扩散模型（MDM两个checkpoint、MotionDiffuse）的采样轨迹上记录每一层激活，对每个中间估计精确计算平衡、滞空、跳跃坠落率等物理量；以统一方式调参所有线性读出器，并与模型自身的干净样本估计对比，另设阳性对照检验可检测的效应量；并对Wan 2.1视频模型的干净潜变量做固定非线性变换后的可读性测试。
AI.result: 平衡与滞空上，层激活在常规基线下看似"领先"模型估计，但读出器统一调参后估计即可追平，加一层增益至多0.01（低于阳性对照可检测阈值）；唯一显著例外是跳跃坠落率：MDM早期去噪层比估计多约0.08 R²（重拟合后达0.11）且随采样推进衰减，MotionDiffuse上增益小且不稳定；估计本身可无训练标记"漂浮"样本，但中止仅节省不到十分之一算力；Wan 2.1的干净潜变量经一个固定非线性后即可读出线性探针漏检的合理性。
AI.conclusion: 所谓"隐藏物理知识"多是读出器提取难度差异而非模型内部未表达的信息；真实但有限的例外集中在早期去噪的坠落率预测上，且工程收益有限。结论对"模型知道得比展示得多"的普适性主张构成重要修正。

title: Constructive Infinitely Differentiable Guidance Vector Fields for Robotic Control
summary: Guidance vector fields (GVFs) are a popular framework for tasks such as robotic path-following and multi-robot motion coordination, but existing approaches may be non-differentiable or have large derivatives, limiting their use in controllers that require derivatives of the guidance signal, which is common when the GVF is used as an input in a cascaded controller. This paper proposes an infinitely differentiable constructive GVF. The resulting vector field depends on a smoothing parameter and is a generalization of [1], recovering the original GVF in the limit as this parameter approaches zero. It also admits a simple and efficient implementation that preserves smoothness under discretization and can reduce computation time by using substantially fewer curve samples while maintaining small path-following errors. We establish the main theoretical properties and demonstrate its practical advantages through numerical and real-world experiments.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无限可微的构造式引导向量场（GVF），依赖平滑参数并推广已有GVF（参数趋于零时退化回原场），离散化下保持光滑、可用更少曲线采样降低计算量且路径跟随误差小，并通过数值与实机实验验证。
AI.motivation: 现有GVF方法不可微或导数过大，限制了其在需要引导信号导数的级联控制器中的使用（如机器人路径跟随、多机器人运动协调）。
AI.method: 构造基于平滑参数的光滑化引导向量场，理论上证明其为原GVF的极限推广并给出主要性质；设计简单高效的实现，保证离散化下的光滑性，并允许大幅减少曲线采样点。
AI.result: 数值实验与真实世界实验表明该方法在保持较小路径跟随误差的同时显著缩短计算时间，且光滑性在离散化下得以保持。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为级联控制提供了可微且导数有界的引导向量场，兼具理论保证与实用效率，适用于机器人路径跟随等控制任务。

title: Let a Small Model Read First: Faster Prefill for Long Interleaved Image-Text Inputs
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) can answer questions about long interleaved inputs, such as documents of many pages and collections of hundreds of images, but they are slow to start: on inputs of about 100K tokens, the prefill takes most of the wait for the first output token. A common approach prunes the input by scoring its tokens with the target model itself or with a small model of the same family that first writes an answer. However, this scoring takes much of the time that pruning saves. We find that the evidence for a question lies in a few whole units (images or paragraphs), and that a small hybrid model finds them with one attention head of an early layer, even at half image resolution. Based on these findings, we propose SkimPrefill, which lets the small hybrid model read the whole input first, up to that early layer, with images at half resolution. Most layers of the small hybrid model (Qwen3.5-0.8B) run in linear time, so this pass is short. SkimPrefill then ranks every unit with that head and gives the target the top units as an ordinary shorter prompt. One untrained selector serves targets of different model families. Extensive experiments on MMLongBench at 128K tokens, with 19 datasets of five task types, show the effectiveness of SkimPrefill. With 10% of the input tokens kept, SkimPrefill speeds up the prefill of Qwen3.5-9B, Gemma-4-12B and Qwen3-VL-32B by 3.7 times, 11.6 time and 8.2 times while maintaining their average accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出 SkimPrefill：用小混合模型（Qwen3.5-0.8B）早期层单个注意力头（半分辨率图像）做一次线性时间"预读"，对图像/段落等整单元打分，仅保留前10%单元送入目标大模型，实现无需训练的跨家族 VLM 长上下文 prefill 加速 3.7–11.6×。
AI.motivation: 交错的超长视觉语言输入（多页文档、上百张图片，约100K token）的 prefill 是首 token 延迟的主要来源。现有剪枝方法需先用目标模型或同族小模型作答再打分，打分开销几乎吃掉全部收益；同时作者观察到证据往往集中在少数"完整单元"（整图或整段）内，且该信号在浅层单头即可被捕获。
AI.method: 1) 用小型混合架构模型（Qwen3.5-0.8B）在图像半分辨率下先跑完整输入至某个早期层，因多数层为线性复杂度，故开销小；2) 在该早期层取一个注意力头，对每个视觉/文本单元（整图或整段）计算相关性分数并排序；3) 取 top-k 单元（约10% token）拼成常规短 prompt 交给目标模型。选择器未经训练，可跨模型家族复用（Qwen3.5-9B、Gemma-4-12B、Qwen3-VL-32B）。
AI.result: 在 MMLongBench 128K token 设置下，覆盖5类任务共19个数据集：保留10%输入 token 时，Qwen3.5-9B、Gemma-4-12B、Qwen3-VL-32B 的 prefill 分别加速 3.7×、11.6×、8.2×，且平均精度保持不降。
AI.conclusion: 长上下文 VLM 的证据集中于少数语义整单元，可由浅层单注意力头低成本定位；以此为据的免训练、跨模型通用预读剪枝，可在大幅削减 prefill 时间的同时保持精度，为长文档/多图推理提供了实用的加速路径。

title: MLIE-CoT: Chain-of-Thought Reasoning via Multi-Level Image Editing
comment: 11 pages, 5 figures. Code: this https URL
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning has proven effective in improving the reasoning abilities of large language models by breaking complex tasks into step-by-step solutions. In recent years, researchers have attempted to extend CoT reasoning to visual generative models to improve their ability to handle complex tasks. However, existing CoT methods for text-to-image generation still rely mainly on textual reasoning and therefore cannot fully use and preserve the correct semantic information already present in an image, as even the most detailed language cannot capture all visual information. With advances in image generation, models such as FLUX and BAGEL can generate images conditioned on visual inputs. Recent work has attempted to carry images forward as context in the chain of thought, but this introduces another limitation: unsuitable earlier images can strongly interfere with the model, while repeated whole-image regeneration introduces new hallucinations at each round and causes them to accumulate. To address these issues, we propose MLIE-CoT, a visual chain-of-thought framework based on multi-level image editing. MLIE-CoT learns to select the repair granularity from three levels, preserving correct semantics whenever possible during reasoning while reducing the effect of incorrect content. To improve the ability of multimodal models to route errors of different severity to appropriate repair levels, we construct an image-repair dataset covering different error cases and use it to train a repair-level router. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MLIE-CoT significantly outperforms both its base models and methods using fixed repair strategies, producing clear improvements across multiple benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 该文提出MLIE-CoT，一种基于多级图像编辑的视觉思维链框架，学习在三个修复粒度（级别）间选择，尽可能保留图像中正确语义、抑制错误内容，并构建图像修复数据集训练"修复级别路由器"。实验显示其显著优于基座模型与固定修复策略。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到图像生成的思维链主要依赖文本推理，无法完整保留图像中的视觉语义信息；而将图像作为上下文逐步传递的方案存在两大问题：不恰当的早期图像会强干扰模型，且每轮整图重生成会引入并累积新幻觉。
AI.method: 提出MLIE-CoT视觉思维链框架：(1) 以多级图像编辑替代整图重生成，从三个修复粒度中学习选择；(2) 构建覆盖不同错误情形的图像修复数据集，训练修复级别路由器，使多模态模型将不同严重程度的错误路由到合适修复级别；(3) 推理过程中尽量保留正确语义、局部修正错误。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，MLIE-CoT显著优于其基座模型（如FLUX、BAGEL类视觉条件生成模型）以及采用固定修复策略的方法，在多个基准上取得明显提升。
AI.conclusion: 以"粒度自适应的局部图像编辑"作为视觉思维链的动作空间，可缓解整图重生成带来的幻觉累积与错误上下文干扰，是提升多模态模型复杂图像生成推理的有效途径。

title: Explainable and CPU-Efficient Brain Tumor Classification from MRI Using Two-Phase EfficientNetB3 Fine-Tuning
summary: Brain tumors are among the most lethal neurological disorders, with over 308,000 new diagnoses annually worldwide. Accurate classification of tumor type from Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) scans is critical for treatment planning; however, manual radiological interpretation is time-consuming and prone to inter-observer variability. This paper proposes an automated deep learning pipeline for four-class brain MRI classification (glioma, meningioma, no tumor, and pituitary tumor) using EfficientNetB3 transfer learning with a custom classification head. A two-phase training strategy is adopted: Phase 1 trains the head with a frozen backbone (best validation accuracy: 92.77%), and Phase 2 selectively fine-tunes the top 37 layers at a 100x reduced learning rate (best validation accuracy: 94.91%). On an independent balanced test set of 1,600 MRI images, the system achieves 90.62% overall accuracy and a macro-average AUC of 0.9854. Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping (Grad-CAM) is integrated for class-discriminative visual explainability. The proposed system simultaneously addresses three dimensions absent in prior work: high accuracy, CPU-only computational efficiency, and clinical interpretability.

AI.tldr: 基于EfficientNetB3迁移学习与两阶段训练（冻结主干训练分类头 + 以1/100学习率微调顶部37层）的四分类脑部MRI分类流水线，测试集精度90.62%、宏平均AUC 0.9854，并集成Grad-CAM可解释性，强调纯CPU可运行的临床可用性。
AI.motivation: 脑肿瘤（胶质瘤、脑膜瘤、无肿瘤、垂体瘤）MRI分类对治疗规划至关重要，但人工判读耗时且存在观察者间差异；作者声称现有工作缺乏"高精度 + 仅CPU高效计算 + 临床可解释性"三者兼备的方案。
AI.method: EfficientNetB3预训练骨干 + 自定义分类头；两阶段迁移训练：阶段一冻结骨干仅训练头（验证集最优92.77%），阶段二以100倍降低的学习率选择性微调顶部37层（验证集最优94.91%）；使用Grad-CAM生成类别判别性热力图；在1600张独立均衡测试集上评估精度与宏平均AUC。
AI.result: 验证集最优准确率94.91%（阶段二）；独立均衡测试集整体准确率90.62%，宏平均AUC 0.9854；Grad-CAM可视化提供类别判别性解释。
AI.conclusion: 该工作是一个标准、规整的医学影像迁移学习基线：两阶段微调策略合理但无方法创新，指标属领域常见水平，且验证–测试精度落差（94.91% vs 90.62%）提示泛化差距；"CPU高效"与"可解释性"更多是工程陈述而非系统贡献，缺乏外部数据集验证与临床评估，对通用表征学习或物理/具身智能方向无方法洞见可迁移。

title: NativeSeg: Native Vision Language Segmentation of 3D Computed Tomography via Spatial Visual Tokens and Verified Local Zoom
comment: 13 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Code: this https URL ; Weights: this https URL
summary: Text prompted 3D computed tomography (CT) segmentation requires both full slice context and fine boundary precision across volumes where over $80\%$ of organ prompted slices lack the queried target. Existing medical vision language models (VLMs) are largely non native segmenters: they delegate pixel delineation outside the VLM by compressing reasoning into a 1D [SEG] vector for an external Segment Anything Model (SAM) decoder, quantizing masks into lossy discrete codebooks, or issuing box prompts to stateless external SAM tools without empty slice screening or spatial state memory. We introduce NativeSeg, a native vision language segmentation framework on Low Rank Adaptation (LoRA) adapted Qwen3.8-27B that performs dense mask decoding, volumetric triage, spatial error self diagnosis, and multiround local zoom directly over the VLM's 2D spatial visual tokens without external SAM decoders. NativeSeg decodes confidence maps from upper layer 2D spatial tokens fused with a five slice U-Net pathway, halts at zero zooms on $>91\%$ of standalone evaluations via a native presence gate (<pres>), localizes uncertain boundaries via a 20 cell multiscale error gate (<err>), and accepts zoomed updates only when predicted error decreases. Trained solely on adult CT, NativeSeg improves Round $0$ DSC by $+19.81$ and $+7.04$ points over discrete codebook and 1D [SEG] readouts on the identical backbone, reaches $86.81\%$ adult and $87.04\%$ zero shot pediatric DSC, and safely refines 2D nnU-Net ($89.52\%$ adult; $86.86\%$ pediatric), 3D SegVol ($86.81\%$), and 3D VoxTell ($89.85\%$).

AI.tldr: NativeSeg：在 LoRA 适配的 Qwen3.8-27B 上做原生视觉语言分割，直接在 VLM 二维空间视觉 token 上解码稠密掩码，无需外部 SAM 解码器；配合体数据分诊、空间误差自诊断与多轮局部放大。
AI.motivation: 文本提示 3D CT 分割需全切片上下文与精细边界，且超过 80% 的器官提示切片不含目标；现有医学 VLM 多为"非原生分割器"——靠 1D [SEG] 向量交给外部 SAM、有损离散码本量化、或无状态外挂 SAM 发框提示且不筛空切片、无空间状态记忆。
AI.method: 上层二维空间 token 融合五切片 U-Net 通路解码置信图；原生存在性门控 <pres> 在独立评估中 >91% 情况零缩放即停止；20 单元多尺度误差门控 <err> 定位不确定边界；仅当预测误差下降时接受放大更新。仅用成人 CT 训练。
AI.result: Round 0 DSC 较同骨干的离散码本与 1D [SEG] 读出分别提升 +19.81 与 +7.04 点；成人 86.81%、儿科零样本 87.04%；可安全精化 2D nnU-Net（成人 89.52%、儿科 86.86%）、3D SegVol（86.81%）与 3D VoxTell（89.85%）。
AI.conclusion: 证明了 VLM 可原生承担稠密掩码解码与自迭代纠错，摆脱外部分割解码器依赖，并在跨域（儿科零样本）与多骨干集成中保持增益。

title: Retroactive Concept Bottleneck Models for Exemplar-Free Class-Incremental Learning
summary: Exemplar-free class-incremental learning (EFCIL) requires models to learn new classes sequentially without retaining training samples from previous tasks. Continual concept bottleneck models (CBMs) make their predictions interpretable by identifying visual concepts in an image and using them to score each class. However, these methods typically focus on preserving learned concepts or approximating past classes with generated features, which can leave new concepts underused in old-class predictions. We propose RetroCBM, which retains a small set of vocabulary-independent statistics relating frozen visual features to the embedding space of a pretrained vision-language model. Even after earlier training images have been discarded, we can use these statistics to supervise new concepts. To do so, we develop a retroactive regression rule that yields the same predictor for each new concept as class-balanced ridge regression on all images seen so far. We then reproject the stored statistics to recover the full-history squared classification loss and thus learn how much each new concept should contribute to old-class predictions. Since the classifier may use systematic concept errors to distinguish nearby classes, we further introduce a graph-weighted penalty on the margin shifts caused by those errors. Across six datasets, RetroCBM outperforms state-of-the-art interpretable methods in all class-incremental settings, with an 18.1\% relative gain in mean average incremental accuracy over the strongest exemplar-free baseline.

AI.tldr: RetroCBM：无样本类增量学习中，用少量词表无关的冻结特征统计量实现"回溯式回归"，使新概念可服务旧类预测，并加图加权间距惩罚，六数据集上优于现有可解释方法。
AI.motivation: 持续概念瓶颈模型（CBM）在无样本类增量场景下，通常只关注保护已学概念或用生成特征近似旧类，导致新任务学到的概念难以用于旧类预测，概念利用率不足。
AI.method: 保留一小部分"词表无关"的统计量，刻画冻结视觉特征与预训练视觉-语言模型嵌入空间的关系；提出回溯式回归规则，使每个新概念的预测器等价于在迄今全部图像上做类平衡岭回归；再将统计量重投影以恢复全历史平方分类损失，从而学习新概念对旧类预测的贡献权重；此外引入图加权惩罚，抑制分类器利用系统性概念误差来区分相邻类别所造成的margin漂移。
AI.result: 在六个数据集的所有类增量设置下优于最先进的可解释方法，相对最强无样本基线在平均增量精度上取得18.1%的相对提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过存储轻量统计量并结合回溯式回归与margin惩罚，可在不保存旧样本的前提下让新概念有效参与旧类判别，兼顾可解释性与增量性能。

title: EviScope: Evidence-Conditioned Sampling for Long-Range 3D Detection
summary: Query-based camera-radar detectors choose where and over which frames each object query samples from the query's position or feature. We test whether radar evidence around the query should also set these choices at the 150 m range of MAN TruckScenes, where recall differs across object-level radar-return counts within every range band. EviScope is a minimal test: the current frame's returns form a non-learned bird's-eye evidence field, which each query reads at its decoded centre to scale its radial sampling extent and to weight eight frames. It adds 5,450 parameters (0.009%) to RaCFormer, with no latency increase in our timing. Our module-free recipe exceeds the published TruckScenes mAP (25.9 over seven runs against 24.1), so we measure the module only against its own baseline at matched seeds. The evidence a query reads rises with its object's return count (Spearman 0.51) but captures zero-return objects only in part, and the learned radius tracks it ($\rho\approx-0.91$ in four runs). Over seven four-epoch pairs the module changes NDS by $+0.31\pm0.36$ and mAP by $-0.27\pm0.22$ (mean $\pm$ SE). Against a geometry-only conditioner with the same parameter count, trained at three matched seeds, it is higher by $+1.25\pm0.72$ NDS and $+0.87\pm0.21$ mAP, on mAP in every pair, and the control's mean NDS is near the baseline's. An exploratory far-range gain failed an internally pre-specified held-out test, and large inference-time substitution penalties also occur without query-local evidence: neither learned allocation nor inference-time dependence substitutes for matched end-to-end comparisons.

AI.tldr: EviScope：用当前帧雷达回波构建非学习鸟瞰证据场，让每个 query 据其解码中心读取证据，自适应调整径向采样范围并加权融合八帧；仅增 5,450 参数（0.009%），无延迟增加，但平均收益不显著且未能稳定超越几何条件控制组。
AI.motivation: 检验在 150 m 远距场景（MAN TruckScenes）下，雷达证据是否应当参与决定 query 的采样位置与跨帧采样范围；此前 query-based 相机-雷达检测器仅由 query 自身位置/特征决定采样策略。
AI.method: 将当前帧雷达回波构成非学习的鸟瞰证据场，每个 query 在其解码中心读取该场，用于 (1) 缩放径向采样范围、(2) 对八帧做加权；嵌入 RaCFormer，附加 5,450 参数。评估含 7 组四轮训练配对、同种子对照、几何-only 同参数量条件组，以及预注册的留出测试。
AI.result: 模块无关的改进配方已达 25.9 mAP（7 次运行）高于发表值 24.1；证据强度与目标回波数正相关（Spearman 0.51），学习半径与证据强负相关（ρ≈−0.91）；但模块相对自身基线 NDS +0.31±0.36、mAP −0.27±0.22（不显著）；对同参数量几何条件组提升 +1.25±0.72 NDS、+0.87±0.21 mAP；远距增益未通过预注册留出测试，推理时替换惩罚在无 query 局部证据时同样出现。
AI.conclusion: query 局部雷达证据可被读出并影响采样分配，但端到端效果不稳健，不能替代匹配的端到端对照；对"证据不应显式决定采样"提出审慎的否定性证据。

title: Homeward: No Place Like the Training View
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies implicitly assume that third-person cameras remain fixed at their data-collection poses; once a camera is bumped, remounted, or swapped at deployment, task success degrades precipitously even though the underlying task and robot remain unchanged. We present Homeward, a training-free, plug-and-play observation adapter that canonicalizes observations from an uncalibrated deployment camera back into the training view for frozen VLA policies. Our design stems from a closed-loop diagnostic paradox in simulation: while re-rendering perturbed views into the training camera with oracle geometry recovers much of the lost performance, substituting an off-the-shelf feed-forward 3D foundation model can leave the policy worse off than applying no correction at all. This degradation concentrates on the thin, articulated robot arm, which feed-forward depth prediction tears and scatters - yet the arm's exact 3D state is already known from robot kinematics. Homeward exploits this asymmetry: it estimates what is unknown - camera parameters and static scene depth - from the live RGB frame and a single training-view reference, and renders what is known - the moving robot links - directly from the kinematic model. Evaluated across $\sim$300,000 closed-loop episodes spanning four frozen VLAs, Homeward boosts success across all 1,599 camera variants of LIBERO-Plus from 62.5%, 76.5%, 68.0%, and 3.6% to 77.6%, 95.1%, 91.2%, and 26.4% for OpenVLA-OFT, $\pi_{0.5}$, $\pi_0$, and OpenVLA, respectively. Without any scene fine-tuning or deployment camera calibration, Homeward extends to 6-DoF random placements, focal-length changes, and, with per-step pose estimation, continuous intra-episode camera drift, while matching or surpassing a calibrated, scene-trained view-synthesis baseline on three of four policies on LIBERO-Plus.

AI.tldr: Homeward: a training-free, plug-and-play observation adapter that canonicalizes uncalibrated deployment camera views back into the training viewpoint for frozen VLA policies, using live RGB + a single training-view reference to estimate camera intrinsics/extrinsics and static depth, while rendering the moving robot links from kinematics instead of feed-forward depth.
AI.motivation: VLA policies implicitly assume third-person cameras stay at data-collection poses; camera bump/remount/swap at deployment causes sharp success drops even though task and robot are unchanged. Feed-forward 3D foundation models, used as a naive correction, tear and scatter the thin articulated arm and can be worse than no correction.
AI.method: Exploit a known/unknown asymmetry: unknown = camera parameters and static scene depth, estimated from the live RGB frame plus one training-view reference; known = robot link geometry, rendered directly from the kinematic model. Compose the two into a re-rendered canonicalized observation fed to a frozen VLA. Training-free, no scene fine-tuning, no deployment calibration; optional per-step pose estimation for intra-episode drift.
AI.result: ~300k closed-loop episodes over 4 frozen VLAs; on all 1,599 LIBERO-Plus camera variants, success rises from 62.5/76.5/68.0/3.6% to 77.6/95.1/91.2/26.4% for OpenVLA-OFT, π0.5, π0, OpenVLA. Generalizes to 6-DoF random placements and focal-length changes; with per-step pose estimation handles continuous camera drift; matches or beats a calibrated, scene-trained view-synthesis baseline on 3/4 policies.
AI.conclusion: Viewpoint canonicalization with hybrid known-kinematics + estimated-geometry rendering is an effective, model-agnostic robustness fix for frozen VLA policies, and demonstrates that hybrid geometric priors beat pure feed-forward 3D models on thin articulated structures.

title: ShoWorld: Shape-Faithful Multi-Hypothesis Occupancy World Model
summary: Occupancy world models struggle to forecast moving objects due to motion uncertainty and shape distortion. A single trajectory can average plausible futures into an implausible path, and repeated re-voxelization can erode or inflate object shape even under correct motion. We introduce ShoWorld to address these challenges through separate motion and shape representations. The motion forecaster predicts probabilistic trajectories conditioned on scene layout, nearby agents and the future ego trajectory. Each hypothesis is rendered into occupancy and fused according to its probability to retain alternative futures. The shape component predicts sub-voxel points with occupancy probabilities and offsets from local geometry. These points move rigidly with the object, and voxel occupancy follows the probability that at least one occupied point falls within it. This representation reduces shape distortion under motion. ShoWorld achieves state-of-the-art results on Occ3D-nuScenes. With ground-truth occupancy and ego trajectory, it improves mIoU and IoU by 6.56 and 9.16 points overall and by 6.06 and 5.53 points on dynamic classes.

AI.tldr: ShoWorld 将占用世界模型解耦为运动与形状两部分：运动预测器在场景布局、邻近智能体和自车未来轨迹条件下预测概率化轨迹并按概率融合渲染；形状部分用带占用概率与偏移的亚体素点集随物体刚体运动，再由"体素内至少一个占用点"的概率生成体素占用，缓解运动不确定性与重复体素化带来的形状畸变，在 Occ3D-nuScenes 上取得 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 占用世界模型在预测运动物体时面临两类问题：(1) 运动不确定性导致单一轨迹把多个合理未来平均成不合理的路径；(2) 即使运动正确，反复重体素化也会侵蚀或膨胀物体形状。作者认为根源在于运动与形状被耦合在同一体素表示中，因此需要分离二者。
AI.method: 方法由两个模块组成。运动预测器以场景布局、邻近 agent 及未来自车轨迹为条件，输出多模态概率轨迹假设，每条假设渲染为占用后按概率融合，以保留备选未来。形状模块从局部几何回归亚体素点，每个点带占用概率与相对局部几何的偏移；点随物体做刚体变换，体素占用由"至少一个占用点落入该体素"的概率决定，从而在运动过程中抑制形状畸变。
AI.result: 在 Occ3D-nuScenes 上达到 SOTA。在给定真值占用与自车轨迹的条件下，整体 mIoU 与 IoU 分别提升 6.56 和 9.16 点，动态类别上分别提升 6.06 和 5.53 点。
AI.conclusion: 将运动（概率化轨迹假设+概率融合）与形状（亚体素点集+刚体运动+点级占用聚合）分离，是提升占用世界模型对动态物体预测质量的有效设计范式，且适用于自动驾驶场景的未来占用推演。

title: Anchoring with Visual Evidence: Explicit Semantic Anchors for Joint Change Detection and Captioning
summary: Joint change detection and captioning seeks to localize changes and describe them from bi-temporal remote sensing images. A key challenge is translating dense visual evidence into the semantic conditions that guide description generation. We propose Explicit Semantic Anchors (ESA), a supervised interface that exposes entity presence, temporal appearance variation, and spatial extent. A prediction-guided readout combines visual features and predicted change probabilities, and three factor heads estimate the corresponding anchor activations. These activations guide generation through two complementary routes. The context route maps the three factor activations to three separate memory tokens, one per factor, and appends them to the dense visual memory, while the lexicon route produces an additive vocabulary bias at each decoding step. Dense visual memory remains available for spatial detail and information beyond the explicit factors. Anchor targets are derived from existing images and change annotations, requiring no additional anchor-level language annotation. At inference, all conditions are computed from the input image pair and the model's own predictions. Experiments on LEVIR-MCI and WHU-CDC show strong joint detection and captioning performance, supporting the use of supervised visual attributes as explicit conditions for change description generation.

AI.tldr: 提出显式语义锚点(ESA)接口，将双时相遥感变化检测的稠密视觉证据转化为实体存在、时相外观变化、空间范围三类语义锚点激活，经上下文路由(三个记忆token)与词典路由(解码词表偏置)引导变化描述生成，无需额外锚点级语言标注。
AI.motivation: 联合变化检测与描述生成的关键难点在于：如何把稠密的视觉证据转化为可指导语言生成的语义条件，现有端到端方法缺乏显式、可监督的语义中间接口。
AI.method: 监督式ESA接口：预测引导读出将视觉特征与预测变化概率融合，三个因子头分别估计实体存在、时相外观变化、空间范围的锚点激活；上下文路由把三因子激活映射为三个独立memory token追加到稠密视觉记忆，词典路由在每个解码步产生加性词表偏置；锚点标签由现有图像与变化标注自动导出。推理时所有条件由输入图像对与模型自身预测计算。
AI.result: 在LEVIR-MCI与WHU-CDC数据集上取得较强的联合检测与描述生成性能。
AI.conclusion: 以监督的视觉属性作为显式条件可有效提升变化描述生成，验证了显式语义锚点接口在遥感联合变化检测-描述任务中的可行性。

title: When to Refine: Selective Search for Frozen Visual World Models
summary: Planning with a visual world model requires deciding both which actions to execute and how long to search for them. We introduce Selective CEM Refinement (SCR), a learned rule for deciding whether to continue cross-entropy method (CEM) search with a frozen LeWorldModel. After five it- erations, the gate measures how far the mean first action chunk has moved, how much the mean terminal cost of elite plans has fallen, and how widely their first chunks vary. It returns the current plan for execution or continues the same search for ten more iterations. The gate requires no addi- tional world-model rollout. On 16 PushT scenes evaluated with two planning seeds, SCR succeeded in 25 of 32 trials, compared with 28 of 32 for fixed 15-iteration search (Fixed-15). All 25 SCR suc- cesses occurred in trials that Fixed-15 also solved, yield- ing 89.29% paired success retention. Across complete episodes, including replanning, SCR evaluated 23.81% fewer candidate plans and reduced mean controller time per eight-environment batch by 17.22%. Its observed suc- cess rate was 5.36 percentage points above an analytic mix- ture of the two fixed-depth controllers at the same expected candidate workload, although the difference changed sign across planning seeds. Compared with gating only at the initial solve under the same random-draw padding proto- col, gating again at replanning produced nine additional early exits. This reduced total candidate evaluations by 15.79%, while successes fell from 27 to 25.

AI.tldr: SCR：在冻结的LeWorldModel上用一个轻量门控决定CEM搜索是否提前停止（5次迭代后判断，继续则再跑10次），无需额外世界模型rollout。
AI.motivation: 视觉世界模型规划中，动作选取与搜索深度（计算量）都需决策；固定迭代次数的CEM浪费算力，而过早停止会降低成功率，需要自适应搜索预算。
AI.method: 在CEM第5次迭代后，用冻结的LeWorldModel计算三个统计量：首动作chunk均值的移动距离、精英方案平均终止代价的下降幅度、首chunk的方差；训练一个学习型门控据此决定返回当前计划还是再迭代10次。门控本身不需额外rollout。
AI.result: 16个PushT场景×2个随机种子：SCR成功25/32，固定15次迭代成功28/32；SCR的25次成功均为Fixed-15也成功的试验（配对成功率保留89.29%）。完整回合（含重规划）下候选方案评估减少23.81%，每8环境批次平均控制时间降低17.22%；观测成功率比同等期望计算量的两固定深度控制器解析混合高5.36个百分点，但该差异随种子改变符号。相较仅在初始求解门控，重规划时再次门控额外产生9次提前退出，候选评估总数再降15.79%，成功率由27降至25。
AI.conclusion: 提出一种无额外rollout的CEM早停门控，可显著降低候选评估与控制时间，但存在成功率损失且优势随随机种子不稳定；单任务、小规模实验，收益与稳健性仍需更强证据。

title: Every Query Routes Itself: Accelerating Video Diffusion Transformers with Per-Query Routed Sparse Attention
summary: Self-attention over long token sequences dominates the inference cost of video diffusion transformers. Clustering-based sparse attention clusters both queries and keys and lets all queries in a cluster share one selection of key clusters. We show that this sharing limits accuracy: with key clusters and density fixed, attention grows more accurate as the query clusters are refined, and is most accurate when each query selects on its own, which needs no query clustering at all. We therefore propose Per-Query Routed Sparse Attention (PQRS), a training-free method that clusters only keys, lets each query select its own key clusters, and compensates for the unselected ones with their centroids. Per-query selections leave no query tile with a shared key list, so PQRS traverses key clusters instead of queries, buckets queries with identical selections into dense tasks, and merges their partial results in one pass under a fixed softmax offset carried from the previous denoising step. On four text-to-video and image-to-video models from the Wan and HunyuanVideo families, PQRS is the fastest of all the sparse attention methods we evaluate and the closest to the dense output, reaching $28.9$ dB PSNR on Wan2.1-T2V and $35.4$ dB on HunyuanVideo at $1.66$--$2.10\times$ end-to-end speedup.

AI.tldr: PQRS: 训练无关的逐查询路由稀疏注意力，仅对 key 聚类、让每个 query 独立选择 key 簇，并以簇质心补偿未选簇，在 Wan/HunyuanVideo 上实现 1.66–2.10× 端到端加速且最接近稠密输出。
AI.motivation: 视频扩散 Transformer 的推理开销主要来自长序列上的自注意力。现有聚类稀疏注意力让同一 query 簇内所有 query 共享一套 key 簇选择，作者指出这种共享会损失精度：在 key 簇与密度固定时，细化的 query 簇精度更高，完全不聚类（每 query 独立选择）最优。
AI.method: 训练无关方法：仅对 key 做聚类，每个 query 独立选择自己的 key 簇；未选中的 key 用其簇质心近似补偿。由于逐 query 选择不再有共享 key 列表的 query tile，PQRS 改为遍历 key 簇，将选择完全相同的 query 分桶为稠密任务，并在一次 pass 中合并局部结果，同时沿用上一步去噪的固定 softmax 偏移以保证数值一致。
AI.result: 在 Wan 与 HunyuanVideo 家族共四个文生视频/图生视频模型上评测：PQRS 是所有对比稀疏注意力方法中最快的，且输出最接近稠密结果；Wan2.1-T2V 达 28.9 dB PSNR，HunyuanVideo 达 35.4 dB，端到端加速 1.66–2.10×。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了共享 key 选择是聚类稀疏注意力的精度瓶颈，提出解耦的逐查询路由方案，在无需训练的前提下兼顾速度与保真度，可作为视频扩散模型的高效推理即插即用组件。

title: RECLAIM: Robot-Vision-Informed Adversarial Patch Defense via Embodied Attention Feedback
summary: Vision-language-action policies control embodied agents through a perception-action loop grounded in physical interaction, where adversarial patches can corrupt action predictions and thereby alter subsequent observations. To mitigate these threats, many existing defenses rely on policy adaptation or auxiliary models, but require additional training or inference. We introduce RECLAIM, a training-free, inference-time defense that uses a frozen VLA's own attention response to local visual interventions to guide purification during closed-loop embodied manipulation. Our key insight is that attention changes induced by local edits provide feedback for choosing where and how to purify as the robot interacts with its environment. RECLAIM combines this feedback with robot geometry to refine patch localization and select local treatments, then revalidates them as the agent's embodied actions change the observed scene. We evaluate RECLAIM against patches generated by four adversarial attack methods across multiple manipulation task suites under frozen VLA control. Under adversarial patch attacks, RECLAIM succeeds in at least one rollout on 95% of the evaluated tasks and raises rollout success on LIBERO-Object from 0% without defense to 70.0%. Its mean decision time is only 548.9 ms per control step. These results highlight policy-guided visual purification as an effective approach to defending embodied agents against adversarial patches and recovering closed-loop task execution.

AI.tldr: RECLAIM：利用冻结VLA自身对局部视觉编辑的注意力响应作为反馈，在闭环操作中免训练地定位并净化对抗补丁。
AI.motivation: VLA策略的感知-动作闭环使对抗补丁可持续污染动作预测并改变后续观测；现有防御依赖策略微调或辅助模型，需额外训练/推理开销。
AI.method: 训练无关的推理时防御：以冻结VLA对局部图像修改的注意力变化作为反馈信号；结合机器人几何先验精化补丁定位、选择局部净化处理；随具身动作改变场景后迭代重验证处理效果。
AI.result: 在四类攻击方法生成的补丁、多个操作任务套件上评估：95%任务至少一次rollout成功；LIBERO-Object rollout成功率从无防御0%提升至70.0%；平均决策时间548.9 ms/控制步。
AI.conclusion: 策略引导的视觉净化可有效抵御具身智能体对抗补丁，并恢复闭环任务执行。

title: Single-Controller Teleoperation and Multimodal Dataset Generation for a Mobile Manipulator
summary: Robot learning systems require synchronized, high-quality demonstrations that combine visual, proprioceptive, and action data. However, collecting such datasets with mobile manipulators is often slowed down by fragmented teleoperation interfaces and manual post-processing workflows. This paper presents an integrated framework for teleoperated multimodal data collection on a Clearpath Dingo-O mobile base equipped with a Kinova Gen3 Lite manipulator and an Intel RealSense RGB-D camera. The framework combines single-controller operation of the base, arm, and recording process with an automated ROS-based pipeline for data capture, image-quality filtering, temporal synchronization, visualization, and export to machine-learning-ready Zarr datasets. We validate the system on a pick-and-place mobile-manipulation task in which the robot transports a bottle between two surfaces. The results show that the unified controller supports complete task execution and recording without external commands, while the data pipeline produces synchronized datasets for short demonstrations and identifies corrupted visual frames. The proposed framework provides a practical basis for producing structured demonstrations for robot-learning research.

AI.tldr: 提出一套在Dingo-O移动底盘+Kinova Gen3 Lite+RealSense上的遥操作多模态数据采集框架：单手柄统一控制底盘/机械臂/录制，配套自动化ROS流水线完成图像质量过滤、时间同步、可视化与导出为Zarr数据集，并在抓取-放置任务上验证。
AI.motivation: 机器人学习需要同步、高质量的视觉-本体感觉-动作多模态示教数据，而移动操作平台的采集流程受碎片化遥操作接口与手工后处理拖慢，缺乏端到端集成方案。
AI.method: 硬件为移动底座+轻量机械臂+RGB-D相机；软件采用单一控制器同时操控底座、机械臂与录制触发，并构建基于ROS的自动化流水线：数据采集、图像质量筛选（识别损坏帧）、时间戳同步、可视化与Zarr格式导出。
AI.result: 统一控制器可在无外部指令情况下完成整段任务执行与录制；流水线可对短示教生成时间同步数据集并检测出损坏视觉帧。仅在一个瓶子搬运的抓取-放置任务上验证。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为机器人学习研究提供了实用的结构化示教数据生产基础，但缺少下游策略学习实验与规模化数据验证，属工程性工具贡献。

title: OmniFish: A Bioinspired, Modular, Reconfigurable Soft Robotic Fish Enabling Multi-Modal Swimming
comment: Under review at Bioinspiration & Biomimetics. 10 figures, 7 tables
summary: In this work, we introduce OmniFish, a bioinspired modular soft robotic fish designed to emulate the full spectrum of body and/or caudal fin (BCF) locomotion modes within a single robotic platform. The design combines morphology averaging across representative fish species with a tendon-driven compliant segmented spine whose effective stiffness can be reconfigured through progressive mechanical jamming. By selectively constraining body segments, OmniFish shifts deformation from whole-body undulation to posterior body bending and localized tail oscillation, enabling bioinspired Anguilliform, Subcarangiform, Carangiform, Thunniform, and Ostraciiform swimming using a single tendon-driven actuator. The design was guided by morphometric analysis and evaluated through caudal-fin thrust characterization, numerical body-drag simulations, kinematic analysis, and swimming performance experiments. Kinematic analysis confirmed the intended robot transition from distributed body undulation to localized tail oscillation. Swimming experiments demonstrated distinct mode-dependent performance, with the Ostraciiform configuration achieving the highest straight-line velocity of 8.14 cm/s and the lowest cost of transport of 2.42 at 1.5 tail beats/s. These proof-of-concept results show that a mechanically simple stiffness-reconfigurable architecture can generate distinct BCF swimming modes and provide a versatile strategy for developing multimodal soft robotic fish.

AI.tldr: OmniFish: 一种受生物启发的模块化软体机器鱼, 通过可重构刚度的分段肌腱驱动脊椎, 单一驱动实现 Anguilliform/Subcarangiform/Carangiform/Thunniform/Ostraciiform 五种 BCF 游动模式。
AI.motivation: 现有机器鱼多针对单一游动模式设计, 难以在一平台上复现 BCF 全域运动谱系; 希望用机械结构(而非多执行器)实现模式切换, 提升平台通用性与简洁性。
AI.method: 基于多种代表性鱼类的形态学平均做外形设计; 采用肌腱驱动的柔性分段脊柱, 通过渐进式机械阻塞(particle jamming 类)调节有效刚度; 选择性约束体节, 使变形从整体波动转向后体弯曲与尾部局部振荡。评估手段包括形态测量分析、尾鳍推力表征、数值体阻仿真、运动学分析与游动性能实验。
AI.result: 运动学分析证实机器人可从分布式身体波动过渡到局部尾部振荡; 不同模式性能差异明显, Ostraciiform 构型在 1.5 摆尾/秒下达到最高直线速度 8.14 cm/s 与最低运输成本 2.42。
AI.conclusion: 机械结构简单、刚度可重构的架构即可产生多种可区分的 BCF 游动模式, 为多模态软体机器鱼提供通用设计策略; 目前为原理验证阶段, 模式切换的定量控制与水下自主性仍有待完善。

title: Comparing Each Generation with Independent Siblings Gives Video World Model Post-Training a Proper Objective for Outcome Frequencies
summary: Video world models are used as simulators, so when a first frame leaves several physical outcomes open, repeated generations should produce each outcome as often as it occurs in the data. Physics post-training scores every generation against the single recorded future of its history, which makes single videos more faithful, but the expected score is linear in the model distribution and is maximized by always producing the most likely outcome. The log-likelihood of the recorded outcome is maximized by the data distribution, and its gradient weights agreement with the record by the inverse of how often the model produces the generated outcome, a frequency that other generations of the same history with independent noise, its siblings, can estimate. To train with this weight from a finite group, we propose SibPO, which performs Sibling-paired Policy Optimization: siblings estimate a truncated inverse-frequency weight for agreement with the record, and a second term subtracts the same weight times the agreement with the siblings, which makes the expected objective a strictly proper divergence over outcome cells at every group size. On PisaBench, SibPO lowers the KS distance to simulated landing times by 9.1-10.2% relative to the strongest method outside its reward family on three of four video models without degrading single videos, and it lowers the error of estimated robot policy success rates by 13%.

AI.tldr: SibPO：利用同源"兄弟"样本估计截断逆频率权重，构造严格proper散度目标，使视频世界模型生成的多结果分布匹配数据分布而非集中于最可能结果。
AI.motivation: 物理后训练以单条记录未来做打分，期望分数对模型分布线性，最优解退化为总输出最可能结果，导致多结果场景下生成多样性/概率校准缺失。
AI.method: 以记录结果对数似然的梯度出发，权重为模型产生该结果的频率的倒数；用同一历史、独立噪声的兄弟样本估计该频率（截断），并增加减去同权重乘兄弟一致性的第二项，使任意组大小下目标成为结果单元上的严格proper散度。
AI.result: PisaBench上，四个视频模型中三个的着陆时间KS距离相对非同族最强方法降低9.1–10.2%，单视频质量不降；估计机器人策略成功率的误差降低13%。
AI.conclusion: 成对兄弟分组可低成本实现分布级（proper scoring）物理后训练，兼顾单样本保真与多模态概率校准，对下游策略评估更可靠。

title: RAID: Representation Autoencoder for Intrinsic Decomposition
summary: Single-image intrinsic decomposition is an inherently ill-posed problem, requiring the disentanglement of strongly coupled appearance factors from a single RGB observation. Recent methods address this ambiguity with diffusion priors, at the cost of large, iterative, and often stochastic models. We show that accurate decomposition does not require a large generative model. Our key idea is to decouple reconstruction from decomposition on top of a strong pretrained representation. First, an $X \rightarrow X$ teacher learns to reconstruct each intrinsic map from DINOv3 features using a shared decoder, without paired RGB-to-intrinsic supervision. Then, a DINOv3-based student predicts the corresponding teacher representations from RGB through lightweight, modality-specific projections, enabling training on partially annotated datasets and predicting all intrinsics in a single forward pass. \textbf{RAID}, predicts intrinsic properties in the structured latent space, enabling a compact 165M-parameter model, 100x faster than diffusion-based methods. Despite its compact size, it achieves competitive or superior decomposition quality, with improved robustness to input resolution. Additionally, our learned projections yield interpretable, modality-specific feature spaces.

AI.tldr: RAID 用强预训练表征 DINOv3 解耦"重建"与"分解"：先用 X→X 教师从 DINOv3 特征重建各本征图，再用轻量模态投影从 RGB 预测教师特征，单次前传输出全部本征属性，165M 参数、比扩散法快 100 倍。
AI.motivation: 单图本征分解（反照率/光照等）本质是不适定问题，强耦合的外观因素难以解耦。现有方法依赖扩散先验，模型大、需迭代采样、随机性强，推理代价高。作者主张精度提升不必来自大规模生成模型，而应来自强判别式表征 + 恰当的解耦训练策略。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：(1) X→X 教师——以共享解码器从 DINOv3 特征重建每个本征图，无需 RGB→本征的配对监督；(2) 学生——基于 DINOv3 骨干，通过模态特定的轻量投影从 RGB 预测对应教师表征，从而可在部分标注数据集上训练，并在单次前传中同时预测所有本征通道。最终在结构化隐空间内做本征预测。
AI.result: 模型仅 165M 参数，推理速度较扩散方法快约 100×；分解质量达到有竞争力或更优水平，并在输入分辨率变化下鲁棒性更强；学到的模态特定投影呈现可解释的特征空间。
AI.conclusion: 用强预训练表征配合"重建-分解解耦"的两阶段蒸馏，可在远小得多的紧凑模型上实现与非生成式/生成式基座相当甚至更优的本征分解，表明精度瓶颈不在生成模型规模，而在表征与监督组织方式。摘要未给出具体基准数据、定量指标与代码公开信息。

title: SCRiD: Spatial and Contextual References for Generalizable AI-Generated Video Detection
summary: Generalizable AI-generated video detection remains challenging because natural motion and content variations can resemble synthesis artifacts, making isolated video discrepancies unreliable indicators of authenticity. To address this challenge, we propose Spatial and Contextual Reference-informed Detection (SCRiD), a framework that interprets video variations through complementary spatial and contextual references. Specifically, we introduce Matched-Coordinate Residual Response (MCR) to characterize temporal residual associations under motion and coordinate references with matched subpixel sampling conditions. We further develop Real-Conditioned Score Adaptation (RCSA), which learns a content-conditioned denoising reference from authentic videos and probes its responses across multiple noise scales and quality views to guide feature adaptation. To integrate these complementary sources of evidence, we design Reversible Evidence Exchange (REE) to enable information exchange through reversible symplectic updates. We train SCRiD using synthetic videos from only 4 generators and evaluate it across 88 generator or task subsets spanning 6 benchmarks. Our method achieves average ACC and AP of 72.72% and 74.23%, respectively, outperforming the strongest baseline by 3.24 and 0.81 percentage this http URL and robustness experiments further validate the effectiveness of the proposed components and the stability of SCRiD under common post-processing operations.

AI.tldr: SCRiD框架通过空间与上下文参考解释视频差异，实现可泛化的AI生成视频检测。
AI.motivation: 自然运动与内容变化会与合成伪影混淆，单一孤立的视频差异不足以可靠判定真实性，需借助互补参考提升跨生成器泛化性。
AI.method: 提出Matched-Coordinate Residual Response（MCR），在运动与坐标参考下以匹配的亚像素采样条件刻画时序残差关联；提出Real-Conditioned Score Adaptation（RCSA），从真实视频学习内容条件的去噪参考，并在多噪声尺度与质量视角下探测其响应以引导特征自适应；设计Reversible Evidence Exchange（REE），通过可逆辛更新实现互补证据的信息交换。
AI.result: 仅用4个生成器合成视频训练，在6个基准的88个生成器或任务子集上评估，平均ACC 72.72%、AP 74.23%，较最强基线分别提升3.24与0.81个百分点；消融与鲁棒性实验验证各组件有效性及常见后处理下的稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 多参考证据融合可显著提升生成视频检测的跨生成器泛化性与鲁棒性，但方法属通用CV检测范畴，与具身智能核心方向的关联有限。

title: Fuse Before Reconstruct: A Novel Reconstruction Paradigm for Multimodal Industrial Anomaly Detection
comment: Preprint before peer review. Includes supplementary material. Code: this https URL
summary: Industrial anomaly detection plays a pivotal role in precision manufacturing, where joint analysis of multimodal data emerges as a critical approach to enhance detection accuracy. Feature reconstruction, a dominant paradigm for such joint analysis, is primarily implemented through intra-modal and cross-modal methods, both of which are plagued by significant limitations. Intra-modal reconstruction neglects complementary cross-modal information, while its cross-modal counterpart is prone to projection errors and ambiguous one-to-many mappings (e.g., same textures mapping to multiple geometries), leading to detection failures. To address these limitations, we propose a novel feature reconstruction paradigm, Fuse Before Reconstruct (FBR), which first fuses multimodal features and then performs reconstruction for anomaly detection. Firstly, we propose a bidirectional cross-modal attention mechanism to achieve deep feature complementarity between image and point cloud features, mitigating projection bias through channel alignment and dynamic spatial prior integration. Besides, a learnable pixel-wise gated fusion strategy is adopted to preserve multi-modal structural consistency while optimizing local feature combination. Finally, dual-path collaborative reconstruction is implemented to recover original modal features from the fused representations, where cross-modal consistency constraints effectively eliminate mapping ambiguities. Extensive experiments show that FBR achieves 98.3% I-AUROC on MVTec 3D-AD and 92.6% I-AUROC on Eyecandies, surpassing previous state-of-the-art methods by +2.9% and +4.1%, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出"先融合后重建"(FBR)多模态工业异常检测范式:先用双向跨模态注意力对齐通道与动态空间先验,再加可学习逐像素门控融合,最后双路协同重建并加跨模态一致性约束,在MVTec 3D-AD达98.3% I-AUROC、Eyecandies达92.6%。
AI.motivation: 工业异常检测中多模态联合分析日益重要,但主流特征重建范式存在两类缺陷:模态内重建忽略跨模态互补信息;跨模态重建易受投影误差与一对多映射歧义影响导致检测失败。
AI.method: 1) 双向跨模态注意力实现图像与点云特征的深度互补,通过通道对齐与动态空间先验整合缓解投影偏差;2) 可学习逐像素门控融合策略,在优化局部特征组合的同时保持多模态结构一致性;3) 双路协同重建,从融合表示恢复原始各模态特征,并用跨模态一致性约束消除映射歧义。
AI.result: 在MVTec 3D-AD上取得98.3% I-AUROC,在Eyecandies上取得92.6% I-AUROC,分别较此前SOTA提升+2.9%与+4.1%。
AI.conclusion: 将重建对象从单模态/跨模态投影改为融合表示,可同时获得互补性与映射一致性,是工业RGB-3D异常检测的有效新范式,但尚未涉及机器人操作或通用三维重建场景。

title: TinyARM-X: A Series of Open-Source, Configurable, and Transparent Torque-Controlled Desktop-Scale Robotic Manipulators
comment: 9 pages, 5 figures. Submitted to a robotics Journal. Reviews have not come in yet
summary: Visuomotor policies have demonstrated that imprecise low-cost robots can autonomously complete complex manipulation tasks. However, most inexpensive manipulators rely on compact and rigidly position-controlled servos for actuation, which complicate simulation, operation, and safety. This work introduces TinyARM-X, a framework for easily manufacturable, configurable, and torque-controllable low-cost (<350 USD) serial manipulators. By using a single hardware/software architecture, a <7 Degree of Freedom (DoF) TinyARM can be manually reconfigured to an operational >3 DoF robot within 10 min. Actuator modeling and dynamic compensation enable torque-controlled applications like mixed-reality impedance control teleoperation and simulator force feedback rendering. Experiments include mechanical benchmarking and real-world force-aware telemanipulation. The TinyARM-7 has a payload of 33.5 g, a max speed of 0.77 m/s, and a reach of 210 mm. Moreover, with dynamic compensation, the robot has a backdrive-breakaway force of 1.4 N and a backdrive-running force of 0.7 N. Additionally, Cartesian-Impedance Control (CIC) attains a translational stiffness of >15 N/m. Lastly, the TinyARM-X stack is open-sourced to disseminate accessible desktop-scale torque-controlled robotic manipulation to the community.

AI.tldr: TinyARM-X：低成本(<350 USD)、可重配置、可力矩控制的串联机械臂框架，含执行器建模与动态补偿，支持阻抗控制遥操作与仿真力反馈。
AI.motivation: 低成本机械臂多用紧凑刚性位置伺服，导致仿真建模难、操作受限且安全性差；缺少可负担的桌面级力矩控制平台。
AI.method: 统一硬件/软件架构，<=7 DoF 模块化可手工重构（<10 min 变为>3 DoF 机器人）；执行器建模+动态补偿实现力矩控制，构建混合现实阻抗控制遥操作与仿真器力反馈渲染。
AI.result: TinyARM-7 负载33.5 g、最大速度0.77 m/s、臂展210 mm；动态补偿后反驱启动力1.4 N、运行力0.7 N；笛卡尔阻抗控制平移刚度>15 N/m；含机械基准测试与真实力感知遥操作实验；开源。
AI.conclusion: 提供可复现、廉价、可重构的桌面级力矩控制操作平台，推动社区普及力控机械臂研究。

title: SCR: Detecting Backdoor-Poisoned Samples through Clean-Reference Residuals
summary: Deep neural networks are vulnerable to backdoor attacks, in which adversaries manipulate model predictions by injecting poisoned samples into training data. Detecting these samples remains challenging because legitimate semantic variation can obscure poisoning-related signals in learned representations. Consequently, class-level statistics used by existing detectors may flag benign feature deviations while overlooking poisoned samples that blend into the class distribution. In this paper, we propose Semantic Counterfactual Residualization (SCR), which uses a small set of clean reference samples to account for benign variation through sample-specific feature reconstruction.
