SCR identifies poisoned samples by detecting coherent deviations from these clean baselines, without requiring prior knowledge of the attacks. We evaluate SCR through experiments covering twelve dirty-label and clean-label attacks across CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and Tiny ImageNet. With a small clean-reference set, SCR achieves attack-averaged true positive rates above 99.5\% and false positive rates below 2\% on each dataset, outperforming eight representative detection baselines in macro-TPR.

AI.tldr: 提出语义反事实残差化（SCR），用少量干净参考样本做样本级特征重构以抵消良性语义变异，通过检测与干净基线的相干偏差识别后门中毒样本，无需攻击先验。
AI.motivation: 现有后门检测器依赖类级别统计，合法语义变异会掩盖中毒信号，既误报良性特征偏移，又漏掉融入类分布的中毒样本。
AI.method: SCR 以小型干净参考集构造样本特异的重构基线，将每个样本特征对干净基线做反事实残差化，在残差空间中检测一致性偏差以判定投毒样本；不依赖攻击类型先验知识。
AI.result: 在 CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、Tiny ImageNet 上覆盖 12 种 dirty-label 与 clean-label 攻击，攻击平均 TPR 超过 99.5%，FPR 低于 2%，macro-TPR 优于 8 个代表性检测基线。
AI.conclusion: 样本级残差化能有效分离良性变异与中毒信号，显著提升跨攻击、跨数据集的检测鲁棒性，且仅需少量干净参考样本。

title: Beyond Appearance: Evidence-Guided Programmatic 3D Scene Reconstruction with Agentic Lighting Reasoning
comment: Project Page: this https URL Code: this https URL
summary: Image-to-code methods for 3D scene reconstruction produce executable code that generates editable digital content and supports visual simulation. However, existing methods primarily rely on appearance similarity, which provides limited guidance for distinguishing errors in geometry, materials, and illumination. Light shapes scene appearance through its interactions with geometry and materials, influencing shading, cast shadows, and reflections. We therefore present LightHarness, a VLM-based agentic framework that incorporates explicit lighting reasoning into iterative scene reconstruction. To be specific, we leverage complementary geometric, intrinsic, and illumination cues to jointly refine scene structure and appearance, and propose Lighting Reasoning Memory to maintain light-source hypotheses, which supports evidence, and revision history throughout iterations. Together, they support reasoning about partially visible and unseen sources, with evidence-guided verification directing subsequent revisions. Our framework reconstructs explicit scenes through coherent reasoning about geometry, materials, and illumination without additional training or differentiable rendering. Extensive experiments demonstrate superior image-to-code reconstruction accuracy under challenging shadows and complex illumination, further supporting downstream scene editing, object insertion, and versatile relighting.

AI.tldr: LightHarness 是一个基于 VLM 的智能体框架，在迭代式图像到代码 3D 场景重建中引入显式光照推理，通过几何/本征/光照互补线索与"光照推理记忆"联合精化场景结构与外观。
AI.motivation: 现有 image-to-code 重建方法主要依赖外观相似度，难以区分几何、材质与光照层面的错误。由于光照通过其与几何、材质的交互决定阴影、投射阴影与反射，显式建模光照可作为更强的诊断信号，尤其是对部分可见或不可见光源的推断。
AI.method: LightHarness 为 VLM agent 驱动的迭代重建流程：利用几何、本征（intrinsic）与光照三类互补线索联合优化场景结构与外观；提出 Lighting Reasoning Memory 维护光源假设、支撑证据与修订历史，从而在迭代中对外观证据进行引导式校验并驱动后续修正；无需额外训练、无需可微渲染即可产出显式可执行场景代码。
AI.result: 在具有挑战性阴影与复杂光照条件下，image-to-code 重建精度优于已有方法；并进一步支持下游场景编辑、物体插入与多样化重打光应用。
AI.conclusion: 显式光照推理与记忆化的假设维护能有效弥补纯外观相似度的监督不足，为 agent 驱动、可编辑的 3D 场景代码重建提供无需训练的可解释迭代范式。

title: BaseRSI: Recursive Self-Improvement of a Base Vision-Language Model via Training-Free Harness Internalization
summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) is moving from the harness of prompts and tools around a base model toward the model itself. However, existing RSI still faces key challenges, including harness-bound gains that stay outside the base model, black-box supervision that reads only the model's outputs, and imprecise edits whose site and strength are fixed in advance. To address these challenges, we propose BaseRSI, a new paradigm of Recursive Harness Internalization: the base model improves its harness, then writes what the harness adds into its own weights through training-free edits, round after round on its own responses. To support this paradigm, we introduce ReGap, a mechanism that supervises every transformer block with the high-dimensional activation difference that the harness makes at that block alone, and updates the block's weights along this signal in a low-dimensional subspace. Building on this mechanism, we further propose ReKey, an algorithm that writes this signal by regression into a few key-value neurons of every block, and measures the site and strength of each edit on the model's own responses. Moreover, the base model fills every role of this recursion with forward passes alone, and its edits, written at different sites, compose in one checkpoint without refitting. Experimental results on ten visual reasoning benchmarks show that BaseRSI consistently improves a base vision-language model both in distribution and on held-out benchmarks. Our code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: BaseRSI 提出"递归脚手架内化"范式：基座模型先用 harness（提示/工具）提升自身表现，再把 harness 带来的增益以免训练权重编辑写入自身体重，逐轮自我迭代。核心机制 ReGap 用每个 transformer block 处的激活差作为该 block 的监督信号并在低维子空间更新权重，ReKey 进一步把该信号回归写入每块少量 key-value 神经元，并基于模型自身响应自适应确定编辑位置与强度。
AI.motivation: 现有递归自我改进（RSI）存在三个瓶颈：增益被"卡"在外部 harness 中而未进入基座模型参数；监督是黑盒的、只读模型输出；编辑的位置与强度预先固定、缺乏精确性。
AI.method: 1) 范式层：Recursive Harness Internalization，模型生成 harness、在自身响应上训练free地做编辑、多轮循环；2) ReGap：以 harness 在每个 block 引起的激活差（高维）作为该 block 的局部监督，沿该信号在低维子空间中更新该块权重；3) ReKey：将信号以回归方式写入每块少量 key-value 神经元，并在模型自身响应上测量编辑的位点与强度；4) 递归各角色仅用前向即可完成，不同位点的编辑可在同一 checkpoint 中组合、无需重训。
AI.result: 在 10 个视觉推理基准上，BaseRSI 在分布内与留出基准上均持续提升基座视觉语言模型，且编辑可组合、无需 refit。
AI.conclusion: 该工作把"外部 harness 增益→内部权重"的迁移形式化，并给出无需训练、可组合、可多轮迭代的 block 级定位编辑实现，为递归自我改进提供了从输出监督走向激活级监督的可行路径。

title: ALIVE: Bring Foundation Features to Life with Events
summary: Visual foundation models provide powerful representations for diverse tasks, but their features become stale as visual content changes between image observations. Refreshing them requires new frames and repeated runs of a computationally expensive image encoder. We introduce ALIVE, an event-based method that incrementally updates native foundation model features between image observations. Given an anchor image, ALIVE uses subsequent events to transport and correct existing multi-layer features extracted by a frozen DINOv3 encoder. Its lightweight updater is trained end-to-end using only synthetic data, without downstream task supervision, and transfers directly to real-world event streams without any adaptation. Across three real-world datasets and five task-dataset settings spanning object detection, semantic segmentation, and depth estimation, ALIVE outperforms all evaluated event-based methods in every metric. On DSEC, when the anchor frame is 200,ms old, ALIVE improves over anchor-image predictions by 30.9,mAP in detection, 11.6,mIoU in segmentation, and 15.9% in depth AbsRel. Compared with image re-encoding, ALIVE reduces FLOPs by 82.4% and latency by a factor of 2.5.

AI.tldr: ALIVE 用事件相机增量刷新冻结 DINOv3 的多层特征：以锚点图像特征为起点，用后续事件流"传输+校正"特征，轻量更新器仅用合成数据端到端训练，可直接零适配迁移到真实事件流。
AI.motivation: 视觉基础模型的特征会随观测间场景变化而过时，刷新需新帧+重跑昂贵图像编码器，代价高。
AI.method: 冻结 DINOv3 提取锚点图像多层特征；后续事件流驱动轻量 updater 对特征做空间传输与残差校正；updater 端到端训练，仅用合成事件-图像数据，无下游任务监督，无真实域适配。
AI.result: 3 个真实数据集、5 个任务-数据集设置（检测/语义分割/深度），所有指标优于对比的事件方法；DSEC 上锚帧滞后 200ms 时检测 +30.9 mAP、分割 +11.6 mIoU、深度 AbsRel 改善 15.9%；相较图像重编码 FLOPs 降 82.4%、延迟降 2.5×。
AI.conclusion: 事件驱动的特征增量更新可作为视觉基础模型的低成本"特征保鲜"机制，合成到真实的零适配迁移具备实用价值，适合嵌入实时感知/具身系统的前端。

title: SHAPE: Discrete Supervision and Parallel Continuous Streams for Learning Dexterous Manipulation from Egocentric Human Data
summary: Egocentric human recordings are far cheaper than dexterous robot demonstrations, promising stronger pretraining and direct skill learning without task-specific robot data. Yet humans and robots differ in morphology and kinematics, so human recordings lack the joint positions and actuator commands that supervise robot policies, providing only retargeted end-effector (EEF) actions. This raises two questions: how human data should supervise the policy, and how a dexterous robot should read out actions at deployment. We address both in SHAPE (Supervision from Human Action tokens with Parallel Executable streams), a vision-language-action (VLA) model whose backbone predicts discrete action tokens of EEF chunks as an auxiliary task, while a shared flow-matching expert outputs two executable streams, EEF and joint. On a bimanual robot with 22-DoF hands, a matched study shows that discrete supervision helps learn from human data, driving backbone gradients and shaping action-informative representations across domains. Under standard control pipelines at deployment, direct joint readout excels at fine-grained control with robot demonstrations, scoring 0.80 across six tasks against 0.63 for {\pi}0.5, whereas IK-based EEF readout excels at human-to-robot transfer. Pretrained with human data and discrete tokens, SHAPE learns new tasks from human demonstrations without task-specific robot data.

AI.tldr: SHAPE以离散EEF动作token作辅助监督、flow-matching专家并行输出EEF与关节双流，实现人类数据预训练与灵巧机器人部署的双赢。
AI.motivation: 人类自采数据远比灵巧机器人演示廉价，但人机在形态与运动学上的差异使人类数据仅能提供重定向后的末端执行器（EEF）动作，缺少关节位置与执行器指令等监督信号。这引出两个问题：人类数据应如何监督策略，以及灵巧机器人在部署时应如何读出动作。
AI.method: 提出SHAPE（Supervision from Human Action tokens with Parallel Executable streams）VLA模型：骨干网络以EEF动作块的离散动作token预测作为辅助任务，共享的flow-matching专家输出EEF与关节两条可执行流；在22自由度双手臂机器人上做匹配对照实验。
AI.result: 离散token监督能驱动骨干梯度、跨域塑造动作信息表征；标准控制管线下，直接关节读出在精细控制上优于π0.5（六任务0.80 vs 0.63），而基于IK的EEF读出在人类到机器人迁移上更优；用人数据和离散token预训练后，SHAPE无需任务专属机器人数据即可从人类演示学习新任务。
AI.conclusion: 离散动作token监督与并行EEF/关节双流读出设计，使VLA能够有效利用廉价人类视频数据实现人到机器人技能迁移，且保留机器人演示下的精细控制优势。

title: DAL: Dynamic Angular Loss for Imbalanced Medical Image Classification
comment: Accepted at the British Machine Vision Conference (BMVC) 2026. 18 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Code: this https URL
summary: Class imbalance remains a major obstacle in medical image classification, where rare but clinically important classes are often overshadowed by majority categories. Although current strategies for reducing bias, including angle-based softmax (ABS) losses, offer strong discriminative features, their behavior in settings with a small number of severely imbalanced classes remains insufficiently understood. Previous approaches that estimate the intrinsic parameters of ABS rely on the assumption of many classes, which does not hold in medical settings. We derive data-driven upper and lower bounds for the scale parameter and an upper bound for the angular margin using negative-angle statistics, and use these to drive a batch-adaptive angular margin (BAAM), which we combine with dynamically-weighted cross entropy (DWCE) to define our dynamic angular loss (DAL). Across four highly imbalanced medical image classification benchmarks spanning dermatology, ophthalmology, and gastrointestinal endoscopy, our method consistently achieves superior balanced accuracy and the lowest coefficient of variation of per-class recall. Although this entails a small performance reduction on majority classes, the gains on minority categories are substantial, yielding a reliable and equitable overall classifier. Our source code is available at: this https URL .

AI.tldr: 针对医学图像分类中类别严重不均衡问题，推导ABS角度softmax的尺度参数上下界与角度间隔上界（基于负角度统计），提出批自适应角度间隔BAAM+动态加权交叉熵DWCE=DAL，在四个医学不均衡基准上取得最佳平衡准确率与最低类召回变异系数。
AI.motivation: 医学图像分类中少数但临床关键的类常被多数类压制；现有角度softmax(ABS)损失在"类别数少且严重不均衡"场景下的行为缺乏理解，且其本征参数估计依赖"类别数多"的假设，在医学场景不成立。
AI.method: 用负角度统计量推导尺度参数的数据驱动上下界和角度间隔上界；据此构造批自适应角度间隔(BAAM)，与动态加权交叉熵(DWCE)结合形成动态角度损失(DAL)。
AI.result: 在皮肤科、眼科、胃肠内镜等四个高度不均衡医学图像基准上，平衡准确率一致更优，各类召回变异系数最低；多数类性能略降，但少数类提升显著。
AI.conclusion: 在类别数有限且严重不平衡的医学场景下，通过数据驱动界约束ABS参数可得到更公平、更稳定的分类器；为长尾医学分类提供了可解释的参数设定理论依据。

title: EgoJev: Finding Evidence in Egocentric Video by Reading VLM Decisions
summary: Questions about long egocentric video often depend on one brief moment, such as the second a hand puts an object down. A vision-language model (VLM) that sees a few evenly spaced frames usually misses it. Training-free methods rank frames with a separate image-text model or ask the VLM to write a time. In a controlled test, the VLM itself locates the moment better when it chooses among labeled frames, and we read this choice from its output distribution. With the same candidates, this choice lands on the evidence more often than image-text scores or a written time span, and it compares all candidates in one decision. Based on this finding, we propose EgoJev, a training-free frame selector for wearable assistants. EgoJev reads where the evidence is from labeled thumbnails and looks again at the windows it points to. It places its few answer frames at the quantiles of the resulting distribution. One frozen VLM selects, answers and returns the evidence time, with no second model. A wearable device can encode its coarse thumbnails while it records. With Qwen3.5-4B and 8 answer frames, EgoJev raises QAEgo4D accuracy from 51.2% with uniform sampling to 62.0%, and it outperforms recent training-free frame selectors on QAEgo4D and MyEgo. A single-level version runs on a Mac and an iPhone.

AI.tldr: EgoJev：免训练的第一视角视频帧选择器，让冻结VLM从带标签缩略图中"选择"证据帧，读其输出分布定位时刻，并在该分布上按分位数取帧回答。
AI.motivation: 第一视角长视频问题常依赖某一瞬刻（如手放下物体的一秒），均匀采样会漏掉；免训练方法依赖外部图文模型打分或让VLM写出时间，精度受限。
AI.method: 受控实验发现：同一候选集下，VLM在"从带标签帧中选择"任务的输出分布中读取的选择，比图文相似度排序或文本化时间跨度更常命中证据。据此构建两阶段免训练流程：先用带标签缩略图读出证据所在位置，再对指向的窗口二次凝视，按所得分布的分位数放置少数答案帧；单一冻结VLM完成选择、回答与证据时间返回，无第二模型；设备可在录制时离线编码粗缩略图。
AI.result: Qwen3.5-4B + 8答案帧下，QAEgo4D准确率由均匀采样51.2%提升至62.0%；在QAEgo4D与MyEgo上优于近期免训练帧选择器；单层版本可在Mac与iPhone上运行。
AI.conclusion: 把"选择"作为VLM的定位接口，比外部检索打分更可靠，且免训练、单模型、端侧可行，为可穿戴助手提供实用的时刻定位与取帧方案。

title: Hydrodynamics of robotic micro-swimmers in confinement
summary: Inspired by seminal work by E.M. Purcell, we discuss the problem of predicting and optimizing the performance of autonomous robots swimming in confinement. Our approach is based on the explicit numerical resolution of the fluid flow induced by the swimmer, and it is validated experimentally on a cm-size prototype composed of a cargo head and a rotating propulsive tail. Using hydrodynamic scaling, we predict the performance of replicas of our prototype scaled down to mm- and sub-mm-size to test the feasibility of autonomous micro-robots navigating in narrow vessels. The main result of our theoretical, computational, and experimental analysis is that, while hydrodynamics seems to place no fundamental obstruction to the vision of autonomous micro-robots navigating in narrow lumens inside the human body, it does provide useful and strict guidelines for rational design at different length scales.

AI.tldr: 结合Purcell的低雷诺数游泳理论，通过数值求解流体流动并制作厘米级原型进行验证，用流体力学标度预测毫米及亚毫米尺度微型游泳机器人在狭窄管道中的性能。
AI.motivation: 探讨自主微型机器人能否在人体狭窄腔道中游动导航，以及流体力学是否为该设想设置了根本性障碍。
AI.method: 显式数值求解游泳体诱导的流场，结合水动力标度律推演不同尺度下的性能；以厘米级“货物头+旋转推进尾”原型开展实验验证。
AI.result: 流体力学并未对微型机器人在狭窄腔道内自主导航构成根本性障碍，但为不同尺度下的理性设计提供了严格的设计准则。
AI.conclusion: 微型游泳机器人在受限环境中导航在流体力学上是可行的，且可通过标度分析指导多尺度设计。

title: H3Remover: Reinforcing Video Object Removal without Paired Data
comment: Project page: this https URL , code at: this https URL
summary: Pretrained video editors possess rich removal and completion priors, yet may retain targets or alter unrelated content. We present H3Remover, which reinforces MiniMax-H3 Base Ref2VA for video object removal without paired object-free training targets. To discourage superficial edits such as recoloring, a target-removal reward favors calibrated depth changes consistent with revealing farther content. To limit unintended scene changes, a background-geometry reward encourages preservation of relative depth ordering. To preserve background appearance without retaining unwanted shadows or reflections, an appearance reward constrains RGB changes in source-derived protected regions while exempting targets and estimated effects. Frozen HPSv3 complements these constraints with perceptual-quality feedback for synthesized content. Evaluation regions remain fixed across candidates, and DiffusionART optimizes LoRA adapters with the backbone frozen. Experiments show substantial reconstruction gains over original H3, with qualitative comparisons demonstrating more effective object removal and better preservation of surrounding scene content.

AI.tldr: H3Remover 用强化学习（目标移除、背景几何、外观三类奖励 + 冻结 HPSv3 感知先验）微调 MiniMax-H3 Base Ref2VA 的 LoRA，实现无配对无目标视频监督的视频物体移除。
AI.motivation: 预训练视频编辑模型具备去除与补全先验，但容易残留目标或篡改无关内容；且缺少成对的"无目标"训练视频。
AI.method: 以 MiniMax-H3 Base Ref2VA 为骨干、冻结参数，仅用 DiffusionART 优化 LoRA。奖励设计：目标移除奖励要求"揭示更远处内容"的标定深度变化，抑制表面重着色；背景几何奖励保持相对深度序；外观奖励在源图派生的保护区域内约束 RGB 变化，同时豁免目标及估计的阴影/反射效应；冻结 HPSv3 提供感知质量反馈。评估区域在各候选间固定。
AI.result: 相对原始 H3 取得显著重建提升；定性对比显示去除更彻底、周围场景内容保持更好。
AI.conclusion: 无需成对无目标数据即可通过多约束强化学习获得更可靠的视频物体移除，深度一致性与背景保真是关键约束信号。

title: Hypnos: A Dual-Phase End-to-End Platform for Scalable Continual Learning at the Edge
summary: Continual learning (CL) enables neural networks to adapt to non-stationary data streams by mitigating catastrophic forgetting, offering a path to robust, private, and adaptable edge devices. Yet, porting CL to real-world edge devices remains challenging for two reasons: (i) online operation, where sensor data arrives one sample at a time and the device must adapt on-the-fly, and (ii) the low footprint of edge devices, which makes traditional error backpropagation training prohibitive. Inspired by the brain's wake and sleep cycles, the former for rapid adaptation with minimal resources and the latter for long-term consolidation, we introduce Hypnos, an open-source dual-phase platform for efficient CL at the edge. In the wake phase (e.g., daily operation), Hypnos relies on a low-footprint system-on-chip with a RISC-V microcontroller unit (MCU) targeting efficient inference and supporting lightweight gradient-free prototype updates. In the sleep phase (e.g., night-time charging), where wall-plug energy and larger memory budgets are available, a smart charger performs rehearsal-based gradient updates for consolidation. Deployed on a ZCU104 field-programmable gate array (FPGA) and synthesized in a 28-nm process, Hypnos is benchmarked on the CORe50 NICv2-391 protocol. It sets a new state-of-the-art accuracy of 78.6%-81.6% for edge CL systems, with an on-device latency of 7.79s-10.54s per sample depending on activation precision, and requires $3.8\times$ fewer learning steps and $22\times$ less learning compute than quantized latent replay at higher accuracy and comparable latency.

AI.tldr: Hypnos：受"清醒-睡眠"启发的开源双阶段边缘持续学习平台。清醒阶段在 RISC-V MCU SoC 上做高效推理与无梯度原型更新；睡眠阶段由智能充电器执行基于回放的梯度巩固。ZCU104+28nm 实现，CORe50 NICv2-391 达 78.6%-81.6% 准确率。
AI.motivation: 边缘设备需在线适应非平稳数据流，但受两类约束：(i) 样本逐个到达、需即时自适应；(ii) 资源极小，无法承受误差反传训练。受大脑清醒（快速低耗适应）与睡眠（长期巩固）双周期启发，寻求在边缘实现高效持续学习。
AI.method: 双阶段架构：Wake 阶段由含 RISC-V MCU 的低功耗 SoC 负责推理，并支持轻量的无梯度原型（prototype）更新；Sleep 阶段（如夜间充电、有墙插供电与更大内存预算时）由智能充电器执行基于回放（rehearsal）的梯度更新以巩固知识。软硬件协同部署于 ZCU104 FPGA，并在 28nm 工艺综合。
AI.result: 在 CORe50 NICv2-391 协议上取得 78.6%-81.6% 的边缘 CL SOTA 准确率；单样本片上延迟 7.79-10.54 s（随激活精度变化）；相比量化潜在回放，学习步数减少 3.8×、学习算力减少 22×，同时准确率更高、延迟相当。
AI.conclusion: 将梯度计算与在线适应在时间与硬件资源上解耦（快慢双相位）是边缘持续学习的可行且高效范式；开源平台为边缘端自适应感知提供了可复现的硬件-算法基线。

title: AggCLIP: Aggregating CLIP for Zero-Shot Multimodal Anomaly Detection
comment: 13 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. Author version of the ACM Multimedia 2026 paper
summary: Zero-Shot Multimodal Anomaly Detection (ZSMAD) aims to identify both appearance and geometric defects in novel categories without relying on target-specific training data, making it especially valuable in real-world scenarios constrained by data scarcity, privacy concerns, or high annotation costs. While recent approaches successfully adapt vision-language models like CLIP to achieve this open-vocabulary generalization, they still face significant challenges: (i) severe geometric information loss during 3D-to-2D point cloud rendering; (ii) spatially noisy 2D feature maps produced by raw CLIP patch embeddings, compounded by shallow late-stage modality fusion; and (iii) severe cross-modal semantic misalignment due to decoupled processing streams. To address these limitations, we propose AggCLIP, a novel framework that adapts frozen CLIP representations for ZSMAD by explicitly incorporating local geometric structure and visual spatial context. Specifically, to accurately localize fine-grained defects, we design a Geometry-Aware Spatial Aggregation (GSA) module that refines back-projected 3D point features via density-adaptive neighborhood weighting, alongside a Context-Aware Spatial Aggregation (CSA) module that smooths multi-scale 2D patch embeddings using a lightweight trainable adapter. Furthermore, to prevent semantic drift between modalities, we introduce a Dual-Stream Prompt Contrastive (DSPC) loss, which aligns the abstract concepts of normality and abnormality across the point cloud and RGB streams. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed AggCLIP framework achieves state-of-the-art performance on the MVTec 3D-AD and Eyecandies benchmarks under both one-vs-rest and cross-dataset zero-shot settings, notably surpassing the strongest competitive methods by up to 2.9% in pixel-level AUPRO.

AI.tldr: AggCLIP：通过密度自适应几何聚合（GSA）、多尺度2D patch平滑（CSA）与双流提示对比损失（DSPC），将冻结CLIP适配到零样本多模态异常检测，缓解3D渲染几何信息丢失、2D特征噪声与跨模态语义错位。
AI.motivation: ZSMAD需在无目标训练数据下同时检测外观与几何缺陷。现有CLIP类方法存在三点缺陷：(i) 3D→2D渲染导致几何信息严重丢失；(ii) 原始CLIP patch特征空间噪声大、仅做浅层后期融合；(iii) 点云与RGB解耦处理造成跨模态语义错位。
AI.method: 冻结CLIP主干。GSA模块对反投影的3D点特征做密度自适应邻域加权以保留局部几何结构；CSA模块用轻量可训练适配器平滑多尺度2D patch嵌入以注入空间上下文；DSPC损失在点云流与RGB流之间对齐"正常/异常"抽象概念，抑制语义漂移。
AI.result: 在MVTec 3D-AD与Eyecandies上，one-vs-rest与跨数据集零样本设置均取得SOTA，像素级AUPRO最多超过最强对比方法2.9%。
AI.conclusion: 显式引入局部几何结构与视觉空间上下文、并在提示层面做跨模态概念对齐，可有效提升CLIP在多模态零样本异常检测中的细粒度定位能力；属工业检测方向的方法改进。

title: Conceptual full-vehicle modeling of a modular all-wheel-drive robotic ADS test platform as a foundation for a digital twin architecture
comment: 9 pages, 10 figures. Supplementary project files are available at this https URL
summary: This paper presents the development of an initial full-vehicle simulation model of the PixKit modular electric test platform in IPG CarMaker. The objective is to create a physics-based and extendable model structure that can serve as a low-level foundation for future digital twin applications. The reference vehicle is a skateboard chassis combining unconventional vehicle characteristics such as four independent wheel-hub motors and rear axle steering capable of high steering angles. Since complete measurement data of the vehicle is not yet available, the model parameterization is based on a combination of manufacturer documentation, derived values and engineering assumptions. The modeling approach focuses on the system-level integration of the main vehicle subsystems rather than on a fully validated representation. The resulting model was assessed through basic driving scenarios with different steering inputs and configurations. The simulations showed stable model behavior and physically plausible interaction between the subsystems. The all-wheel-drive configuration produced symmetric wheel responses in longitudinal driving, while counter-phase rear axle steering increased the yaw response and reduced the simulated turning circle diameter compared with front axle steering only. The circular driving scenario further indicated bounded roll and slip behavior. Overall, the implemented CarMaker model provides a traceable and functional simulation basis for the PixKit vehicle. It can support future model refinement, calibration with real vehicle data and development with the goal of creating a validated digital twin architecture.

AI.tldr: 在IPG CarMaker中搭建PixKit模块化电动滑板底盘测试平台的初始整车仿真模型，作为未来数字孪生应用的基础。
AI.motivation: PixKit滑板底盘具四轮独立轮毂电机与后轴大转角转向等非常规特性，且尚缺完整实测数据；需要一个可追溯、可扩展的物理仿真底层框架，为后续数字孪生开发与实车标定提供起点。
AI.method: 在IPG CarMaker中构建整车系统级模型，参数化来源为厂商文档、派生值与工程假设；建模重点为各子系统系统级集成而非完全验证；通过不同转向输入与配置的基础驾驶工况评测（纵向驱动、同/反相位后轴转向、定圆行驶）。
AI.result: 仿真表现出稳定的模型行为与子系统间物理合理的相互作用；四驱配置下纵向驱动轮响应对称；反相位后轴转向提升横摆响应并减小转向半径；定圆工况显示有界的侧倾与滑移行为。
AI.conclusion: 该CarMaker模型为PixKit车辆提供了可追溯且功能性的仿真基础，可支撑后续模型细化、实车数据标定以及面向经认证数字孪生架构的开发。

title: Piccolo: Co-Evolving Decision Models and Data through Recursive Self-Improvement
comment: 22 pages, 13 figures, 11 tables. Project page and blog: this https URL
summary: We present Piccolo, a family of multimodal decision models (0.8B to 27B) that coevolves model capabilities and training data via Agentic Data Engineering and recursive self-improvement (RSI). The models predict probabilities over candidate answers for general-purpose text and visual judgments, agent harnesses, data workflows, and interactive games. Piccolo-27B tops the Decision Index Vision Full leaderboard with a score of 75.59, while Piccolo-9B and Piccolo-4B achieve 68.35 and 67.46, respectively. All three rank first on the Private benchmark in their respective model-size categories. Research agents analyze model behavior, construct training data, conduct experiments, and use the results to refine subsequent proposals. Semantic slices and a shared research memory connect these actions across the model family's development. With training recipes comprising hundreds of thousands of examples, data selection and feedback-driven refinement are central to the self-improvement process. Our large-scale RSI exploration yields three counter-intuitive insights for decision-model development: (1) Backbone-recipe co-adaptation outweighs raw model recency: earlier backbones can surpass newer generations on visual tasks under identical recipes; (2) Targeted data curation enables 4B-9B models to rival 27B baselines on specialized workflows; and (3) Continuous loss reduction can decouple from and even degrade discrete decision accuracy. Together with the released weights and tools from the Data-Juicer and AgentScope ecosystems, Piccolo provides an actionable blueprint for building frontier decision models and scaling data-driven RSI.

AI.tldr: Piccolo 是一族多模态决策模型（0.8B–27B），通过 Agentic Data Engineering 与递归自我改进（RSI）让模型能力与训练数据共同演化，27B 版本在 Decision Index Vision Full 榜单登顶（75.59）。
AI.motivation: 作者希望建立一个可扩展、数据驱动的递归自我改进范式，使决策模型的能力提升不再单纯依赖更新更强的基座，而由数据工程与模型共演化驱动；同时给出可复用的实践蓝图。
AI.method: 构建多模态决策模型家族，输出候选答案上的概率分布，覆盖文本/视觉判断、agent harness、数据工作流与交互游戏；由研究型 agent 分析模型行为、构造训练数据、执行实验并根据结果迭代改进提案，以语义切片与共享研究记忆跨模型串联；训练配方达数十万样本，依赖数据选择与反馈驱动细化。
AI.result: Piccolo-27B 以 75.59 居 Decision Index Vision Full 榜首，9B/4B 分别为 68.35/67.46，且三者在 Private 榜单各自规模档均列第一；RSI 大规模探索给出三点反直觉结论：(1) 基座-配方共适应胜过模型新近度；(2) 定向数据策划使 4B–9B 在特定工作流上比肩 27B 基线；(3) 连续 loss 下降可与离散决策准确率脱钩甚至导致退化。
AI.conclusion: 论文公开权重及 Data-Juicer、AgentScope 生态工具，将“数据策划 + 反馈闭环”确立为决策模型自我改进的核心杠杆，为构建前沿决策模型与规模化数据驱动 RSI 提供可操作范式。

title: Predicting Species Splits: A Challenging Fine-Grained Benchmark for Category Discovery
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Evaluations and Datasets Track)
summary: Widely used category discovery benchmarks have become increasingly saturated and often fail to reflect real-world discovery settings, making long-term evaluation of new methods difficult. We introduce PS-SPLIT, a large-scale fine-grained benchmark for category discovery, motivated by taxonomic splitting: the real-world process by which what was once considered a single species is found to comprise multiple distinct ones. PS-SPLIT contains 79K globally distributed, high-quality, community-collected bird images spanning 771 species, derived from 257 recent real expert-verified taxonomic splits, with associated geographic metadata and full taxonomic hierarchy. The visual differences between categories arising from real taxonomic splits can be very subtle, often requiring significant human expertise to tell apart, making PS-SPLIT a challenging benchmark which we hope will assist in advancing fine-grained category discovery research. Based on taxonomic splitting, we introduce the task of discovery by category splitting, where the goal is to determine which known categories should be subdivided into new finer-grained subcategories. We adapt four generalized category discovery methods to this setting, evaluate existing methods, and show that there is substantial room for future progress.

AI.tldr: PS-SPLIT：源自257个真实专家验证的物种分类拆分、含79K张鸟类图像/771个物种的细粒度类别发现大规模基准；并定义"按类别拆分发现"新任务（判断哪些已知类别应被细分为新的子类），适配四种类别发现方法进行评估，显示仍有大量提升空间。
AI.motivation: 现有广义类别发现基准趋于饱和，难以反映真实世界的发现场景，导致新方法难以长期评测；真实"分类拆分"（原被视为一个物种后被拆为多个）产生的类间视觉差异极细微，具有挑战性。
AI.method: 构建PS-SPLIT基准：79K社区采集的全球分布高质量鸟类图像、771个物种，基于257个近期专家验证的taxonomic splits，附地理元数据与完整分类层级；基于taxonomic splitting提出"discovery by category splitting"新任务，并将四种广义类别发现（GCD）方法适配到该设置下评测。
AI.result: PS-SPLIT因真实拆分带来的细微类间差异而具有高难度；适配的四种GCD方法在该基准上表现有限，暴露出显著的性能缺口。
AI.conclusion: PS-SPLIT为细粒度类别发现提供了更具挑战性的评测平台，并开辟"按类别拆分发现"这一新研究方向，但现有方法远未解决该问题。

title: DrawScore: Evaluating Generated CAD Models against Engineering Drawings
summary: Automatic CAD generation is commonly evaluated with volumetric IoU, Chamfer Distance, and surface F-score, which barely penalize local errors that occupy only a small fraction of a part's volume or surface area, such as a misplaced hole or a slot on the wrong face, even though such errors are critical to manufacturing. We formalize these metrics in a unified integral form and show that the weight of a local error decays as the $(k+q)$-th power of its size, where $k$ is the dimension of the integration domain and $q$ is determined by the penalty function. Guided by this analysis, we propose DrawScore, which projects both models into three orthographic views with visible and hidden lines, as in engineering drawings, and applies a saturating penalty along the projected curves, so that the weight of a local error decays only linearly. Controlled experiments confirm the predicted decay orders, and on outputs of existing CAD generation agents, DrawScore exposes errors in outputs that IoU rates as nearly perfect. DrawScore further improves generation as a reinforcement learning reward and, for CAD generation from engineering drawings, serves as a test-time verifier without 3D ground truth or an additional reward model. Our code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出DrawScore，通过三视图投影曲线上的饱和惩罚，使局部CAD错误权重仅线性衰减，暴露IoU视为完美的错误，并可作为RL奖励与测试期验证器。
AI.motivation: 现有CAD生成评测（volumetric IoU、Chamfer Distance、surface F-score）几乎不惩罚体积/面积占比小的局部错误（如孔位偏移、槽错面），但这些错误对制造至关重要。
AI.method: 将现有指标统一为积分形式，分析局部错误权重随尺寸的(k+q)次幂衰减规律；据此提出DrawScore：把模型投影为带可见线与隐藏线的三视图（工程制图风格），沿投影曲线施加饱和惩罚，使错误权重仅线性衰减。
AI.result: 受控实验证实预测的衰减阶数；在现有CAD生成智能体输出上，DrawScore揭示了IoU评为近乎完美的输出中的错误；作为RL奖励可提升生成质量；在工程图到CAD生成任务中可作无3D真值、无额外奖励模型的测试期验证器。
AI.conclusion: 以工程制图视角重构CAD评测指标，可在局部细节层面有效区分与指导CAD生成，兼具评测、奖励与验证三重用途。

title: Improving Zero-shot 3D Semantic Mapping in Offroad with Geometric Priors
summary: Semantic 3D mapping is a powerful representation that enables platform agnostic mobile robot navigation in challenging offroad conditions. Current vision foundation models can accurately predict semantics zero-shot on structured scenes but performance is compromised in natural environments. On the other hand, 3D point clouds encode valuable information for discriminating semantics in scenarios where vision foundation models fail. In this work, we propose fitting a sphericity-elevation distribution for each semantic class to act as geometric anchor. Only the points with the most confident vision foundation model predictions are considered when fitting to produce high quality geometric prior distributions. The geometric prior is fused with the vision foundation model prediction to produce the final semantic mapping. The proposed prior improves SAM3 baseline by +6.3 in mIoU and +8.9 in accuracy on the RELLIS-3D dataset, and by +1.7 in mIoU and +2.1 in accuracy on the WildScenes dataset. The source code will be made public upon paper acceptance.

AI.tldr: 为每个语义类别拟合“球形度-高程”联合分布作为几何先验，仅用视觉基础模型高置信预测点进行拟合，再与视觉语义预测融合，提升越野自然环境的3D语义建图精度。
AI.motivation: 视觉基础模型在结构化场景零样本语义预测效果好，但在非结构化自然越野环境中性能下降；而3D点云几何信息可在视觉失效时提供判别性线索，因此需将二者融合。
AI.method: 对每个语义类别统计点云的球形度（sphericity）与高程（elevation）二维分布，构成几何锚先验；拟合时仅采样视觉基础模型预测置信度最高的点以保证先验质量；推理时将几何先验与SAM3等视觉预测融合得到最终语义地图。
AI.result: RELLIS-3D上相对SAM3基线mIoU提升+6.3、精度+8.9；WildScenes上mIoU+1.7、精度+2.1。代码待录用后开源。
AI.conclusion: 几何先验与视觉基础模型互补，可在无需额外标注的情况下稳健提升越野场景语义建图；方法轻量，但依赖类别级分布假设，跨域适用性仍受地形类别统计差异制约。

title: Can Omni-modal LLMs Understand Spoken Intentions?
summary: Omni-modal large language models (omni-modal LLMs) can respond to spoken requests directly through voice and video calls. Such requests rely on the scene shared by the user and the assistant, so the same utterance may call for different help or for no response. Most audio-visual benchmarks provide questions as separate text input, and interactive benchmarks mostly score a response as a whole. It thus remains unclear whether a model recognizes when the user is asking for help, and whether its reply meets the user's need once the request is recognized. We propose O-IN-Bench to evaluate how well omni-modal LLMs understand spoken intentions. A model watches a complete video with native speech and outputs one text response, or [SILENCE] when no response is needed. O-IN-Bench contains 1,000 Chinese and English samples in five categories and 16 subcategories. Contrastive pairs combine the same request with different scene conditions to test whether the response changes with the context. A sample-specific rubric judges language, intent, and content separately, and O-IN-Engine verifies each rubric against the video. Across 30 omni-modal model configurations, the best overall score is 59.6, achieved by Gemini3.7-Flash. Gemini3.7-Flash passes 74.4% of the intent judgments but only 42.6% of the content judgments. When the speech is a conversation between peers rather than a request to the assistant, even strong models often keep responding. When a reply must satisfy several people, the best score is only 25.9. These results indicate that recognizing a request and meeting its requirements are separate abilities, and O-IN-Bench measures each of them.

AI.tldr: 提出 O-IN-Bench，用1,000条中英文视频（原生语音、5大类16子类、含对比对）评测全模态大模型对“口语意图”的理解：模型看完整视频后输出一次文本回复，或在不需回应时输出 [SILENCE]；配合样本级 rubric 与 O-IN-Engine 对语言/意图/内容分项打分。30个配置中最佳总分仅59.6。
AI.motivation: 全模态模型可直接通过语音/视频通话响应用户请求，而请求依赖用户与助手共享的场景，同一句话在不同场景下可能需不同帮助甚至无需回应。现有视听基准多以独立文本给出问题，交互基准又只对整段回复做整体打分，因此无法区分“是否识别出求助意图”与“识别后是否满足需求”这两种能力。
AI.method: 构建 O-IN-Bench：完整视频+原生语音输入，单次文本回复或输出 [SILENCE]；1,000条中文与英文样本，覆盖5大类、16子类；采用对比对设计（同一请求搭配不同场景条件）检验回复是否随上下文变化；为每个样本设计分项 rubric（语言、意图、内容），并用 O-IN-Engine 对照视频逐条核验 rubric 判定。
AI.result: 30个全模态模型配置中最高总分59.6（Gemini3.7-Flash）；该模型意图判断通过率74.4%，但内容判断仅42.6%；当语音是同伴间对话而非向助手请求时，强模型仍倾向于持续回应；当回复需同时满足多人时最佳得分仅25.9。
AI.conclusion: 识别请求与满足请求要求是两种可分离的能力，O-IN-Bench 对二者分别度量；当前全模态模型在意图识别上已有一定水平，但在内容满足、抑制不必要回应、多受众约束等方向仍明显不足。

title: DRIFT: Detachable Reasoning for Runtime-Flexible and Efficient End-to-End Driving
comment: 11 pages, 4 figures, 7 tables. Project page: this https URL
summary: The integration of vision-language models (VLMs) into end-to-end (E2E) autonomous driving has demonstrated strong potential by providing scene description and reasoning capabilities. However, VLMs are computationally expensive, and switching language reasoning on and off at runtime without hurting closed-loop performance has not been demonstrated, which hinders practical adoption. To address these issues, we propose DRIFT, an E2E autonomous driving framework that integrates a lightweight language model (LM) for visual question answering and action commentary. By efficiently projecting intermediate driving representations into the language embedding space, we demonstrate that a compact LM (<150M parameters) can achieve strong scene description and action commentary. Furthermore, we introduce a runtime-flexible planning module that is trained on surrogate reasoning features distilled from the LM and can be conditioned on either the LM or the surrogate reasoning features at inference. This design enables bypassing the LM entirely when required by deployment constraints, without sacrificing driving performance. With only 255M parameters, DRIFT reaches up to a Driving Score (DS) of 97.03 and a Success Rate of 89.39% (mean over three runs) on Bench2Drive by interleaving its LM and surrogate reasoning at a chosen reasoning rate. This is on par with the strongest non-language models while being far more compact than existing VLM-based models. DRIFT further achieves competitive results on the real-world NAVSIM and AlpaSim benchmarks at significantly lower computational cost than existing VLM-based approaches. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: DRIFT：将轻量语言模型（<150M）经中间驾驶表征投影接入端到端自动驾驶，并用蒸馏得到的代理推理特征训练运行时可切换的规划模块，从而实现无性能损失地按需关闭语言推理，总计255M参数在Bench2Drive上取得DS 97.03、SR 89.39%。
AI.motivation: VLM融入端到端自动驾驶虽能提供场景描述与推理能力，但计算开销大，且此前未能证明可在运行时开关语言推理而不损害闭环性能，阻碍了实际部署。
AI.method: 提出DRIFT框架：把驾驶模型的中间表征高效投影到语言嵌入空间，驱动一个紧凑LM（<150M）完成视觉问答与动作解说；同时训练运行时灵活规划模块，以从该LM蒸馏的代理推理特征为训练信号，推理时可条件化于LM输出或代理特征，从而在部署受限时完全绕过LM。
AI.result: 总参数仅255M，在Bench2Drive上以选定推理率交替使用LM与代理推理时，DS达97.03、成功率89.39%（三次运行均值），与最强非语言模型持平；在真实场景NAVSIM与AlpaSim基准上取得有竞争力结果，计算成本显著低于现有VLM类方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过轻量LM+可切换代理推理的架构设计，DRIFT在保持紧凑规模的同时实现了可部署、可按算力预算调节的端到端自动驾驶，为VLM在实车系统中的落地提供了可行路径。

title: Multi-Band Galaxy Novel-View Synthesis with Radiative Gaussian Fields
summary: We propose a novel view synthesis tool for galaxies based on Gaussian Splatting (GS). Unlike RGB data, where GS has achieved success, galaxy observations consist of multi-band signals from a massive number of bodies, contain complex patterns of cross-band interactions, and capture light propagation in highly heterogeneous media. As a result, the underlying physical process poses great challenges in model representation and optimization, which have not been investigated in existing research. To this end, we propose a physically inspired Gaussian Splatting method, GalaxyGS, which is equipped with physically meaningful components that capture both the energy emission mechanism of different astronomical bodies and the light propagation between them. In the absence of directly comparable baseline methods, we adopt a wide range of possible alternative approaches. Comparisons conclusively demonstrate that GalaxyGS is better in accuracy and physical fidelity across datasets and metrics.

AI.tldr: 提出物理启发的 Gaussian Splatting 方法 GalaxyGS，用于星系多波段观测的新视角合成，显式建模天体能量发射与介质中光传播。
AI.motivation: RGB 场景的 GS 已成熟，但星系观测是多波段、海量天体、含跨波段相互作用与高度非均匀介质中的光传播，现有 GS 在表示与优化上无法刻画该物理过程。
AI.method: 以 Gaussian Splatting 为渲染核心，构建"物理有意义的组件"：一类刻画不同天文天体的能量发射机制（多波段辐射），另一类刻画天体间/介质中的光传播（含非均匀介质衰减与混合）。因缺乏直接可比基线，作者选取多种替代方案进行对比。
AI.result: 在多个数据集与指标上，GalaxyGS 相比替代方案在重建精度与物理保真度上均更优；具体数值在摘要中未给出。
AI.conclusion: 将物理先验注入 GS 可有效处理多波段、异质介质的天文新视角合成，为科学级神经渲染提供了可行范式。

title: Generalization of Text Line Segmentation for HTR in Historical Documents
comment: This work is going to be published in the proceedings for the Historical Image Processing workshop 2026 (HIP 2026), connected to the International Conference of Document Analysis and Recognition (ICDAR)
summary: In this paper we investigate the generalization capability of state-of-the-art object detection models (Hi-SAM, YOLO, and RT-DETR) for the automatic segmentation of text lines in historical documents. Generalization is needed because it is not practical for museums and archives to produce large amounts of labeled samples for each new collection. We also evaluate the few-shot setting by fine-tuning the networks with only a small number of training samples per target dataset. To this end, we use nine different datasets that differ significantly in visual layout and language. Additionally, we discuss why mean average precision (mAP), a classic evaluation metric for object detection, is insufficient for assessing the quality of a text line segmentation model. Depending on the dataset, our CRNN models achieve character error rates (CER) ranging from 2.48% to 7.07% per page for the segmented text lines. This is sufficient for reading comprehension and simple text searches. Finally, we quantify the resource and time requirements of training and inference in different use case settings. This forms the basis for more informed decisions about model and hardware choices based on available resources.

AI.tldr: 评估 Hi-SAM、YOLO、RT-DETR 在9个历史文档数据集上的文本行分割泛化性与少样本微调表现，并论证 mAP 不足以评价该任务，改用下游 CRNN 的 CER（2.48%–7.07%/页）衡量。
AI.motivation: 博物馆与档案馆难以为每个新馆藏标注大量样本，因此需要模型具备跨数据集泛化能力，并明确少样本微调的实际收益与资源代价。
AI.method: 在视觉版式与语言差异显著的9个历史文档数据集上，对三种SOTA检测模型做零样本跨域测试与仅少量样本的少样本微调；分析mAP与下游OCR质量的失配，并以CRNN识别CER作为任务级评价指标；同时量化不同使用场景下的训练/推理时间与资源开销。
AI.result: 分割文本行经CRNN识别后CER为2.48%–7.07%/页，足以支撑阅读理解与简单全文检索；mAP与最终识别质量相关性不足，不能作为可靠选型指标；给出了各场景训练与推理的资源时间对比。
AI.conclusion: 历史文档文本行分割应以端到端识别指标而非检测mAP来评价，少样本微调可在低标注成本下达到可用精度，资源开销数据可为模型与硬件选型提供依据。

title: HandWorldBench: A Unified Benchmark for Hand-Centric World Models
summary: Recent advances in world models are opening new possibilities for fine-grained embodied tasks, with hand-object interaction offering a particularly demanding setting. Modeling these interactions involves capturing how hand actions change objects and how the resulting states persist over time. Yet systematic evaluation tailored to these hand-centric capabilities remains underdeveloped. To address this gap, we introduce HandWorldBench, a unified benchmark that systematically evaluates hand-centric world models across human hands, simulated dexterous hands, and real dexterous hands along six dimensions: visual quality, hand fidelity, appearance consistency, instruction following, physical consistency, and temporal coherence. To construct the benchmark, we develop a data curation pipeline that extracts hand-object interaction clips and screens them for quality, yielding 20,500 high-quality egocentric clips from over 600 hours of footage. We then manually select 500 clips covering seven task families for evaluation. Benchmarking eleven models under a unified protocol reveals that stronger hand-pose control does not consistently translate into coherent object-state evolution and persistence or robust cross-embodiment performance, with several specialized hand-control models underperforming general-purpose text/image-to-video generators on dexterous-hand tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出 HandWorldBench，一个面向手-物交互的世界模型统一基准，覆盖真人手、仿真灵巧手、真实灵巧手，六维度评估（视觉质量、手部保真、外观一致性、指令遵循、物理一致性、时序连贯），从600+小时视频构建20500段高质量自我中心片段并精选500段/7类任务，评测11个模型。
AI.motivation: 世界模型在细粒度具身任务上进展迅速，手-物交互是其中最具挑战的场景，但缺少系统化、以手为中心的能力评估体系。
AI.method: 数据策管流水线：从600余小时素材中抽取手-物交互片段并做质量筛选，得到20,500条高质量自我中心视频；再人工选取500条覆盖7个任务族的片段，统一协议下按六个维度基准测试11个模型。
AI.result: 更强的手部姿态控制并不稳定转化为连贯的物体状态演化与持续性，也难以保证跨具身鲁棒性；若干专用手部控制模型在灵巧手任务上不如通用文本/图像到视频生成模型。
AI.conclusion: 手中心世界模型的关键瓶颈在于物体状态演化与跨具身泛化，而非单纯手部姿态精度；该基准为后续方法研究提供了统一评测锚点。

title: Jeveration: System One Models Now Generate
summary: System One models such as Jev return decisions through fast, parallel prediction. In this paper, we introduce Jeveration, showing that the same decision paradigm can also generate high-quality images in a single forward pass. Jeveration builds on a frozen vision-language model, repurposing its visual-semantic knowledge for holistic image generation. The key challenge is to maintain global consistency. A single prompt admits many valid images, yet parallel predictions must converge on a coherent whole. We therefore condition all positions on a shared random state to coordinate parallel predictions, so that each draw yields a different but coherent image. Since the model tends to ignore this state under direct image supervision, we first learn a distribution over discrete image codes to guide single-pass generation. Beyond text-to-image generation, we further unify image-to-image generation and dense prediction within the same architecture, so that one checkpoint supports all three tasks, each in one forward pass. Experiments show that Jeveration generates a 512x512 image in 78 ms, up to 122x faster than existing unified models, while maintaining competitive image quality and dense prediction performance.

AI.tldr: Jeveration 复用冻结视觉语言模型，通过共享随机状态协调并行预测，单次前向即可生成512x512图像（78ms），并统一文本生图、图像到图像和稠密预测三类任务。
AI.motivation: 将 System One 式快速并行决策范式（如 Jev）迁移到图像生成，探索单次前向生成高质量图像的可能性；难点在于并行预测需在极大多解空间中保持全局一致性。
AI.method: 以冻结的视觉语言模型为基础，将所有位置的预测条件化于共享随机状态以协调并保证一致性；由于直接图像监督下模型倾向忽略该状态，先学习离散图像码的分布来引导单步生成；同一架构与单一检查点统一 text-to-image、image-to-image 与稠密预测。
AI.result: 78ms 生成 512x512 图像，较现有统一模型最快加速达 122 倍，同时在图像质量与稠密预测上保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 单次前向的并行生成范式可达到实用图像质量，并可作为多任务统一的高效生成骨干。

title: A$^3$Bench: Compositional Reasoning over Aggressive Interactions in Videos
summary: Recent Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved strong performance on general video understanding benchmarks, yet their ability to reason about participant roles in aggressive interactions remains largely unexplored. Existing violence and crime datasets primarily evaluate whether aggression occurs, without testing whether models can identify who performed the action, who received it, and how participants are related within the scene. To address this gap, we introduce A$^3$Bench, a benchmark to study aggressive action and association in videos. The benchmark evaluates whether models can jointly recognize aggressive actions, distinguish aggressors from victims and bystanders, and correctly bind actions to participants under challenging distractor settings. We benchmark 17 multimodal models and find that they struggle substantially on fine-grained aggressive-scene understanding. Performance degrades consistently as reasoning complexity increases, with models frequently confusing aggressors with victims or bystanders, revealing a systematic failure in role-action association rather than coarse aggression recognition alone. We further observe that increasing model scale or generic reasoning models experience limited improvement. Finally, we explore a simple role-graph prompting strategy that encourages structured reasoning over participant interactions, leading to improvements in compositional reasoning. Our findings highlight that reliable aggressive-scene understanding remains a major challenge for current MLLMs and motivate future research on role-aware video reasoning beyond coarse violence detection. Code and dataset: this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出A³Bench基准，考察MLLM在视频攻击性场景中联合识别攻击行为、区分施暴者/受害者/旁观者并将动作正确绑定到参与者的"角色—动作关联"能力；17个模型普遍失败。
AI.motivation: 现有暴力/犯罪数据集只评估"是否发生攻击"，不测试模型能否判断谁实施、谁承受、参与者间关系；MLLM的细粒度角色推理能力尚未被系统检验。
AI.method: 构建A³Bench视频基准，设计含干扰项的任务以联合评测攻击行为识别与角色绑定；评测17个多模态模型，并按推理复杂度分层分析；提出简单的角色图提示（role-graph prompting）引导对参与者交互的结构化推理。
AI.result: 模型在细粒度攻击场景理解上表现显著不足；随推理复杂度上升性能单调下降，常将施暴者与受害者/旁观者混淆，说明失败源于角色—动作关联而非粗粒度攻击识别；增大模型规模或使用通用推理模型带来的提升有限；角色图提示可改善组合推理。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的攻击性场景理解仍是当前MLLM的主要短板，需发展超越粗粒度暴力检测的角色感知视频推理；基准与代码已公开。

title: Hierarchical Admittance-Impedance Control for Mobile Manipulator Load Transfer
comment: Accepted at the International Symposium on Robotics Research (ISRR 2026); 5 figures
summary: This paper presents a hierarchical admittance-impedance controller that combines an inner Cartesian impedance controller, an outer 6D admittance supervisor, and workspace-aware mobile-base assistance for guided load transfer. The method is motivated by assistive tasks such as airport baggage handling, where a robot should support a payload while a human worker guides its motion through small physical forces. Following an interaction-role interpretation of admittance and impedance, the torque-controlled Franka Research 3 manipulator behaves as a Cartesian impedance at the robot-object interface, providing compliant load support around a commanded equilibrium pose. At the human-facing interaction level, the outer admittance supervisor converts measured human wrench input into smooth Cartesian reference motion. The workspace-aware assistance layer shares the admittance-generated translational motion between the manipulator and a velocity-controlled base when larger motion is required, while front-side load alignment keeps the carried object near the robot's frontal region for safer and more intuitive guidance. The system was implemented in ROS and validated through a suitcase transfer experiment, showing that the robot can support the load while allowing the human to guide the transfer with relatively little effort.

AI.tldr: 提出分层导纳-阻抗控制器：内层笛卡尔阻抗、外层6D导纳监督器、工作空间感知移动底盘辅助，实现行李箱导引搬运。
AI.motivation: 机场行李等辅助搬运任务中，机器人需承载负载而由人类以微小外力导引运动，需兼顾柔顺支撑与直观引导。
AI.method: 基于导纳/阻抗的交互角色解释：Franka Research 3力矩控制机械臂在机器-物体界面表现为笛卡尔阻抗；外层导纳监督器将测得人体力旋量转换为平滑笛卡尔参考运动；工作空间感知层在需要大范围运动时将平移分量分配给速度控制移动底盘，并通过前侧负载对齐保持物体位于机器人前部区域。ROS实现。
AI.result: 行李箱传递实验验证：机器人可支撑负载，人类以较小努力完成引导搬运。
AI.conclusion: 分层导纳-阻抗架构配合移动底盘工作空间划分，可有效实现人机协同负载搬运，具备工程可用性但缺乏量化评估与多场景泛化验证。

title: 4D-TEMPO: Differentiable 4D-STEM ptychography via fast Physics Optimizers
comment: 34 pages: 8-page paper, references, and 23-page supplementary material; 10 figures, 10 tables
summary: Electron ptychography recovers atomic structure from 4D-STEM data: diffraction patterns at multiple positions of a scanned probe. Current codes reconstruct an image and read atoms off it, or fit atoms under an $L_1$ loss; neither gives per-atom uncertainty. We propose 4D-TEMPO, a differentiable physical renderer that fits the atoms, the microscope, and the detector directly to the recorded electron counts under a Poisson likelihood. The output is a list of atoms, each a Gaussian primitive with a 3D position, a thermal width, and a model-conditional error bar from the Fisher information. The Fisher information also conditions the solver, gives the dose (electrons per Å$^2$) each parameter needs, and separates calibration from imaging. On a simulated WSe$_2$ bilayer, starting from the published reconstruction, fitted atoms cut in-plane error by a third (3.2 vs. 4.8 pm) and depth error by 40-61% against its 3D peaks. Depth comes from multiple scattering into the dark field, the faint counts outside the direct beam. The two layers, $10\times$ closer than the depth of field, separate; per-atom depth then follows the layer geometry. When the model is well specified, the bars are calibrated (69% of position coordinates within $1\sigma$). On experimental WSe$_2$, fitted atoms predict held-out patterns better than the three published codes we test. With free probe modes where atoms are incomplete, the same likelihood predicts best on all three held-out benchmarks, matches every WSe$_2$ baseline in 5 min against up to 20.5 h, and passes torchslice at its released setting 180$\times$ sooner on PrScO$_3$. Per-atom error bars, planned doses, and fast reconstruction point to low-dose, real-time 3D imaging of beam-sensitive and dynamic materials.

AI.tldr: 提出4D-TEMPO：一个可微物理渲染器，在泊松似然下将原子、显微镜与探测器直接拟合到4D-STEM电子计数，输出带Fisher信息误差棒的高斯原子列表，并实现更快、更准的原子级三维重建。
AI.motivation: 现有电子叠层成像（ptychography）流程要么先重建图像再由图上读原子，要么在L1损失下拟合原子，均无法给出逐原子不确定度；同时也缺少剂量规划与校准/成像的有效分离手段。
AI.method: 以可微物理前向模型（含多重散射暗场贡献）渲染4D-STEM衍射图，直接对原始电子计数做泊松似然拟合；每个原子为带三维位置与热振动宽度的高斯原语，并用Fisher信息给出模型条件下的逐参数误差棒，同时其用于求解器条件化与每参数所需剂量估计，实现校准与成像解耦。
AI.result: 仿真WSe2双层：相较已发表重建的3D峰，面内误差由4.8 pm降至3.2 pm（降低约1/3），深度误差降40-61%；间距为景深1/10的两层可分离，逐原子深度吻合层几何；模型设定正确时误差棒校准（69%坐标在1σ内）。实验WSe2上预测留出衍射图优于三种已发表代码；自由探针模式、原子不完整时在三个留出基准上均最优，5分钟即可匹配全部WSe2基线（基线最长20.5 h），在PrScO3上以发布设置比torchslice快180倍。
AI.conclusion: 逐原子误差棒、可规划的剂量与快速重建支持面向束敏与动态材料的低剂量、实时三维原子成像；该方法将物理渲染式可微建模引入原子分辨表征。

title: Counterfactual World Models: JEPAs That Reason About "What If"
summary: World models operate in a world they cannot fully observe. When a hidden disturbance, such as a current pushing a boat, changes the outcome of an action, a counterfactual question follows: what would have happened under a different action, subject to the same disturbance? Its answer separates bad decisions from bad luck. We prove that world models trained on factual transitions cannot answer it on their own, whatever their data or capacity. For many physical systems, the observed outcome and a simple property of the dynamics suffice: natura non facit saltus, nature makes no leaps. When actions and disturbances act as separate forces, their interaction is second-order in time, so the counterfactual outcome is, to first order, the observed outcome plus the difference between the world model's predictions under the alternative and factual actions. This yields a counterfactual world model with no counterfactual data, extra parameters, or retraining. For transitions of duration $h$, we prove an $O(h^2)$ bound on the counterfactual error relative to the disturbance variance, establish a matching minimax lower bound from unpaired factual data, and characterize failures at discontinuities, coordinate folds, and disturbances that scale the command. We validate these predictions from pixels with JEPA world models on frozen DINOv2 and masked autoencoder (MAE) encoders. On four rendered simulators, our approach improves counterfactual $R^2$ from $38$--$46\%$ to $86$--$96\%$ with the same world models; on a fifth, an underwater vehicle, it reaches $90$--$94\%$ with sixteen times more factual data. Four further frozen encoders, DINOv3, SigLIP~2, CLIP and EVA-02, give $81$--$95\%$ on the same simulators. In hindsight planning, it finds the action that would have reached the goal in $35$--$69\%$ of events, against $14$--$23\%$ for an oracle planner that knows the simulator but not the outcome.

AI.tldr: 该论文证明仅用事实轨迹训练的世界模型无法独立回答反事实问题，并提出利用"自然不作跳跃"（动力学时间光滑性）先验：当动作与扰动为可分离力时，反事实结果一阶近似等于观测结果加上世界模型在替代动作与事实动作下预测之差，无需反事实数据、额外参数或重训练。
AI.motivation: 世界模型在无法完全观测的环境中运行（如水流推动船只）。当隐藏扰动改变动作结果时，"在同一扰动下换一个动作会怎样"这一反事实问题可以区分决策失误与运气不佳。作者指出仅从事实转移训练的世界模型理论上无法回答该问题。
AI.method: 基于动力学的二阶时间交互假设，构造反事实估计：ŷ_cf = y_obs + f(s,a') − f(s,a)。给出相对扰动方差的 O(h²) 误差上界、与之匹配的 minimax 下界（基于非配对事实数据），并刻画在不连续点、坐标折叠、扰动缩放指令等情形下的失效。实验用 JEPA 世界模型（冻结 DINOv2 与 MAE 编码器）从像素验证，另测 DINOv3、SigLIP2、CLIP、EVA-02。
AI.result: 四个渲染仿真器上反事实 R² 从 38–46% 提升至 86–96%；第五个水下航行器任务在使用 16 倍事实数据时达 90–94%；四个其他冻结编码器在相同仿真器上达 81–95%。后见之明规划中，35–69% 的事件能找出可达成目标的动作，而知晓仿真器但不知结果的 oracle 规划器仅 14–23%。
AI.conclusion: 世界模型的反事实能力可由简单物理先验（时间光滑性）以零额外成本获得，并有理论保证与失效边界刻画；在从像素学习的 JEPA 世界模型上跨编码器、跨仿真器一致有效，可支撑后见之明规划。局限在于需动作与扰动可分离、连续动力学，不适用于不连续或参数化扰动。

title: Read Together, Answer Apart: How Earlier Questions Help Vision-Language Models Look
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are often asked several questions about the same image in a single prompt (co-asking), yet existing evaluations report conflicting accuracy gains and hallucinations at the prompt level without tracking how individual answers change. By pairing each question's single-question and co-asked answers across 22 open-weight VLMs (1B-35B), we find that erratic net shifts reflect two opposing effects: on Densely Captioned Images (DCI), every model repairs 15.4%-29.8% of its single-question errors under co-asking, while the share of correct answers turned wrong falls from 30.8% on weaker models to 4.7% on stronger ones. Across all 14 models supporting custom attention masks, we show through attention readouts and layer-window interventions that earlier same-image questions read visual information into their question tokens in the early-to-middle layers during prefill, helping later questions concentrate image attention onto their queried targets. This visual help accumulates across the scene even across non-overlapping regions, whereas blocking earlier questions from attending to the image lowers both target localization and accuracy in all 14 models. While cross-question help is established during shared question reading, part of the co-asking damage enters later during answer decoding when the decoder attends to other question stems. We therefore introduce Read Together, Answer Apart, a training-free decoding mask that keeps shared prefill intact and isolates each answer from other stems, improving co-asking accuracy on 12 of 14 models on DCI (up to +4.71 percentage points, closing 70% of the pooled gap to asking alone) and on 10, 8, and 5 of the 14 models on WebUI, FinTabNet, and GQA (up to +11.4, +5.3, and +1.1 points).

AI.tldr: 论文逐题追踪22个开源VLM在单问与同提示多问(co-asking)下的答案变化，揭示co-asking既有"修复错误"的增益也有"答对变错"的损失，并定位其机制在prefill的跨题视觉注意力共享与解码期的题干干扰，提出免训练解码掩码Read Together, Answer Apart。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM评估只在prompt层面报告co-asking的总体准确率变化与幻觉，互相矛盾，无法说明单条答案究竟如何变化、是哪些环节导致了增益或损害。
AI.method: 对22个1B–35B开源VLM，将同一问题的单问答案与co-asked答案配对比对；在14个支持自定义注意力掩码的模型上用attention readout与layer-window干预定位机制；据此设计免训练解码掩码，保留共享prefill、在解码时隔离各答案对其他题干token的注意力。
AI.result: DCI上每个模型修复15.4%–29.8%的单问错误，答对变错比例从弱模型30.8%降至强模型4.7%；14个模型均显示早问在早中层prefill把图像信息读入问题token、帮助后问聚焦目标，屏蔽早问对图像的注意会同时降低定位与准确率；解码掩码在DCI上12/14模型提升（最高+4.71pt，弥补70%差距），WebUI/FinTabNet/GQA分别为10/8/5个模型提升（最高+11.4/+5.3/+1.1pt）。
AI.conclusion: co-asking的净效应是两种相反效应的叠加，可通过逐题配对分析清晰拆解；跨题视觉帮助发生在共享prefill，而部分损害源自解码期题干干扰，因此只需在解码阶段加掩码即可无损保留增益并抑制损害，实现免训练即插即用的改进。

title: HINT-WAM: Hindsight-Informed Training for World Action Models
summary: World action models (WAMs) have shown promising generalization and data efficiency in robot manipulation by coupling action generation with predictions of future visual dynamics. Translating these capabilities into reliable task execution, however, remains a challenge for existing post-training methods. Offline supervised fine-tuning provides dense supervision on expert trajectories, but its flow-matching action expert is trained only on noised demonstration actions and never on the intermediate states produced by its own sampler; task-specific adaptation can also compromise pretrained capabilities. On-policy reinforcement learning trains on the policy's own behavior, yet sparse task rewards make exploration and credit assignment difficult, while dense reward shaping still provides scalar evaluations rather than direct action targets. We introduce \textbf{HINT-WAM}, the first on-policy self-distillation framework that supervises the action expert on its own sampling trajectories using hindsight, the future video of the demonstration, as privileged information available to the WAM itself. For each demonstration observation, the student generates its action through its own denoising trajectory, and at the states along this trajectory the same model acts as a teacher conditioned additionally on this hindsight, providing a conditional action distribution as a dense training target, while the student sees only deployment-time inputs and needs no environmental rewards or simulator interaction. To transfer this supervision to a flow-matching action expert, HINT-WAM distills the teacher into the student with an energy score, a distribution-level objective that matches the teacher's action distribution from the student's own samples rather than regressing its velocity field. The project web is available in this https URL .

AI.tldr: HINT-WAM 提出首个 on-policy 自蒸馏框架，用演示的未来视频作为后见之明特权信息，让同一个 WAM 在自身采样轨迹上充当教师，并以 energy score 的分布级目标蒸馏给 flow-matching 动作专家。
AI.motivation: 现有 WAM 后训练方法存在明显短板：离线监督微调仅在有噪声的专家动作上训练动作专家，从未在其采样器产生的中间状态上监督，且任务适配易损害预训练能力；on-policy RL 虽训练自身行为，但稀疏任务奖励导致探索与信用分配困难，稠密奖励塑形仍只给标量评价而非直接动作目标。
AI.method: 对每条演示观测，学生模型通过自身去噪轨迹生成动作；在轨迹中间状态上，同一模型额外以该演示的未来视频（后见之明）为条件担任教师，输出条件动作分布作为稠密目标；学生推理时仅需部署输入，无需环境奖励或模拟器交互。针对 flow-matching 动作专家，采用 energy score 的分布级蒸馏目标，从学生自身样本匹配教师动作分布，而非回归其速度场。
AI.result: 摘要中未给出具体定量结果，仅报告框架有效性与项目主页链接。
AI.conclusion: HINT-WAM 将后见之明视作 WAM 自带的特权信息，在 on-policy 采样轨迹上实现稠密、分布级监督，兼顾 on-policy 数据分布一致性与免奖励、免仿真交互，为 WAM 的任务级后训练提供了新范式。

title: Training-free motion statistics match self-supervised behavior encoders
comment: 10 pages, 7 tables, 1 figure. Code will be released with the conference version
summary: Self-supervised encoders for animal behavior are often trained on, or fed, hand-built movement features. We ask whether they beat those ingredients when compared fairly. A training-free representation, made of generic per-frame measurements summarized over fixed time windows and reduced with PCA, is compared with retrained and released encoders (BAMS, hBehaveMAE) under a preregistered protocol: frozen representations of equal size and one shared classifier. On CalMS21 it reaches 85.8 macro F1 against 82.4 for the best encoder, ties with four labelled videos, and leads when the annotator changes or new behaviors must be learned from a few videos; the reading holds for encoders retrained with three seeds. On the MABe22 mouse triplets it scores 83.7 against 80.3 for the released hBehaveMAE (gap +3.4, 95% interval +2.1 to +4.7). On a second species, the MABe22 fly groups, the same recipe scores 51.6 mean F1 over 50 tasks against 48.2 for BAMS, the best published method. On Shot7M2, the synthetic basketball benchmark built by hBehaveMAE's authors, it scores 68.8 against 64.7 for hBehaveMAE, the best method in that paper, though hBehaveMAE remains better on the shortest movements. Short time windows carry most of the result. Raw keypoints in each body's own frame, summarized over the same windows, already match or beat the encoders on both mouse datasets and on Shot7M2; on the fly groups they fall short, and the measurements add 5.3 points. On these benchmarks, current behavior encoders have yet to beat the hand-built features they learn from, and such baselines should be reported alongside them.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑动物行为自监督编码器是否真正优于其训练所用的手工特征，提出一个免训练基线（逐帧通用测量+固定时间窗汇总+PCA），在冻结表征、等维度、统一分类器的公平协议下与BAMS、hBehaveMAE比较，在CalMS21、MABe22、Shot7M2上普遍领先或持平。
AI.motivation: 动物行为编码器通常以手工运动特征为输入或训练数据，却未被公平地与这些特征本身对比；作者希望回答编码器是否真的超过其"原料"。
AI.method: 构建免训练表征：每帧通用测量（及原始关键点）在固定时间窗内汇总，经PCA降维；预注册协议下比较冻结表征（等维度）配同一共享分类器，与重训练的及已发布的BAMS、hBehaveMAE对比，并做三随机种子复现与短时间窗消融。
AI.result: CalMS21上达85.8 macro F1（最佳编码器82.4），与四条标注视频打平，在标注者变更与少样本新行为学习上领先；MABe22小鼠三体上83.7 vs 80.3（差+3.4，95%区间+2.1~+4.7）；MABe22果蝇群50任务平均F1 51.6 vs BAMS 48.2；Shot7M2上68.8 vs hBehaveMAE 64.7（后者在最短动作上仍优）。短时间窗贡献主要性能，原始关键点已能匹配或超过编码器（果蝇组除外，测量额外+5.3）。
AI.conclusion: 在这些基准上，当前行为编码器尚未超越其学习所用的人工特征；应将此类简单基线作为标准报告项。

title: The Elephant in the Question: Unified Models Picture the Concepts Behind Their Answers
comment: 32 pages, including supplementary material. Code: this https URL
summary: Visualizing intermediate representations could help us inspect the reasoning steps underlying a model output. Unified multimodal models offer this opportunity by combining understanding and generation in one architecture. Their image generators can access representations formed while processing text. We introduce the V-lens, which uses this connection to visualize a chosen token's hidden state without training a decoder. Across four diffusion-based and two purely autoregressive unified models, the resulting images reveal key intermediate concepts that connect a question to its answer even when the concepts are never named explicitly. Controlled tests show how this content changes with context, token position, and depth. We then introduce lens tuning, which supervises selected hidden states with pictures through the V-lens. Across BAGEL, SenseNova-U1, and HunyuanImage-3.0, the rate of correct visualizations of pronoun referents rises from 2-11% to 86-94%. Surprisingly, such visual supervision also improves text answers without supervising the answer tokens directly. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出 V-lens：无需训练解码器，直接利用统一多模态模型理解侧隐状态驱动图像生成器，将指定 token 的中间表示可视化；进一步提出 lens tuning 用图像监督选定隐状态，显著提升代词指代可视化正确率（2-11%→86-94%），并意外提升文本答题准确率。
AI.motivation: 需要可解释性工具来检视统一多模态模型在文本理解过程中形成的中间表示；这类模型的生成器可直接访问文本处理所得的隐状态，为"无解码器的表示可视化"提供了天然通道。
AI.method: V-lens：将选定 token 的隐状态作为条件注入图像生成器进行可视化，无需训练解码器；在 4 个扩散式与 2 个纯自回归统一模型上验证，并做受控实验考察上下文、token 位置、网络深度的影响。Lens tuning：用图片对选定的隐状态进行监督微调（BAGEL、SenseNova-U1、HunyuanImage-3.0）。
AI.result: 可视化能揭示连接问题与答案、但未被显式命名的关键中间概念；lens tuning 将代词指代可视化正确率从 2-11% 提升到 86-94%，并间接改善文本答案质量。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 统一多模态模型的"理解→生成"通路可作为隐状态探针与监督接口，兼具可解释性与表示正则化价值；但属于模型可解释性/多模态表示方向，与具身智能、3D 重建、世界模型等核心方向无直接方法关联。

title: Ultimate3D: Teaching Multimodal LLMs 3D Camera-Object Relations by Large-Scale Visual Instruction Data
comment: Accepted to Machine Vision and Applications 2027
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) struggle with accurately capturing camera-object relations, especially for object orientation, camera viewpoint, and camera shots. This stems from the fact that existing MLLMs are trained on images with limited diverse camera-object relations and corresponding textual descriptions. To address this, we propose a synthetic generation pipeline to create large-scale 3D visual instruction datasets. Our framework takes 3D assets as input and uses rendering and diffusion-based image generation models to create photorealistic images preserving precise camera-object relations. Additionally, large language models (LLMs) are used to generate text prompts for guiding visual instruction tuning and controlling image generation. We create Ultimate3D, a large-scale 3D-grounded 2D visual instruction dataset. Ultimate3D consists of 240K VQAs with precise camera-object annotations, and corresponding benchmark. MLLMs fine-tuned on our proposed dataset outperform commercial models by a large margin, achieving an average accuracy improvement of 29.7% on camera-object relation recognition tasks. Our code, dataset, and benchmark will contribute to broad MLLM applications.

AI.tldr: 提出3D资产驱动的合成数据流水线，结合渲染与扩散模型生成保真相机-物体关系的图像，并用LLM生成文本指令，构建Ultimate3D（240K VQA）数据集与基准，微调后MLLM在相机-物体关系识别上平均提升29.7%。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM训练图像的相机-物体关系（物体朝向、相机视角、镜头类型）多样性不足且缺少对应文本描述，导致模型难以准确捕捉此类关系。
AI.method: 以3D资产为输入，用渲染与扩散生成模型合成照片级真实且相机-物体关系精确可控的图像；用LLM生成引导视觉指令微调的文本提示并控制图像生成；构建240K带精确相机-物体标注的VQA数据集Ultimate3D及配套基准。
AI.result: 在Ultimate3D上微调的MLLM大幅超越商业模型，相机-物体关系识别任务平均准确率提升29.7%。
AI.conclusion: 3D-grounded合成数据可有效补足MLLM对相机-物体关系的理解能力，代码、数据集与基准将开放以推动MLLM应用。

title: Planner-Controller Interaction for Ackermann Navigation: A Matched Simulation and Hardware Benchmark
comment: 32 pages, 8 figures, 8 tables. Code: this https URL and this https URL
summary: Global planners and path-tracking controllers are often evaluated independently, although their interaction determines how a vehicle follows a planned path. Whether simulation accurately predicts the performance of specific planner-controller combinations on Ackermann-steered hardware remains uncertain. This study evaluated three geometric controllers (Regulated Pure Pursuit, Stanley, and Vector Pursuit) paired with two global planners (Hybrid A* and NavFn) on a 1/10-scale Quanser QCar and in a matched Gazebo simulation. Both environments used shared custom planning and control algorithms, matched route geometry and goals, ground-truth pose references, and a common evaluation pipeline. Five runs per configuration and environment yielded 60 benchmark runs. Controller rankings for tracking accuracy and command smoothness transferred consistently between environments, with Spearman correlations of 0.77-0.94. However, planner-dependent effects showed substantially weaker agreement. In simulation, planner selection changed the root-mean-square (RMS) angular acceleration of the commanded velocities by no more than 0.030 rad/s^2, whereas Hybrid A* increased it by 0.141-0.843 rad/s^2 on hardware, depending on the controller. These differences coincided with planner-dependent achieved speeds that the simulation's idealised longitudinal response did not reproduce. Mean controller computation times remained below 0.5 ms on the Jetson TX2. The findings demonstrate that agreement in controller rankings does not guarantee accurate prediction of planner-dependent performance for specific controller pairings on hardware, highlighting the importance of physical validation.

AI.tldr: 该研究在1/10比例Quanser QCar实车与匹配Gazebo仿真中，用统一算法、路线和评估流程对比3种几何控制器与2种全局规划器的组合（共60次基准运行），检验仿真能否预测实车性能。
AI.motivation: 全局规划器与路径跟踪控制器通常被独立评估，但其耦合决定了实际跟踪表现；对Ackermann转向硬件上特定规划器-控制器组合，仿真预测的可靠性尚不明确。
AI.method: 共享自定义规划与控制代码，Regulated Pure Pursuit / Stanley / Vector Pursuit 三种控制器分别搭配 Hybrid A* 与 NavFn 两种规划器；实车与仿真采用相同路线几何、目标点、真值位姿参考与统一评估管线；每配置每环境5次，共60次运行；以Spearman相关与RMS角加速度等指标比较排名与性能一致性。
AI.result: 控制器在跟踪精度与指令平滑度上的排名跨环境稳定迁移（Spearman 0.77–0.94）；但规划器相关效应一致性显著较弱：仿真中规划器对指令速度RMS角加速度的影响≤0.030 rad/s²，而实车中Hybrid A*使其增加0.141–0.843 rad/s²（依控制器而定）；差异伴随规划器相关的实际速度差异，仿真的理想化纵向响应未能复现。控制器平均计算时延在Jetson TX2上低于0.5 ms。
AI.conclusion: 控制器排名一致并不保证仿真能准确预测特定组合下规划器相关性能，仿真保真度需物理验证；评价规划-控制耦合时应优先关注纵向动态建模。

title: Edge-Efficient Joint RAW Image Compression and Restoration for Smart Wearable Devices
summary: Smart wearable devices, such as augmented reality glasses, increasingly rely on cameras to understand and interact with their surroundings. However, their compact sensors often capture noisy RAW images, while limited compute and power make high-quality on-device restoration difficult. This creates an emerging need to reduce both local computation and transmission cost without sacrificing image quality. Two common solutions are to offload restoration or to compress the raw data before transmission. The first makes RAW transmission costly; the second reduces the payload but can spend bitrate preserving sensor noise. We address this fundamental mismatch with an asymmetric framework for joint RAW compression and restoration that directly optimizes the transmitted representation for clean image reconstruction. A lightweight on-device encoder compresses noisy RAW measurements into a bitstream, while a higher-capacity backend decoder jointly denoises and demosaics the encoded representation. We use knowledge distillation to train a smaller encoder for tighter compute budgets. Experiments on real and synthetic data show improved rate-restoration performance over strong cascaded compression-restoration pipelines and learned compression baselines. On SIDD, our method improves PSNR by more than 1.5 dB over cascaded baselines at approximately 0.25 bits per pixel. We further validate the method on real 12 MP RAW images captured with commercial smart glasses and measure sender-side latency on both smartphone and smart-glasses hardware. The distilled encoder achieves a 27.6$\times$ NPU inference speedup over on-device NAFNet for 256$\times$256 output patches. The code is available at this https URL

AI.tldr: 为智能眼镜等穿戴设备设计非对称联合RAW压缩与复原框架：端侧轻量编码器压缩含噪RAW，后端大容量解码器联合去噪与去马赛克，并用知识蒸馏训练更小编码器。
AI.motivation: AR眼镜等穿戴设备传感器小、RAW含噪，本地算力与功耗有限，难以高质量端侧复原；直接上传RAW传输代价高，而先压缩再复原又易把码率浪费在编码传感器噪声上，存在"传输表示与干净图像复原目标不匹配"的根本问题。
AI.method: 非对称架构：端侧轻量编码器将含噪RAW压成比特流，直接面向干净图像重建优化传输表示；后端高容量解码器在该表示上联合完成去噪与去马赛克。采用知识蒸馏把大编码器能力迁移到小编码器以适配更紧的计算预算。
AI.result: 在真实与合成数据上，率-复原性能优于强级联压缩-复原流水线与学习式压缩基线；SIDD上约0.25 bpp时PSNR较级联基线提升超1.5 dB。用商用智能眼镜实拍12MP RAW验证有效；蒸馏编码器在256×256输出patch上相对端侧NAFNet实现27.6倍NPU推理加速。
AI.conclusion: 通过以干净重建为目标端到端优化传输表示，可同时降低端侧计算与传输开销并保持复原质量，适合真实穿戴设备部署。

title: ReCoCo: From Patches to Compositions for Visual Representation Learning
summary: Self-supervised learning has produced powerful visual representations, yet learning strong dense features remains challenging. While consistency between augmented views provides strong image-level supervision, extending this principle to local visual content is less straightforward. Existing approaches often match individual patches across views or identify coherent regions, introducing uncertainties in correspondence estimation and assumptions about how visual content should be grouped. We introduce ReCoCo (Regional Composition Consistency), a principled approach that extends cross-view consistency to the regional level without requiring such correspondences or semantic grouping. ReCoCo represents the content shared between augmented views through compositions of their patch-level predictions over learned visual prototypes. By aligning these compositions, the model learns from regions containing multiple visual concepts without requiring them to be separated beforehand. ReCoCo integrates naturally with teacher-student self-distillation and introduces no additional learned parameters. Extensive experiments demonstrate substantial improvements in frozen-feature segmentation, clustering, and regional retrieval while maintaining competitive image-level recognition, alleviating the trade-off between dense and global representation quality.

AI.tldr: ReCoCo：在自监督自蒸馏框架中，用patch级预测在学习到的视觉原型上的“区域组合”表示跨增强视图的共享内容，并对其对齐，实现无需patch对应或语义分组的区域级一致性学习，且不引入额外参数。
AI.motivation: 自监督学习在图像级表示上很强，但稠密特征学习仍困难；将跨视图一致性推广到局部内容时，现有方法需在视图间匹配patch或识别一致区域，引入对应估计不确定性与对内容如何分组的先验假设。
AI.method: 把两视图间共享的内容表示为各视图patch级预测在视觉原型上的组合（composition），直接对齐这些组合分布，而非建立patch级或区域级对应；与teacher-student自蒸馏自然结合，无新增可学习参数。
AI.result: 大量实验显示在冻结特征的分割、聚类和区域检索上显著提升，同时图像级识别保持竞争力，缓解稠密表示与全局表示质量之间的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 区域级一致性不必依赖显式对应或语义分组，原型组合对齐是一种简洁有效的稠密自监督信号，可提升密集预测任务的迁移性。

title: RoboMorpher: Scaling Robot Morphology Representations for Cross-Embodiment Action Prediction
summary: Learning shared action representations is central to cross-embodiment manipulation. However, identical joint values can produce different spatial configurations across robots, limiting representations learned from joint values alone. We introduce RoboMorpher, a morphology-conditioned action tokenizer that jointly reconstructs joint angles and link poses to associate control coordinates with their kinematic effects. MorphGen supplies scalable kinematic supervision by generating serial-arm descriptions from survey-derived geometric priors. We pretrain RoboMorpher on 40 million morphology-state pairs and integrate the frozen tokenizer into a vision-language-action policy for discrete prediction and continuous refinement. We also introduce EmbodiBench, a ten-task benchmark with 30 generated URDFs per task. With downstream URDFs excluded from tokenizer pretraining, the policy achieves 56.40% success on RoboTwin 2.0 and 23.27% on EmbodiBench, exceeding continuous joint-space control by 9.73 and 15.34 percentage points. Removing link-pose supervision reduces EmbodiBench success by 17.94 percentage points, supporting morphology-aware geometric supervision for joint-action representation learning.

AI.tldr: 提出形态条件动作分词器 RoboMorpher，联合重建关节角与连杆位姿，并用 MorphGen 合成运动学监督，预训练后冻结接入 VLA 策略；同时发布 EmbodiBench 基准，跨本体控制显著优于纯关节空间基线。
AI.motivation: 跨本体操作需要共享动作表示，但相同关节值在不同机器人上对应不同空间构型，仅从关节值学习的表示缺乏运动学语义与形态泛化性。
AI.method: RoboMorpher：以形态为条件的动作 tokenizer，同时重建关节角与连杆位姿，将控制坐标与其运动学效应关联；MorphGen 基于调研几何先验生成串联臂描述以提供可扩展运动学监督；在 4000 万形态-状态对上预训练，将冻结 tokenizer 集成进 VLA 策略，用于离散 token 预测加连续细化。
AI.result: 在 RoboTwin 2.0 达 56.40% 成功率，在新建 EmbodiBench（10 任务、每任务 30 个生成 URDF，下游 URDF 排除于预训练）达 23.27%，分别比连续关节空间控制高 9.73 和 15.34 个百分点；去除连杆位姿监督使 EmbodiBench 成功率下降 17.94 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 形态感知的几何监督对关节动作表示学习有效，跨本体动作 tokenization 可提升 VLA 策略在新形态上的泛化能力。

title: Synthesizing hyperspectral Data using generative Models to train spectral Unmixing Methods for low-cost Crop Residue Cover Mapping
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures. Published in the XXV ISPRS Congress 2026
summary: The spectral range of the Field Imaging Nanosatellite for Crop residue Hyperspectral Mapping (FINCH), developed by the University of Toronto Aerospace Team's Space System Division, poses significant challenges for hyperspectral unmixing to determine crop residue cover fractional abundances. The severe lack of standard indices necessitates the use of complex, data-driven unmixing models. Complex unmixing models require dense, well-distributed manifolds, whereas ground-truth datasets are sparse and expensive. To better leverage the information content in existing ground-truth datasets, this study presents a framework that decouples interpolation and abundance-mapping estimation via an intermediary conditional data generator, contrasting with traditional single-model unmixing pipelines. This decoupling enables the inclusion of physical prior knowledge about spectra, which is not natively accessible to unmixing models, thereby artificially expanding the dataset to serve as a Monte Carlo approximation of the population risk. To test this hypothesis, we have proposed two generator models: a 1D Conditional U-Net with Conformer Layers (GD-Streamline) and a Dual-Path Transformer Conditional Variational AutoEncoder (TCVAE), and two unmixing models: Multi-Layered Perceptrons (MLP) and Fourier Neural Operators (FNO). The results of the study indicate a need for rigorous integration and introduction of spectral priors within the scope of the proposed decoupling framework to prevent domain and mode collapse and hallucination by the generator models; otherwise, this leads to falsely approximated data manifolds, ultimately resulting in unsatisfactory and out-of-distribution unmixing performance.

AI.tldr: 提出一种解耦式高光谱解混框架：用条件数据生成器（1D Conv U-Net+Conformer "GD-Streamline"、双路 Transformer CVAE "TCVAE"）作为插值/中间生成环节，再配 MLP 与 Fourier Neural Operator 解混器，以蒙特卡洛方式近似群体风险、人为扩增稀疏地面真值数据。
AI.motivation: FINCH 纳卫星的作物残茬高光谱成像光谱范围缺乏标准指数，必须依赖复杂数据驱动解混模型；而此类模型需要密集、分布良好的流形，实测地面真值数据却稀疏且昂贵。作者希望更充分地利用现有真值数据中的信息。
AI.method: 将传统单模型解混流水线拆分为"插值 + 丰度映射估计"两级，中间插入条件数据生成器，从而把解混模型本身无法直接利用的光谱物理先验引入生成过程，扩展数据集以做群体风险的蒙特卡洛近似。对比两类生成器（GD-Streamline、TCVAE）与两类解混器（MLP、FNO）的组合。
AI.result: 实验表明生成器模型会出现域坍缩、模式坍缩与幻觉，导致近似出的数据流形失真，最终解混性能不理想且分布外泛化差；说明必须在该解耦框架内严格整合并引入光谱先验。
AI.conclusion: 解耦+生成式扩增的思路有效但尚不成立：缺乏严格光谱先验约束时，生成器会污染流形，解混性能反而失真。后续工作应聚焦先验约束下的生成器设计，本质更接近一项带负面结论的可行性探索。

title: DiWALI: Diffusion Policy Learning in World Models via Latent Action Inference from Human and Robot Play
summary: Learning robot manipulation is constrained by the availability of action-labeled robot data, for both imitation and world models. Humans can demonstrate skills in seconds, but their demonstrations lack the required robot actions. We introduce DiWALI, a framework that learns and improves diffusion policies within a world model trained on human and robot play. DiWALI infers latent actions from consecutive frames using an inverse dynamics model, enabling world model training without action labels, and grounds them in robot commands through a decoder trained separately on robot play. Skill policies are trained over latent actions from action-free human demonstrations and improved with reinforcement learning in imagination. On the CALVIN benchmark, DiWALI policies trained solely from human demonstrations substantially outperform baselines trained with robot demonstrations. Incorporating human play into the world model training also yields stronger policies after fine-tuning than using the same amount of robot play alone. Experiments on a physical robot show that skills learned primarily from human demonstrations are further improved in imagination with a world model trained on human and robot play. Together, these results demonstrate that human experience can support both manipulation skill acquisition and subsequent policy improvement, reducing reliance on action-labeled robot data. Videos, dataset and code are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出 DiWALI 框架：用逆动力学模型从连续帧推断隐动作，在无动作标签的人-机器人 play 数据上训练世界模型，再将隐动作通过解码器落地为机器人指令，从而在想象中训练并 RL 改进扩散策略；仅用人演示训练的 CALVIN 策略优于用机器人演示训练的基线。
AI.motivation: 机器人操作学习受限于带动作标签的机器人数据（模仿学习与世界模型都需要），而人类演示易得却缺少对应机器人动作，因此需要一种能利用无动作标签的人类 play 数据的范式。
AI.method: (1) 用逆动力学模型从相邻帧推断隐动作，使世界模型可在无动作标签数据上训练；(2) 另用机器人 play 单独训练解码器，将隐动作 grounding 到真实机器人命令；(3) 在隐动作空间上以人类演示训练扩散策略，并在世界模型想象中做强化学习改进；人类与机器人 play 混合用于世界模型预训练。
AI.result: CALVIN 上仅用人类演示的 DiWALI 策略显著优于用机器人演示训练的基线；把人类 play 混入世界模型训练后，微调得到的策略优于等量机器人 play；真机实验显示主要来自人类演示的技能可借助人-机器人混合 play 训练的世界模型在想象中进一步提升。
AI.conclusion: 人类经验可同时支撑操作技能获取与策略改进，降低对动作标注机器人数据的依赖；视频、数据与代码已公开。

title: Does the Action Matter? Probing Action-Conditioned Semantic Forecasting as a World Model for Autonomous Driving
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables. Accepted at the WAM-AD Workshop, WACV 2027. Code: this https URL
summary: World models are increasingly used in autonomous driving to predict how a scene evolves under the ego vehicle's actions, supporting counterfactual reasoning and model-based planning. However, existing evaluations focus on prediction fidelity and planning performance, and rarely verify that the predictions depend on the conditioning action. In this paper, we study action dependence in action-conditioned semantic forecasting, which predicts future semantic segmentation from past segmentations and the ego action. We compare a forecaster with feature-wise and input-level action conditioning against an identical model without action input, and measure action dependence with test-time action interventions scored by standard segmentation metrics. The evaluation is validated in a synthetic environment with known action-dependent dynamics and applied to Cityscapes and BDD100K, both within each dataset and across the two vehicle platforms. Experiments show that the executed action improves mid-term mIoU by at most 2.5 points on Cityscapes and 0.6 points on BDD100K, whereas a wrong action reduces it by up to 23.2 and 7.0 points, below the model without action input.
