On real data, feature-wise conditioning depends 1.6 times more on the action than input-level conditioning at similar accuracy, whereas both depend on it equally in the synthetic environment, where the history does not determine the action. These results show that an accuracy gain indicates that a driving world model uses its action, but not how strongly its forecasts depend on it. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 论文研究动作条件语义预测中的"动作依赖性"：用测试时动作干预+分割指标，对比有/无动作输入及两种条件注入方式的预测器。
AI.motivation: 现有驾驶世界模型评估只看预测保真度和规划性能，很少验证预测是否真正依赖所条件的自车动作，导致"准确率提升"被误当作"动作被使用且依赖充分"的证据。
AI.method: 构建动作条件语义预测器（由历史语义分割+自车动作预测未来分割），比较feature-wise条件注入、输入级条件注入与无动作输入的相同模型；在合成环境（动作动力学已知）以及Cityscapes、BDD100K（跨数据集与跨车辆平台）上进行测试时动作干预（执行动作/错误动作）并按标准分割指标评分。
AI.result: 执行动作最多带来中期mIoU +2.5（Cityscapes）/ +0.6（BDD100K）；错误动作使mIoU下降最多23.2 / 7.0，甚至低于无动作输入的模型。真实数据上feature-wise条件对动作的依赖约为输入级的1.6倍（精度相近），而合成环境中两者依赖程度相同（因历史不决定动作）。
AI.conclusion: 准确率增益只说明模型在一定程度上使用了动作，不能说明预测依赖动作的强弱；需用动作干预协议显式测量动作依赖性，作为世界模型评估的补充维度。

title: Communications-free Collective Intelligence Via Allocentric Belief
summary: A team of skilled card players share no information amongst each other, and yet still are able to coordinate their play by watching the same players and reading the same tells. Autonomous systems have failed to exploit this logic, relying instead on explicit communication or complex state estimation schemes that can fail when it matters most. Without it, decentralized agents diverge in their world beliefs, and coordination collapses. Here we show that anchoring all agents to a single shared external actor, a common witness whose reactions encode team state, produces spontaneous, communication-free coordination. An allocentric belief network trained on witness behavior allows each agent to independently reconstruct full team state, keeping group beliefs consistent with no inter-agent exchange. Across five competitive environments allocentric belief alignment outperforms egocentric approaches in collective performance, and even scales to sixty-agent teams where standard methods fail. These results establish a new principle for collective intelligence: in the absence of communication, a shared gaze replaces a shared channel.

AI.tldr: 提出"共同见证者"(common witness)机制：所有去中心化智能体锚定到同一外部演员，该演员的反应隐式编码队伍状态；每个智能体用训练于见证者行为的异中心(allocentric)信念网络独立重建全局队伍状态，从而在零通信条件下实现自发协同。
AI.motivation: 多智能体去中心化协同通常依赖显式通信或复杂状态估计，通信受限或估计失效时各智能体世界信念发散、协同崩溃。现实中熟练玩家通过观察同一对象/线索实现无通信协同，自主系统尚未利用这一机制。
AI.method: 引入单一共享外部actor作为"见证者"，其行为反应作为团队状态的隐式编码；为每个智能体训练异中心信念网络(从见证者行为中学习)，使其独立推断完整团队状态，实现无智能体间信息交换的信念对齐，并与自我中心(egocentric)基线对比。
AI.result: 在5个竞争性环境中，异中心信念对齐的集体表现优于自我中心方法；可扩展至60智能体团队，而标准方法在此规模失效。
AI.conclusion: 确立集体智能新原则：缺乏通信渠道时，共享"凝视"(共享外部参照)可替代共享信道，实现隐式信念同步与可扩展协同。

title: Gaspard: Expressive unified speech and gesture synthesis with continuous autoregressive flow-matching and decoupled classifier-free guidance
summary: Human communication involves highly coordinated multimodal signals such as speech and co-speech gestures. Existing approaches for generating both modalities commonly follow a cascaded pipeline, where speech is generated first and subsequently used to drive gesture generation; speech generation is therefore independent of gestures. We introduce Gaspard, a unified speech--gesture generation model based on continuous autoregressive generation with next-step flow-matching predictions, and trained on Seamless Interaction, a large-scale multimodal dataset. The heterogeneous temporal properties of speech and gesture motivate modality-specific prediction heads and decoupled classifier-free guidance over the two generation streams. This guidance rebalances the influence of speech and gesture at inference time, improving expressivity while mitigating dynamics collapse in continuous autoregressive gesture generation. Objective and perceptual evaluations show that Gaspard is a strong gesture generation model against unimodal baselines and that it produces highly synchronous speech and gestures compared to a matched cascaded system.

AI.tldr: Gaspard：统一的语音–共语手势生成模型，采用连续自回归生成与逐步flow-matching预测，在Seamless Interaction大规模多模态数据上训练，通过模态专属预测头与解耦CFG实现高同步的语音+手势联合生成。
AI.motivation: 现有语音+手势生成多为级联流水线（先生成语音再由语音驱动手势），语音生成独立于手势，无法建模二者的协同性，导致跨模态同步性差、手势动态塌缩。
AI.method: 统一自回归框架：以连续自回归+next-step flow-matching同时生成语音与手势流；针对两模态异构时间特性设计模态专属预测头；推理时对两条流做解耦的classifier-free guidance以再平衡模态影响；在Seamless Interaction大规模多模态数据集上训练。
AI.result: 客观与感知评测显示，Gaspard作为手势生成模型优于单模态基线，且相较匹配的级联系统产生高度同步的语音与手势；解耦CFG缓解了连续自回归手势生成的动态塌缩并提升表现力。
AI.conclusion: 联合而非级联的生成范式是提升语音–手势协同性的关键；模态特异建模与解耦引导为异构多模态连续生成提供了可行方案。

title: NereidVLA: Learning to Understand and Navigate the Underwater World
summary: Underwater navigation requires translating visual spatial cues into motion, yet marine vision-language datasets rarely include paired robot trajectories. We present NereidVLA, a vision-language-action model that transfers marine spatial knowledge to language-conditioned 3D navigation. We first train Sea2Know on approximately two million marine examples to learn target grounding, spatial relations, and scene structure without paired robot-motion supervision. We then adapt it using expert trajectories executed under simulated underwater vehicle dynamics. Given RGB histories and a language instruction, NereidVLA predicts discrete motion tokens that decode into local 3D trajectories for closed-loop tracking. Evaluation combines an independent six-dimensional underwater navigation understanding benchmark with offline prediction and closed-loop navigation. Under matched navigation training and execution settings, marine spatial pretraining increases simulation success from 72.4% to 84.4%. Without fine-tuning on the real test environment, NereidVLA achieves 78.75% success in laboratory-pool robot trials, compared with 47.50% for InternVLA-N1. These results show that marine spatial supervision can support downstream motion learning and physical underwater navigation.

AI.tldr: NereidVLA：先用约200万海洋图文样本训练Sea2Know学习目标定位与空间关系，再用仿真水下动力学下的专家轨迹做VLA微调，输出离散运动token解码为局部3D轨迹实现闭环导航，仿真成功率72.4%→84.4%，真实水池78.75% vs InternVLA-N1 47.50%。
AI.motivation: 水下导航需将视觉空间线索转为运动，但海洋视觉-语言数据集几乎不含配对机器人轨迹，缺乏可迁移的空间-运动监督。
AI.method: 两阶段：Sea2Know在约200万海洋样本上做无机器人运动监督的空间预训练（目标grounding、空间关系、场景结构）；随后在模拟水下航行器动力学下用专家轨迹适配，构建NereidVLA——输入RGB历史与语言指令，预测离散运动token并解码为局部3D轨迹供闭环跟踪。评估含自建六维水下导航理解基准、离线预测与闭环导航。
AI.result: 匹配训练/执行设置下，海洋空间预训练将仿真成功率由72.4%提升到84.4%；未经真实测试环境微调，实验室水池机器人试验成功率78.75%，InternVLA-N1为47.50%。
AI.conclusion: 海洋空间监督可支撑下游运动学习与真实水下物理导航，验证了“空间知识预训练→动作微调”的迁移路径，但依赖自建基准且真实试验仅限受控水池。

title: Learning to Interact in Multi-Agent Self-Play for Controllable Autonomous Driving Scenario Generation
summary: Large-scale, multi-agent self-play trains robust driving policies effectively in simulation, but controlling these models to generate specific, safety-critical edge cases remains a key challenge. Existing goal-conditioned self-play frameworks rely primarily on static map-location goals and fail to reliably produce complex agent interactions such as aggressive tailgating or adversarial cut-offs. These agent interactions are necessary for rigorous autonomous vehicle (AV) testing. To address this, we present an extended multi-agent self-play framework that introduces agent-relative dynamic goals. By conditioning policies on this extended goal representation, our framework enables targeted, controllable scenario synthesis. We demonstrate that our approach successfully generates interactive driving behaviors that static-goal baselines cannot simulate, providing a flexible tool for long-tail scenario generation in AV testing.

AI.tldr: 提出扩展的多智能体自博弈框架，引入"智能体相对动态目标"（agent-relative dynamic goals），以可控地合成如紧贴跟车、恶意加塞等交互式安全关键驾驶场景。
AI.motivation: 现有目标条件自博弈依赖静态地图位置目标，难以可靠产生复杂智能体交互（如激进跟车、对抗性加塞），而这些交互对自动驾驶严格测试至关重要。
AI.method: 在仿真中扩展多智能体自博弈框架，将策略条件从静态地标目标改为智能体相对动态目标表示，使策略条件化于交互层面目标以实现定向场景生成。
AI.result: 成功生成静态目标基线无法模拟的交互式驾驶行为，为自动驾驶长尾场景生成提供灵活工具。
AI.conclusion: 相对动态目标显著提升自博弈策略的可控性与交互复杂度覆盖，是长尾场景合成的有效手段；但验证局限于仿真，缺少规模化的可控性定量指标与真实数据支撑。

title: Teleoperated Haircutting with Delay Compensation and Passivity-Based Control for Unilateral Internet Teleoperation under Real Communication Uncertainties
summary: Robotic haircutting requires accurate motion execution and reliable communication to safely reproduce the operator's commands. Internet-based teleoperation is a key enabling technology to remotely perform precise manipulation tasks such as haircutting. However, communication uncertainties, including variable transmission delays and packet jitter, degrade synchronization between the master and slave systems and affect tracking performance. This paper presents a unilateral Internet teleoperation framework for robotic haircutting that takes into account experimentally measured communication uncertainties. Three delay-compensation techniques, namely Zero-Order Hold (ZOH), First-Order Hold (FOH), and Low-Pass Filtering (LPF), are evaluated together with a classical proportional-derivative (PD) controller and a passivity-based synchronization controller. Unlike conventional studies based on synthetic delay models, the proposed framework is validated using communication data acquired from a real cloud-based teleoperation platform, where both packet delay and effective delay are characterized. The results demonstrate that combining delay-compensation techniques with passivity-based synchronization improves the robustness of unilateral Internet teleoperation under realistic communication uncertainties, providing a reliable control framework for robotic haircutting applications.

AI.tldr: 基于真实云端遥操作平台实测延迟数据，评估ZOH/FOH/LPF延迟补偿与PD、无源性同步控制器组合，实现单边互联网机器人理发遥操作。
AI.motivation: 机器人理发需高精度运动与可靠通信；互联网遥操作存在变时延与数据包抖动，破坏主从同步与跟踪性能。以往研究多用合成延迟模型，缺乏真实网络数据验证。
AI.method: 构建单边互联网遥操作框架；采用实验实测通信不确定性（数据包延迟与有效延迟）替代合成模型；对比三种延迟补偿技术（ZOH、FOH、LPF）与经典PD控制器、无源性同步控制器的组合效果。
AI.result: 延迟补偿与无源性同步控制相结合，在真实通信不确定性下显著提升单边互联网遥操作的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 为机器人理发应用提供了基于实测网络数据的可靠控制框架；单边遥操作+延迟补偿+无源性控制是应对真实时延不确定性的有效方案。

title: ShadowTransfer: A Geographic Transfer Benchmark for Overhead Shadow Detection
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026, Track on Evaluations and Datasets. 53 pages. Project page: this https URL . Code: this https URL . Data: this https URL (DOI https://doi.org/10.57967/hf/11483 )
summary: Overhead aerial imagery feeds dense-prediction pipelines that are routinely trained in one geographic region and deployed in another, yet no benchmark measures how shadow detection models transfer across regions. Existing overhead shadow datasets either lack a geographic transfer protocol or rely on automatically generated labels. We introduce ShadowTransfer, a benchmark of 4,500 human-verified shadow masks across three U.S. cities at two native resolutions, paired with a leave-one-city-out evaluation protocol. Under vanilla training, holding out the test city costs 3.5 to 7.8 mIoU across four architectures, the gap remains significant when the training set grows from 225 to 900 images, and six of eight adaptation methods degrade more than vanilla training on average. We propose a three-probe framework that diagnoses where and how the transfer breaks: the failure operates in feature space, beyond the reach of pixel-histogram matching, shows up as a confidence collapse on shadow pixels while background confidence stays intact, and is recoverable by retraining different architectural components depending on the model: encoder for some, decoder for others. These findings replicate on INRIA building footprints, suggesting they describe geographic transfer beyond shadows. Guided by the diagnosis, we build Spectral Information Bottleneck (SIB), a plug-in module with one component per finding. Across the 9 (architecture, held-out city) cells, SIB has the smallest mean gap to the within-city upper bound of the ten methods we evaluate (6.42 mIoU), level with FDA. The benchmark, LOCO protocol, code, and trained models are released to support reproducible evaluation of geographic transfer in overhead dense prediction.

AI.tldr: 提出 ShadowTransfer 基准（3 城 4,500 张人工核验阴影掩膜 + 留一城市 LOCO 协议），量化跨地域迁移退化，并提出三探针诊断框架与 Spectral Information Bottleneck (SIB) 插件模块。
AI.motivation: 鸟瞰影像稠密预测模型常在甲地训练、乙地部署，但缺乏衡量阴影检测跨地域迁移的基准；现有数据集要么无地理迁移协议，要么用自动生成标签。
AI.method: 构建含 4,500 张人工核验掩膜、两档原生分辨率、三座美国城市的基准与 LOCO 评测；在 4 种架构、8 种域适应方法上测迁移差距；设计三探针诊断（特征空间失效、超越像素直方图匹配、阴影像素置信度崩塌、按架构分别重训 encoder/decoder 可恢复）；据此构造 SIB 插件模块，逐项对应诊断结论。
AI.result: 普通训练留出测试城市损失 3.5–7.8 mIoU，训练集从 225 增至 900 张后差距仍显著；8 种适应方法中 6 种平均劣于基线；SIB 在 9 个（架构，留出城市）单元上平均差距最小（6.42 mIoU），与 FDA 持平；结论在 INRIA 建筑足迹数据上复现。
AI.conclusion: 跨地域迁移失效发生于特征空间而非像素统计，表现为阴影像素置信度崩塌，且可依架构分别修复；基于该诊断的 SIB 有效缩小域间差距，且现象可能超越阴影任务，适用于更广的鸟瞰稠密预测迁移。

title: PrismRestore: A Compact Restoration Toolbox for Agentic Image Restoration
summary: Agentic image restoration composes operations to handle mixed degradations, yet its toolbox often requires storing multiple restoration networks. We propose PrismRestore, which constructs a compact bank of callable restoration actions from a single frozen all-in-one model. Our approach builds on task-dependent yet overlapping channel responses in the shared model. An offline task-prior search uses activation and gradient statistics to group channels with similar response profiles, then searches task-specific modulation coefficients over non-representative channels while leaving representative channels unmodulated. The resulting prior bank enables explicit action selection and composition without additional restoration backbones or task-specific adapter modules. A state-conditioned policy learns to compose these actions using Group Relative Policy Optimization. Its objective separately normalizes fidelity and perceptual feedback within groups of trajectories sampled for the same input, and combines terminal evaluation with return-to-go derived from stepwise quality changes. Experiments on synthetic composite-degradation and real-world multi-task benchmarks show improvements over the evaluated all-in-one baselines and restoration quality competitive with multi-model agents. PrismRestore achieves these results with a single restoration backbone and faster inference than the evaluated agentic baselines.

AI.tldr: PrismRestore用单个冻结的all-in-one修复模型通过通道分组与任务先验调制构建可调用动作库，并用GRPO策略组合动作完成复合退化图像修复。
AI.motivation: Agentic图像修复需要组合多种操作，但往往要保存多个修复网络，参数与显存开销大。作者希望从单一共享模型内部挖掘任务相关但重叠的通道响应，从而以零额外骨干网络的方式导出可组合的"动作"。
AI.method: 离线任务先验搜索：利用激活与梯度统计将共享模型中响应剖面相似的通道分组，在非代表性通道上搜索任务特定的调制系数，代表性通道保持不变，得到先验库用于显式动作选择与组合。在线阶段用状态条件策略（GRPO）学习动作组合，其目标在同输入采样轨迹组内分别归一化保真度与感知反馈，并将终端评估与基于逐步质量变化的return-to-go结合。
AI.result: 在合成复合退化基准与真实世界多任务基准上，优于所评估的all-in-one基线，修复质量与多模型agent方法相当；仅用一个修复骨干，推理速度快于所评估的agentic基线。
AI.conclusion: 单一冻结模型中存在可被分组调制的任务先验通道结构，可支撑无需额外骨干或adapter的动作库与策略组合式修复，兼顾效率与质量。

title: Unified Law for Visual Tasks (The Four Laws of Computer Vision)
comment: Preview version (main paper only); This work began in December 2024. Project page at this https URL GitHub org at this https URL Hugging Face org at this https URL This is an empirical article that attempts to unify thousands of visual tasks through a single methodology. Patent pending (inventors: SF and DM)
summary: In this paper, we propose a Unified Law for Visual Tasks, which could be further divided into Four Laws of Computer Vision, with the goal of enabling a single framework or method to uniformly train on and perform nearly all visual tasks. Our starting point is an inspiration and hypothesis: if the world information is encoded into image, which we call World Snapshots, then image processing is world processing, and image generation is World Snapshot generation. Furthermore, if all visual and visualization tasks can be reformulated as generation tasks, then a unified method, World Snapshot Models (WSMs), can perform the vast majority of visual tasks, much as large language models have largely unified natural language processing. This paper validates these laws across more than 1,000 trained and evaluated visual tasks (defined by distinct input-output mappings) and presents a unified training framework for future visual-task research and applications.

AI.tldr: 提出"视觉任务统一定律"（含计算机视觉四定律），假设世界信息被编码为图像（World Snapshots），若所有视觉任务可重构为生成任务，则统一的 World Snapshot Models (WSMs) 可像 LLM 统一 NLP 一样统一绝大多数视觉任务，并在 1000+ 视觉任务上验证。
AI.motivation: 视觉任务高度碎片化，缺乏类似大语言模型在自然语言处理中那样的通用统一框架；作者希望通过"图像即世界快照"的假设，将所有视觉与可视化任务统一为生成问题，从而用一个方法覆盖几乎所有视觉任务。
AI.method: 提出"视觉任务统一定律"并细化为计算机视觉四定律；核心假设为世界信息被编码进图像（World Snapshots），从而图像处理即世界处理、图像生成即世界快照生成；基于"所有视觉任务可重构为生成任务"的前提，设计统一的 World Snapshot Models (WSM)，以单一生成式训练框架覆盖多种输入-输出映射。摘要未给出模型架构、目标函数、数据规模或评测指标等具体技术细节。
AI.result: 在 1000+ 个已训练与评测的视觉任务（按不同输入-输出映射定义）上验证了所提出的定律，并据此提出一个面向未来视觉任务研究的统一训练框架。摘要未披露具体精度、对比基线或消融结果。
AI.conclusion: 论文主张视觉任务可被统一为生成范式，并给出跨千余任务的验证与统一训练框架，为视觉任务的统一化研究提供了概念与实证基础；但缺乏具体方法细节与定量证据，其"定律"级主张仍需更严格的实验支撑。

title: Render the Robot, Generate the World: One Video World Model Across Embodiments
summary: Predicting the consequences of an agent's actions requires modeling both the body's motion and the environment's response. Most video world models attempt to learn both from numerical actions, even though geometry and kinematics already specify the intended motion. We introduce Doppel, an embodiment-agnostic video world model conditioned on camera-aligned renderings of future body configurations and numerical action trajectories. By explicitly providing the intended motion, Doppel can focus on predicting object motion and interaction-driven changes in the environment. Rendered motion also provides a common visual interface across different embodiments and action spaces. To train on robot datasets without camera extrinsics, we recover camera poses and align rendered trajectories with recorded observations. We jointly train a single shared video backbone and conditioning adapter on eight datasets spanning eight robot and human embodiments, from single- and bimanual robot arms to a dexterous humanoid and human hands and bodies, using about 600 hours of video without embodiment labels. Across three robot-arm datasets, Doppel improves PSNR over action-only baselines by 1.00 dB on held-out trajectories and 1.20 dB under out-of-distribution evaluation, while predicting more consistent object motion. Training on all eight embodiments (Doppel-8) improves robot predictions over the three-robot model (Doppel-3) on four of six evaluation sets. Project page: this https URL .

AI.tldr: Doppel: 以"相机对齐的未来身体几何渲染 + 数值动作"为条件的 embodiment-agnostic 视频世界模型，用渲染轨迹统一不同具身的视觉接口，8 数据集联合训练提升机器人预测质量。
AI.motivation: 视频世界模型需同时建模本体运动与环境响应，但纯数值动作条件已隐含几何与运动学信息，迫使模型从零学"身体怎么动"，浪费容量且难以跨具身共享。作者希望显式提供意图运动，使模型专注预测物体运动与交互引起环境变化，并提供跨具身/跨动作空间的共同视觉接口。
AI.method: 条件于未来身体构型的相机对齐渲染 + 数值动作轨迹；对无外参机器人数据集恢复相机位姿并将渲染轨迹与观测对齐；八数据集（单臂、双臂、人形、人手人身的 8 种具身，约 600 小时视频，无具身标签）共享同一视频骨干 + 条件适配器联合训练。
AI.result: 三个机械臂数据集上较 action-only 基线 PSNR 提升 1.00 dB（held-out）与 1.20 dB（OOD），物体运动预测更一致；Doppel-8 在 6 个评测集中的 4 个优于 Doppel-3。
AI.conclusion: 用几何渲染作具身无关的运动接口是有效且可扩展的世界模型条件化方案，跨具身联合训练带来正迁移；不足在于仍为离线视频预测指标，缺少闭环控制验证与推理效率分析。

title: Grana: Compositional Reward Modeling for Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation
summary: Robot reward modeling faces two challenges: generalizing across tasks and accurately tracking progress in long-horizon manipulation. General-purpose reward models demonstrate broad task transfer, but transfer from short-task pretraining to long-horizon tasks remains underexplored. Long-horizon progress models often rely on task-specific subtask classifiers or fixed action vocabularies, limiting the reuse of learned progress knowledge when adapting to new tasks. To address these challenges, we introduce Grana, a vision-language robot reward model that learns to identify unfinished subtasks and estimate their continuous progress using open-vocabulary subtask descriptions. We train a language-conditioned model to estimate progress in short-horizon tasks and individual subtasks of long-horizon tasks. For long-horizon tasks, we combine the selected subtask's predicted progress with credit for preceding completed subtasks to estimate whole-task progress. General progress prediction requires training the model across diverse tasks with progress supervision that accounts for imperfect execution. Elapsed-time proxies can misrepresent progress when relative subtask durations vary, or failures reverse local progress. We therefore introduce an annotation protocol that converts sparse subtask boundaries and action-quality annotations into dense progress targets, without requiring annotators to assign numerical progress scores. Pretraining with this supervision on 200 diverse, mostly short-horizon manipulation tasks enables zero-shot reward prediction on unseen tasks and improves progress prediction after adaptation to multi-minute, long-horizon tasks. Experiments demonstrate (i) generalizable reward prediction, including adaptation to five long-horizon tasks, (ii) benefits from pretraining and composing subtask progress estimates, and (iii) improved downstream policy performance.

AI.tldr: Grana：开放词表的视觉-语言机器人奖励模型，用子任务描述估计未完成子任务及其连续进度，并用稀疏子任务边界+动作质量标注转换为稠密进度目标；200个多为短时任务的预训练带来零样本奖励预测与长时任务适配。
AI.motivation: 机器人奖励建模面临两大难题：跨任务泛化，以及在长时域操作中准确跟踪进度。通用奖励模型虽有一定迁移能力，但从短任务预训练迁移到长时域任务尚属空白；现有长时域进度模型依赖任务专用子任务分类器或固定动作词表，难以复用已学进度知识。
AI.method: 提出Grana，语言条件的视觉-语言奖励模型，以开放词面子任务描述识别当前未完成子任务并估计其连续进度；短时任务与长时任务子任务统一训练。长时任务中，将选中子任务预测进度与已完成前序子任务的信用分组合，得到整体进度。训练监督来自新标注协议：将稀疏子任务边界与动作质量标注转换为稠密进度目标，无需人工打分，并考虑执行不完美（失败导致局部进度回退、子任务时长不均），替代易失真的时间代理。
AI.result: 在200个多样（多为短时域）操作任务上以此监督预训练，可实现未见任务的零样本奖励预测，并在适配后提升多分钟长时域任务的进度预测。实验显示：(i) 可泛化的奖励预测，包括适配五个长时域任务；(ii) 预训练与子任务进度组合均带来增益；(iii) 下游策略性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 开放词表子任务级进度建模加可扩展标注协议，是获得可迁移机器人奖励/进度模型的有效途径，为长时域操作的下游策略学习提供通用奖励信号。

title: Phoenix: Learning Scene Structure Representations for Generalizable World-Action Models
summary: World-action models jointly predict future observations and actions, yet reconstruction-oriented visual representations do not explicitly emphasize the spatial relationships and object-state changes needed for manipulation. We introduce Phoenix, which learns representations of scene structure for world-action modeling. Specifically, Phoenix Encoder enriches DINOv3's general visual semantics through dual-teacher distillation of geometric and spatiotemporal semantic knowledge. Next, CS-VAE causally aggregates and compresses Phoenix Encoder features into generative latents while preserving scene information and spatial layout. Finally, Phoenix jointly predicts these latents, complementary appearance latents, and robot actions, linking scene evolution with action generation. To study pretraining data efficiency, we curate approximately 39,000 hours of egocentric and robot manipulation data for representation learning and use the robot demonstration subset for WAM pretraining. Following benchmark-specific post-training, Phoenix achieves state-of-the-art performance across simulation and real-robot benchmarks spanning single-arm, bimanual, and dexterous manipulation. It demonstrates strong robustness to perturbations, achieving success rates of 94.8% on LIBERO-Plus and 72.4% on RoboTwin 2.0 C2R, alongside strong cross-embodiment transfer and real-world manipulation performance on Bench2Dex and RoboDojo-RealWorld, respectively. Pretraining-scale analysis shows larger performance gains from data scaling than a video-VAE-only baseline, indicating stronger scaling benefits and more effective data utilization. Moreover, Phoenix maintains high success rates when adapted with limited downstream demonstrations, demonstrating strong few-shot adaptation. Our code, pretraining data, and models are available on the project page to help the community reproduce our results.

AI.tldr: Phoenix 提出一种面向世界-动作模型（WAM）的场景结构表征：用双教师蒸馏（几何+时空语义）增强 DINOv3 得到 Phoenix Encoder，再用 CS-VAE 因果聚合压缩为生成潜变量，并与外观潜变量、机器人动作联合预测；在 LIBERO-Plus 达 94.8%、RoboTwin 2.0 C2R 达 72.4%，并具强跨具身与少样本适应能力。
AI.motivation: 重建导向的视觉表征未显式强调操作所需的空间关系与物体状态变化，限制世界-动作模型在操作任务上的效果。
AI.method: Phoenix Encoder 通过双教师蒸馏将几何与时空语义知识注入 DINOv3；CS-VAE 因果聚合并压缩特征为保留场景信息与空间布局的生成潜变量；最终联合预测该潜变量、互补外观潜变量与机器人动作。使用约 39,000 小时第一视角与机器人操作数据进行表征学习，机器人示例子集用于 WAM 预训练。
AI.result: 仿真与真机基准（单臂、双臂、灵巧操作）取得 SOTA，LIBERO-Plus 94.8%、RoboTwin 2.0 C2R 72.4%，对扰动鲁棒；跨具身迁移与 Bench2Dex、RoboDojo-RealWorld 真机表现良好；数据缩放收益优于仅用 video-VAE 的基线；少样本下游适配保持高成功率。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模场景结构与空间布局的表征更适合世界-动作建模，且具备更好的数据缩放效率与少样本适配性；代码、预训练数据与模型已开放。

title: $Z$-sight: Unifying Vision-Language-Action and Latent World Modeling
summary: We introduce $Z$-sight, a unified robot foundation model that couples vision-language-action (VLA) and generative latent world modeling. Video-based world action models (WAMs) show the value of joint future-and-action generation for control, yet inherit the heavy cost of video generators. Recent latent-space policies avoid pixel generation, yet typically align intermediate features or rely on frozen target encoders, decoupling future prediction from the VLM's native feature space. $Z$-sight instead predicts the future directly in the visual token space in which its VLM perceives the present. Coupling a foresight expert and a continuous action expert with the VLM in a mixture-of-transformers, $Z$-sight jointly denoises future spatial tokens and actions at inference without pixel reconstruction or external encoders. Trained on human video and robot trajectories, $Z$-sight achieves 81.9% success on SIMPLE (+9.6 points over the strongest baseline) and 73.3% across six Unitree G1 tasks (+20.0 points) at 110 ms per chunk, while remaining competitive on tabletop benchmarks.

AI.tldr: Z-sight 将 VLA 与生成式潜空间世界模型统一：直接在 VLM 的视觉 token 空间预测未来，用 Mixture-of-Transformers 耦合预见专家与连续动作专家，推理时联合去噪未来空间 token 与动作，无需像素重建或外部编码器。
AI.motivation: 视频式世界动作模型（WAM）证明联合生成未来与动作对控制有价值，但继承了视频生成器的高昂成本；现有潜空间策略转而对齐中间特征或依赖冻结目标编码器，使未来预测与 VLM 原生特征空间解耦。
AI.method: 以 VLM 感知当下的同一视觉 token 空间作为未来预测空间；Mixture-of-Transformers 架构整合预见专家（foresight expert）、连续动作专家与 VLM；训练数据为人类视频与机器人轨迹；推理时对���来空间 token 与动作联合去噪，无像素解码。
AI.result: SIMPLE 基准成功率 81.9%（较最强基线 +9.6 点）；Unitree G1 六项任务平均 73.3%（+20.0 点）；每 chunk 推理 110 ms；在桌面操作基准上保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 在 VLM 原生视觉 token 空间做世界建模可兼顾未来预测能力与推理效率，为统一 VLA + 潜空间世界模型提供了简洁且可部署的范式，人形机器人与高动态任务收益尤为显著。

title: UltraTex: Aligning Physical Knowledge for High-Fidelity PBR Texture Generation
comment: Accepted to ACM Transactions on Graphics (SIGGRAPH Asia 2026). Project page: this https URL
summary: Generating physically based rendering (PBR) texture maps for a 3D mesh from a single reference image is highly ambiguous, as the observed appearance entangles material identity, surface reflectance, and illumination. While current generative methods produce realistic albedo maps, they still struggle to infer accurate metallic and roughness attributes for relighting. We present UltraTex, a cascaded multi-view framework that moves beyond appearance matching by integrating physical knowledge into multi-view diffusion-based PBR generation. UltraTex first jointly predicts albedo and world-space shading normals to generate more detailed albedo maps, and then predicts metallic-roughness (MR) maps conditioned on the generated albedo, reference image, and material semantic priors. To inject material semantics, a lightweight adapter transforms hidden-layer features of a vision-language model (VLM) into intrinsic material representation tokens, providing part-level knowledge anchors for MR estimation. To model material-light interaction, photometric representation alignment guides intermediate diffusion features toward ground-truth material renderings under controlled lighting. This makes metallic and roughness variations observable through highlight intensity, specular sharpness, and local reflectance contrast, providing stronger guidance for fine-grained material prediction without explicit lighting supervision. Extensive experiments show that UltraTex generates high-quality textures and outperforms existing open-source and commercial methods in visual fidelity, material accuracy, and physical plausibility.

AI.tldr: UltraTex是一个级联多视角扩散框架，从单张参考图像为3D网格生成高质量PBR贴图（albedo与metal-roughness），通过VLM特征适配器注入材质语义，并以光度表示对齐强化材质-光照交互建模。
AI.motivation: 单图生成PBR贴图高度歧义，观测外观耦合了材质身份、表面反射率与光照；现有生成方法虽能产生逼真albedo，但难以推断准确的metallic与roughness属性，导致重光照效果不可靠。
AI.method: 提出级联多视角框架：(1) 联合预测albedo与世界空间着色法线，提升albedo细节；(2) 以生成的albedo、参考图及材质语义先验为条件预测MR图。语义注入方面，用轻量adapter将VLM隐藏层特征转换为固有材质表示token，提供部件级知识锚点；物理建模方面，采用光度表示对齐，将扩散中间特征向受控光照下的GT材质渲染结果对齐，使highlight强度、高光锐度与局部反射对比度成为材质可观测线索，无需显式光照监督。
AI.result: 大量实验表明UltraTex能生成高质量贴图，在视觉保真度、材质准确性与物理合理性上优于现有开源及商业方法。
AI.conclusion: 将物理知识（VLM材质语义先验+光度对齐）显式融入多视角扩散，是突破外观匹配、实现可重光照PBR材质推测的有效路径。
